text: Ukukhula kwezinhlelo zokusebenza zokufunda izilimi Ngiyaziwa ngoSipho Mthembu, umfundisi wezilimi oneminyaka engu-10 yokuhlangenwe nakho. Ngikhule emndenini owawukhuthaza ukufunda izilimi ezahlukene, okwenza ngaba nomdlandla wokuhlola izindlela ezintsha zokufunda. Ngonyaka ka-2015, ngathola ithuba lokusebenzisa izinhlelo zokusebenza zokufunda izilimi, futhi lokhu kwashintsha impilo yami. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, ngiqaphele ukuthi izinhlelo zokusebenza ezifana ne-Duolingo, Babbel, kanye ne-Memrise zikhula ngokushesha. Lezi zinhlelo zenza ukufunda kube mnandi futhi kube lula, zisebenzisa izindlela ezihlukahlukene ezifana nemidlalo, izivivinyo, nezifundo ezimfushane. Lokhu kwenza abafundi bakwazi ukufunda izilimi ezintsha noma ngabe bahlala kuphi, ngisho nasemsebenzini. Ngiyavuma ukuthi izinhlelo zokusebenza zikhuthaza abantu abaningi ukuba baqale ukufunda izilimi, ikakhulukazi abasha. Ngithokozisa kakhulu ukuthi lezi zinhlelo zenza ukufunda kube yinto ethokozisayo, futhi zikhuthaza abantu ukuba baqhubeke bezama. Ngiyabonga ukuthi izinhlelo zokusebenza zokufunda izilimi zikhona, ngoba zenza kube lula ukufinyelela ulwazi olusha, futhi zikhuthaza ubudlelwano phakathi kwabantu abavela ezizindeni ezahlukene. Ngiyazi ukuthi ikusasa lokufunda izilimi lizoba lihle kakhulu, futhi ngiyajabula ukuba yingxenye yalo mkhankaso.

Izinguquko endleleni abantu abasebenzisa amabhange edijithali ziqale ngesikhathi sokukhula kobuchwepheshe besimanje. Ngasekupheleni kweminyaka yama-1990, amabhange aqala ukuhlinzeka ngesevisi ye-inthanethi, okuvumela abantu ukuba benze izimali zabo ngaphandle kokuvakashela emabhange. Lokhu kwaba yisinyathelo esikhulu, njengoba kwavula amathuba amasha kubantu abaningi, ikakhulukazi labo abahlala ezindaweni ezikude. Ngonyaka ka-2000, ukwamukelwa kwekhompyutha ezindlini kwandisa ukufinyelela kumasevisi ezokuxhumana. Lokhu kwaholela ekwandeni kokusebenzisa amabhange edijithali, lapho abantu beqala ukusebenzisa ama-ATM, izinhlelo zokusebenza, kanye nezinsizakalo ze-inthanethi ukuze baphathe izimali zabo. Lezi zinguquko zenza kube lula ukuhamba kwemali, ukugcina izikhwama, nokwenza izinkokhelo. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, ubuchwepheshe bukhula kakhulu. Ngeminyaka yama-2010, izinkampani eziningi ziqala ukuhlinzeka ngesevisi yokukhokha ngefoni, okwenze kube lula ukuhlela izinkokhelo. Lokhu kwazisa abantu abaningi ngendlela entsha yokuphila, lapho ukusebenzisa amakhadi noma imali cash sekuyinto engajwayelekile. Namuhla, amabhange edijithali asebenza ngendlela ehluke kakhulu kunakuqala. Abantu bangasebenzisa izinhlelo zokusebenza ezihlukahlukene ukuze baqaphe izimali zabo, benze izinkokhelo, futhi bathole izinsiza eziningi ngaphandle kokuphuma emakhaya. Lezi zinguquko zikhombisa ukuthi ubuchwepheshe buhlale bujabulisa, futhi buphinde buphucule impilo yabantu emhlabeni jikelele. Ngakho-ke, izinguquko endleleni abantu abasebenzisa ngayo amabhange edijithali zikhombisa intuthuko esiyifinyelele ekwakheni ikusasa elikhanyayo nezinsizakalo ezithuthukile.

UHlabisa kulindeleke amemezele usuku lokhetho ngaphambi kokuphela kukaJuni. Ukhetho kulindeleke ukuthi lube ngoNovemba noma uJanuwari.UNksz Dawn Mbatha, isikhulu esibhekele imali kwikhomishini, uthe banesabelomali sika-R4.75 billion kulo nyakamali.Uthe bayaxoxa noMnyango kaMgcinimafa ngemali njengoba kubhekwe okhethweni. UMamabolo uthe baqinisa izinhlelo zabo ukuze kungabi nezikhalo ngemiphumela yokhetho. "Sizowamema namaqembu ezepolitiki ukuthi alethe abacwaningi abazobheka uhlelo lwemiphumela esilusebenzisayo ukuze kungabi nezikhalo. Kwaba nezikhalo okhethweni lwango-2024 ngezinkinga ezithinta ibhodi eliveza imiphumela yokhetho," usho kanje.Lezi zinselelo zakhalisa amaqembu amaningi. Kwakucima ibhodi isikhathi eside. Kwenzeka lokhu nje iMKP ifuna luhlehliswe ukhetho oluzayo, ikhala ngokuthi kumele lubanjwe uma sekuxazululwe isikhalo eyasifaka mayelana nemiphumela yokhetho lwango-2024.I-IEC yazichitha izikhalo zeMKP kanti leli cala elafakwa yileli qembu kulindeleke ukuthi liqulwe eNkantolo yezoKhetho ngenyanga ezayo. Umholi weMKP, uMnuz Jacob Zuma, uthe ukugijimela ukuba nolunye ukhetho ekubeni singakaphumi isinqumo ecaleni abalifakile kuzokwenza ukuthi abantu bangayithembi imiphumela yokhetho. "Kufanele sibatshele ukuthi sifuna ukwazi ukuthi ashonaphi amavoti ethu antshontshwa okhethweni olwedlule. Asibatshele ukuthi asifuni ukuthi kube khona olunye ukhetho ngoba kunezinkinga abangakazixazululi," kusho uZuma.

Ukuhlaziywa komkhakha wezincwadi ezilalelwayo (audiobooks) Umkhakha wezincwadi ezilalelwayo, owaziwa nangokuthi ama-audiobooks, ubonisa ukukhula okusheshayo emhlabeni wonke, uhlanganisa ubuchwepheshe besimanje nezidingo zabafundi. Le nhloso yokuhlaziya izobheka izinzuzo, izinselelo, kanye nomthelela walolu hlobo lwezincwadi emphakathini. Okokuqala, izincwadi ezilalelwayo zikhuthaza abantu abaningi ukuba bafunde, ikakhulukazi labo abangenayo isikhathi sokufunda izincwadi ezibhalwe phansi. Lokhu kubalulekile, njengoba lezi zincwadi zenza kube lula ukufinyelela kolwazi, zikhuthaza umqondo wokufunda, futhi zandisa imikhuba yokufunda phakathi kwezizukulwane ezahlukene. Ngaphezu kwalokho, zenza kube nokwenzeka kwabantu abakhubazekile, ikakhulukazi labo abanezinkinga zokubona, ukufinyelela ezincwadini. Nokho, umkhakha wezincwadi ezilalelwayo ubhekene nezinselelo ezithile. Ukuze kube nokwamukelwa okuhle, kudingeka izinga eliphezulu lokukhiqiza, okuhlanganisa izwi elihle, ukuhlela kahle, kanye nezithombe ezihambisanayo. Lokhu kudinga izinsiza ezinkulu, okwenza kube nzima kubabhali abancane nabakhiqizi. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukuncintisana phakathi kwezinkampani ezikhiqiza izincwadi ezilalelwayo kudala umphumela wokwehlisa izindleko, okungaholela ekwehleni kwekhwalithi. Ekugcineni, umkhakha wezincwadi ezilalelwayo ubonisa ukukhula okukhulu, futhi unomthelela omuhle ekufundeni nasekuthuthukiseni ulwazi. Nokho, ukuze uqhubeke nokukhula, abahlinzeki kumele baqinisekise ikhwalithi, baphendule izidingo zabafundi, futhi bahlaziye izinselelo ezikhona. Lokhu kuzokwenza ukuthi izincwadi ezilalelwayo zibe yinsiza ebalulekile emhlabeni wezincwadi.

UMENGAMELI webandla ama-Afrika, ubonge wanconcoza kumalungu aleli bandla ngokuzikhandla enze konke okusemandleni ngenhloso yokuqinisekisa ukuthi ibandla liba nezakhiwo ezisezingeni elihle. UMfu Nkosinathi Hlomuka onguMengameli waleli bandla uncome amakholwa enkonzweni yakamuva ebiseMtshezi.Uveze ukuthi minyaka yonke baye benze isiqiniseko sokuthi sikhona isakhiwo esiqedwayo ngoba bafuna ukuthi leli bandla libe nezindawo zokukhonzela kuyona yonke indawo.Uthe naye uqhubeka emsebenzini omuhle owaqalwa abanye omengameli bangaphambili abake balihola ibandla. ''Uma uzothula ubheke kahle uzobona ukuthi mkhulu kangakanani umsebenzi nabanye omengameli abangaphambi kwami abawenzile uma kukhulunywa ngodaba lokwakhiwa kwezakhiwo zebandla,'' usho kanje.Eqhuba uthe zikhona nezinye izakhiwo abasematasa nazo ngoba "alikho iSekethe okumele kukhulunywe indaba yokuthi liswele indawo yokukhonzela kumbe likhonzela ezikoleni".Echaza, uthe yonke le misebenzi yinto esuka kudala kumsunguli webandla lama-Afrika, ongasekho uMfu Gadner Mvuyane owayeyala amalungu ewatshela ukuthi awazenzele izinto. ''Okujabulisayo wukuthi konke asitshela khona kubonakala kusahamba kahle kuze kube yimanje," usho kanje.

Ukusetshenziswa kwezimali zedijithali (cryptocurrency) emabhizinisini amancane Ngiyaziwa ngokuthi nguSipho Mthembu, umnikazi wephrojekthi encane yokuthengisa izimpahla ezikhethekile eThekwini. Njengomuntu onothando lwezobuchwepheshe, ngithole ithuba lokusebenzisa imali zedijithali ukuze ngithuthukise ibhizinisi lami. Ngonyaka odlule, ngathola ukuthi izimali zedijithali, njenge-Bitcoin ne-Ethereum, zingaba yinsiza enkulu ekwandiseni ukuthengisa kwami. Ngokusebenzisa i-cryptocurrency, ngikwazile ukuhlinzeka ngemikhiqizo yami kubathengi abavela emhlabeni wonke ngaphandle kwezithiyo ezinkulu. Lokhu kwenze kube lula ukuhweba, njengoba izinkokhelo zenzeka ngokushesha futhi ngaphandle kwezindleko eziphezulu ezivamile kumabhange. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukuthola izinkokhelo ngezimali zedijithali kwandise ukuvikeleka, njengoba izinkokhelo zikhona emkhakheni we-blockchain, okwenza kube nzima ukuhweba ngenkohliso. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, ngithole ukuthi abathengi bami bahlala bejabule kakhulu uma benikela ngezimali zedijithali. Lokhu kudalile ubudlelwano obuhle phakathi kwami nabathengi, futhi ngithole ukuthi abanye baphinde babuyela ukuze bathenge futhi. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ngithole ithuba lokukhulisa ibhizinisi lami, ngithola izinzuzo ezinkulu ezivela ekusebenziseni lezi zimali. Ngokubona impumelelo yami, ngikhuthaza abanye abanikazi bamabhizinisi amancane ukuthi bacabangele ukusebenzisa izimali zedijithali. Lokhu akusizi kuphela ekwandiseni ibhizinisi, kodwa futhi kukhuthaza ubuchwepheshe obusha nokuhweba okukhululekile. Ngiyazi ukuthi ikusasa lezezimali liseduze, futhi ngizimisele ukuba yingxenye yalo.

Ukukhula kwezinhlelo zokusebenza zokufunda izilimi kuyinto ebalulekile emkhakheni wezobuchwepheshe kulezi zinsuku. Izinhlelo ezifana ne-Duolingo, Babbel, ne-Rosetta Stone zishintshe indlela abantu abafunda ngayo izilimi. Nokho, lesi sikhula sihamba nezinkinga ezidinga ukugxilwe kuzo. Ngempela, izinhlelo zokusebenza zokufunda izilimi zenza ukufunda kube lula, kube nephumelelayo, futhi kube mnandi. Zihlinzeka ngezifundo ezihlanganisa ukuphindaphinda, ukuhlela, nokuqhathanisa, okwenza abafundi bakwazi ukufunda izilimi ezintsha noma baqinise ulwazi lwabo ngempumelelo. Lokhu kusebenza kahle kulabo abaphila izimpilo ezinzima, abangenamathuba okuxhumana, noma abathanda ukufunda izilimi emakhaya. Kodwa-ke, kukhona impikiswano ethile mayelana nokwenzeka kwalezi zinhlelo. Abanye abantu bakholelwa ukuthi zikhawulelwe uma kuziwa ekuxhumaneni nomphakathi. Isibonelo, ukufunda isiNgisi kudinga ukuxhumana ngqo ukuze uqinisekise ikhono lokukhuluma kahle. Ukuze lokhu kuzuze, abafundi badinga ukuhlangana nabantu abakhuluma kahle izilimi, okungatholakali kalula ezinhlelweni zokusebenza. Ngaphezu kwalokho, kubalulekile ukuqaphela izikhala zobuchwepheshe ezisemkhakheni wezemfundo. Abafundi abangenayo inthanethi bangase bazizwe bengaphumeleli ekufundeni kahle izilimi abahlela ukuzifunda. Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukuthuthukisa izinhlelo zokusebenza ezihambisana nezidingo zomphakathi. Ekugcineni, ukuphucula izinhlelo zokusebenza zokufunda izilimi kudinga ukugxila emithini yokuhlangenwe nakho kwabafundi, kanti kufanele kube nomqondo ohlanganyelwe nezifiso zomphakathi. Lokhu kuzokwenza ukufunda izilimi kube lula futhi kujabulise, futhi kuzothuthukisa amathuba okukhuluma ngempumelelo.

Ukukhula komkhakha wezokudlala imidlalo yamavidiyo eNingizimu Afrika kuxhumene kakhulu nokuthuthuka kwezobuchwepheshe, izinguquko zamasiko, kanye nezinselelo ezithile. Ngemuva kweminyaka yama-1990, umkhakha wezokudlala imidlalo yamavidiyo waqala ukuzwakala, kodwa wathuthukiswa kakhulu ngemuva kokwethulwa kwemishini yokudlala ye-inthanethi kanye ne-computer. Ngalesi sikhathi, imidlalo yamavidiyo yayivame ukuvela ezinkampanini ezinkulu eziphuma phesheya, kanti abantu abaningi eNingizimu Afrika babengenakho ukufinyelela kulokhu. Nokho, ngo-1999, kwenzeka umcimbi obalulekile lapho umnotho waseNingizimu Afrika wavulwa emakethe ye-video game, okwakuhlanganisa ukusungulwa kwe-PlayStation. Lokhu kuholele ekwandeni kwezinto eziningi, kuhlanganise nokusungulwa kwezinkampani ezincane ezikhiqiza imidlalo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, phakathi kweminyaka yama-2000, abadlali baqala ukusebenzisa izinsiza ze-inthanethi ezifana nama-forums nezinkundla zokuxhumana, okwandisa ukuxhumana phakathi kwabantu abathanda imidlalo. Lokhu kwaholela ekwande kokukhiqizwa kwemidlalo eNingizimu Afrika, futhi kwakha umqondo wokuthokozisa udlalayo. Namuhla, umkhakha wezokudlala imidlalo yamavidiyo eNingizimu Afrika ubonisa uthando olukhulu, futhi uqhubeka uzama ukuthuthukisa izixazululo ezihamba phambili. Abadlali basadlala indima ebalulekile ekwakheni ubuntu, futhi izinkampani zifunda ukusebenzisa izinsiza ezitholakalayo ukuze zifeze izidingo zabathandi bemidlalo. Lokhu kubonisa ukuthi umkhakha uzokhula kakhulu eminyakeni ezayo, ubeka eNingizimu Afrika endaweni ebalulekile emkhakheni wezokudlala imidlalo yamavidiyo.

Ukusetshenziswa kwama-drone kwezolimo zanamuhla Ngokwanda kwezobuchwepheshe, ama-drone asebenzisa izindlela ezintsha zokuphucula ukukhiqizwa kwezolimo. Izinsuku zanamuhla zibonisa ukuthi ama-drone ayingxenye ebalulekile yokuphathwa kwezolimo, okwenza kube lula ukuhlinzeka ngezinsiza ezidingekayo ukuze kukhule izitshalo. Ama-drone asetshenziswa kakhulu ekuboniseni izimo zezindawo zokulima. Ngokusebenzisa ama-camera aphezulu, abalimi bangathola izithombe ezicacile zomhlaba wabo, bakwazi ukubona izindawo ezidinga ukunakekelwa ngokushesha. Lokhu kusiza ekutholeni izinkinga ezifana nezifo ezithathelwana ezitshalo, ukungabi namanzi, noma ukungabi khona kwezinsiza ezidingekayo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ama-drone angasiza ekuphakamiseni izinga lokukhiqiza. Abalimi bangasebenzisa ama-drone ukuhlinzeka ngamakhemikhali, amanzi, noma izithako zokudla ezidingekayo ezitshalo, okwenza kube lula futhi kusheshe. Lokhu kuholela ekunciphiseni izindleko zokusebenza, njengoba abalimi bengasadingi ukusebenzisa izindlela ezijwayelekile ezithatha isikhathi eside. Ukwengeza, ama-drone anikeza ithuba lokuhlola izitshalo ngezikhathi ezithile, okwenza kube lula ukuhlela izinyathelo zokulima. Lokhu kubalulekile ekwenzeni izinqumo eziphusile mayelana nezinsiza ezidingekayo, okugcina umkhiqizo uphumelele. Ngokubambisana nezobuchwepheshe, ama-drone akhombisa ukuthi angaba yinsiza ebalulekile kwezolimo, okwenza kube lula ukuhlinzeka ngezinsiza ezidingekayo ukuze kukhule umkhiqizo. Lokhu kubonisa ukuthi ikusasa lezolimo lihlala lishintsha, futhi ama-drone azoba yingxenye ebalulekile yalesi sikhathi esisha.

Ngesikhathi esithile, uSipho wayehlala edolobheni elincane, lapho abantu babebonana khona bexoxa ngolimi lwabo lwesintu. Nokho, uSipho wayenombono omkhulu: wayefisa ukufunda izilimi eziningi ukuze akwazi ukuhamba emhlabeni. Kodwa, wayebhekene nezithiyo zokuntuleka kwezinsiza zokufunda. Omunye usuku, uSipho wathola uhlelo lokusebenza olusha lokufunda izilimi. Lolu hlelo lwakha izifundo ezahlukahlukene, luhlanganisa imidlalo, izivivinyo, nezifundo ezithokozisayo. Waqala ukusebenzisa leli hlelo nsuku zonke, futhi ngokushesha waqaphela ukuthi ukufunda izilimi akukhona nje ukuhamba phambili, kodwa kuyajabulisa futhi kuyakhuthaza. Njengoba edlula ezifundweni, uSipho waqala ukufunda isiNgisi, isiFulentshi, nesiJalimane. Uhlelo lwalunikeza ithuba lokuxhumana nabanye abafundi emhlabeni jikelele, okwenza uSipho azizwe engakaze abone. Waqala ukuxoxa nabantu abavela emazweni ahlukene, efunda ngamasiko abo, izindlela zabo zokuphila, nezinkolelo zabo. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, uSipho waba nekhono lokukhuluma izilimi eziningi, futhi lokhu kwavula amathuba amasha empilweni yakhe. Waqala ukuhamba, efunda izilimi ezithile ezindaweni ezahlukene, futhi wathola abangane abaningi. Uhlelo lokusebenza lwamfundisa ukuthi ukufunda izilimi akugcini nje ngokufunda amagama, kodwa kuyindlela yokuxhumana nabantu, ukwakha ubudlelwano, nokuhlonipha amasiko ahlukene. U-Sipho wathola ukuthi ukukhula kwezinhlelo zokusebenza zokufunda izilimi akukhona nje ukwanda kwezobuchwepheshe, kodwa kuyindlela yokwakha umhlaba onobudlelwano obukhulu, lapho abantu bexhumana khona ngaphandle kwemingcele yolimi. Lokhu kwashintsha impilo yakhe, futhi waba isibonelo sokuthi ukufunda izilimi kungaba yindlela yokuphila enothando.

"Umgilwa usheshe wathatha isibhamu sakhe, wadubula ebhekise kubasolwa, abaphunyule babaleka. Umufi ubaleka nje, udubulekile,” kusho uNetshiunda.Uthe amaphoyisa alwa nobugebengu obusemngceleni azwe ukuthi kunesidumbu esingcwatshwe ngendlela engafanele eMgodiwemvubu ngeSonto. "Amaphoyisa athole ukuthi leso sidumbu ngesikaMalwane obedutshulwe esikhathini esingengakanani ngosuku olufanayo. Kuvele ukuthi singcwatshwe ngokuyimfihlo wumfowabo, uMnuz Musa Malwane, naye ofunelwa uxhaxha lwamacala okubulala nawobugebengu obusemngceleni,” kusho uNetshiunda. Uqinisekise ukuthi lezi zelamani zifunelwa necala lokubulawa kwenyanga edumile eManguzi, uJames 'God'olulala amankankane’ Mthembu. Uthe isidumbu sikamufi sigcine simbiwa ngokulandela uhlelo olufanele, kanti uphenyo lwamaphoyisa lusaqhubeka. Uthe nokucingwa kusaMusa nakho kusaqhubeka, wanxusa abangaba nolwazi ngokuthi uphi, bathinte amaphoyisa.

Indima yabasunguli bamabhizinisi obuchwepheshe (tech startups) emnothweni Eminyakeni edlule, amabhizinisi obuchwepheshe aphume phambili njengamafasitela amasha emnothweni, ethuthukisa izindlela zethu zokuphila, ezokuxhumana, kanye nezokusebenza. Njengomuntu ophila kulesi sikhathi esigcwele ubuchwepheshe, ngikholelwa ukuthi abasunguli bamabhizinisi obuchwepheshe banezifundo eziningi ezibalulekile emnothweni wethu. Okokuqala, lezi zinkampani zenza kube lula ukufinyelela kwezinsizakalo, okwandisa amathuba emisebenzi, futhi kukhuthaza ubuchwepheshe obusha. Lokhu kusebenza kahle kuphakathi kwezinga lemisebenzi lasekhaya, njengoba abantu abaningi beza nezixazululo ezintsha, beholela ekwandeni kwamathuba kubantu abaningi. Isibonelo, amabhizinisi afana nehlelo lokusebenza lokuhamba, awekho omkhulu uma kuziwa ekwandiseni ukuthengiswa kwempahla nezinsizakalo. Okwesibili, abasunguli bamabhizinisi obuchwepheshe banesibopho sokwakha umnotho owenziwe ngamasu amasha. Njengoba beqala amabhizinisi, bakhulisa impumelelo emnothweni, nciphisa umnotho wezomhlaba, futhi bathuthukisa ukuphishekela izixazululo ezintsha. Lokhu kuholela ezindleleni ezifanele zokunciphisa imiphumela emibi, okwenza umnotho wethu unothe kakhulu. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukunikela kwabo kubantu abangasebenzi ngokusemthethweni, kuveza ukuthi amalungu omphakathi angaba nemiphumela emihle ezinkampanini zabo, ukwakha isimo sokubambisana ngendlela eyakhayo. Kanti lokhu kudala umoya wokusebenza nalabo abasha, okwandisa ikhono lezakhamuzi ukujabulisa imiphakathi yethu. Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukuthi sixhase futhi sikhuthaze abasunguli bamabhizinisi obuchwepheshe. Njengoba besebenzisa ubuchwepheshe obusha, basungula amathuba amasha, futhi bakha umphakathi onempilo, siyakuthokozisa ukuhamba phambili emnothweni. Sihlanganyela kulolu hambo lokubambisana, futhi tilele ubuchwepheshe ngoba bukhona ukuzayo.

NgoMgqibelo ngizobe ngiKwaZulu-Natal, lapho sizoqoka khona ithimba elisha. Sivele sesibaqokile abaholi abaphezulu abazohola ithimba. "Ithimba ebelikhona belinabaholi abangaphezu kuka-60.Kulindeleke ukuthi abaningi badliwe yizembe njengoba uMbalula akuveza phambilini ukuthi bazolinciphisa ithimba.UMbalula wakhala nogokuthi ithimba ebelikhona liyahluleka ukwenza umsebenzi walo, lazi ukulwa izimpi zangaphakathi kuphela.Waze wafanisa ithimba nohlobo lwemoto i-Tazz.I-ANC isanda kumemezela izinguquko ebuholi obuphezulu bethimba elihola isifundazwe.Kulezi zinguquko kuqokwe uMnuz Mike Mabuyakhulu njengomdidiyeli, kwathi uMnuz James Nxumalo waqokwa njengomgqugquzeli.Kulezi zinguquko ezimenyezelwe uMbalula ngeledlule, abaholi abanohlonze okubalwa kubo, uMnuz Jeff Radebe, uNkk Nomusa Dube-Ncube, noNkk Weziwe Thusi, badliwe yizembe.UMbalula uveze ukuthi bazophinde baqoke amathimba azohola i-ANC ezifundeni. "NgoMsombuluko, ngeholidi, sizoqoka ubuholi bazo zonke izifunda ze-ANC KwaZulu-Natal.

Izinselelo zokuvikelwa kwedatha yomuntu siqu ezinkundleni zedijithali Namuhla, ubuchwepheshe bukhula ngokushesha, kodwa lokhu kuza nezinkinga eziningi, ikakhulukazi mayelana nokuvikelwa kwedatha yomuntu siqu. Izinkundla zedijithali, ezifana nezokuxhumana, zenza kube lula ukwabelana ngemininingwane, kodwa lezi zinsiza zithwele umthwalo omkhulu wokuvikela le mininingwane. Okokuqala, ukungavikeleki kwedatha kubalulekile. Izinkampani eziningi azinayo imithombo eyanele yokuvikela imininingwane yomsebenzisi. Lokhu kuholela ekutheni kube nezinsongo eziningi, ezifana nezokuhlasela kwe-cyber, lapho abahlaseli bethola khona ukufinyelela kalula kumakhasi e-inthanethi. Lokhu kudala ukungathembeki kubasebenzisi, okwenza kube nzima ukuvuma ukusebenzisa lezi zinsiza. Okwesibili, imithetho yokuvikela idatha iyashintsha njalo. Imithetho efana ne-General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) e-Europe ibeka izidingo ezinzima, kodwa ezindaweni eziningi, imithetho ayikabi khona noma ayiqinile. Lokhu kudala ubunzima ekuphatheni idatha, njengoba izinkampani zidinga ukuhamba phakathi kwemithetho ehlukahlukene, okungaholela ekutheni zingawuvikeli kahle umsebenzisi. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukungazi kahle kwabantu mayelana nezingozi zokwabelana ngemininingwane kuyinkinga enkulu. Abantu abaningi abazi kahle ukuthi imininingwane yabo ingasetshenziswa kanjani, futhi lokhu kubavulela amathuba okukhwabanisa. Ukukhulisa ukuqwashisa kubalulekile ukuze abantu bakwazi ukuvikela idatha yabo. Ekugcineni, nakuba izinkundla zedijithali zikhuthaza ukwabelana, kubalulekile ukuthi ziqhubele phambili izinqubomgomo ezicacile nezisebenzayo zokuvikela idatha yomuntu siqu. Ukuze sithole ikusasa elinempilo, kumele sikhulume ngalezi zinselelo futhi sizame ukuthola izixazululo ezisebenzayo. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuvikela imininingwane yethu, futhi sibe nokwaneliseka ekusebenziseni izinkundla zedijithali.

Ucwaningo ngokusetshenziswa kwezimoto ezizishayelayo emhlabeni Umbuzo 1: Yini imoto ezizishayelayo? Imoto ezizishayelayo, noma i-autonomous vehicle, iyimoto engadingi umshayeli ukuze ihambe. Lezi zimoto zisebenzisa ubuchwepheshe obuthuthukisiwe, njengezinhlelo ze-sensor, i-AI, kanye nezinhlelo zokuxhumana ukuze ziqonde imvelo yazo. Umbuzo 2: Ziyini izinzuzo zokusebenzisa izimoto ezizishayelayo? Izimoto ezizishayelayo zinezinto eziningi ezinhle. Zinciphisa amathuba okuphazamiseka emgwaqweni, zandisa ukuphepha, futhi zinciphisa izingozi. Futhi, zingasiza ekunciphiseni umoya ophumayo, njengoba zisebenza kahle kakhulu uma kuqhathaniswa nezimoto ezishayelayo. Umbuzo 3: Yiziphi izinselelo ezihambisana nokusetshenziswa kwezimoto ezizishayelayo? Kunezinkinga ezithile ezihambisana nalezi zimoto. Lokhu kufaka phakathi izinkinga zokuphepha, izinkinga zokuxhumana, kanye nezinkinga zomthetho. Abantu baphinde bakhathazeke ngokuqhubeka kokuncintisana emsebenzini, njengoba izimoto ezizishayelayo zingase zishintshe indlela abantu abasebenza ngayo. Umbuzo 4: Ucwaningo lukhombisa ukuthuthuka kanjani emhlabeni? Ucwaningo luveza ukuthi izimoto ezizishayelayo ziya zanda emhlabeni. Emazweni amaningi, izinhlelo zokuhlola nezokusebenza ziye zathuthukiswa, futhi izinkampani eziningi zisebenza ekwakheni lezi zimoto. Lokhu kubonisa ukuthi umhlaba ushintsha, futhi imoto ezizishayelayo ingase ibe yisixazululo esisha sokuhamba. Umbuzo 5: Yini ezayo mayelana nezimoto ezizishayelayo? Ngokuthuthuka kwezobuchwepheshe, kubonakala sengathi izimoto ezizishayelayo zizoba yingxenye ebalulekile yokuhamba emhlabeni. Kubalulekile ukuthi sibe nezinhlelo ezinhle zokulawula nokuphatha lezi zimoto ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuphepha nokusebenza kahle.

Ngesikahthi sesidlula eGateway wangitshela ukuthi imoto ngizoyifica ipake ngasegaraji eMega City,'' kuchaza yena.Eqhuba uthe wamtshela nokuthi uzohlangana nowesifazane omfishane, ompofu, ogqoke amateku amhlophe futhi ozobe ehamba nge-mercedes benz. "Wangitshela ukuthi loyo wumkakhe,'' kusho uKhumalo. ''Ngampela sengifikile kwaqhamuka le moto kwehla yena kanye lo muntu wesifazane engitshelwe ngaye. Ngambuza ukuthi ungubani wangiphendula ngokuthi angibuze lo muntu ongithumileyo,'' usho kanjena.Uthe bahamba nayo imoto baya KwaMaphumulo, ishayelwa uMzo ethole umyalelo wokuthi mayiyiswe emagcekeni akwaCele.Ngakusasa uthe wethuka uma ethi uyaphuma egcekeni lakwakhe ekhangwa yiCreta eSilver Grey phakathi kukhona uFaith kanye nodadewabo kaCele. ''Bangitshela ukuthi sebemtholile umuntu ozobashayelela imoto kumele iphindele emuva,'' kuchaza yena. Ebuzwa ngobudlelwane bakhe noMzo uthe wayekade emsebenzela kwakhe ekhanda izimoto kodwa wamxosha ngemuva kokuba entshontshe imoto yakhe. ''Kodwa wabuye waxolisa ngamvumela ukuba abuye ezosebenza,'' usho kanje.Ebuzwa ukuthi kukhona yini lapho benoCele noma uFaith abake babhunga ngetulo lokusoconga umufi uthe lutho. UCele sasixhunyaniswa wukuthi ungumakhelwane ethanda ukuthi ngimazise ngokuthi kwenzekani emndenini wakhe.

Ukuhlaziywa komkhakha wezokudlala amabhodi nemidlalo yokucabanga Q: Yini imidlalo yokucabanga? A: Imidlalo yokucabanga ibandakanya imidlalo edinga ukucabanga okujulile, ukuhlela, nokwenza izinqumo. Lokhu kufaka phakathi imidlalo efana neChess, Go, kanye neScrabble. Q: Yini eyenza imidlalo yokudlala amabhodi ibe nentshisekelo? A: Imidlalo yokudlala amabhodi inikeza ithuba lokuxhumana phakathi kwabantu, ikakhulukazi uma kudlalwa emaphakathini. Iphinde ibe nendlela yokuthuthukisa amakhono okucabanga, ukuhlela, nokuxhumana. Q: Yiziphi izinzuzo zokudlala imidlalo yokucabanga? A: Ziningi izinzuzo, kuhlanganise nokuthuthukisa amakhono okuxazulula izinkinga, ukwakha ubudlelwano, nokunciphisa ukucindezeleka. Imidlalo yokucabanga ingasiza ekuthuthukiseni umqondo, ikakhulukazi ezinganeni. Q: Kukhona yini izinselelo emkhakheni wezokudlala amabhodi? A: Yebo, kunezinselelo eziningi. Lokhu kufaka phakathi ukuncintisana okuqinile, izinguquko ezisheshayo ezimakethe, kanye nezidingo zokwakha imidlalo ethokozisayo nehluke. Abadali bemidlalo badinga ukuhlala bephambili ukuze bahlale benomthelela. Q: Yiziphi izitayela ezintsha ezivela emkhakheni? A: Kukhona ukwanda kokuhlanganiswa kwemidlalo yokudlala amabhodi nemidlalo yevidiyo, kanye nokusebenzisa ubuchwepheshe obufana ne-AR (Augmented Reality) ukuze kuthuthukiswe ulwazi lomsebenzisi. Lokhu kudala amathuba amasha kubadali bemidlalo. Q: Uthini umbono wakho ngekusasa lemidlalo yokucabanga? A: Ngibona ikusasa lemidlalo yokucabanga likhanya, njengoba abantu beqhubeka nokufuna izindlela zokuxhumana nokuzijabulisa. Imidlalo yokudlala amabhodi izohlala ibalulekile, ikakhulukazi emiphakathini.

Umthelela wezobuciko bedijithali emisebenzini yesimanje Ngokwanda kwezobuchwepheshe, ubuciko bedijithali buye baba nomthelela omkhulu emisebenzini yesimanje. Lokhu kubonakala kakhulu emikhakheni ehlukene, okuhlanganisa ubuciko, umculo, nezokuxhumana. Abaculi bamanje sebesebenzisa amathuluzi edijithali ukuze bakhe imisebenzi yabo, okwenza kube lula ukufinyelela kubabukeli abaningi. Uhlelo lwezobuciko bedijithali luhlanganisa izinhlelo zokusebenza ezithuthukisiwe, izithombe ezidijithali, nezinhlelo zokuhlela umculo. Lokhu kudala amathuba amasha kubaculi, njengoba besakwazi ukudala imisebenzi emisha ngaphandle kwezithiyo ezinkulu. UJohn Mthethwa, umculi odumile, uthe: “Ubuciko bedijithali buvule amathuba amaningi. Ngiyakwazi ukufinyelela kubalandeli bami emhlabeni jikelele ngempela.” Ngaphezu kwalokho, ubuciko bedijithali buye bukhuthaze ukuxhumana phakathi kwabaculi nabalandeli. Izinkundla zokuxhumana zibe yinsika ebalulekile ekwaziseni imisebenzi, futhi abaculi bangakwazi ukuthola impendulo ngqo kubabukeli babo. Lokhu kudala umuzwa wokubambisana, okwenza ubuciko bube nomthelela omkhulu emphakathini. Nokho, kukhona nezinselelo ezihambisana nokwanda kobuciko bedijithali. Abaculi badinga ukuqonda kahle izindlela zokuvikela imisebenzi yabo, njengoba ukweba kokuqukethwe sekuyinto evamile. Lokhu kudinga ukuthi abaculi babe neziqu ezithile kwezobuchwepheshe ukuze bakwazi ukuvikela imisebenzi yabo. Ngokubheka konke lokhu, umthelela wezobuciko bedijithali emisebenzini yesimanje ubonakala uqhubeka nokukhula, unikeza amathuba amasha, kodwa futhi ulethe nezinselelo ezidinga ukuxazululwa. Ubuciko bedijithali buyeza, futhi umhlaba ubheke phambili ekuboniseni imisebenzi emisha.

UMAKADEBONA kwezobuciko futhi oyisazi samasiko, uSolwazi Velaphi "VVO” Mkhize, usedalule ukuthi bekuhlale kuyisilonda kuyena ukubona kushabalala igama lezingqalabutho zobuciko, ezabamba iqhaza kuleli zwe ngezikhathi zobandlululo.UMkhize usho kanje exoxa neSolezwe ngencwadi eyiqoqo lezinkondlo zesiZulu ayihlelile esihloko sithi UMSAMO: Imfihlo Yempophoma: Kuthangi - Izolo - Nanamuhla, edidiyele izinkondlo eziwu-28 zowayeyisishoshovu sobuciko nembongi uBethuel Blose Ndelu, owayaziwa ngelikaNonkamfela - ongasekho emhlabeni. "Kumqoka ukuthi thina esisaphilayo kube wumsebenzi wethu ukuthi sizihluphe ngokuvumbulula imisebenzi emidala yobuciko bamaciko akithi angasekho emhlabeni, aze ashona ingayibonanga ilanga - bese siyididiyela futhi siyenze kabusha ukuze ibe wumthombo wolwazi ozohlale ukhona futhi ube wusizo esizukulwaneni esizayo,” usho kanje.Eqhuba, uthe kade afisa ukuhlanganisa imisebenzi yobuciko kaNonkamfela, kodwa kwangashesha ukwenzeka ngenxa yokuthi bekukuningi kakhulu obekumxinile okubalwa nemisebenzi yasemsakazweni Ukhozi FM neqondene naye yesintu. "Ngize nngaqala ukusebenzela kulo msebenzi ngoba yena uNonkamfela esefika amagemugemu kimina ngephupho, engikhumbuza ukwenza lo msebenzi - njengoba kuvele kuyinto esasiyikhulumile savumelana ukuthi ngisale ngimqedelela yona uma eshona engakayiqedi. Imisebenzi yakhe yobuciko eminingi ayenza ngezikhathi zobandlululo. "Kungithathe cishe iminyaka emithathu ukuqoqa cishe lonke ulwazi ngebengizokudinga ukudidiyela incwadi njengoba isizophuma iyilokhu esiyikhona manje.

Yazi, indima yemidlalo yendabuko empilweni yethu ibaluleke kakhulu. Noma sihamba phi, sithola imidlalo ethile edinga ukuba sidlale ndawonye, okwenza kube lula ukudala ubumbano. Ngokuyinhloko, imidlalo yendabuko akuyona nje indlela yokuzijabulisa; iyindlela ethokozisayo yokwakha ubudlelwano phakathi kwabantu. Ucabanga ncamashi, uma umphakathi udlala umdlalo wezok Traditional Dance, bonke abantu bejabula, beqhamuka emakhaya abo, bephuma abangane. Lobo buhlanti, loli suku lunokwandisa ubudlelwano, njengoba abantu bekhuluma, behlekisa, futhi besabelana ngezinkumbulo. Kungabukeka kancane, kodwa lezi zixhumanisi zenza ukuthi sibe nempilo engcono. Futhi akukhona nje ukudlalela, kodwa imidlalo yendabuko ifundisa izifundo ezibalulekile. Iziphakamiso, ukuxhumana, nokubambisana – konke lokhu kuza lapho sithokozisa emidlalweni. Ukubona umphakathi uphakamisa isiko elithile, lokho kudala umqondo wokuzithoba, umdlandla, futhi kubuye kube nomthelela omuhle ezimpilweni zethu. Ngakho, njengoba sithuthukisa imidlalo yendabuko, asithokozisi kuphela, kodwa futhi sihamba phambili ekwakheni umphakathi onobumbano. Uhlelo oluphumelelayo lungashiwo njengemidlalo esinse umoya, eyakhayo, futhi ezwakalayo. Ngokuqhubeka nalemidlalo, singaqhubeka sithokozisa futhi sakhe izixhumanisi ezinqala phakathi kwethu. Lokho kuyingxenye yesiko lethu, futhi kuyasiza ekwakheni eminye imidlalo ezayo. Ngabe unayo imidlalo ethile oyithandayo?

Ekhaya elisemaphandleni, lapho izintaba nezihlahla zikhangisa ubuhle bemvelo, kwaqhamuka umqondo omusha wezokuvakasha. UNomsa, intombazane encane ethokozisayo, yayikholelwa ekutheni umnotho wendawo ungathuthukiswa ngezokuvakasha zasemakhaya. Ngemva kokuphothula izifundo zakhe, wanquma ukuvula indawo yokwamukela izivakashi ezivela emadolobheni. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, uNomsa wakha ibhizinisi elincane lokwamukela izivakashi, elawulwa ngempela ngendaba yendawo. Waqala ukuhlela imicimbi yokuvakasha, efaka phakathi ezokuthuthukisa, ukufundisa izivakashi ngemigudu yokuphila kwasemakhaya, kanye nokwabelana ngemisebenzi yokukhonza, efana nezinsizakalo zokupheka ukudla kwasekhaya. Izivakashi zafika, zikhumbula izinsuku zabo ezinhle ezisemakhaya. Zazithokozisa ngezithombe ezinhle, zifunda ngezamasiko, futhi zaba nezinhloso zokuhamba zisebenzisana nezinhlangano zomphakathi. Lokhu kuvuselela umnotho wendawo; abanikazi bamabhizinisi basemakhaya baqala ukuthola imali, izisebenzi zanda, futhi umoya wokubambisana wawusuka phansi. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, umphakathi waba nempumelelo. UNomsa wabona ukuthi izokuvakasha zasemakhaya zingaholela ekuthuthukisweni komnotho, zixhumanisa abantu, zithuthukise izimboni, futhi ziqinise imiphakathi. Ngamafuphi, waphumelela kakhulu, futhi umphakathi wakhe waba isibonelo esihle sokuthi izokuvakasha zingaba nesandla esikhulu ekuthuthukiseni umnotho wendawo.

Umthelela wokwanda kwezindawo zokusebenza ezihlanganyelwayo (co-working spaces) Ngomhla ka-15 kuNcwaba 2023, sizoba nomcimbi obalulekile ophathelene nomthelela wokwanda kwezindawo zokusebenza ezihlanganyelwayo. Lo mcimbi uzobanjelwa eNyuvesi yaseThekwini, futhi uzohlanganisa abaculi, osomabhizinisi, nabafundi abavela ezikhungweni ezahlukene. Umgomo wethu uwukuhlola ukuthi izindawo zokusebenza ezihlanganyelwayo zishintsha kanjani indlela esisebenza ngayo, zikhuthaza ubuchwepheshe, futhi zixhumanisa abantu abanemibono efanayo. Izindawo zokusebenza ezihlanganyelwayo ziye zaba yinsika ebalulekile emhlabeni wezohwebo, zikhuthaza ukuxhumana phakathi kwabantu abavela emikhakheni ehlukene. Lo mcimbi uzohlinzeka ngendawo yokwabelana ngemicabango, lapho abathintekayo bengakwazi ukwabelana ngamasu, izifundo, nezindlela zokuphumelela. Sizoba nezinkulumo ezivela kubachwepheshe abanolwazi, kanye nezifundo ezithokozisayo ezizogxila ekuthuthukiseni amakhono okusebenza. Ngaphezu kwalokho, sizoba nezingxoxo ezivulekile, lapho abantu bengakwazi ukubuza imibuzo nokwabelana ngemicabango yabo. Lo mcimbi uzoba yithuba elihle lokwakha ubudlelwano obusha, nokuthola ukuqonda okujulile kokuthi izindawo zokusebenza ezihlanganyelwayo zingasiza kanjani ekuthuthukiseni imisebenzi yethu. Sicela ubhalise kusenesikhathi ukuze uqinisekise indawo yakho. Hamba nathi kulolu hambo lokuhlola umthelela omkhulu wezindawo zokusebenza ezihlanganyelwayo, futhi ube yingxenye yokwakha ikusasa eliqhakazile.

Ukusetshenziswa kwezimali zedijithali (cryptocurrency) emabhizinisini amancane Emhlabeni wamanje, imali zedijithali, noma i-cryptocurrency, ziye zathuthukisa indlela amabhizinisi amancane aphatha ngayo izimali. Lezi zimali zisetshenziswa njengendlela yokukhokha, ukuhweba, nokugcina imali. Kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi yini i-cryptocurrency nokuthi ingasiza kanjani amabhizinisi amancane. Okokuqala, i-cryptocurrency iyimali ethokozisayo edalwe ngezifundo ezinzima zezezimali nezobuchwepheshe, njengokusebenzisa ubuchwepheshe be-blockchain. Lokhu kuqinisekisa ukuthi ukuthengiselana kwenziwa ngendlela ephephile futhi engaguquki. Amabhizinisi amancane angazuza kakhulu ekwenzeni izinkokhelo ezikhawulelayo, ngoba akudingeki ukuba abhekane nezindleko eziphezulu zokuhambisa imali ngezindlela zendabuko. Okwesibili, ukusebenzisa i-cryptocurrency kulethe amathuba amasha okwandisa ukufinyelela kumakhasimende. Ngamakhono amaningi okuthenga online, abathengi bangakhetha ukukhokha nge-cryptocurrency, ngobuningi bakhona bukhula. Lokhu kukhuthaza umphakathi omusha wabathengi futhi kuvula iminyango emisha yokusebenza. Ngaphezu kwalokho, i-cryptocurrency iyindlela enhle yokuvikela imali emonakalisweni. Njengoba izimali zedijithali zingazitholi izinguquko ezinkulu njengezinga lemali lendabuko, amabhizinisi amancane angakwazi ukugcina inani lemali yabo. Lokhu kubaluleke kakhulu ezimakethe ezishintshashintshayo. Ekugcineni, amabhizinisi amancane angase afune ukufunda kabanzi ngalezi zimali ukuze akwazi ukuzisebenzisa ngendlela efanelekile. Ukuhlola izinzuzo nokuthi zingakwazi kanjani ukuhlinzeka ngamasu aphumelelayo kuzoqinisekisa ukuthi amabhizinisi azithokozisa kahle ngezimali zedijithali, ethuthukisa ukuncintisana kwawo emakethe.

UKUQOKWA kukaLiet General Puleng Dimpane njengebamba esikhundleni sokuba uKhomishana wamaPhoyisa kuZwelonke sekuqubule impikiswano ngokuthi ngabe ukufanele ngokuphelele yini ukumelana nokudingeka kulo msebenzi.ULiet General Dimpane umenyezelwe uMengameli Cyril Ramaphosa ngoLwesine, ukuthi usezobamba kulo msebenzi, ngenxa yokumiswa kobekuwona uLiet General Fannie Masemola.

SEKUZE kwejwayeleka ukuthi amaqembu ezepolitiki agqigqe eNdlunkulu kaZulu, eyokotha iSilo futhi lokhu kukhona okuthile okukuchazayo ngobudlelwano bepolitiki yamaqembu nobukhosi. Cishe wonke umuntu uyazi ukuthi osopolitiki uma kukhona into abayenzayo, basuke belele emqondweni othile wokuthi bahlomule amavoti.Kuyacaca ukuthi amaqembu lawa aqonda kabanzi ukuthi amandla obukhosi nokuthi uma ebonakala eduze kweSilo cishe lokhu kungakha isithombe esithile kubantu abangaphansi kwaso. Amahele lawa ayokotha iSilo, aqala ukwanda kakhulu manje njengoba kubhekwe okhethweni lukazwelonke oluzoba ngonyaka ozayo.Awafiki nje ngezandla kodwa asuke eqhuba imihlambi yezinkomo akhuleka ngazo kusona iSilo. Akugcini lapho, kuba nenimhlangano ebanjelwa esithe okugcina kungaziwanga ukuthi kuxoxwani kuyona. Okuqaphelekayo wukuthi wonke amaqembu akhuluma kahle ngeSilo kwabezindaba esho khona ukuthi siwuhlaka olubalulekile futhi ayaseseka.ISilo siphila ngomgomo wokuthi asihlangene naqembu lezepolitiki kodwa simukela wonke umuntu uma efisa ukusondela eyokotha ebukhosini. ISilo sikaZulu siphethe ubukhosi obukhulu, obudumile nobuhlonishwayo emhlabeni nokuchaza ukuthi kunezinkumbi zabantu abangaphansi kwaso. Ubukhosi bukaZulu budala kakhulu futhi budume ngamaqhawe aziwayo emlandweni.ISilo siphinde sengamele umhlaba omkhulu KwaZulu-Natal ngaphansi kwebhodi Ingonyama Trust ehlala isematheni nosopolitiki bephikisana ngayo ngakhulu.Into enkulu kosopolitiki wukucubuza amagabade kubantu bese bethola amavoti azobasondeza emandleni.

Kulabo abahlala ezindaweni zamakhosi njengakoLoskop, Lotheni, eMpendle, Nkandla naseMashobeni, nabalayishela abantu izimpahla besuka ezitolo, basengaphephela kuyo, iqhubeke impilo. Ingigeze inhliziyo ngakhumbula ukuthi empeleni iChina kade yahamba phambili kwezobuchwepheshe uma ubheka ukuthi emakhaya izinto esizisebenzisayo, phecelezi amagajethi, amaningi akhiwa khona.Ngisho uTerence Tracy we-Afro Offroad 4x4 Driver Training uvumelane nami ezishaya isifuba, ethi iJMC edayisa izimoto ezilinganiselwa kuhhafu wesigidi ngonyaka emhlabeni jikelele, ishaye into ecokeme nge-Vigus double cab.Iphawula i-Head of Product kwaJMC nakwaGAC Motor, uKarabo Ndaba, izwakale ilibuka ngeso elihle ikusasa le-JMC Vigus double cab 4x4, yathi abantu baseMzansi abaphume ngobuningi bayoyithenga ngoba bayobe bengashayanga eceleni. I-JMC iveze ukuthi ngo-7.1l kadizili uyakwazi ukuhamba ufinyelele ku-100km kanti uma uzohamba ngayo etiyeleni kufanele ibe ku-2H, obhuqwini uyibeke ku-4H. Koxakile onezithiyo eziningi uyibeka ku-4L, ungayixini ngoba bungachitheka bugayiwe.Leli veni lethulwa nje, bekungakapholi amaseko iJMC - izimoto zayo ezilethwa yiSalvador Caetano South Africa - yethule iveni layo lokuqala eNingizimu Afrika, iVigus, intengo yayo ebiqala ku-R299 900 i-single cab.Amasondo ayo okwazi ukunqamula ngawo kuyo yonke indawo angu-17 inch. Ine-hill descent control engadinge ukuthi ubambe ibhreki uma usendaweni eyehlelayo njengoba izenzela yona umsebenzi. Inama-airbag amane kwewumshini ozishintshayo kanti kweshintshwayo mabili.

Ekukhuleni komhlaba wezobuchwepheshe, ama-smartwatch ahlale edlalela indima ebalulekile empilweni yabantu. Ngemuva kokwaziswa kwawo kuqala emhlabeni, okwakhiwe ngama-digital watch, abantu baqala ukuthola izindlela ezintsha zokuwasebenzisa. Njengoba umqondo wokuhamba phambili kwezobuchwepheshe ufinyelela kwabantu abaningi, ama-smartwatch akhula waba nezinselelo eziningi. Ngaphakathi kweminyaka yama-2010, ama-smartwatch aqala ukujabulisa abantu abaningi, engakhawulile emisebenzini yawo ngokukodwa. Asetshenziswa kakhulu ukuze kubonakale isikhathi, kodwa abantu baqala nokuwasebenzisa ukuze balandele impilo yabo. Izici ezifana nokuhlola izinga lempilo, ukuhamba, nokugcina izibalo zamasiko eziphilayo, kwenza ama-smartwatch abe yinto ebalulekile empilweni yansuku zonke. Ngonyaka ka-2015, ama-smartwatch aqala ukutholwa ezimakethe eziningi, futhi abantu bavele baqonda ukuthi angabasiza kanjani ekulandeleni izimpilo zabo. Abaningi baqala ukuthola izinzuzo zokugcina izibalo ziphucukile, futhi lokhu kwashintsha indlela abahlala nomsebenzi. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, ama-smartwatch aba nezinye izici ezinjengezaziso ezivela ezinhlelweni, ukuhamba UV, nokukwazi ukwenza imisebenzi ngezinsiza zokusebenza. Ngaphandle kokuthi abantu basebenzisa ama-smartwatch njengemishini yokwenziwa, kwaqhubeka nokufinyelela emnothweni. Lokhu kuwufakazi wokuthi noveli yokudlulisela amaminithi ezinsuku zamanje, ama-smartwatch aseqhulwini njengomngane owaziwayo emisebenzini yansuku zonke. Ngakho-ke, umphakathi usayidala ubuqotho bokungenelela okuqhubekayo, njengoba ama-smartwatch eqhubeka nokukhulisa impilo yabantu ngezindlela eziningi. Thina njengomphakathi, sikhuluma ngekusasa elikhazimulayo lemidlalose futhi siyakhumbula ukuthi, ukusuka esikhathini esidlule, ama-smartwatch abambe iqhaza elikhulu empilweni yethu.

Ukusetshenziswa kwama-drone kwezolimo zanamuhla Ama-drone, noma ama-unmanned aerial vehicles (UAV), asebenza njengenhlangano enkulu kwezolimo zanamuhla. Lokhu kuthuthukisa ukusebenza kwezimboni zokufuya izilimo kanye nemifino. Njengoba ubuchwepheshe buqhubeka buhamba phambili, ama-drone agcina ekhonjiswa njengomsebenzi obalulekile ekuvuseleleni nasekuthuthukiseni umkhiqizo wezolimo. Okokuqala, ama-drone asetshenziswa ekubhekaneni nokuhlola izindawo ezinkulu zezinkanyezi. Ngokusebenzisa amakhamera aphezulu, ama-drone angathola izithombe ezicacile ezibonisa isimo sezitshalo, kuziqinisekisa ukuthi zikhula kahle. Lokhu kuhlola kusiza abalimi ukuba babone izinkinga ezifana nezinambuzane, izifo, noma izinkinga zokunisela ngaphambi kokuthi zibe nezinhlayiya ezinkulu. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ama-drone angasiza ekuphakamiseni izivuno. Abalimi bangasebenzisa ama-drone ukuhlinzeka ngezithako ezidingekayo ezifana namafutha adingekayo nokudla kwezitshalo ngaphakathi komhlaba. Lokhu kuwenziwa kahle futhi ngokushesha, okuvuna umkhiqizo ophezulu. Ukusetshenziswa kwama-drone kwesimo sokulima kubevele kwafaka umthelela omkhulu ekongeni izinsiza. Ngokuhlinzeka ngosizo lwesikhathi noshishino, ama-drone angasiza abalimi ukuba baphumelele, balungise izinkinga, futhi balinganise imithombo yabo. Lokhu kubalulekile ekwandiseni umkhiqizo wezolimo, akuzukwenzeka ngaphandle kwalolu hlobo lobuchwepheshe. Ekugcineni, ukusebenzisa ama-drone kwezolimo kunikeza indlela entsha yokuhlela, yokuhlola, kanye nokuphakela izitshalo, okuholela ekukhuleni komkhiqizo ngokushesha nangempumelelo. Bayingxenye ebalulekile yokwakha ikusasa eliqhakazile kwezolimo.

Uthe kubhungwe nangombiko wakamuva oveze ukuthi abantu baKwaZulu-Natal, bamanqika ukuthi bavote ngoba sebelahle ithemba kuhulumeni.Kuzokhumbuleka ukuthi lo mbiko waveza ukuthi abantu bakulesi sifundazwe sebelahle ithemba kakhulu uma kuqhathaniswa nezinye izifundazwe ngokuvota ngenxa yokuthi abasamethembi uhulumeni.UMntwana Thulani uthe bayakwamukela ukuthi ikhomishini iyabuhlonipha ubuholi bomdabu nokugqugquzela abantu basemakhaya ukuthi bavote. Kusasa kulindeleke lezi zikhulu zibe nesithangami nabezindaba ukuzochaza ngohambo lwazo kulesi sifundazwe. Aba maningi amacala okwadingeka siwaxazulule ayethinta abantu abazojutshwa amaqembu okhethweni lwango-2024," kusho uMamabolo izolo ngesikhathi bekhuluma ngamalungiselelo okhetho, ekomitini loMnyango wezaseKhaya ePhalamende. Ukusetshenziswa kobuchwepheshe bokuphrinta be-3D embonini Ubuchwepheshe bokuphrinta be-3D sekubeke isisekelo esikhulu ezinhlelweni ezahlukene ezifana nezembatho, ezokwakha, imishini, kanye nezobuchwepheshe. Le ndlela yokukhiqiza ikhombisa indlela entsha yokwakha izinto, ivumela ukukhiqiza imikhiqizo ngendlela ethuthukile. Ezinye zezindlela ezijwayelekile zokuphrinta be-3D zifaka phakathi ukuklama imodeli yomkhiqizo nge-software, bese umshini uphrinta le modeli ngokwakha imisebe eyahlukene. Lokhu kunciphisa isikhathi sokukhiqiza, kwenza kube lula ukwenza izingxenye eziyinkimbinkimbi, futhi kuthuthukisa ukunemba. Emkhakheni wezokwakha, ukuphrinta be-3D kusiza ekuhlinzekeni ngama-modules ezakhiwo, okwenza kube lula ukuhlela nokwakha izakhiwo ezahlukene. Kwezamabhizinisi, izinkampani zisebenzisa leli thuluzi ukwenza izicubu zokuhlola, okwenza kube lula ukuthola imiphumela ye-Prototype ngokushesha ngaphambi kokukhiqiza. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukuphrinta be-3D kuthuthukiswe ezimbonini zemithi, lapho kudalwe khona izitho zomzimba ezizenzakalelayo nezisetshenziswa eziningi kumkhakha wezempilo. Lokhu kukhombisa ukuthi ubuqambi besikhathi esizayo busebenza, futhi ukusakazwa kobuchwepheshe bokuphrinta be-3D kuzothuthukisa imikhiqizo nezinsiza ezitholakalayo. Ukusetshenziswa kwalezi zindlela ezintsha kukhombisa indlela esheshayo yokukhiqiza, okuholela ekwenzeni umkhiqizo ophucukile, kanye nokunciphisa izindleko, okusiza izinkampani ukuhambisana nezidingo eziqhubekayo zemakethe.

Emadolobheni amancane, uThandi wayejwayele ukuhamba ezitolo zendawo ukuze athenge izinto azidingayo. Nokho, njengoba isikhathi sihamba, waqala ukuqaphela izinguquko ezinkulu emkhakheni wokuthenga. Ukuhlanganiswa kwe-e-commerce kwavela, futhi lokho kwashintsha indlela abantu abathenga ngayo. Ngelinye ilanga, uThandi wathola isikhangiso se-inthanethi esikhangisa imikhiqizo ethokozisayo. Wazama ukungena ku-inthanethi, wathola ukuthi angathenga konke akudingayo ngaphandle kokuphuma endlini. Lokhu kwamsiza ukuba acabange ukuthi kungani kufanele ahambe ezitolo uma angathola konke kalula ngekhompyutha yakhe. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, uThandi waqala ukujwayela ukuthenga ku-inthanethi. Wathola ukuthi izitolo eziningi zendawo zikhona ku-inthanethi, futhi ezinye zazo zikhokhela izindleko zokulethwa. Lokhu kwenza kube lula kakhulu, futhi wathola isikhathi esithe xaxa sokwenza izinto azithandayo. Nokho, akuzange kube lula kuphela. UThandi waqala ukubona ukuthi izitolo zendabuko ziya zincipha, futhi abathengisi bendawo babebhekene nezinkinga. Uthando lwakhe lokuthenga ezitolo lwaluphela kancane kancane, njengoba ebona izitolo eziningi zivalwa. Lokhu kumshiya nomuzwa wokukhathazeka, njengoba ebona umphakathi wakhe ushintsha. Ekugcineni, uThandi wathola ibhalansi. Waqala ukuhamba ezitolo zendabuko ngezikhathi ezithile ukuze axhase abathengisi bendawo, kodwa waqhubeka nokuthenga ku-inthanethi ukuze athole izinto ezithile. Wafunda ukuthi izinguquko emikhubeni yokuthenga zikhona, kodwa kubalulekile ukugcina isiko lokuthenga lendawo. Lokhu kwamsiza ukuba abe nekhono lokuphila phakathi kwezinguquko ezinkulu zomhlaba.

Ukusetshenziswa kwama-drone kwezolimo zanamuhla Ngokukhula kwezobuchwepheshe, ama-drone sekwaba yinsiza ebalulekile emkhakheni wezolimo. Namuhla, abalimi bathola izinzuzo eziningi ngokusebenzisa lezi zinsiza, okwenza kube nokusebenza kahle okukhulu emasimini. Ama-drone asetshenziselwa ukuhlola izitshalo, ukuqapha izifo, kanye nemiphumela yokungena kwamanzi. Lezi zinsiza zikwazi ukuthola ulwazi oluyigugu ngokushesha, lapho abalimi bengathola khona imibiko enembile mayelana nezimo zezimila zabo. Lokhu kusiza ekwenzeni izinqumo ezisheshayo zokuvikela izitshalo, okunciphisa ukulahleka kokudla. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ama-drone angasetshenziswa ukwenza ukuhlinzekwa kwezinsiza ezifana nezibulali-zinambuzane kanye nezinhlamvu. Lokhu kwenza kube lula ukufinyelela ezindaweni ezinzima, okwandisa ukukhiqiza kokudla. Ukusetshenziswa kwe-drone kunciphisa umthelela wezemvelo, njengoba kunciphisa izidingo zokusebenzisa izimoto ezinkulu ezidla uphethiloli. Izifundo zikhombisa ukuthi ukusebenzisa ama-drone kwezolimo kungaholela ekwandeni kokukhiqizwa, okuthuthukisa umnotho wabalimi. Ngakho-ke, ama-drone awazange abe yinsiza kuphela, kodwa sebecabanga ngempumelelo emhlabeni wezolimo. Njengoba ubuchwepheshe buqhubeka nokuthuthuka, kubonakala sengathi ama-drone azoba nemithelela emikhulu emkhakheni wezolimo ezinsukwini ezizayo.

UKUNYUKA kwezigameko zabafundi basemanyuvesi okuthiwa baphila nokuhlukumezeka sekusukumise inhlangano iSouth African Union of Student kanye nezinye izinhlaka ukuze kube khona okwenziwayo ngalokhu.NgoLwesihlanu eBlue Water, eThekwini le nhlangano ngokubambisana nabeWear Your Brand bathule ngokusemthethweni ingqungquthela ezokuba ngoJuni okuzobe kuhloswe ngayo ukuqwashisa abafundi abaphila nokuhlukumezeka kodwa buthule.Kuvelile lapha ukuthi laba bafundi ukuhlukumezeka bakuthola,ezindawerni ezahlukene okungaba yisemakhaya ebudlelwaneni nakwezinye izindawo.USihlalo wale nhlangano, uMnuz Quinton Oliphant uveze ukuthi le ngqungquthela ibandakanya izikhungo zintathu eziphakeme yiMangosuthu University of Technology (MUT), University of KwaZulu Natal (UKZN) kanye neDurban University of Technology (DUT).Uthe abakabi nalo usuku oluqondile lwayo, kodwa izokube isingethwe ngesinye salezi zikhungo ezingenhla.Uthe ngokwacwaningo abalwenzile batholile ukuthi baningi kakhulu abafundi abasezikhungweni zemfundo ephekeme abahlukumzekayo ngezindlela ezahlukene. Wathi yingakho bebone kungcono ukuba bahlele le ngqungquthela.Uthe inhlosongqangi yayo ukuthi kubhungwe kabanzi ngamasu angasetshenziswa ngenhloso yokubhekana nje ngqo nalesi simo.Uthe kungabe benza elikhulu iphutha leli uma bengase bathule nje bagoqe izandle ekubeni izinto zonakala.Okubakhathaza kakhulu uthe ukuthi lezi zigameko kuvela ukuthi zimandla kakhulu kubantu besifazane. Uthe yingakho le ngqunguthela beyethe elokuthi yiGBVF Summit.

UYINYATHELE emsileni uSihlalo weKhomishini eVikela iMiphakathi, ezeNkolo neziLimi, uNkk Thoko Mkhwanazi-Xaluva ngokuveza ukuthi ukholelwa emadlozini osekuvukuze ulaka olusha ngaye kubantu abangamaKrestu osekunesikhathi bekhala ngokuthi uyabanyundela. UNkk Mkhwanazi-Xaluva, njengoSihlalo we-CRL Rights Commission, uzithola ekulesi simo nje yingoba waphakamisa ukuthi amasonto awalawulwe ngokuthi abhaliswe futhi kukhishwe amalayisensi abefundisi azolawulwa wumthetho eNingizimu Afrika.Isikhalo sakhe esikhulu esokuthi maningi amabandla anemikhuba ecindezela nethunaza abantu. Ubefuna ukuba uMkhandlu wakhe unikwe amandla okuphenya la masonto athe chithi saka ukuthi awanyatheli yini amalungelo abantu abangamakholwa. Lesi siphakamiso senyusa imimoya emakholweni amaningi ekhuza ibhadi ngokuthi uhulumeni ufuna ukushayela abezenkolo imithetho ngendlela abakhonza ngayo, okuyinto uMthethosisekelo ongayivumi.Ekhuluma neSolezwe Ngempelasonto ngalokhu, uSolwazi Musa Xulu phambilini obekade eyingxenye yomsebenzi wale Khomishini, uthe uNkk Mkhwanazi-Xaluva akenzanga kahle ngokugqashiya ngokuthi uyisangoma ekubeni azi ukuthi uphethe isikhundla esimqoka kanjena.UXulu ukhuluma kanjena nje kune-video eveza uXaluva ekhuluma emi phambi kwezangoma esho ukuthi yena uyakholelwa kwelakhe idlozi. ''Asazi mhlawumbe phela awabo amadlozi awabasebenzeli,'' uzwakala ebhinqa kanje engacacisi ukuthi ubhekise kubani.UXulu lokhu uthi kubi ngoba kuzodala inzondo phakathi kukaMkhwanazi-Xaluva namaKrestu.

UKUHLANGANA enyuvesi besaqeqeshelwa umkhakha wokuthwebula nokubonana njalo uma benza imisebenzi yabo yalo mkhakha kwaze kwaqinisa ubudlelwano kwizinsizwa ezinhlanu, futhi kwazisiza nangokuzibula ngenkampani ezisiza ukusebenza ndawonye. Labo woMnuz Sabelo Magwaza weSabelo Mag yaseMlaza, wuSiphesihle Biyela weSphewato Media yaseNanda, wuBusiswa Chiliza wenkampani Umshuthi Media yaseMagabheni, wu-Emihle Dlamini wePluug Talk Studio yaKwaMashu noMonde Mhlongo weMonde Films yaseClermont - asebesebenzisana enkampanini yabo abayiqale ndawonye iKune Studio.Engxoxweni neSolezwe Ngempelasonto, uMagwaza uthe baqale ukuzwana noBiyela noDlamini besaqeqeshelwa lomkhakha eDurban University of Technology (DUT) ngo-2020, okuthe ngo-2022 bahlangana noChiliza noMhlongo - sebevele sebenamabhizinisi abo alo msebenzi, okuqinise ubudlelwano babo baze bashisekela ukusebenzisana ndawonye. "Kuqale kancane kuwukuthi siyalekelelana uma kukhona oyedwa phakathi kwethu osuke enomsebenzi omkhulu nodinga izandla eziningi, kwagcina kuba wumkhuba wethu ukuthi njalo siyalekelelana uma kunemisebenzi enjalo - sase sanquma ukuqala le nkampani ngenhloso yokuthi uma kunemisebenzi emikhulu siyenze egameni layo kuphela,” kusho uMagwaza.Eqhuba, uthe ukuqala iKune Studio kubasize kakhulu ukuthola imisebenzi yemicimbi emikhulu yohulumeni neyemicimbi emikhulu yobumnandi ejwayele ukwenzeka eThekwini namaphethelo, okubasiza ukuthi benze inzuzo ngezindlela eziningi futhi ezihlukene. "Lokhu kusisiza nangokuthi uma kwenzeka ukuthi oyedwa wethu athole ikhasimende elidinga ukwenzela umsebenzi odinga abantu abaningi, kuba lula ukuthi alidlulisele kwiKune Studio - bese singena sonke kalula kanjalo, okusisiza kakhulu ukuya phambili,” kusho yena.Uthe wethemba ukuthi ukungenisa kwabo ngale ndlela ehlukile kanjena kuzokhuthaza nabanye abantu abasha abanamakhono ehlukene basemalokishini ukulandela ezinyathelweni zabo ukwenza kahle, nokusebenzisana ukuze baphumelele.

Ayikho into engikholwa ukuthi imqoka ngaphezulu kwemfundo.Yingakho sibone kungcono ukuba sifake isandla,''echaza.Uveze nokuthi emagcekeni alesi sikole bafake nesigwedla samanzi ngenxa yokuthi bayiqonda kahle kamhlophe indaba yenkinga yamanzi ebhekene nalo mphakathi wakule ndawo. ''Yonke leya ndawo inenkiga yamanzi yingakho sibone kufanele ukuba sibalekelele nangamanzi,''usho kanjena.Uveze ukuthi lesi sikole sesizoba nabafundi abangu-84 ngemuva kokuba kunezelwe leli gumbi. Ekuqaleni uthe bebengu-54. Uthe ufisa ukusibona lesi sikole sikhula nangokwesibalo.Amalungu omphakathi akule ndawo akushayele elikhulu ihlombe leli lokhu okwenziwe yilo somabhizinisi.UGumede uveze ukuthi leli gumbi kulithathe izinyanga ezine ngaphambi kokuba liphothulwe ngokugcwele.Ubonge umakhi walo owaziwayo endaweni, uMnuz Skhona Madlala athe uvolontiyile walakha mahhala ethi yindlela naye abuyisela ngayo emphakathini.NgoJanuwari lo somabhizinisi uke wazibambela mathupha elungisa umgwaqo ngenxa yokuthi ubungekho sesimweni esifanele.Uthishanhloko wesikole, uNksz Hlongwa ubonge kakhulu kuGumede ngeqhaza lakhe kulesi sikole. Uthe kuyajabulisa ukubona abantu basemphakathini bebuyisela kuwona.

"Ngize nngaqala ukusebenzela kulo msebenzi ngoba yena uNonkamfela esefika amagemugemu kimina ngephupho, engikhumbuza ukwenza lo msebenzi - njengoba kuvele kuyinto esasiyikhulumile savumelana ukuthi ngisale ngimqedelela yona uma eshona engakayiqedi. Imisebenzi yakhe yobuciko eminingi ayenza ngezikhathi zobandlululo. "Kungithathe cishe iminyaka emithathu ukuqoqa cishe lonke ulwazi ngebengizokudinga ukudidiyela incwadi njengoba isizophuma iyilokhu esiyikhona manje. Bekudingeka ukuthi sivumbulule enqwabeni yemiqulu yolwazi enemisebenzi yakhe,” kusho uMkhize.Uthe uhlanganise le ncwadi ngosizo lwabahluzi oSolwazi Gugu Mazibuko we-University of Johannesburg, Nksz Fortunate Ngconco woMnyango wezemiDlalo, ubuCiko namaSiko KwaZulu-Natal noMnuz Senzo Mkhize - omsize ukuvumbulula ezinye izinkondlo. "Lo msebenzi udidiyele izinkondlo ezihluba udlubu ekhasini ngobunzima umuntu omnyama adlule kubona ngenkathi kusabusa uhulumeni wengcindezelo, bese kuba khona nalezo eziqhakambisa ubuhle bemvelo namandla ayo ukulungisa izimo ezithile ezweni,” kusho yena.Le ncwadi izobiza u-R250 iyinye, kanti izoqala ukutholakala emcimbini wokuyethula ozoba se-UKZN ophikweni iHoward College, eThekwini, ngoLwesithathu kusuka ngo-3 ntambama kuya ku-7 kusihlwa.

Okuqaphelekayo wukuthi wonke amaqembu akhuluma kahle ngeSilo kwabezindaba esho khona ukuthi siwuhlaka olubalulekile futhi ayaseseka.ISilo siphila ngomgomo wokuthi asihlangene naqembu lezepolitiki kodwa simukela wonke umuntu uma efisa ukusondela eyokotha ebukhosini. ISilo sikaZulu siphethe ubukhosi obukhulu, obudumile nobuhlonishwayo emhlabeni nokuchaza ukuthi kunezinkumbi zabantu abangaphansi kwaso. Ubukhosi bukaZulu budala kakhulu futhi budume ngamaqhawe aziwayo emlandweni.ISilo siphinde sengamele umhlaba omkhulu KwaZulu-Natal ngaphansi kwebhodi Ingonyama Trust ehlala isematheni nosopolitiki bephikisana ngayo ngakhulu.Into enkulu kosopolitiki wukucubuza amagabade kubantu bese bethola amavoti azobasondeza emandleni. Inhlangano ebusayo i-ANC nabaholi bayo abajutshwe kuhulumeni bayagqigqa kakhulu ukuyokotha iSilo. I-ANC yona uma iziphendulela ngokuzihuqa eSilweni ithi inakekela ubuholi bendabuko ngoba buyingxenye ebalulekile yokubuswa kwezwe.UKhongolose uma ucubungula imbangela yokwehlelwa amavoti KwaZulu-Natal, ukubeka kucace ukuthi udaba lweSilo neNdlunkulu kaZulu lunomthelela. Bakubeka kucace ukuthi kukhona isidingo sokuthi kulungiswe ubudlelwano benhlangano nendlunkulu futhi kulekelelwe ukudala uzinzo.UNobhala -Jikelele we-ANC, uMnuz Fikile Mbalula, egcina ukuvakashela iSilo wakhuleka ngezinkomo eziwu-10 ngoMeyi nonyaka. Kwasabalala ukukhuluma okuthi i-ANC ibizama ukuthenga iSilo kodwa kwachithwa lokho, kwathiwa kushiwo abantu abangaqondi ngosiko. "Ukuvakasha kwethu siyobona iSilo kuyingxenye yokuthi sihlale sixhumene nezinhlaka ezibalulekile emphakathini.

KUKHONA nobeyisisebenzi kwabathathu abasolwa ngecala lokubulala ngesihluku umndeni wabayisikhombisa eNewark, KwaDukuza, ngoLwesibili.Izidumbu zabafi okuthiwa baneminyaka ephakathi kuka-20 no-83, kuvela ukuthi zikhonjwe abasolwa eMelmoth, ngoLwesithathu. Okhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uColonel Robert Netshiunda, uthe kubasolwa okuthiwa baneminyaka ephakathi kuka-21 no-28, kukhona oyedwa obeyisisebenzi emzini wabafi. Uthe kulindeleke ukuthi bavele eNkantolo yeMantshi yaKwaDukuza, namuhla. Elandisa ngesigameko, uthe abagilwa baqale bathunjwa, besuswa ekhaya labo eliseNewark ngoLwesibili ebusuku, bayobulawa eMelmoth. "Yisisebenzi esihlanza indlu esihlabe umkhosi ngesigameko ngoLwesithathu ekuseni, kulandela ukuthi sifike ekhaya labagilwa, sathola ukuthi kugqekeziwe, amalungu omndeni ayisikhombisa wonke engekho, kanjalo nemoto ingekho,” kusho uNetshiunda. Uthe kube sekubizelwa endaweni yesigameko amaphoyisa aseNewark kanjalo namanye ama-unit amaphoyisa. Kuwona uthe kusebenzisane amaphoyisa aseNewark, abaphenyi baKwaDukuza, KwaDukuza Tactical Response Team, Provincial Counter Intelligence Unit, Provincial Counter Kidnapping Unit neProvincial Serious Violence Crimes Unit. Uthe uphenyo lwawo luqale lwawaholela KwaHlomendlini, eMandeni, lapho okufike kwaboshwa khona abasolwa ababili ngoLwesithathu. "Oyedwa wabasolwa utholwe neselula yoyedwa wabagilwa. Umkhondo ube usuwakhomba KwaDendethu, eSundumbili, amaphoyisa lapho okufike kwaboshwa khona umsolwa wesithathu,” kusho uNetshiunda.

KUHLUKENE imibono kwizazi zepolitiki emuva kokuthi lowo owayengumengameli wezwe, uMnuz Jacob Zuma, ememezele ukuthi ngeke ayivotele i-ANC okhethweni lwangonyaka ozayo.Ngosuku lokubuyisana uZuma ushaqise abaningi ememezela ukuthi uzovotela iqembu elisha elibizwa ngokuthi uMkhonto Wesizwe njengoba engeke asebenzisane ne-ANC eholwa nguMengameli Cyril Ramaphosa.Isazi sepolitiki esizimele, uMnuz Thabani Khumalo, sithe isenzo sikaZuma siphambene nemigomo ye-ANC ekubeka kucace ukuthi uma ujoyina le nhlangano uzimisele ukuyeseka.Uthe silubeka obala uqhekeko olukhona kule nhlangano.Ubalule ukuthi i-ANC izithola ibhekene nesimo esinzima lapho kuyiphoqa ukuthi yenze okuthile ngoZuma kwazise usesigungwini esibhekelele ukusebenza kwayo. "UZuma akafunanga ukuthi azixoshe kodwa ushiyele i-ANC ukuthi kube iyona ezithathela isinqumo ngekusasa lakhe. Uwumuntu okwaziyo ukuthola uzwelo ngoba uma i-ANC imxosha uyobe esekhala ngokuthi inhlangano aseyisebenzele iminyaka engaphezu kuka-60 isimxoshile. Okuzoba nzima kwi-ANC wukuthi uma ingamxoshi izokwenzanjani ngaye ngoba uhlala esigungwini esibhekelele ukusebenza kwenhlangalo lapho kuzobe kubhungwa ngezinhlelo zokhetho nokunye njengoba kuqala unyaka,” kusho uKhumalo.Uthe okwenziwa wuZuma nokwenziwa wuThabo Mbeki akufani neze ngoba uMbeki akazange amemezele ukuthi uzosebenzisana nelinye iqembu kodwa wathi ivoti lakhe liyimfihlo.Ekhuluma kwiNewzroom Afrika, uSolwazi Andre Duvenage oyisazi sepolitiki esizinze eNyuvesi yaseNorth West, uthe akayiboni i-ANC ixosha uZuma ngenxa yogazi analo njengoba kubhekwe okhethweni.

"Abasatshiswayo kanjalo nabathuswa ngokuthi bazoqondiswa ubugwegwe, abasibikele ngokushesha. Akwesekwe namalungu ethu ajutshwe kuhulumeni yi-ANC." Uthe abayona ingozi kwi-ANC wathi into eyingozi kakhulu ukulawulwa koMbuso yidlanzana kanjalo nokulahleka kwethemba kubasebenzi. "Ukungenzi kahle kukahulumeni, ukulahlekelwa yithemba kwabantu ngezinye zezinto eziyinkinga kuleli. Yizona zinto ezinkulu eziyizingqinamba." Uyalele izinhlaka ezifundazweni nasezifundeni ukuthi zibe nemihlangano okuzobhungwa kuyona indaba yomdonsiswano okhona ne-ANC. Uthe kuzoba nezifundo zokwazisa amalungu ngesinqumo sokuzimela okhethweni kanjalo nombono we-SACP ngohulumeni basekhaya.Isinqumo seSACP sidale uqhekeko nangaphakathi ezinhlakeni zale nhlangano njengoba kuze kwahlakazwa ubuholi baKwaZulu-Natal ngoba kuthiwa abuhambisani nalesi sinqumo. Kwaqokwa ubuholi besikhashana kulesi sifundazwe njengoba kuthiwa abanye abaholi bakhala ngokuthi iSACP iyagagamela ngokuzimela okhethweni.

''Ngaleso sikhathi bengizitshela ukuthi uzothamba mhlawumbe usefuna senze inkonzo yasekameleni kanti angibuzanga, umuntu kukhulu afuna ukukwenza kimina,'' echaza.Uthe umyeni wakhe ube esemthatha emsondeza kahle wambeka echosheni lombhede samuntu abazokwenza inkonzo njengoba naye ekhumule ibhulukwe. "Emqondweni wami bese ngizitshela ukuthi siya ocansini,'' echaza.Uthe umuzwe esememeza esethi ngeke aze alale naye yena ngoba uyamcika futhi unephunga elingelihle. "Ngemuva kwalokho, wathatha isikele wangilimaza ngaphansi,'" echaza.Nakhona lapho, uthe waqhubeka embuza ukuthi wenzeni kepha impendulo engayitholi, kunalokho uthe umyeni wakhe wayephenduke isilwane ebona kahle nje ukuthi usho ukumudla eluhlaza futhi usho ukuqeda nje nya ngaye.Uthe kukhona lapho ayemshaya aze amhudule phansi endlini, walimala kabi emhlane nasezingalweni ngokunjalo. Uveze ukuthi wagcina ekwazile ukuphuma endlini abaleke ayofuna usizo.Njengamanje ubhacile ngoba ubona kahle ukuthi umyeni wakhe uma engahlangana naye angaqeda ngaye. ''Ngenxa yalesi simo ngibone kungcono ukuba ngithuthe emzini wethu ngiye kwenye indawo ngoba ngisabela impilo yami," kusho yena.Uthe udaba ulubikile emaphoyiseni waboshwa umyeni wakhe wavela nasenkantolo kodwa kuyimanje ungaphandle ngebheyili. ''Uyabona njengoba engaphandle ngebheyili ngisaba kakhulu ngoba angimazi ukuthi yini ayicabangayo ngami.

Ngasekupheleni kukaMsombuluko, uNandi, obhade aged 45, waba nokukhathazeka okwengeziwe. Uqedile ukuphatha izingane zakhe, kodwa umqondo wokuthi kumele aqhubeke nemfundo wawumkhathaza. Ezinyangeni ezedlule, wayebona izikhangiso zezinkundla zokufunda online ezikhuluma ngokuqhubeka nemfundo kubantu abadala. Ngezinye zezinsuku, uNandi wathola umdlandla, wavula ikhompiyutha yakhe, wabhala "ukufunda online" ku-inthanethi. Ngemuva kwalokho, wathola izifundo ezahlukene, kusukela kwezobuchwepheshe bezokuxhumana kuya kwezemfundo. Waqala ukufunda ngekhompyutha, wamangala ukuthi isikhathi sidlulile, engazi ukuthi uqhubekile kangakanani. Ngaphezu kwalokho, wathola umphakathi omuhle, abantu abaninzi ababesebenzisa lezi zinkundla, babezokwesizana, babelana ngezifundo, futhi baphakamisa imicabango emisha. Ngaleso sikhathi, uNandi waqonda ukuthi ukufunda akupheli, futhi umhlaba ungokwenkolo. Kwakuyithuba elisha, futhi uNandi wathola injabulo enkulu kanye nokwaneliseka kokufunda. Ngemva kwezinyanga ezintathu, wathola isitifiketi, waphinde waba nemibono emisha, waba nesibindi sokuthatha izinyathelo ezinkulu empilweni yakhe. Ukufunda online kwaba umthombo wokukhula, kwemfundo, nokuphila okuhle. Ngakho, uNandi waphuma phambili; wayezimisele ukuhamba phambili, umbono omusha, nolwazi olwandisiwe.

Ukuhlaziywa kokukhula kokusebenza kwama-robot embonini Emhlabeni wezobuchwepheshe, ukukhula kokusebenza kwama-robot embonini sekuphenduke udaba olubalulekile lokucwaninga. Izinkampani zisebenzisa ama-robot ukuze zithuthukise ukukhiqiza, zinciphise izindleko, futhi zandise ikhwalithi yomkhiqizo, ukuze zifinyelele ubuchwepheshe obuphambili. Lokhu kuholele ekwandeni kokusebenza kwama-robot, okwenza kube lula ukuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo eziphambili. Ngokwezinhlolovo, ama-robot angakwazi ukwenza imisebenzi eminingi ngokushesha nangempumelelo, okwenza kube lula ukuhlangabezana nezidingo zamakhasimende. Lokhu kuholela ekunciphiseni isikhathi sokukhiqiza, okuvumela izinkampani ukuthi zikwazi ukuveza imikhiqizo emisha emakethe ngokushesha. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ama-robot angakwazi ukusebenza ezimeni ezinzima lapho abantu bengakwazi khona, ngaleyo ndlela kuncishiswe ubungozi kubantu emsebenzini. Nokho, ukwanda kokusebenza kwama-robot akugxilanga kuphela emisebenzini ethile. Ukufakwa kobuchwepheshe bokufunda ngomshini (machine learning) kanye ne-AI (Artificial Intelligence) kukhombisa amathuba amasha. Lokhu kukhuthaza ama-robot ukuba azifundele futhi akhulise ukusebenza kwawo ngokuhamba kwesikhathi. Ngokuhamba kwegumbi, ukutshalwa kwezimali ezinkulu ekuthuthukiseni ama-robot kuzothuthukisa kakhulu ukusebenza kwemboni. Kubalulekile ukuthi izinkampani ziqhubeke nokuhlola lezi zinguquko ukuze ziqinisekise ukuthi zihlala zisebenzisa ubuchwepheshe obuphambili. Ngakho-ke, ukukhula kokusebenza kwama-robot embonini akusikho kuphela ukunciphisa izindleko, kodwa futhi kuholela ekwandeni kokuncintisana emakethe, okuholela ekuthuthukiseni umnotho jikelele. Ngokubheka konke lokhu, kucacile ukuthi ama-robot azoba neqhaza elikhulu ekwakheni ikusasa lezemboni.

Ukukhula komkhakha wokuthengisa online kubathengisi abazimele Emhlabeni wanamuhla, ukuthengisa online sekuphenduke umkhakha obalulekile kubathengisi abazimele. Lokhu kukhula kuxhumene nezinguquko ezinkulu kwezobuchwepheshe, ukufinyelela kwe-inthanethi, kanye nezidingo ezikhulayo zabathengi. Abathengisi abazimele, abavame ukuba nezinselelo zokungakwazi ukufinyelela emakethe enkulu, manje sebekwazi ukusebenzisa izinkundla zokuthengisa online ukuze bathole amakhasimende amaningi. Okokuqala, ukuthengisa online kunikeza abathengisi abazimele ithuba lokukhulisa ibhizinisi labo ngaphandle kwemikhawulo ye-geographical. Noma ngabe bakuphi, bangathengisa imikhiqizo yabo kumakhasimende aphesheya kwezilwandle. Lokhu kwenza kube lula ukuhweba, futhi abathengisi bangakwazi ukuhlinzeka ngemikhiqizo yabo kumakhasimende abavela ezindaweni ezahlukene. Okwesibili, izinkundla zokuthengisa ezidumile, njenge- Shopify, Amazon, ne-eBay, zinikeza amathuluzi alula okwakha izitolo eziku-inthanethi. Lokhu kwenza kube lula kubantu abangakaze bathengise online ukuba baqale. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izinkundla zokuxhumana, njenge-Facebook ne-Instagram, zenza kube lula ukufinyelela kubathengi, okuvumela abathengisi ukuthi bakhuthaze imikhiqizo yabo ngendlela efanele. Ekugcineni, ukukhula komkhakha wokuthengisa online kubathengisi abazimele kuholela ekwandeni kokuncintisana. Lokhu kusho ukuthi abathengisi kufanele bahlale bephucula izinga lemikhiqizo yabo, izinsizakalo, kanye nezindlela zokumaketha ukuze bagcine ubudlelwano obuhle namakhasimende. Ngakho-ke, ukuthengisa online akugcini nje ngokukhulisa amathuba, kodwa futhi kudinga ubuchwepheshe bokuphumelela. Ngale ndlela, ukukhula komkhakha wokuthengisa online kubathengisi abazimele kuveza amathuba amasha, kodwa futhi kudinga ukuzinikela nokuhlakanipha ukuze baphumelele.

UCele sasixhunyaniswa wukuthi ungumakhelwane ethanda ukuthi ngimazise ngokuthi kwenzekani emndenini wakhe. UFaith sasingaxhumani naye,'' kusho yena.U-Advocate Mvune izolo utshele inkantolo ukuthi ingabusebenzisi ubufakazi obuphambi kwayo obethulwe uFaith noMzo ekhala ngokuthi buyashayisana futhi buntekenteke.Wenze izibonelo lapho okushayisana khona ubufakazi obethulwe yilaba.Eqhulwini uqale wakhuluma ngokuthi uFaith esitatimendeni sakhe esifungelwe ayevuma kusona icala waveza ukuthi umyeni wakhe wayemhlukumeza, kodwa uma esethula ubufakazi ebhokisini useshaya ingqimphothwe uthi ubudlelwane bakhe nomufi babubuhle kakhulu kwaze kwafika isikhathi lapho eficwa khona wukufa.Uqhubekile wathi esitatmendeni sakhe sokuvuma icala, uFaith wathi kwavunyelwana ngokuthi inkabi uMzo, izokhokhelwa u-R150 000 uma iwenze ngempumelelo umsebenzi wokusoconga umufi, kodwa uma esemile ebhokisini usethi akazi lutho ngesivumelwano semali esithinta iukukhokhelwa kwenkabi.Uqhubekile uMvune wathi uMzo esitatimendeni wathi uKhumalo owamnikeza isibhamu kanye nezinhlamvu. ''Esitatimendeni uMzo uthe waze wazifaka yena izinhlamvu esibhamini. Kodwa uma esemi ebhokisini useyashintsha futhi uthi uKhumalo owafaka izinhlamvu,'' kuchaza uMvune.

ITHIMBA elijutshwe yiSilo uMisuzulu Sinqobile kaZwelithini lithi ziyathembisa izingxoxo zalo namaqembu ameleleke ePhalamende mayelana nodaba lokuchibiyela umthetho olawula isikhwama esigade umhlaba kaZulu, iNgonyama Trust.Ithimba libe nemihlangano namaqembu ezepolitiki ameleleke ePhalamende ayisishiyagalombili kulezi zinsuku ezimbili ezedlule.Obekuxoxwa emhlanganweni yisiphakamiso seSilo sokuba kuchitshiyelwe umthetho olawula iNgonyama Trust.IMbube ifuna umthetho ugunyaze ukuthi kube iyona eqoka amalungu ebhodi leNgonyama Trust, njengamanje amalungu ebhodi aqokwa uNgqongqoshe wezoMhlaba.IMbube ifuna nokuthi iNgonyama Trust iphathwe uhulumeni waKwaZulu-Natal esikhundleni sokuthi iphathwe uhulumeni kazwelonke.Amaqembu ahlangane nethimba yi-ANC, MKP, DA, EFF, Bosa, ACDP, FF Plus neRise Mzansi.UNdunankulu kaZulu, uMfu Thulasizwe Buthelezi, uthe izingxoxo zabo namaqembu ezepolitiki zihambe kahle. "Amaqembu azibophezele ekwesekeni izinguquko ezizokwenza ukuthi kuzuze abantu abahlala ezindaweni zamakhosi. "Kuxabene ubendle kwiNgonyama Trust njengoba iSilo singahoshelani namalungu ebhodi esiwasola ngokuthi awafuni ukusamukela njengosihlalo webhodi.Imizamo kaNgqongqoshe wezoMhlaba, uMnuz Mzwanele Nyhontso, yokuchitha amalungu ebhodi yahluleka.UNyhontso waqale wabhalela amalungu ebhodi incwadi ewabuza ukuthi kungani kufanele angamiswa.Amalungu ebhodi atshela uNyhontso ukuthi akanawo amandla okuwamisa emsebenzini.Muva nje, uNyhontso uzame ukuhlakaza ibhodi kodwa isinqumo sakhe sachithwa yiNkantolo eNkulu eMgungundlovu.

Ukukhula kwezinhlelo zokusebenza zokufunda izilimi Emhlabeni wanamuhla, ukukhula kwezinhlelo zokusebenza zokufunda izilimi kubonakala ngokucacile. Lezi zinhlelo ziye zaba yinsiza ebalulekile kubantu abafuna ukuthuthukisa amakhono abo ezilimini ezahlukene. Ngaphezu kokuba zisebenziseka kalula, zikhuthaza ukufunda okuqhubekayo, okwenza kube lula ukufinyelela ezilimini eziningi. Izinhlelo ezifana ne-Duolingo, Babbel, ne-Rosetta Stone ziye zaba nemiphumela emihle. I-Duolingo, ngokukhethekile, ibonakala iyinsiza ethandwa kakhulu, ngenxa yokwakheka kwayo okuhehayo nokuhlanganisa imidlalo yokufunda. Lokhu kwenza ukufunda kube mnandi futhi kube lula, ikakhulukazi kubantu abasha. I-Babbel, ngakolunye uhlangothi, igxile ekufundeni izilimi ngokusebenzisa izimo zempilo yangempela, okwenza kube lula ukuhlanganisa ulwazi olutholakele nezimo zangempela. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izinhlelo zokusebenza zikhuthaza ukufunda okuzimele, okuvumela abafundi ukuba baphendule ngezikhathi zabo. Lokhu kubalulekile, ikakhulukazi kulabo abanezikhathi ezinzima zokufunda ezikoleni noma emsebenzini. Ukuze uthole imiphumela engcono, izinhlelo zikhuthaza ukusebenzisa izindlela ezihlukahlukene zokufunda, njengezithombe, ama-video, nezivivinyo. Nokho, kunezinkinga ezithile ezihambisana nalezi zinhlelo. Abanye abantu bangase baphawule ukuthi ukufunda nge-apps akufani nokufunda ngokomuntu, njengoba ukuxhumana nabanye abantu kungase kube kuncane. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izinhlelo eziningi zidinga ukukhokhwa ukuze uthole izici ezithuthukisiwe. Ngokuphetha, ukukhula kwezinhlelo zokusebenza zokufunda izilimi kubonisa indlela entsha yokufunda. Lezi zinhlelo zikhuthaza abantu abaningi ukuba baqale uhambo lwabo lokufunda izilimi, futhi zenza kube lula ukufinyelela ulwazi olusha. Noma zikhona izinselelo, izinzuzo zikhangayo, futhi zikhombisa ikusasa elikhanyayo lokufunda izilimi.

"Uyavumelana nami ukuthi umkakho wayengeke azidubule?” kubuza uSouls.UZungu uphendule ngelithi isibhamu sadubula ngesikhathi sisezandleni zikamufi. "Isibhamu saqhuma ngesikhathi sisezandleni zakhe. Ngiyadideka. Ngizamile ukukuchaza ukuthi isibhamu saqhuma ngesikhathi kukhona umbango waso, saqhuma kaningi saze sayeka. Angizange kodwa ngithi wazidubula,” kusho uZungu. Imantshi, uMnuz Muntukayise Khumalo, ibuzisisile ukuthi kwenzeka kanjani ukuthi isibhamu siqhume ngaphandle kokuthi oyedwa wabo asiqhumise, uphendule ngelithi akazi ukuthi saqhuma kanjani, akwaziyo nje ukuthi sona saqhuma. Ugcine esephendula ngokuthi isibhamu sasingeke siqhume ukube babengalwi, besibanga. Emva kokucindezelwa ngemibuzo uSouls, ugcine esethi uye unkosikazi wakhe owacindezela isibhamu. "Engingakuvumi ukuthi wazibulala. Mhlawumbe wacindezela isibhamu ngephutha, hhayi ngoba nakhu ayezibulala,” kusho uZungu. USouls ube esekhumbuza uZungu ngobufakazi bukadokotela bokuthi umufi wayezophelelwa amandla esadubuleke kabili entanyeni, nokho uZungu ubuphikisile lobu bufakazi bukadokotela. Icala lizoqhubeka ngenyanga ezayo.

Izinselelo zokuvikelwa kwedatha yomuntu siqu ezinkundleni zedijithali Ngiyingcweti kwezobuchwepheshe, ngithokozisa ukuphila kwami ngokusebenzisa izinkundla zedijithali. Njengomuntu ophila ezweni elishintsha ngokushesha, ngibona izinselelo eziningi zokuvikelwa kwedatha yomuntu siqu. Njengoba ngihamba phambili, ngiyazi ukuthi izinkundla zedijithali ziwusizo, kodwa zibuye zibe nezingozi ezinkulu. Okokuqala, ukungena kwabantu abangafanele ezinkundleni zedijithali kubangela ukukhathazeka. Ngithola ukuthi izinkampani eziningi azigcini kahle ngemininingwane yami, okwenza kube lula ukuthi abaphangi baphumelele ekutholeni idatha yami. Lokhu kudala umuzwa wokungaphephile, njengoba ngihlala ngicabanga ukuthi ngabe ngiyavikeleka yini. Okwesibili, ukungabi nolwazi olufanele mayelana nezindlela zokuvikela idatha kuyinselelo enkulu. Abantu abaningi abazi kahle ukuthi bangayivikela kanjani idatha yabo, futhi lokhu kuholela ekutheni baphule imithetho yokuphepha. Ngiyazi ukuthi kufanele ngifunde futhi ngiqonde izinqubo zokuvikela, kodwa lokhu kudinga isikhathi nemizamo. Ekugcineni, izinkundla zedijithali zihlala zishintsha, futhi lokhu kudinga ukuthi ngihlale ngibuyekeza ulwazi lwami. Ngiyazi ukuthi ukuvikelwa kwedatha yomuntu siqu akupheli, kodwa kudinga ukuzinikela okuqhubekayo. Ngakho, ngizama ukuhlala ngiqaphele, ngifunde, futhi ngithuthukise izindlela zami zokuvikela idatha, ukuze ngiqinisekise ukuthi ngihlala ngiphephile ezinkundleni zedijithali.

''Ngingasho kugcwale umlomo nje ukuthi ube budedengu kakhulu ngokukhuluma ngaleya ndlela. Okubi kakhulu ngaye wukuthi umane akhulume nje noma yikanjani ezinkundleni zokuxhumana, kumele akuyeke lokho ngoba kuzomfaka enkingeni,'' kuxwayisa uXulu.Eqhuba uthe lusazoqhubeka udungunyane phakathi kukaMkhwanazi-Xaluva namaKrestu uma eqhubeka eziphatha ngale ndlela.UXulu ukhale ngokuthi enye inkinga enkulu wukuthi uMkhwanazi-Xaluva akayiqondi kahle inkolo yobuKrestu, wathi ngenye yezinto ezidala ukuthi enze noma kanjani. ''Iqiniso ukuthi indaba yamadlozi nayo ingenye inkolo ngokwayo. Uma-ke uzothatha umuntu onjalo uthi wena makabheke amaKrestu vele izoba khona nakanjani inkinga okuyiyo kanye le esizithola sibhekene nayo manje,'' usho kanjena.Eqhuba uXulu uthe kwakhona ukuthi ufuna ukulawula ukusebenza kwabefundisi namabandla kuwuphawu olusobala lokuthi udidekile futhi akaqondi kahle ukuthi iyini inkolo yobuKrestu. ''Inkolo yobuKreistu izilawula yona kusukela endulo kodwa uMkhwanazi-Xaluva wathi uzoyilawula ngenxa yokudideka nokungaqondi kahle ukuthi yini le akuyona," kusho uXulu.Uqhuba athi ngokomthetho ka-2002 uMkhwanazi-Xaluva kumele abeseke abezilimi, amasiko nabamabandla, bese ebachushisa uma kukhona lapho okubonakala bentula khona umhlahlandlela. "Kulo mthetho ke akukho nokukodwa lapho kuthiwa makalawule amakholwa, kodwa-ke nangu uyakweza. Ngeke kwenziwe lutho-ke ngoba nalabo abambekile bathule ekubeni enza into engekho kulo mthetho. "Inhlangano iSouth African Church Defenders izwakalise ukungenami okukhulu ngale nkulumo kaMkhwanazi-Xaluva.

Izinguquko emikhubeni yokulalela umsakazo ngenxa yezinkundla zokusakaza 1. Qonda izinkundla zokusakaza Qala ngokuhlola zonke izinkundla ezitholakalayo zokumsakaza, kuhlanganise nezinye iziteshi zomsakazo, izinhlelo zokusebenza (apps) kanye nezinye izinsiza ezikwi-inthanethi. Lokhu kuzokusiza uqonde izinsiza ezitholakalayo zokulalela umsakazo. 2. Bhalisela izinkundla ezikuvumela ukulalela Ukulalela umsakazo sekungokwakho. Bhalisela izinkundla ezikuvumela ukufinyelela kumasayithi omsakazo nge-inthanethi, okuvumela ukuba uthole izinhlelo ozithandayo, noma ngabe ukhona kuphi. 3. Khetha izinhlelo ezithembekile Thola izinhlelo zokusebenza ezinhle ezikuvumela ukuthi ulalele umsakazo, njengama-podcast noma iziteshi zomsakazo ezikwi-inthanethi. Qinisekisa ukuthi ulandela iziphakamiso ezivela kubangani noma kwabanye abantu abanolwazi. 4. Sebenzisa izikhangiso ezifanele Izingxoxo ezikwi-inthanethi, izikhangiso ze-social media, nezinhlelo zokusebenza zomsakazo zivame ukuhlinzeka ngezikhangiso ezithokozisayo. Yibamba udumo lwezikhangiso ezithakazelisayo ukuze uthole okuthakazelisa. 5. Bamba iqhaza emiphakathini Joyina imiphakathi ezinkundleni zokuxhumana ukuze ubambe ingxoxo nabanye abalandeli bomsakazo. Lokhu kuzokwenza ube nolwazi olunzulu ngama-programs owaziyo. 6. Qhubeka nokuhlola izinguquko Njalo hlola izindlela ezintsha zokulalela umsakazo. Izinkundla zokusakaza zihlala zishintsha, ngakho kufanele uhlale uhambisana nezinguquko futhi uvuselele ulwazi lwakho. Ngalezi zinyathelo, uzokwazi ukuhamba nezinguquko emikhubeni yokulalela umsakazo ngendlela efanele. Lokhu kuzokwenza ube nekhono lokuhlola nokuqonda okuqukethwe okuningi.

Ukuhlaziywa komkhakha wokukhiqiza okuqukethwe ku-YouTube Ngokukhula okukhulu kwe-YouTube, umkhakha wokukhiqiza okuqukethwe ubonakala uthuthuka ngokushesha, ulethe amathuba amaningi nezinselelo ezihlukahlukene. Ukukhiqizwa okuqukethwe, okukhuluma ngama-video ahlukahlukene, kuhloswe ukuheha izithameli eziningi, futhi lokhu sekubangele ukuthi abantu abaningi baqale ukwakha ama-channels abo. Ngokwesibalo esisha esikhishwe ngocwaningo lwe-Statista, i-YouTube inabantu abangaphezu kwezigidi eziyi-2.5 emhlabeni jikelele, okukhombisa umthelela omkhulu kuleli khasi. Lokhu kukhuthaza abakhiqizi ukuba baqhubeke nokwenza okuqukethwe okwakha ubudlelwano nezithameli zabo. Abakhiqizi bahlala bejolise ekwakheni okuqukethwe okuthokozisayo, okujabulisayo, nokufundisayo. Kodwa-ke, le mboni ibhekene nezinselelo eziningi, kuhlanganise nokuncintisana okukhulu. Njengoba abantu abaningi beqala ukukhiqiza, umkhiqizo ophumelelayo udinga ukuba uhluke, futhi lokhu kudinga ubuchwepheshe obuphambili, izinsiza ezinhle, kanye nesu eliqinile lokumaketha. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izinguquko ezisheshayo kumathrendi nezidingo zababukeli zenza kube nzima ukuba abakhiqizi bahlale behamba phambili. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, abakhiqizi abanamakhono, abaqonda izidingo zababukeli, bangathola amathuba okwenza imali ngale ndlela, ngokusebenzisa izikhangiso, ukuthengisa, noma ukuxhumana nabanye. Lokhu kukhuthaza umkhakha ukuthi uqhubeke uthuthuka, futhi kubonisa ukuthi i-YouTube iyinsika ebalulekile emhlabeni wokukhiqiza okuqukethwe. Ngokubheka phambili, umkhakha wokukhiqiza okuqukethwe ku-YouTube uzoba nendima ebalulekile ekwakheni amabhizinisi amasha, futhi uqhubeke nokwenza umthelela omkhulu emiphakathini eminingi.

Ukusetshenziswa kwezinkundla zokufunda online kubantu abadala Inqubo Yokufunda Ngaphandle Kwezakhiwo Zesikole 1. Ukukhetha Inkundla Qala ngokukhetha inkundla efanele yokufunda online. Bheka izinkundla ezihlinzeka ngezifundo ezihambelana nezifiso zakho, njenge Coursera, Udemy, noma edX. Qinisekisa ukuthi inkundla inikeza izifundo ezisemthethweni nezitholakala kalula. 2. Ukubhalisela I-akhawunti Ngemuva kokukhetha inkundla, bhalisela i-akhawunti. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukungena ngemvume, ukufaka imininingwane yakho, kanye nokuvuma imigomo nemibandela. Qinisekisa ukuthi usebenzisa i-imeyili efanele ukuze uthole izaziso ezibalulekile. 3. Ukukhetha Izifundo Ngemuva kokubhalisela i-akhawunti, hlola izifundo ezitholakalayo. Khetha izifundo ezihambisana nezinhloso zakho zokufunda. Ungakhetha izifundo ezithokozisayo, ezithinta umsebenzi wakho, noma ezithinta izifiso zakho. 4. Ukubhalisela Izifundo Uma usukhethile izifundo, bhalisela lezi zifundo. Lokhu kuvamise ukufaka ukukhetha “Bhalisela” noma “Qala” esikrinini. Qinisekisa ukuthi uyabhalisela izifundo ezikhethiwe ukuze uqhubeke. 5. Ukuhlela Isikhathi Sokufunda Hlela isikhathi sokufunda nsuku zonke. Ukufunda online kudinga ukuzimisela. Dala uhlelo lokufunda oluhambisana nezikhathi zakho, uqinisekise ukuthi unikeza isikhathi esanele sokuphothula izifundo. 6. Ukubamba Izingxoxo Sebenzisa izinkundla zokuxhumana ezitholakalayo ukuze uxoxe nabanye abafundi. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukufunda, ukwabelana ngolwazi, nokuxazulula izinkinga. 7.
