Ukuhlola Nokubuyekeza Ngemuva kokuphothula izifundo, hlola ulwazi olutholakele. Bheka izifundo ezithile, futhi uqinisekise ukuthi uyawuqonda kahle umqondo. Ungaphinda futhi ubuyekeze izifundo uma kudingeka. 8. Ukwenza Izicelo Zokufunda Uma usuphothulile izifundo, sebenzisa ulwazi lwakho ezintweni eziphilayo. Lokhu kungaba ukufaka izicelo emsebenzini, ukuthuthukisa amakhono, noma ukwenza izinqumo ezibalulekile empilweni yakho. Ngale ndlela, abantu abadala bangazuza kakhulu ekufundeni online, bekhulisa amakhono abo futhi bethola amathuba amasha.

UMNYANGO wezeMpilo KwaZulu-Natal usudalule izinto ocabanga ukuthi ziyimbangela yezibalo ezishaqisayo zokukhulelwa kwezingane nentsha ezirekhodiwe ngonyakamali u-2025/26.Imininingwane ikhombisa ukuthi zingu-421 izingane ezineminyaka engu-10 kuya ku-14 ezikhulelwe. Ngaphezu kwalokho, bangu-28 108 abakhulelwe ababikiwe entsheni eneminyaka engu-15 kuya ku-19. Phambilini abeChildline KZN bacashunwa kwi-IOL bezwakalisa ukukhathazeka ngokuthi izibalo zikhomba izinkinga zokuhlukunyezwa, ukuxhashazwa, ubumpofu, amagebe emfundo, ukuntuleka kokwesekwa kwentsha, ukungalingani, indawo engaphephile, kanye nokufa kwemindeni.Kuthiwa into ehamba phambili eholela intsha Ophathe wukufuna ukuzizwela umuzwa wokuya ocansini. Lokhu kubhebhethekiswa okomlilo wequbula yizinkundla zokuxhumana nezinhlelo zethelevishini.Ongoti bavumelana ngokuthi abazali babudedengu ekuqapheleni ukuthi izingane zabo yini eziyibukayo kwithelevishini nakumaselula. Bathi ngaleyo ndlela, izingane zingcina sezibuka izinto ezingakakulungeli ukuthi zizibone ngenxa yeminyaka. Kuthiwa izingane zigcina zibuka izinto ezingaziqondi bese zifuna ukuzizwela ngokwazo ukuthi lezo zinto zinjani uma zenziwa. Kwenye inkathi kuyenzeka kwithelevishini kungene into engazilungele izingane zibe zibuka zihleli nabazali. Lapha kuvela ukuthi abanye abazali baye bangakwazi ukulawula isimo ngendlela efanele. Leli phuzu ligqamisa abazali abangakwazi ukukhuluma nezingane zabo ngezinto okungafanele zingene kuzo. Kuhlaluka ukuthi yisifo sakhona esesithathwa njengamahlalakhona kwabansundu ukungakhulumi nezingane ngezinto ezijulile okubalwa kuzo nokuya ocansini.

Umthelela Wokwanda Kwezindawo Zokusebenza EziHlanganyelwayo (Co-Working Spaces) Isingeniso Eminyakeni yamuva, izindawo zokusebenza ezihlanganyelwayo ziye zaqhubekela phambili kakhulu, zikhanga abantu abaningi abafuna indawo yokusebenza engabizi, ethokomele futhi enobudlelwano. Lezi zindawo azigcini nje ngokuba izindawo zokusebenza, kodwa ziba yizikhala zokuxhumana, zokubambisana, nezokwakha ubudlelwano. Umthelela Emnothweni Ukuvela kwezindawo zokusebenza ezihlanganyelwayo kukhuthaze ukuhweba nokwandiswa kwamabhizinisi amancane. Lokhu kudala amathuba emisebenzi, kuthuthukisa imikhiqizo, futhi kukhuthaza ukusungulwa kwezixazululo ezintsha. Abantu abaningi, ikakhulukazi ohwebo abasha, bathola ukuthi izindawo zokusebenza ezihlanganyelwayo zibavumela ukuba basebenzisane, babelane ngemicabango, futhi baphucule izinga labo lokusebenza. Umthelela Kwezokuxhumana Izindawo zokusebenza ezihlanganyelwayo ziqinisa imikhakha yokuxhumana phakathi kwabantu. Lokhu kudala inethiwekhi enkulu yabantu abavela ezindaweni ezahlukene, okuvumela ukubambisana kwezobuchwepheshe nezimboni ezahlukene. Ngakho-ke, izinkampani ziba nekhono lokuthola izixazululo ezingcono, kwanda ukuxhumana phakathi kwazo. Umthelela Kwezempilo Yengqondo Ngaphezu kwezinzuzo zomnotho, izindawo zokusebenza ezihlanganyelwayo zikhuthaza impilo yengqondo engcono. Ukusebenza endaweni enabantu abaningi kudala umuzwa wokuxhumana, okwakha umoya omuhle wokusebenza. Lokhu kunciphisa imiphumela emibi yokusebenza wedwa, njengokukhathazeka nokudangala. Isiphetho Ngokwanda kwezindawo zokusebenza ezihlanganyelwayo, kuvela amathuba amasha emnothweni, kuthuthukiswa ubudlelwano, nokuphuculwa kwempilo yengqondo. Ukuze sizuze kokubili kumphakathi nasemphakathini, kubalulekile ukuhlinzeka ngalesi sikhala esisha, esinobungane, nesikhuthazayo. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukwakha ikusasa eliqhakazile labantu bonke.

"UNtuli unxuse abantu ukuthi behlise umoya, wathi akufanele kubukeke sengathi abantu baKwaZulu-Natal bacwasa abantu bokufika.Ukusho lokhu ngesikhathi ekhuluma nabeSABC News. "Kufanele kucace ukuthi inkinga esinayo ingabantu abakuleli ngokungemthetho. Akufanele kube nokudideka kule nto. Umuntu wangaphandle ofuna ukuba kuleli kufanele abe namaphepha amgunyaza ukuba abe kuleli. Abangenawo amaphepha kufanele babuyele emazweni abo. "UMkhwanazi yena uthe usazoba nomhlangano nabaholi bezinhlangano ezihlela imibhikisho.UMkhwanazi uthe ababhikishi abakuqeqeshelwe ukubona ukuthi abantu bokufika banamaphepha aqondile yini.Ukusho lokhu ngesikhathi ekhuluma nabeNewzroom Afrika. "Uma ababhikishi benolwazi ngabantu bokufika abakuleli ngokungemthetho kufanele babikele amaphoyisa kube yiwona aphenyayo. Bazogcina sebephambanisa nabantu balana eNingizimu Afrika bebadidanisa nabokufika."

"Emva kokuthola le mininingwane, babe sebebadubula bebabulala bobathathu. Laba abanye abagilwa abane, bona bagwazwe, baze bafa,” kusho uNetshiunda. Uthe uphenyo lwamaphoyisa luveze ukuthi ngoLwesibili ebusuku kanjalo nangoLwesithathu ekuseni, kube nemali ekhishwe emabhange abagilwa izikhawu eziningi. UKhomishana wamaPhoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uLieutenant General Mkhwanazi, uwashayele ihlombe amaphoyisa ngokusheshe ababophe abasolwa. Ube eseyalela abaphenyi ukuthi baqinisekise ukuthi ubulungiswa buyenzeka ukuze izihlobo zabagilwa zizothobeka amanxeba. Uthe kuyakhathaza ukuzwa ukuthi omunye wabasolwa ubeqashwe abagilwa. "Siyabanxusa abaqashi ukuthi abazikhathaze ngokuthola ulwazi ngomuntu abamqashayo, baphinde bayihlole indlela yabo yokuziphatha esolisayo,” kusho uMkhwanazi. Uthe imvamisa, ezindaweni ezingamapulazi noma ezithe qekelele, amacala enziwa ngabantu ngabagilwa ababaziyo noma abasondelene nabo.

Isibhamu sabuyiselwa kuSnyman ekuseni ngosuku okwaphuma ngalo isinqumo sokuthi akanacala. Lokho kusho ukuthi wabuyiselwa isibhamu ngaphambi kokuthi kuphume isinqumo senkantolo. "UMalema uqhuba athi uCesar akanalo igunya lokukhipha umyalelo wokuthi kubuyiselwe uSnyman isibhamu.UMalema uthe yimantshi noma ijaji abanamandla okunquma ukuba kubuyiselwe ubufakazi emuva uma sekuphothulwe icala. "Kusobala ukuthi wephula imigomo yeNPA uCesar ngokukhipha umyalelo angagunyaziwe ukuba awukhiphe. "Kusale kancane ukuba uMalema ayolala ezikhindini ngesikhathi inkantolo imgweba iminyaka emihlanu ebhadla ejele ngesonto eledlule.UMalema wasindiswa wukuthi wafaka isicelo sokuphonsela inselelo isigwebo sakhe.Inkantolo yabe isimdedela ngesexwayiso.Isicelo sikaMalema sokuphonsela inselelo isigwebo sakhe sizolalelwa enkantolo enkulu.Ukugwetshwa kukaMalema iminyaka emihlanu ebhadla ejele kubeka engcupheni isikhundla sakhe sokuba yilungu lePhalamende.Umthetho awumuvumeli umuntu oseke wadonsa isigwebo esingaphezu kwezinyanga ezingu-12 ukuthi abe yilungu lePhalamende.

ZITAKULWE yiqembu Inkatha Freedom Party (IFP) izelamani zakwaNzimande eSikhalambazo, eMandeni, ku-ward 15, ebezihlala endlini esesimweni esingagwinyisi amathe ngenxa yokuthi ibingaqediwe ukwakhiwa, ingenamawindi futhi ingenazo nezicabha.Lapha kukhulunywa ngoNksz Lindelwa Nzimande (50) ohamba ngesihlalo esinamasondo kanye nomfowabo uMnuz Mjabuliseni Nzimande (48) ohamba ngezinduku.Ngemuva kokuba loyo oyilungu lophiko lukazwelonke kwi-IFP futhi ogaqele esokuhola leli qembu eMandeni, uMnuz Lonhle Gumede, ezwile ngalokhu usukumele phezulu wayiqedela indlu wathenga amawindi nezicabha washiya negilosa.UGumede uhambele kulo muzi ephelezelwa ngamanye amalungu e-IFP. Uthe kuyinto eseqhulwini ngaso sonke isikhathi kubona beyiNkatha ukuqikinisekisa ukuthi bayanakekelwa abantu abaphila nokukhubazeka. ''Ngesikhathi ngizwa ngalokhu ngibone kungcono ukuba ngingayizibi le nto kodwa ngisukume ngifake isandla. Ngiwumuntu okholelwayo kakhulu ekutheni kumele bathandwe futhi banakekelwe ngayo yonke indlela ikakhulu labo abaphila nokukhubazeka,''echaza.Uthe uyafisa ukuthi bathole ukusizakala nabanye abantu abaphila nokukhubazeka abasezingxenyeni ezehlukene zeKwaZulu-Natal kanjalo naseNingizimu Afrika jikelele. ''Lena yinselelo kunoma ngubani ukuthi lapho ekhona abhukule kube khona akwenzayo ukulekelela abantu abaphila nokukhubazeka.

ASHAYA phansi ngonyawo amaKhomanisi athi ngeke avume ukuchukuluzwa yi-ANC.Lokhu kushiwo unobhala jikelele weSACP uMnuz Solly Mapaila, othe abakaze bayibuke njengesitha i-ANC. "Asikaze sibe nenkinga yokuthi i-ANC ingenela ukhetho. Asikaze siqondise muntu ubugwegwe ngokuvotela i-ANC. Ngeke sivume ukuthi kuchukuluzwe amalungu ethu ," kusho uMapaila. Usho lokhu nje i-ANC neSACP babhekene ngeziqu zamehlo ngodaba lokungenela ukhetho ngokuzimela kweSACP. Phambilini iSACP ibivota ne-ANC kanti manje lezi zinhlangano zizoba yizimbangi.UMapaila uthe eminyakeni engu-30 edlule, bebelokhu beseka i-ANC kanti bebeze bayikhankasele. "Siyaqhubeka asijiki ekungeneleni ukhetho oluzayo. Ngeke sisatshiswe muntu ngokungenela ukhetho," kuqhuba uMapaila. Uyalele amalungu eSACP ukuthi angavumeli muntu ukuthi awasabise. "Ningavumi ukusatshiswa nganoma yingani njengoba singenela ukhetho. Ningasuli ngoba nisatshiswa," usho kanje.Uthe ngeke bawachukuluze amalungu anquma ukuqhubeka nokuba yingxenye ye-ANC. "Sizosihlonipha isinqumo samalungu asala kwi-ANC, ngeke siwakhiphe inyumbazana. Akekho umuntu okumele asatshiswe ngoba siphila ngokwentando yabantu eyalwelwa kanzima." Ugqugquzele abahlukunyezwayo ukuthi babike ngokushesha. "Abasatshiswayo kanjalo nabathuswa ngokuthi bazoqondiswa ubugwegwe, abasibikele ngokushesha. Akwesekwe namalungu ethu ajutshwe kuhulumeni yi-ANC." Uthe abayona ingozi kwi-ANC wathi into eyingozi kakhulu ukulawulwa koMbuso yidlanzana kanjalo nokulahleka kwethemba kubasebenzi.

Idokhumenti Yenqubomgomo: Ukuhlaziywa Kokwanda Kokusebenza Kwama-Robot Embonini Isingeniso Ngokwanda kwezehlakalo zomhlaba jikelele, ubuchwepheshe bama-robot busebenza njengengxenye ebalulekile yokuthuthukiswa kwezindlela zokukhiqiza. Le dokhumenti ihlose ukuhlaziywa kokusebenza kwama-robot embonini, ukuze kuqondwe kanjani lokhu kukhula kuzothinta umnotho, umkhiqizo, kanye nezisebenzi. Ukuhlaziywa Kokusebenza Kwama-Robot Ukusebenza kwama-robot embonini kukhule kakhulu ezikhathini zakamuva ngenxa yokuthuthukiswa kobuchwepheshe be-AI (Artificial Intelligence) ne-automation. Lokhu kukhula kube nesandla ekwenzeni imikhiqizo ibe namandla, lwenze kube lula ukuhlinzeka ngezidingo zabathengi. Izinzuzo ezibalulekile zifaka phakathi: 1. Ukuphucula Umkhiqizo: Ama-robot aqinisekisa ukwenziwa kwezingxenye eziningi ngasikhathi sinye, okwandisa izinga lokukhiqiza. 2. Ukunciphisa Izindleko: Ngenxa yokusebenza okunembile kwama-robot, izindleko zokukhiqiza zincipha, okuholela ekutholeni inzuzo ethuthukisiwe. 3. Izimpendulo Ezisheshayo: Ukuze uhlangabezane nezidingo ezishintshashintshayo, ama-robot angaguqulwa kalula ukuze ahlangabezane nezimfuneko zemboni. Izinkinga Nezixazululo Nokho, kukhona izinselelo ezihambisana nokwanda kokusebenza kwama-robot, ezifana nokukhathazeka ngokuqashwa kwezisebenzi. Ukuze sukuqhamuka nezinkinga, kudinga ukusungulwa kwemigomo ethile yokuhlanganisa ama-robot nezisebenzi ezikhona, ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi ukephukele ukuthola imbango phakathi kwamathuba ezintsha nokugcinwa kwemisebenzi. Isiphetho Ukuze iNkampani yethu iqhubeke nokukhula nokuphumelela ngaphansi kwalesi simo, kubalulekile ukuhlinzekela ukusungulwa kwama-policy ajulile ahlanganisa zonke lezi zici. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube nokuthula phakathi kokusebenza kwama-robot nemisebenzi yabantu, kuqinisekisa impumelelo yangaphakathi nelokhu sisebenzisana nenhlalakahle yomphakathi.

"Ngizizwa ngithobeke kakhulu ukungena ezicathulweni zowumsunguli waleli, uNkk Zanele KaMagwaza Msibi, ongasekho. Izithunywa ezisethembe ngokuyisa phambili iqembu, zisinike umyalelo wokuthi sidale ubumbano, sinxenxe amalungu asebuholini baphambilini - abengekho kule ngqungquthela - ekutheni sibuyisane ukuze sikwazi ukuliyisa phambili. Izithunywa zithe kumele sidale ukuthula, silwe nesihlava esifaka ehlazweni sokugijima izinkantolo,” usho kanje.Uthe bazophinde belwele ukulungisa isimo ne- Independent Electoral Commission ikwazi ukubabuyisela ohlwini lwamaqembu angenele ukhetho.Abanye abaqokwe nguMnuz Milton Sokhela okhethwe ngo- elethu kwesePhini likaMengameli, uMnuz Sibusiso Mkhabela kwesikaSihlalo, uMnuz Rodney Hlatshwayo kwesePhini likaSihlalo, uMnuz Teddy Thwala kwesikaNobhala-Jikelele noNksz Sithembile Msomi kwesephini lakhe.Bekuyingqungquthela yesibili yokukhetha ubuholi baleli qembu elisungulwe ngo-2011 nguKaMagwaza Msibi owayesuka kwi-IFP. Yize kunjalo, ubuholi obuqokwe kweyango-2019, obusafake isicelo sokuthi kubuyekezwe ukuhlakazwa kwabo njengoba inkantolo yayinqume kanjalo phambili emva kwezikhalo zokuthi akuhanjiswanga ngesikhathi buqokwa, uyaphikisana nale ngqungqutthela. Lobu buholi buveza ukuthi buzokuphonsela inselelo ukuhlala kwale ngqungquthela. Kubona kukhona uMnuz Canaan Mdletshe, kanti buthi njengoba inkantolo ibavumelile ngenyanga edlule ukuthi bangasifaka isicelo sokubuyekezwa kokuhlakazwa kwabo, ngakho ubuholi babo busamile kuze kuphume isinqumo.

Ukukhula komkhakha wokuthengisa online kubathengisi abazimele Ezinsukwini zamuva, umkhakha wokuthengisa online ubone ukuhamba phambili okukhulu, ikakhulukazi kubathengisi abazimele. Lokhu kukhula kuchazwe yindlela abantu abaningi abathanda ngayo ukuthenga imikhiqizo nemikhiqizo etholakala ku-inthanethi. Ukuthengisa online akusangokuphathwa kwezinhlangano ezinkulu kuphela, kodwa sekuyithuba elikhulu kubathengisi abazimele. Ngokwenyuka kwezinkundla zokuxhumana, abathengisi bazitholele ithuba lokufinyelela ikhasimende elikhulu. Izinkundla ezifana ne-Facebook, Instagram, ne-TikTok zenza kube lula ukufinyelela abantu abaningi futhi bathumele imikhiqizo yabo. Lokhu kudala ubudlelwano obusondelene nosizo olukhululekile phakathi kwabathengisi nabathengi. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ubuchwepheshe bokuthengisa online buvumela abathengisi abazimele ukuba benze kahle ngezindleko. Ngaphandle kokuba nezikhulumi ezinkulu zokuthengisa, abathengisi bangakha izitolo eziku-inthanethi ezilula. Lokhu kunciphisa izindleko zokuphakela nezokumaketha, kwenza kube lula kubo ukuqhuba ibhizinisi. Nokho, kufanele kuthiwe ukuthengisa online kudinga ukuzikhandla nokuhlonipha izimiso zokusiza ukudala igama elihle. Ukuze ube phezulu, abathengisi abazimele kudingeka ukuthi bahlale bevuselela izindlela zokumaketha, bakhe ubudlelwano obuqinile nabathengi, futhi bahlale benolwazi oluqinile ngemikhiqizo yabo. Ngokubanzi, ukwanda kokuthengisa online kubathengisi abazimele kuveza amathuba amaningi. Ngokusebenzisa ubuchwepheshe obufanele, izinkundla zokuxhumana, kanye nezindlela zokumaketha ezisebenzayo, abathengisi bangakwazi ukukhulisa ibhizinisi labo nokuqinisekisa impumelelo eside. Ukubambisana nabathengi bakha umgogodla wobudlelwane obuqinile, okwenza umkhakha ube nezindaba ezinhle zokuqhubekela phambili.

Indima yezokuvakasha zasemakhaya ekuthuthukiseni umnotho wendawo Ngokubona kwami, izokuvakasha zasemakhaya zidlala indima ebalulekile ekuthuthukiseni umnotho wendawo. Njengoba umhlaba uqhubeka nokushintsha, abantu badinga ukuphuma emakhaya abo ukuze bahlolisise izindawo ezihlukahlukene. Lokhu kudala ithuba elihle lokuthi izindawo zasemakhaya zikhulise umnotho wazo. Izindawo zasemakhaya, ezinomlando ocebile namasiko ahlukahlukene, ziwumthombo omuhle wezokuvakasha. Uma izivakashi zifika, zikhuthaza ukuhweba, zikhuthaza abanikazi bamabhizinisi bendawo, futhi zandisa amathuba emisebenzi. Lokhu akugcini nje ngokuthuthukisa umnotho, kodwa futhi kusiza ekwakheni umphakathi oqinile, lapho abantu behlangana futhi babelane ngamasiko nemicabango. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izokuvakasha zasemakhaya zikhuthaza ukuvikelwa kwemvelo. Izivakashi zifuna ukuzithokozisa ngemvelo, okwenza kube nemizamo eminingi yokugcina izindawo zihlanzekile futhi zihlala zikhangayo. Lokhu kudala isimo esihle sokuthi abantu baziqhenye ngendawo yabo, baphile kahle, futhi bahloniphe imvelo. Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukuthi uhulumeni nabantu bendawo basebenzisane ukuze bathuthukise izinhlelo zezokuvakasha. Lokhu kungafaka phakathi ukwakha izinsiza, ukuxhasa amabhizinisi amancane, nokukhuthaza izinhlelo zokuvakasha ezihambisana nemvelo. Uma sikwazi ukuhlinzeka ngezinsiza ezinhle, sizokwazi ukuheha izivakashi eziningi, okuzoletha izinzuzo ezinkulu emnothweni wethu. Ngokubambisana, singakha ikusasa eliqhakazile kwezokuvakasha zasemakhaya, okuzosiza ekuthuthukiseni umnotho wendawo, futhi sithuthukise impilo yabantu bethu. Indima yethu njengabantu bendawo ibalulekile, futhi kufanele sisebenzise leli thuba ukuze sakhe umphakathi onempilo, ophumelelayo.

Ngaphakathi kwedolobha elincane laseMkhanyakude, kwakukhona ibhizinisi elincane elibizwa ngokuthi "Izimanga Zothando." Le bhizinisi yayithengisa izipho ezihlukahlukene, ikakhulukazi ezokubhalela, kodwa yayidla kanzima ngenxa yokuncintisana okukhulu. Umnini wayo, uNokuthula, wayefuna indlela yokwenza ibhizinisi lakhe likhule futhi lithole amakhasimende amasha. Ngolunye usuku, uNokuthula wathola ithuba lokuphendula izidingo zabalakishi abasha. Waqala ukufunda ngemicimbi yezezimali zedijithali, okwakubizwa nge-cryptocurrency. Wathola ukuthi lezi zimali zaziwusizo, futhi abantu abaningi babefuna ukuyisebenzisa ukuthenga imikhiqizo. U-Nokuthula wathola ukuthi, uma engafaka lezi zimali ebhizinisini lakhe, angathola amakhasimende amasha akhuluma ngempela ngalesi sikhathi se-cryptocurrency. Ngesonto elilandelayo, u-Nokuthula wenza izinguquko. Waqala ukwamukela i-Bitcoin njengendlela yokukhokha. Lokhu kwashintsha yonke into. Amakhasimende amaningi afika, ethenga izipho zakhe, futhi abanye baphinde baba sebenzisa lezi zimali ezintsha ezikhangayo. U-Nokuthula wathola ukuthi, ngokwamukela i-cryptocurrency, akonlywa kuphela ukumkhuthaza, kodwa kwavula nesango lokubambisana nezinkampani ezinkulu ezisebenzisa lezi zimali. Ngokuvamile, ibhizinisi lika-Nokuthula laqhubeka nokukhula. Waqonda ukuthi ukuhambisana nezinguquko zesikhathi kubalulekile. U-Nokuthula waphinde waphakamisa umbono wokuthi amabhizinisi amancane angavuma izinguquko, futhi angasebenzisa amathuba aphuma ezimakethe ukuze akhule ekuphileni. Ngaleso sikhathi, ubufakazi bokuthi i-cryptocurrency ingaba usizo emabhizinisini amancane, kwavula umnyango omusha, okwakuhambisana nezifiso zakhe zokwandisa ibhizinisi lakhe.

SEWUQOKE imenenja entsha uMasipala wesiFunda uMzinyathi oholwa yiMeya uNkk Thembisile Mchunu. Okhethwe kulesi sikhundla nguMnuz Mlungisi Ntanzi obebambile kusona phambilini.UNkk Mchunu uthe uyabethemba kakhulu ubuholi bukaNtanzi ukuthi uzokwazi ukwenza izinto ngendlela. Uchaze lesi sikhundla njengesiwumgogodla wokusebenza kukamasipala. ''Anginakho nokuncane nje ukungabaza ukuthi uNtanzi uzokwazi ukwenza umsebenzi omuhle kulesi sikhundla. Okuhle kakhulu wukuthi ubevele ebambile kusona lokho kuzokwenza ukuthi akwazi ukuqhubeka nento ayiqonda kangcono,'' usho kanjena.Ube esenxusa bonke abasebenzi bakamasipala ukuthi bameseke uNtanzi ukuze aqhubeke nokusebenza kahle nangokuzikhandla.Ekhuluma ngemuva kokuqokwa kwakhe uNtanzi uthe okuseqhulwini kuyena ukwenza konke okusemandleni ngenhloso yokubhekana ngqo nodaba lwenkinga yamanzi.NgokukaNtanzi uyakuqonda kahle kamhlophe ukuthi abantu bakule ndawo bafisa kangakanani ukuthi kugcine kuxazululeke inkinga yamanzi.Ugcizelele ukuthi ufuna ukubuyisa isithunzi salo masipala ngokuthi kuxazululwe ingwadla yokushoda kwamanzi.NgoLwesithathu uNtanzi nePhini leMeya eMzinyathi, uNksz Nothile Zungu, bahambele uMasipala waseMvoti beyohlola umsebenzi wokufakwa kwamanzi okuqhubekayo KwaLatha, eMvoti.Iphini lemeya lithembise ukuthi kuyothi kuphela unyaka umsebenzi usuphothuliwe, abantu bakule ndawo sebewathola amanzi kompompi.

Ukukhula komkhakha wokuthengisa online kubathengisi abazimele Emhlabeni wanamuhla, ubuchwepheshe buhamba phambili ngokushesha, futhi lokhu kubonakala kakhulu emkhakheni wokuthengisa. Ngalesi sikhathi, abathengisi abazimele bathola ithuba elikhulu lokukhula futhi bakhe ibhizinisi labo online. Ngithanda ukusho ukuthi lesi sikhathi sithokozisa, kodwa futhi sinesibopho esikhulu. Okokuqala, ukuthengisa online kunikeza abathengisi abazimele ithuba lokufinyelela emakethe enkulu ngaphandle kokukhathazeka ngokuphatha izitolo zomzimba. Lokhu kuhlanganisa namathuba okuthengisa kwezinye izifunda nezwe lonke, okwenza kube lula ukuheha amakhasimende amasha. Ngokusebenzisa izinkundla ezahlukene zokuxhumana, abathengisi bangakwazi ukufinyelela abantu abaningi, futhi lokhu kuhle kakhulu ekwandiseni ibhizinisi. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukusebenzisa izinhlelo zokuphathwa kokuthengisa online kwenza kube lula ukuhlela izinsiza ezisemqoka. Abathengisi bangabheka kalula ukuthengiswa kwabo, izidingo zamakhasimende, nokuphendula imibuzo ngasikhathi sinye. Lokhu kusiza ekwakheni ubudlelwano obuqinile namakhasimende, okwandisa amathuba okwenza imali. Nokho, ukukhula komkhakha kudinga ukuthi abathengisi bazibophezele ekwenzeni ucwaningo olujulile. Ukukhula komhlaba wokuthengisa online kuhilela izinselelo ezahlukene, okubandakanya ukuncintisana okukhulu. Ngakho-ke, abathengisi abazimele kufanele babe nezinhlelo ezicacile zokumaketha, ukuze bakwazi ukugcina indawo yabo emakethe. Ngokubuka konke, ukukhula komkhakha wokuthengisa online kubathengisi abazimele kuveza amathuba amaningi. Kodwa ke, ukuze baphumelele, kubalulekile ukuthi bazivocavoce, balandele izitayela ezintsha, futhi baqhubeke nokufunda. Lokhu kuzobasiza ukuba baphumelele ezimakethe ezishintshashintshayo, futhi balondoloze ibhizinisi labo isikhathi eside.

UYATHUTHUMELA owesifazane wakwa-H, eMlaza, othi ubhacile njengoba esaba ukuthi umyeni wakhe kungenzeka aphinde amenze isilo sengubo njengoba ezame ukumdubula kodwa wamshweba waphinda wamgxokogxa ngesikele esithweni sakhe sangasese. UNksz Wendy Zondi (36) wakwa-H, eMlaza, uvele ahlengezele izinyembezi uma echaza ngokulimala kwakhe athi kwenzeke ezinyangeni ezedlule.Uthe umyeni wakhe, uMnuz Kagiso Ndimande (38) wafika endlini ntambama baba nokuhilizisana nakhona athi akaqondi ukuthi kahle hle kwakubangelwa yini, wathi umyeni wakhe wafika ekhaya "edle amponjwana" wakhala ngokuthi akakuthandi ukujwayelwa kabi umuntu omganile.UNksz Ndimande uthe kuthe uma embuza ukuthi kwenzekani kodwa engaphenduli, kunalokho ebelesela amazwi awodwa wokuthi akakuthandi ukujwayelwa kabi.Eqhuba, uthe umyeni wakhe ube eseqonda kuyena ehlezi kusofa wamqala ngempama, wathi esababaza lokho wamane wadonsa isibhamu sakhe wamshaya ngesidunu emhlane nasekhanda..Uthe waqhubeka wamshaya waze wadubula kodwa engamphenduli uma embuza ukuthi kwenzenjani futhi woneni ukuze axolise, wathi wayengezwa mshini, wamthatha wamyisa egumbini labo okuyilapho amkhumule khona ngezansi naye wase eyakhumula ibhulukwe. ''Ngaleso sikhathi bengizitshela ukuthi uzothamba mhlawumbe usefuna senze inkonzo yasekameleni kanti angibuzanga, umuntu kukhulu afuna ukukwenza kimina,'' echaza.Uthe umyeni wakhe ube esemthatha emsondeza kahle wambeka echosheni lombhede samuntu abazokwenza inkonzo njengoba naye ekhumule ibhulukwe. "Emqondweni wami bese ngizitshela ukuthi siya ocansini,'' echaza.Uthe umuzwe esememeza esethi ngeke aze alale naye yena ngoba uyamcika futhi unephunga elingelihle.

KONKE sekumi ngomumo ngomcimbi waminyaka yonke wokuhlonipha nokuklomelisa osomabhizinisi bemikhakha ehlukene, nozohambisana nombukiso wokukhangisa ngamabhizinisi abo, amaBambelela Business Awards.Lo mcimbi ohlelwa yiHollywood Foundaton, okhuza ibuya ihlandla lesithathu nonyaka, uzoqala ngombukiso wamabhizinisi ngo-Ephreli 28 ngo-8 ekuseni, bese kuba wumcimbi wokuklomelisa osomabhizinisi ngo-Ephreli 29 ngo-6 kusihlwa - kokubili okuzoba seHollywoodbets Greyville Convention Centre, eThekwini.Kulo mncintiswano, osekwa nawuhulumeni waKwaZulu-Natal, kuzoklonyeliswa osomabhizinisi basesifundazweni abaqhamuka ezindaweni ezihlukene okubalwa kuzona iTheku, uMgungundlovu, Ulundi, Greytown, Richards Bay, Mpangeni nasePort Shepstone.Okhulumela iHollywood Foundation, uNksz Vuyisile Ngobese, uthe nonyaka lo mcimbi bawenze belandela indikimba ethi "Rooted in KZN, Advancing Township and Rural SMMEs for Inclusive and Sustainable Economic Growth", okusho ukuthi babheke ukufukula osomabhizinisi basemalokishini nabasezindaweni zasemakhaya ukuze kusimame umnotho. "Emva kohlelo lokuhlunga, sigcine siqoke amabhizinisi awu-128 eKZN yonkana ukuthi abambe iqhaza ohlelweni lwanonyaka. Sibaqoke eminxeni ehlukene okubalwa owezobuchwepheshe besimanje, ezokwakha, imboni yemfashini, ezempilo nezobuhle okubamba iqhaza elimqoka ukufukula umnotho wesifundazwe sethu,” kusho uNksz Ngobese.Eqhuba, udalule ukuthi kulokhu baqikelelile ukuthi kuqhakambiseke kakhulu osomabhizinisi besifazane njengoba bewu-66% abangenelile, okusho ukuthi nembokodo izoba neqhaza elinqala nelibonakalayo ekukhuliseni umnotho nokuthuthukisa umphakathi.

Indima yemidlalo yendabuko ekwakheni ubumbano emphakathini Umbuzo 1: Yini imidlalo yendabuko? Imidlalo yendabuko ingelinye lamagugu omlando, evame ukudlalwa ukuze kugcinwe amasiko namasiko omphakathi. Le midlalo ivame ukudlalwa emicimbini ehlukene futhi ibonisa ubuqotho bendawo. Umbuzo 2: Yini indima yemidlalo yendabuko emphakathini? Imidlalo yendabuko ikhulisa ubumbano, ibandakanya abantu abavela ezizindeni ezahlukene, futhi iyindlela yokuxhuma abantu. Abantu badlale ndawonye, bakhumbulane ngezimfundiso, futhi baphinde banikeze intshisekelo emlandweni wabo. Umbuzo 3: Zithinta kanjani izizukulwane ezahlukene? Imidlalo yendabuko iyinsiza yokudlulisa ulwazi phakathi kwezizukulwane. Izingane zifunda ngemvelaphi nomlando wezindawo zabo, kuyilapho abadala bejabulisa futhi behlaziya izindlela ezihambisana nokwenziwa. Umbuzo 4: Ingabe imidlalo yendabuko ingavusa impilo yomphakathi? Yebo, imidlalo yendabuko ingasiza ekwakheni umphakathi ophilayo. Lokhu kwenzeka ngesikhathi semicimbi, lapho abantu bejoyina, behlanganyela, futhi befaka izandla ekuphumeleleni kwezinjongo zomphakathi. Umbuzo 5: Kungenzeka kanjani ukuthi imidlalo yendabuko iqhubeke isekhona? Ukuze imidlalo yendabuko iqhubeke, kubalulekile ukuhlinzekwa ngezinsiza, ukufundiswa kwezingane, nokuxhaswa komphakathi. Ukubamba imicimbi njalo nokuhlonipha le midlalo kuyasiza ekugcineni isiko. Umbuzo 6: Yini esingayenza ukuze sithuthukise indima yemidlalo yendabuko? Singenza konke okusemandleni ethu ukuhlela imicimbi, ukufundisa imidlalo ezikoleni, nokuheha abantu abaningi ukuba babambe iqhaza. Imidlalo yendabuko iyindlela yokwakha ubumbano oluqinile emphakathini.

ISILO samaZulu uMisuzulu Sinqobile kaZwelithini, sigqugquzele abantu ikakhulu intsha ukuthi babhalisele ukuvota okhethweni oluzayo.IMbube ithe yeseka umsebenzi weKhomishini yoKhetho kuleli, esemkhankasweni wokukhuthaza abantu ukuthi babhalisele ukuvota okhethweni lohulumeni basekhaya. Sikusho lokhu emuva kokuhlangana nezikhulu zekhomishini, esigodlweni eMashobeni, oPhongolo ngoLwesibili.Okhulumela ihhovisi leSilo, uMntwana Thulani Zulu, uthe iMbube iweseka ngokugcwele umsebenzi wekhomishini njengoba kuza ukhetho. "IMbube igqugquzele abantu ikakhulu intsha ukuthi ibhalise ukuze ivote. Inxuse intsha ukuthi ikwenze lokhu ngokuthula," kusho uMntwana Thulani.Uthe izikhulu zekhomishini zisemkhankasweni wokuhambela izinhlaka zobuholi bomdabu njengoba kuzoba nokhetho. "Ithimba labekhomishini lenabe ngezinhlelo zokhetho okubalwa namalungiselelo alo. Likhulume nangomkhankaso wokufundisa abantu ngokuvota." Uthe kubhungwe nangombiko wakamuva oveze ukuthi abantu baKwaZulu-Natal, bamanqika ukuthi bavote ngoba sebelahle ithemba kuhulumeni.Kuzokhumbuleka ukuthi lo mbiko waveza ukuthi abantu bakulesi sifundazwe sebelahle ithemba kakhulu uma kuqhathaniswa nezinye izifundazwe ngokuvota ngenxa yokuthi abasamethembi uhulumeni.UMntwana Thulani uthe bayakwamukela ukuthi ikhomishini iyabuhlonipha ubuholi bomdabu nokugqugquzela abantu basemakhaya ukuthi bavote. Izikhulu zekhomishini bezikulesi sifundazwe lonke leli sonto zizoxoxa nezinhlaka ezehlukene okubalwa noNdunankulu wesifundazwe, uMnuz Thami Ntuli.

Ukusetshenziswa kwama-drone kwezolimo zanamuhla Ngokukhula kwezobuchwepheshe, ama-drone sekwaba yinsiza ebalulekile emkhakheni wezolimo. Ukusetshenziswa kwama-drone kwezolimo zanamuhla kuholele ekuthuthukisweni kwezindlela zokulima, kunciphisa izindleko, futhi kuthuthukisa umkhiqizo. Lokhu kubonakala ngokucacile emikhakheni ehlukene, okuhlanganisa ukuhlola izitshalo, ukuphathwa kwezinsiza, kanye nokuhlola izimo zezulu. Ama-drone akwazi ukuhlola izindawo ezinkulu ngokushesha, enza kube lula ukufinyelela kulwazi olubalulekile. Ngokusebenzisa ama-sensors, ama-drone angathola izinkomba zokukhula kwezitshalo, izifo, kanye nezidingo zamanzi. Lokhu kwenza abalimi bakwazi ukwenza izinqumo eziphusile, okwandisa umkhiqizo futhi kunciphisa ukusetshenziswa kwezinsiza. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ama-drone angasetshenziswa ekuphakamiseni izithako zokulima, okwenza kube lula ukufaka imfertilizer noma imithi yokulawula izifo. Lokhu kuhlinzeka ngendlela ephumelelayo yokuphatha izinsiza, kunciphisa ukungcola, futhi kunciphisa isikhathi sokusebenza. Nokho, kukhona nezinselelo ezihambisana nokusetshenziswa kwama-drone. Izindleko zokuqala zokuthenga nokugcina ama-drone zingaba phezulu, futhi kudingeka ukuqeqeshwa okuthile ukuze abasebenzi bakwazi ukuwasebenzisa kahle. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izinkinga zomthetho ezihlobene nokusebenzisa ama-drone emapulazini zidinga ukuba zicatshangelwe. Ngokuphetha, ukusetshenziswa kwama-drone kwezolimo zanamuhla kuyinsiza ewusizo kakhulu, ethuthukisa ukusebenza kahle nokukhiqiza. Njengoba ubuchwepheshe buqhubeka nokuthuthuka, kulindeleke ukuthi ama-drone azoba yinxenye ebalulekile emkhakheni wezolimo, anika abalimi amathuba amasha okuphumelela.

I-ANC isabisa ngokuthi izobadiliza ezikhundleni zikahulumeni labo abazoqoma ukukhankasela idlelandawonye layo elikhethe ukungenela ukhetho ngokuzimela, i-SACP.UNobhala Jikelele we-ANC, uMnuz Fikile Mbalula, uthe abazokhetha ukukhankasela amaKhomanisi okhethweni oluzayo bazozibeka engcupheni yokukhishwa ezikhundleni abajutshwe kuzo kuhulumeni.Ukusho lokhu ngesikhathi ekhuluma nabezindaba ngoLwesine. Kunenqwaba yabaholi be-SACP abanezikhundla kuhulumeni okubalwa kubo uNgqongqoshe wezeSayensi nezobuChwepheshe, uDkt Blade Nzimande, uNgqongqoshe wezeMfundo ePhakeme, uMnuz Buti Manamela, noNdunankulu waseLimpopo, uDkt Phophi Ramathuba.I-ANC inikeze amalungu ayo umnqamulajuqu wezinsuku eziyishumi ukuba asho ukuthi azokhankasela liphi iqembu okhethweni lohulumeni basekhaya oluzayo.UMbalula uthe labo abazokhetha ukungaphumeli obala, bazothatha ngokuthi bazokhankasela i-SACP.UMbalula uthe kuyicala ukukhankasela iqembu elincintisana ne-ANC okhethweni, wathi labo abenza lelo cala bazothathelwa izinyathelo. "Onke amalungu e-ANC aphoqelekile ukuba akhankasele i-ANC nabayimele okhethweni. Ngisho nalabo abanobulungu be-SACP baphoqelekile ukuthi bakhankasele i-ANC. Abangeke baphumele obala ukuthi bazokhankasela i-ANC, sizothatha ngokuthi bazokhankasela elinye biqembu. Abakhankasela iqembu elincintisana ne-ANC bazothathelwa izinyathelo. "Uma ujutshwe esikhundleni kuhulumeni sizokuthathela izinyathelo okubalwa kuzo ukuthi sikukhiphe esikhundleni.

BAFUNA amaphoyisa abhukule ekuphenyeni izigameko zokwebiwa kwemfuyo abantu baseMawuleni, ePort Shepstone, abakhala ngokuthi sebephelile amasela. Esigamekweni sakamumva, okuthiwa senzeke ngoLwesihlanu, owesilisa wendawo onguMnuz Mthobisi Cele, webelwe izinkomo eziyisikhombisa.Elandisa ngesehlakalo asifanise nesimngcwabe ephila, uthe umelusi wakhe uqaphele ngezikhathi zantambama, izinkomo sezibuya emadlelweni ukuthi eziyisikhombisa azibonwa. Uthe kuyinqubo yendawo ukuthi abelusi noma imindeni iyazivulela izinkomo ezibayeni, zizihambele ziye emadlelweni, baze bazibone ntambama uma sezibuya khona. Uthe ngesikhathi zidla emadlelweni akekho osuke ehleli nazo eziqaphile. "Kuthe uma kuyobhekwa emadlelweni, kwaficwa ngamanqina azo kanjalo nemiswani, okunye kungekho, kwacaca ukuthi zebiwe yilabo abazibulala khona lapho, maqede balayishe inyama yazo, bese bekhala amaphepha,” kusho uCele.Uthe uvukele emaphoyiseni ekuseni ngoMgqibelo, ukuyovula icala, nokuyilapho ezithele khona phezu kolwazi lokuthi ngayizolo, amaphoyisa athole imoto eyiveni, i-NP200, ebiphantshelwe yisondo esigodini saseMntentweni, bude buduze nedolobha i-Port Shepstone. "Athe le moto ayithole ingenamuntu phakathi, isele dengwane. Athi uma eyibheka ngemumva, athola kukhona inqwaba yenyama nezinhloko. Athi uma eyongikhombisa, nebala ngathola ukuthi yizo izinkomo zami lezi engithi zidukile,” usho kanje.

"Sifuna ukunika abavoti into ehlukile kunalokho abakunikwa i-ANC. Sinxenxa abantu bakuleli ukuthi basondele bavotele inqola ehambayo.” Le nhlanganisela ithembisa ukuthi kuzoba nokulingana ngakwezomthetho, amandla azobuyela kohulumeni basekhaya, kuzoliwa nenkohlakalo, kuzolethelwa abantu izidingo ezibafanele. "Kuzohlinzekwa ngemfundo nezempilo ezisezingeni, kukhuliswe nomnotho ontengayo. Sizosebenza ngamandla ukubumba abantu bakuleli ukuze kube nezinguquko kuleli.” Kwenzeka lokhu nje, uMengameli we-ANC uMnuz Cyril Ramaphosa, usephufumule ezinkundleni ezehlukene ngokuthi le nhlanganisela yamaqembu ngeke iyiketule le nhlangano.URamaphosa wathi bayazi ukuthi ikuphi okudingwa ngumphakathi ngakho bayazilungisa izikhalazo zawo.Waveza ukuthi abeseka i-ANC abawavoteli amanye amaqembu uma bengeneme kodwa bamane bajezise le nhlangano ngokuthi bangayi kovota, bazihlalele emakhaya.Namhlanje abaholi be-ANC okubalwa noRamaphosa basonga imihlangano abebeyihambele yokuchazela abantu ngabakwenzile selokhu bathula umqulu wezethembiso zokhetho lwango-2019.Lo mhlangano usongwa e-Alberton Civic Centre Ekurhuleni, eGauteng.

Kuke kwaba nomdonsiswano oshubile phakathi kwe-IFP ne-ANC esifundazweni ngodaba lweSilo.I-ANC yayikhala ngokuthi i-IFP isebenzisa indlunkulu negama leSilo ukuzigayela amavoti. I-IFP ibihlala ikuchitha lokhu, ithi yinto engekho yona ayixubi iminxa ehlukene iSilo nenhlangano. Obekudala umsindo wukuthi umsunguli we-IFP inkosi Mangosuthu Buthelezi, ongasekho ibiwundunankulu kaZulu isikhathi eside.I-IFP isanda kuhamba nayo iyokotha iSilo yakhuleka ngezinkomo okuthiwa zicela kwezingu-20. Okhulumela i-IFP uMnuz uMkhuleko Hlengwa, ngesikhathi ekhuluma nabezindaba wathi bavakashele iSilo ukuzosiduduza ngokulahlekelwa wundunankulu waso inkosi Mangosuthu Buthelezi. "Kukhona ubudlelwano obukhona ngoba umsunguli we-IFP inkosi Mangosuthu Buthelezi ibuwundunankulu kaZulu. Sithe asivele sizoduduza iSilo ngokulahlekelwa kwaso. UShenge ubambe elikhulu iqhaza ezindabeni zobukhosi endlunkulu. Okunye wukuthi siyazi ukuthi iSilo sibaluleleke kakhulu emphakathini,’’ kusho uHlengwa.ISILO uMisuzulu kaZwelithini sihlala semukela amahele osopolitiki bezokotha bese bedlana indlebe naso ngezindaba ezehlukene Isithombe: NQOBILE MBONAMBI/AFRICAN NEWS AGENCY (ANA)UHlengwa waveza nokuthi bakubona kubalulekile ukuthi bayobona iSilo ngoba nabo banengxenye yabantu beSilo ababasebenzelayo lapho abaphethe khona.

Kwakukhona uSipho, umphakathi wezokuxhumana owaziwa kakhulu ngokuthanda izindaba. U-Sipho wayehlala eGoli, edlala izithombe ezihlekisayo nezifundisayo ku-YouTube. Ngemva kokuba ebone ukuthi abantu abaningi baphendula kahle ezithombeni zakhe, wanquma ukujula emkhakheni wokukhiqiza okuqukethwe. Ngonyaka odlule, uSipho waqala ukuhlola izindlela zokwenza okuqukethwe kwakhe kube ngcono. Waqala ukufunda ngama-algorithms ka-YouTube, indlela yokukhetha izihloko ezithokozisayo, nokuthi ungakha kanjani ubudlelwano obuqinile nababukeli. Wafunda ukuthi umkhakha wokukhiqiza okuqukethwe ungashintsha impilo yomuntu. U-Sipho wakubona lokhu njengemfundo, hhayi nje njengomsebenzi. Ngemuva kokuhamba kweminyaka emibili, uSipho wathola ukuthi umkhakha wokukhiqiza okuqukethwe ku-YouTube unamathuba amaningi. Waqala ukuhlela izinhlelo ezihlukahlukene, ezihlanganisa imihlangano nabanye abakhiqizi, izifundo zokuphila, nezinhlelo zokuhlola imikhiqizo. Lokhu kwaholela ekwandeni kwabantu abawababukeli, futhi uSipho wathola ukuhweba okukhulu. Nokho, uSipho waphinde wabona izinselelo. Ukuncintisana kwakukhula, futhi izidingo zababukeli zashintsha. Waqonda ukuthi ukuhlala phambili kudinga ubuchwepheshe obusha, ukuqhubeka nokufunda, nokuhlonipha izifiso zababukeli. Ngaleso sikhathi, uSipho wathola umqondo wokuthi umkhakha wokukhiqiza okuqukethwe ku-YouTube awupheli, kodwa udinga ukuhlala uvuselelwa. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, uSipho waba yisibonelo sokuthi uma ungazinikela, ungakha impumelelo enkulu. Umkhakha wokukhiqiza okuqukethwe ku-YouTube waba yindawo yokukhula, yokufunda, nokuxhumana, futhi uSipho waba neqhaza elikhulu kulokhu. Ngakho, kwaba sobala ukuthi ukuhamba phambili emkhakheni, kudinga ukuzinikela, ubuhlakani, nokuba nesibindi sokuhlola okusha.

Umthelela wokukhula kwezindawo zokusebenza ezihlanganyelwayo UThandiwe Moyo, oneminyaka engu-28 ubudala, ungumfundi onothando lwezobuchwepheshe ophakathi kokuba umqondisi wezobuchwepheshe eNkampanini Yezokuxhumana. Waqala ukuthola izinzuzo ezinhle zezindawo zokusebenza ezihlanganyelwayo ngesikhathi eqala umsebenzi. Ngemva kokuhlangana nabanye abasebenzi abavela ezindaweni ezahlukene, waqonda ukuthi lezi zindawo zenza kube lula ukuhwebelana ngolwazi, izinsiza, nezinsiza zokufunda. Ngokubambisana nabanye, uThandiwe wathola amathuba amaningi okwakha ubudlelwano obuqinile nokwakha imisebenzi emisha. Ukwanda kwezindawo zokusebenza ezihlanganyelwayo kumenze waba nesikhathi esithe xaxa sokucabanga ngezimakethe ezintsha. Uthanda ukuthi lezi zindawo zikhuthaza ukwakhiwa kobuchwepheshe obusha, okwenza kube lula kubaqalayo ukuthi bakhe amaphrojekthi amasha. UThandiwe uthi, "Ukusebenza ezindaweni ezihlanganyelwayo kudlulela phambili ekwakheni umphakathi osebenzayo. Kulungile ukusiza abanye, futhi ngithola ulwazi olubalulekile olusiza ekuthuthukiseni izinsiza zami." Ngalesi sizathu, ukholelwa ukuthi lezi zindawo zikhombisa ikusasa eliqhakazile, lapho abantu bezosebenzisana khona ukuze bakhe umhlaba omuhle, onobuchwepheshe obuphakeme, nokuhlanganisa wonke umuntu. Ngokubuka kwesikhathi esizayo, uThandiwe ubheke phambili ekuthuthukiseni izindawo zokusebenza ezihlanganyelwayo ukuze zibe ngaphezulu kokuba izindawo zokusebenza, kodwa zibe yizikhungo zokudala, zokubambisana, nokukhula.

Izinyane kuzokhumbuleka ukuthi yilona elasukunyiswa ngosuku lokutshalwa kwenkosi lethulwa njengozongena esikhundleni sikayise. ''Mabangadideki abantu, yinye Inkosi yesizwe saseMathulini, ikhona yazalwa,'' usho kanjena ezisho yena.Izinyane likhuluma kanjena nje, kufanele kukhunjulwe ukuthi kuke kwanemibiko eveza ukuthi usha phansi umbango wesihlalo sobukhosi kulesi sizwe.Kuvela igama likaMnuz Msawakhe Luthuli ozichaza njengoyise wenkosi ekhotheme, owatshela Isolezwe ukuthi naye kumfanele ukuba sesihlalweni sokuhola isizwe.Khona lapho, kuvela negama likaMnuz Busani Luthuli owengamele isikhwana sesizwe saseMathulini futhi ongumfowabo wenkosi esanda kukhothama.Kuzokhumbuleka ukuthi inkosi yaguqa isigubhukane. Likhuluma izinyane, liveze ukuthi lizimisele ukuqhubeka nemisebenzi kayise emihle yokunakekela umphakathi abekade eyenza esadla anhlamvana.Yize izinyane lithe fahla ngodaba lombango wesihlalo sobukhosi kodwa lithe alithandi ukukhuluma ngalolu daba ngenxa yokuthi kusaziliwe. Lithe konke kuzocaca uma sekuphelile ukuzila.Mayelana nohlelo lokuhlinzekwa kwabafundi bezikole zakule ndawo ngemifaniswano, lithe yinto uyise abeyikhonzile kakhulu, lathi yingakho-ke nalo libone kukuhle ukuba likwenze lokhu uyise ayenentshisekelo yakho kakhulu. ''Ubaba ubengumuntu obezifela kakhulu ngemfundo. Wayengenza noma yini uma nje kukhulunywa ngodaba lwemfundo.

UMalwane kuthiwa ubefunelwa necala lokudutshulwa, kubulawe uMnuz Juda Mthethwa ngoFebhuwari 2023.Umthombo ocele ukuthi ungadalulwa uthe umndeni kaGodo usuqalile ukuthola izinsongo ngoba usolwa ngokuthi ubhiyozela ukubulawa kukaMalwane. "Kuthiwa njengoba bejabula nje, nabo basazobulawa,” kusho umthombo.Uqhube wathi okwenzekayo, ukuthi kubulawe abathintekayo ekubulaweni kukaGodo, yinto umndeni obuyilindele vele njengoba ubunayo inkolelo yokuthi umufi uzozilwela nalabo abamsoconga. Ithintwa indodana kaGodo, uMnuz Mandla Mthethwa, yale yaphetha ukuphawula, yathi lolu daba lubucayi, akukho umndeni ongakuphawula. Isolezwe lihlulekile ukuthola ukuphawula komndeni kaJuda njengoba isihlobo, sithe kulukhuni ukuthi bangaphawula ngesehlakalo, kwathi ucingo lukankosikazi kamufi, lwakhala lwangaphendulwa. Osekomitini, elilwa nobugebengu obusemngceleni, uMnuz Joseph Ngubane, uthe nakuba ebulewe ungqondongqondo kodwa kusekhona ukukhathazeka emphakathini ngoba basekhona abanye abasele. Uthe bajatshuliswa wukuthi umgilwa odubule umufi ukwazile ukuzivikela, ehlaselwa. "Neyakhe impilo ibisengcupheni, nabo bebedubula bebhekise kuye,” kusho uNgubane. Uthe ithimba eliyisipesheli elasungulwa ukuze libhekane nalolu hlobo lobugebengu, lisawubambe kahle. "Kuke kuthule, ngoba izigebengu ziyalalisa, kodwa bese kubuye kubhoka ke futhi,” usho kanje, enezela ngokuthi njengoba kwenzeke isigameko nje, ikhona imoto eyiveni ethathwe kuzosa kube yizolo eBhambanana.

Ukuhlaziywa komthelela wemidlalo ye-eSports entsheni yaseNingizimu Afrika Emhlabeni wamanje, imidlalo ye-eSports isiphenduke isiko elikhulu, ikakhulukazi phakathi kwentsha yaseNingizimu Afrika. Njengomuntu onentshisekelo kule mikhakha, ngithanda ukukhetha izinzuzo eziningi ezivela kule midlalo, kodwa futhi ngikhumbule nezingozi ezihambisana nayo. Okokuqala, eSports inikeza ithuba elikhulu lokuxhumana. Abadlali bangahlangana nabantu abanomqondo ofanayo, baphinde bakhe ubudlelwano obuqinile. Lokhu kubalulekile entsheni, njengoba kubasiza ukuba bakhulise amakhono okukhokhela, ukuxhumana, nokubambisana. Ngaphezu kwalokho, umkhiqizo we-eSports uthuthukisa amathuba emisebenzi. Izinkampani nazo zifuna ukuthola abantu abanekhono emikhakheni ehlukene, kusukela kumklamo wezithombe, kuze kube ekuphakamiseni imikhiqizo. Nokho, kufanele sikhumbule ukuthi imidlalo ye-eSports ingaholela ezinhlelweni zokuphila ezingalungile. Ukuhlale phansi isikhathi eside nokudlala imidlalo kungaholela ezinkingeni zempilo, njengezinkinga zokuhamba, ukukhathala, kanye nezinkinga zengqondo. Kubalulekile ukuthi sikhuthaze abasha ukuba balandele imidlalo, kodwa futhi balandele imikhuba emihle yokuphila. Ngakho-ke, ngifisa ukuthumela umyalezo: imidlalo ye-eSports iyinsiza ebalulekile, kodwa kufanele iqhathwe ngokucophelela. Abazali, othisha, kanye nezinkampani kufanele basebenze ndawonye ukuze bakhe imvelo enempilo yokudlala. Uma sinakekela lokhu, singakwazi ukuvumela imidlalo ye-eSports ukuba ikwazi ukuthuthukisa impilo nempumelelo yentsha yethu.

KUMISWE uKhomishana wamaPhoyisa othweswe amacala ayamene nethenda yezigidi zamarandi, uGeneral Fannie Masemola, kwabe sekuqokwa uLieutenant General Puleng Dimpane, ukuba abambe isikhundla.Ukumiswa kukaMasemola kumenyezelwe nguMengameli Cyril Ramaphosa, ngesikhathi ekhuluma nabezindaba izolo.UMasemola uthweswe amacala ayamenele nethenda ka-R360 million eyanikwa inkampani kasomabhizinisi obhekene noxhaxha lwamacala, uMnuz Vusimuzi "Cat" Matlala.UMasemola uvele kafushane eNkantolo yeMantshi ePitoli, ngoLwesibili, lapho ebebhekene khona necala lokwephula imigomo yokuphathwa kwemali yomphakathi, i-Public Finance Management Act.URamaphosa uthe banqume ukunika uMasemola ikhefu njengoba esabhekene nezinsolo.UMasemola uzobuyela enkantolo ngenyanga ezayo, lapho uzokube evele noMatlala namanye amaphoyisa angu-12 athweswe amacala athinta ithenda eyanikwa inkampani kaMatlala.URamaphosa uthe uyamethemba uLieutenant General Dimpane ukuthi uzowenza kahle umsebenzi.ULieutenant General Dimpane ubephethe ezeziMali emaphoyiseni.

Ucwaningo Ngokusetshenziswa Kwezimoto Ezizishayelayo Emhlabeni: Iphrofayela kaThandiwe Mthethwa UThandiwe Mthethwa, umcwaningi ophambili kwezobuchwepheshe bezokuthutha, uthakazelela ukuhlela nezinhlelo eziyinkimbinkimbi. Uma eqhubeka nocwaningo lwakhe, ubuthakathaka bezimoto ezizishayelayo, uThandiwe ungumholi emkhakheni wezokuthutha. Wazalelwa eThekwini ngonyaka ka-1990, wakhulela emndenini ogxile ezintweni zobuchwepheshe. UThandiwe wamukela iziqu zeB.Sc. kuM Mechanical Engineering kwiYunivesithi yaseNatal, lapho athola khona ugqozi lokuhlanganyela nezinhlelo zokuthutha ezilula, ezisetshenziswa emhlabeni jikelele. UThandiwe usebenze nezikhungo ezihlonishwa emhlabeni jikelele, efaka isandla ekuthuthukiseni ama-algorithms awusizo okwenza izimoto ezizishayelayo zisebenze kahle. Ucwaningo lwakhe lukhombisa ukuthi lezi zimoto zinganciphisa izingozi zokufika kwezokuthutha, kanti zinciphisa nemithwalo yemfuyo emhlabeni. UThandiwe uyakholwa ukuthi izimoto ezizishayelayo zingaguqula indlela umphakathi uphila ngayo, zikhuthaze ukuzinza kokuthutha, futhi zinciphise umthelela emvelweni. Ngokubambisana nezinkampani ezinkulu nezikhungo zocwaningo, uThandiwe ufuna ukusiza ukuthuthukisa imithetho nezinhlelo zokulawula ukusetshenziswa kwezimoto ezizishayelayo. Ubonisa intshiseko yokwakha imiphakathi ehlose ukunciphisa imithwalo emhlabeni futhi ukugcina izinsizakusebenza. Imigomo yakhe ibheke phambili, njengoba eqhubeka nokucwaninga, eshinta umcabango wabo bonke abakhethiwe bezokuthutha. UThandiwe Mthethwa uphinde waba yisibonelo somsebenzi oncomekayo emhlabeni wezobuchwepheshe, engumholi ocacile ohamba phambili ezikhathini zanamuhla.

Ukuhlaziywa komkhakha wezincwadi ezilalelwayo (audiobooks) UThandiwe Mthethwa ungumculi wezincwadi ezilalelwayo, ogcine impumelelo enkulu emkhakheni wezincwadi. Wazalwa eThekwini ngo-1985, uThandiwe wathola imfundo yakhe eNyuvesi yaseNatal, lapho afunda khona uBuciko bokuxhumana. Ngemva kokuphothula izifundo zakhe, wathola ithuba lokusebenza njengomhumushi wezincwadi, kodwa wathola ukuthi imizwa yakhe iyakhula ebhalweni olukhuluma abantu. UThandiwe uqale ukufaka isandla emkhakheni wezincwadi ezilalelwayo ngo-2015, lapho ethola ithuba lokubamba iqhaza ekwenzeni ama-audiobooks. Uhlale ekwazi ukucacisa izigcawu ngokuqonda okujulile, okwenza abafundi bazizwe bekhululekile ngesikhathi besalalelwayo. Uzwela kakhulu ubuhle bezincwadi ezilalelwayo, obuthinta izigaba ezihlukahlukene, kusukela ezithakazelweni zezothando kuya kwezemfundo. Njengomculi wezincwadi ezilalelwayo, uThandiwe ukhuthaza ababhali abasha ukuthi baziqonde kahle izilaleli zabo, beqhathanisa izindaba zabo nezindlela zokukhuluma. Uqhakambisa ukuthi leli thuba lokweluleka alikho nje kuphela elokukhuluma, kodwa futhi liphakamisa ukuxhumana phakathi kwababhali nezilaleli. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, umkhakha wezincwadi ezilalelwayo ubonakala uthuthuka kakhulu, uThandiwe ubonakala engomunye wabasunguli abaqinileyo, ngenkathi ebambisene nabanye ukuze kuthuthukiswe umkhakha. Ukuthandwa kwalezi zincwadi ezilalelwayo kusekhaya, kubonisa ukuthi isitayela sakhe sokukhuluma sithokozisa futhi sisiza kakhulu ekwakheni umoya wobungane kumphakathi. UThandiwe Mthethwa, ngomqondo omuhle, uveza izincwadi ezithokozisayo ngempela, efaka umphakathi nemizwelo yabo.

Ebuzwa ngobudlelwane bakhe noMzo uthe wayekade emsebenzela kwakhe ekhanda izimoto kodwa wamxosha ngemuva kokuba entshontshe imoto yakhe. ''Kodwa wabuye waxolisa ngamvumela ukuba abuye ezosebenza,'' usho kanje.Ebuzwa ukuthi kukhona yini lapho benoCele noma uFaith abake babhunga ngetulo lokusoconga umufi uthe lutho. UCele sasixhunyaniswa wukuthi ungumakhelwane ethanda ukuthi ngimazise ngokuthi kwenzekani emndenini wakhe. UFaith sasingaxhumani naye,'' kusho yena.U-Advocate Mvune izolo utshele inkantolo ukuthi ingabusebenzisi ubufakazi obuphambi kwayo obethulwe uFaith noMzo ekhala ngokuthi buyashayisana futhi buntekenteke.Wenze izibonelo lapho okushayisana khona ubufakazi obethulwe yilaba.Eqhulwini uqale wakhuluma ngokuthi uFaith esitatimendeni sakhe esifungelwe ayevuma kusona icala waveza ukuthi umyeni wakhe wayemhlukumeza, kodwa uma esethula ubufakazi ebhokisini useshaya ingqimphothwe uthi ubudlelwane bakhe nomufi babubuhle kakhulu kwaze kwafika isikhathi lapho eficwa khona wukufa.Uqhubekile wathi esitatmendeni sakhe sokuvuma icala, uFaith wathi kwavunyelwana ngokuthi inkabi uMzo, izokhokhelwa u-R150 000 uma iwenze ngempumelelo umsebenzi wokusoconga umufi, kodwa uma esemile ebhokisini usethi akazi lutho ngesivumelwano semali esithinta iukukhokhelwa kwenkabi.Uqhubekile uMvune wathi uMzo esitatimendeni wathi uKhumalo owamnikeza isibhamu kanye nezinhlamvu. ''Esitatimendeni uMzo uthe waze wazifaka yena izinhlamvu esibhamini.

Indima yemidlalo yendabuko ekwakheni ubumbano emphakathini Kujabulela abantu abaningi imidlalo yendabuko, ehlobene nempilo yempucuko yethu. UThabo Mthembu, umphakathi ophuma eMzimkhulu, ungumuntu owaqonda kahle le ndima. Njengomfundisi wedolobha, uThabo usebenze iminyaka eminingi ukuze aqinise ubumbano phakathi kwabantu bendawo. Ukubamba imicimbi yemidlalo yendabuko, uThabo usungule imishado, imikhosi, kanye nezinhlangano zomphakathi ezididiyela ukudlala izinhlelo ezahlukene ezifana nomjaho wezimoto, ukuphepha kwenhlangano, kanye nemidlalo yokudansa. Le midlalo ivuselela ubungane, ibuyisela izinkumbulo ezinhle zabantu, futhi igqugquzela ukuhloniphana phakathi kwezizukulwane. UThabo uthe, "Imidlalo yendabuko akukhona nje ukuzijabulisa, kodwa kuyindlela yokwakha ubumbano phakathi kwabantu." Njengoba edlulisa izifundo ezibalulekile ezivela ezinkolelweni zendabuko, uThabo ushukumisa umoya wokubambisana futhi uphakamisa umqondo wokuhlonipha. Ngaphezu kokuthuthukisa imisebenzi yomphakathi, imidlalo yendabuko inikeza ithuba lokufundisa amalungelo abantu, ivuselela ukuzibophezela kwabantu ukuze bakhuthaze ukuthula nokubumbana. UThabo uyasebenza nempumelelo ukwakha umphakathi onokubambisana, uphumelela ekwakheni ubumbano obuhlala buqinile ngokusebenzisa imidlalo yendabuko. Ngalesi sizathu, indima yezenzakalo zakho iyigugu emiphakathini enengqondo, ibhalela izinkumbulo ezinhle ezinobungane.

Kokunye kungenzeka bazame ukuwela kanti kakuphephile,''usho kanjena.Ugcizelele ukuthi babone kungcono ukuba babeke phambili ukuphepha kwabafundi basikole.IMeya uSibisi ithe kakumele kube khona okukhinyabeza imfundo yabantu bakule ndawo. Uthe ngeke kuze kuzwakale kahle uma sekuthiwa kukhona abafundi abangayile esikoleni ngenxa yokugcwala komfula. "Yingakho nje sibone kusemqoka kakhulu ukuba sisukume senze isiqiniseko esikhulu sokuthi siyalakha leli bhuloho. Sikholwa wukuthi ngeke kube khona izinkinga uma seliphothuliwe,''usho kanjena.Uveze ukuthi ziningi ezinye izinhlelo ezihlabahlosile abanazo, abahlose ukuzisebenzisela ukuthuthukiswa komphakathi wakule ndawo.Ngalo lolu suku kwethuwe usonkontileka ozokwakha ibhuloho, iSikwayo Holdings.Usonkontileka uveze ukuthi umsebenzi uzowenza nabantu basendaweni ukuze kuzoba yibona abahlomula ngamathuba omsebenzi.Ilungu lomphakathi lasendaweni, uNksz Nonhlakanipho Magwaza lithe kube yigxathu elihle elithathwe wubuholi base-Alfred Duma. "Njengoba sekwakhiwe lesi sikole, bese kuphoqa ukuthi libe khona ibhuloho elizodala ukuthi bangabi nankinga abafundi uma bewela,’’usho kanjena.

INYUNYANA yabasebenzi bensimbi, iNational Union of Metalworkers of South Africa, idonse ngendlebe uNgqongqoshe wamaBhizinisi kaHulumeni, uMnuz Pravin Gordhan, ukuba aphasise ukudayiswa kwenkampani yamabhanoyi iMango.Inkantolo esePitoli, isichithile isicelo sikaGordhan sokudlulisa isinqumo senkantolo sangoSepthemba 6.Lapho wayeyalelwa khona ukuthi anqume ukuthi iyadayiswa iMango noma cha kungakapheli izinsuku eziwu-30.Akazange athathe isinqumo, kunalokho wafaka isicelo sokudlulisa icala.Inkantolo yalile ukuba adlulise icala kanti iNumsa ithe lesi sinqumo sizosiza abasebenzi ababalelwa ku-700 abahleli emakhaya njengoba iMango ingasebenzi.UNkk Phakamile Hlubi-Majola okhulumela iNumsa, uthe uGordhan kufanele avume ukuthi iMango idayiswe ngoba umnyango wakhe uhlulekile. "IMango ibiphethwe yiSouth African Airways (SAA) noMnyango wamaBhizinisi kaHulumeni. Ingene ohlelweni lokuhlengwa emuva kokungabi namali. Njengamanje kunosomabhizinisi abafuna ukuyithenga, abanezinhlelo ezinhle zokubuyisa imisebenzi yabantu.

U-gearbox uhlukene kabili njengoba kukhona oyi-6 speed manual noyi-8 speed automatic.Kushayeleke isipikili sokuthi ayizweli futhi yakhelwe ubunzima ngenkathi sinyuka sehla ngayo imiqansa, siyifaka odakeni, siyibhukudisa emaxhaphozini aseSyringa Park, eMuldelsdrift. Yize ifikela emhlabeni owenile ngokwezimbangi - okuyiToyota Hilux engaconsi phansi kosomatekisi neFord Ranger eyintandokazi kwabamathenda, Isuzu D-Max neMahindra Pik UP, iJMC Vigus ibukeka ingase iphendule amatafula ngenxa yentengo yayo engambi eqolo. Kulabo abahlala ezindaweni zamakhosi njengakoLoskop, Lotheni, eMpendle, Nkandla naseMashobeni, nabalayishela abantu izimpahla besuka ezitolo, basengaphephela kuyo, iqhubeke impilo. Ingigeze inhliziyo ngakhumbula ukuthi empeleni iChina kade yahamba phambili kwezobuchwepheshe uma ubheka ukuthi emakhaya izinto esizisebenzisayo, phecelezi amagajethi, amaningi akhiwa khona.Ngisho uTerence Tracy we-Afro Offroad 4x4 Driver Training uvumelane nami ezishaya isifuba, ethi iJMC edayisa izimoto ezilinganiselwa kuhhafu wesigidi ngonyaka emhlabeni jikelele, ishaye into ecokeme nge-Vigus double cab.Iphawula i-Head of Product kwaJMC nakwaGAC Motor, uKarabo Ndaba, izwakale ilibuka ngeso elihle ikusasa le-JMC Vigus double cab 4x4, yathi abantu baseMzansi abaphume ngobuningi bayoyithenga ngoba bayobe bengashayanga eceleni. I-JMC iveze ukuthi ngo-7.1l kadizili uyakwazi ukuhamba ufinyelele ku-100km kanti uma uzohamba ngayo etiyeleni kufanele ibe ku-2H, obhuqwini uyibeke ku-4H.

Izindlela zokuvikela izingane emkhakheni wedijithali Ukukhula kwemidiya ye-dijithali kudinga ukuthi abazali bathathe izinyathelo ezithile ukuze bavikele izingane zabo. Nansi imihlahlandlela elula yokuphatha lokhu: 1. Thola Usizo Kubazali Abanye: - Bamba izingxoxo nabanye abazali ukuze uthole izeluleko ezisebenzayo. Funda ngezinsiza ezifanele zokuvikela izingane. 2. Faka Izivikelo: - Sebenzisa izinhlelo zokuvikela ezifana nezinhlelo zokuphatha isikhathi sokusebenzisa idivayisi. Lokhu kuzokwenza kube lula ukuqapha isikhathi esichithwa izingane emhlabeni wedijithali. 3. Bhala Imigomo Yokusebenzisa: - Hlela imigomo ethile yokuphila online. Nikeza izingane umqondo ocacile wokuthi yini evumelekile nokuthi yini engavumelekile. 4. Yazi Izinsiza Ezinhle: - Thola futhi wabelane ngezinsiza ezisemqoka, njengeziqephu zezingane, ezinomthelela omuhle. Hlela imihlangano yokubuka okuqukethwe online ndawonye ukuze uqinisekise ukuthi bazi kahle. 5. Hlala Uxhumene: - Xhumana njalo nezingane zakho mayelana nezifundo abazitholayo. Qonda abantu abasha abakha ubungane nabo online, futhi unikeze izeluleko zokuhlola imishado yokuxhumana. 6. Fundisa Ngobungozi: - Qeqesha izingane zakho ngengozi ezihlobene nokusetshenziswa kwe-inthanethi, njengokudlwengulwa kokuhlonzwa nohlanga lwemiyalezo. 7. Bheka Izithombe Nemiyalezo: - Qhubeka uhlole izithombe nemiyalezo ezithunyelwa ku-inthanethi. Cela izingane zikhulume nawe uma kwenzeka izinto ezingejwayelekile. Ngalezi zinyathelo, ungavikela izingane zakho emhlabeni wedijithali, uqinisekise ukuthi bazibandakanya ngendlela enempilo futhi evikelekile. Qhubeka uhlola izinguquko emhlabeni wedijithali ukuze uqinisekise ukuvikeleka kwezingane zakho ngaso sonke isikhathi.

KULINDELEKE ukuthi asifake ngoLwesithathu isicelo sakhe sebheyili owesilisa osolwa ngokudubula abulale iphoyisa eNdawana, eKokstad, ngoJulayi nonyaka.Kulesi sigameko kwashona uConstable Smanga Mtolo (29) owayesebenza esiteshini samaphoyisa i-Evatt, khona eKokstad.Kugcine kuboshwa uMnuz Monwabisi Mkulisi (33) esifundazweni saseMpumalanga, ngoMsombuluko odlule, wabuya wazovela eNkantolo yeMantshi yaseKokstad ngoLwesithathu.Ubhekene necala lokubulala nelokuzama ukubulala.Elandisa ngesigameko okhulumela oKlebe KwaZulu-Natal, uLieutenant Colonel Simphiwe Mhlongo, uthe kusolwa ukuthi uConst Mtolo wadutshulwa uMkulisi ngesikhathi engekho emsebenzini. "Kubikwa ukuthi uConst Mtolo wayehleli emotweni yakhe nabangani ngesikhathi kusondela kubo uMkulisi. Kuthiwa baba nengxoxo emfishane ngaphambi kokuthi uConst Mtolo aphume emotweni yakhe,’’ kusho uMhlongo.Uqhube wathi uConst Mtolo wathi ngesikhathi esaqhubeka nokukhuluma noMkulisi, wavele wamdubula ngentululwane yezinhlamvu.Kuthiwa uConst Mtolo wafela khona lapho kanti abangani bakhe ababili ayehamba nabo bona balimala base bephuthunyiswa esibhedlela. "Wabe esebaleka endaweni yesigameko ngezinyawo.

Othishanhloko bezikole balushayele ihlombe lolu hlelo, bathi luklama indima enkulu ekulekeleleni abafundi abantulayo basezikoleni zaseMgababa. Isikole, uMnganiwakhe High, esike saba sematheni naso singezinye sezihlomulile.Ngaphambi kokuba aqale ukukhuluma, abantu ebebehambele umcimbi basukumile bathi "Bayede! ''INduna yakule ndawo, uMnuz Lungani Makhathini, nayo ilimise ngesihloko elokuthi inkosi yakule ndawo yinye, esho lona kanye izinyane lenkosi.Kodwa-ke uMakhathini uthe ngenxa yokuthi bayahlonipha, bazolinda ukuzila kwezinsuku ezingu-90 ngaphambi kokuba konke kuhlale obala.Unxuse isizwe ukuba siqhubeke nokweseka izinyane njengoba besikade vele senza nakuyise esadla anhlamvana. Uthe abangabazi nje nakancane ukuthi uMnyango wezokuBusa ngokuBambisana neziNdaba zoMdabu KwaZulu-Natal, uzomemezela lona izinyane njengelifanele ukuhlala esihlalweni.

Hawu, uyabona yini ukuthi ama-drone asetshenziswa kanjani ezolimo? Kuyamangalisa! Ngicabanga ukuthi sesikhuluma ngama-drone isikhathi eside, kodwa manje sebezithola indlela yokusiza abalimi. Lokhu kuhle kakhulu ngoba kunceda abaningi. Okokuqala, ama-drone asiza ekuhloleni izindawo. Uma umalimi efuna ukuqapha izitshalo zakhe, angathola um drone, awuhambise phezulu, bese ebona konke. Lokhu kunciphisa isikhathi esithathwa ukuhamba ngezinyawo. Futhi, umoya opholile ungase usize ukuhamba phezulu, uthole izithombe ezinhle! Kodwa akukhona nje ukuhlola. Ama-drone angasiza ekulweni nezilokazane. Uma umalimi esebona okungahambi kahle, angasebenzisa ama-drone ukuthumela imithi ethile endaweni ethile. Lokhu kusebenza kahle, ngoba akudingi ukuthi umalimi ahambe yonke indawo. Ubona kanjani ukuthi ama-drone angaba usizo ekulimaleni? Lokhu kudinga ubuchwepheshe obuphambili, kodwa uma umalimi enza kahle, angathola umkhiqizo omuhle. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ama-drone angasiza ekuthumeleni izimpahla, okwenza kube lula ukuhamba kwemikhiqizo. Ngakho, njengoba ubona, ama-drone anenzuzo enkulu ezolimo. Ucabanga ukuthi lokhu kuzoshintsha indlela esikhuluma ngayo ngezolimo esikhathini esizayo? Ngiyabonga!

Enye ingozi yengcindezi yontanga yizidakamizwa. Ochwepheshe kwezokukhuliswa kwezingane basanwaya amakhanda bexakwa wukuthi kungani izingane njalo zikhetha ukungena kwi-internet uma zifuna ulwazi ngezinto ezithinta ucansi. Okuxaka kakhulu ongoti wukuthi nolwazi olungaziphephisa lusuke lukhona kepha intsha ikhetha ukugxila noma ukusebenzisa olungabalungele abantu abasebancane ngokweminyaka.Ephuzwini lendlala, kuqhakanjiswa ukuthi izingane zamantombazane zigcina ziya ocansini ngoba zifuna ukuhlomula ngezinto ezinhle ezisuke zizidinga. Lapha kubalwa amaselula nemali.Lapha kugcina sekunechilo lokuthi abanye abazali bagcina sebamukela lawo manyala bathembele ekondliweni yizingane ezilala no-sugar daddy njengoba zithola imali zize zibhekelele nezidingo zemindeni.Enye inkimbinkimbi wuphuzo oludakayo, oluholela ekutheni intsha izibandakanye nocansi olungaphephile futhi ingahlelile. Lapha umphumela kuba wukuthola izifo kanye nokukhulelwa. "Uvala" kuthiwa wudlame lwezobulili kokunye oluthinta imindeni kanye nokuthwalwa kwezingane okuthiwa wumkhuba odlange ezindaweni eziqhelelene namadolobha amakhulu.

I-ANC izokwenza ezinye izinguquko ebuholini bayo obuphethe esifundazweni iKwaZulu-Natal kanye nasezifundeni zakulesi sifundazwe.UNobhala jikelele we-ANC, uMnuz Fikile Mbalula, uveze ukuthi bazomemezela ithimba lesikhashana elisha elizohola i-ANC esifundazweni baphinde bamemezele nabazohola i-ANC ezifundeni.Ukusho lokhu ngesikhathi ekhuluma nabezindaba ngoLwesine. UMbalula uthe ithimba elisha elizohola isifundazwe uzolimemezela ngempelasonto. "Sesisemaphethelweni okuqokwa kwethimba elisha elizohola i-ANC KwaZulu-Natal. NgoMgqibelo ngizobe ngiKwaZulu-Natal, lapho sizoqoka khona ithimba elisha. Sivele sesibaqokile abaholi abaphezulu abazohola ithimba. "Ithimba ebelikhona belinabaholi abangaphezu kuka-60.Kulindeleke ukuthi abaningi badliwe yizembe njengoba uMbalula akuveza phambilini ukuthi bazolinciphisa ithimba.UMbalula wakhala nogokuthi ithimba ebelikhona liyahluleka ukwenza umsebenzi walo, lazi ukulwa izimpi zangaphakathi kuphela.Waze wafanisa ithimba nohlobo lwemoto i-Tazz.I-ANC isanda kumemezela izinguquko ebuholi obuphezulu bethimba elihola isifundazwe.Kulezi zinguquko kuqokwe uMnuz Mike Mabuyakhulu njengomdidiyeli, kwathi uMnuz James Nxumalo waqokwa njengomgqugquzeli.Kulezi zinguquko ezimenyezelwe uMbalula ngeledlule, abaholi abanohlonze okubalwa kubo, uMnuz Jeff Radebe, uNkk Nomusa Dube-Ncube, noNkk Weziwe Thusi, badliwe yizembe.UMbalula uveze ukuthi bazophinde baqoke amathimba azohola i-ANC ezifundeni.

KUBUKEKA sengathi abaculi bakamaskandi abasagcini nje ngokuqhudelana ngengoma kule mihla kodwa sebethelelana nangomkhuba omuhle wokuvusa imizi yakubo ezindaweni ezisemakhaya. Omaskandi bayaziwa ukuthi bakhonze ukuchoma nangomswenko kodwa sebeswenkisa nemizi yasemakubo manje.Umculo kamaskandi kule minyaka, ubonakale ungenisa kakhulu ngisho kubantu abangebona abasemakhaya. Kuqhudelwana ngezitayela zokugqoka kuze kuqhudelwane nangayo impumelelo yabaculi, imizi nezimoto. Abalandeli bafaka izithombe zezindlu ezakhiwa ngamaqhawe abo beqhoshelane ngazo ezinkundleni zokuxhumana.Sekwejwayelekile ukuthi ezinkundleni zokuxhumana uzithele ezithombeni umaskandi thizeni eveza izakhiwo zezindlu ezindaweni zasemakhaya. Kushiyana amandla ngoba abanye bakha izithabathaba zemizi ezibonakalayo ukuthi kukhokhwe imali eshisiwe.Kamuva nje kade kubatshazwa uGatsheni insizwa yasoPhongolo esematheni ngezingoma ezihlabahlosile. UGatsheni, ozibiza ngegagu lasoPhongolo, uveze umuzi wakubo asanda kuwuvuselela ngezindlu ezintsha. Insizwa yasoPhongolo ezakhele udumo ngengoma ethi Yimi uMalume, iveze izithombe yabonga nabalandeli ngokuyeseka yabonga nabayiqashayo.UGatsheni exoxa neSolezwe ngeMpelasonto, uthe kwakuhlala kuyisilonda enhliziyweni yakhe ukubona isimo sakubo sibheda. "Nganginamahloni ngesimo sasekhaya ngazibekela ukuthi uma izinto zilunga ngiqale ngokulungisa ekhaya. Ayikho indawo edlula ikhaya ngoba ngisho ungahamba uyephi ugcinela khona.

Indima yeminyuziyamu ekugcineni umlando namasiko Iminyuziyamu ibalulekile empilweni yethu njengoba ibamba izigigaba zomlando, izinkolelo, nezindlela zokuphila zabantu. Zikhona ezindaweni eziningi, futhi zinezindima ezihlukahlukene ezisetshenziswa ukuze kugcinwe umlando namasiko. Lokhu kubalulekile ngoba kuhlangene nezindlela zokukhumbula izenzakalo ezibalulekile nezingcaphuno zempilo yabantu. Okokuqala, iminyuziyamu iyindawo yokugcina izinto ezibalulekile, kusukela ezincwadini zomlando, izithombe, nezithombe eziyimpumelelo. Lezi zinto ziqinisekisa ukuthi izizukulwane ezizayo zingafunda ngamasiko nezinkolelo ezazikhona ngaphambili. Ngaphandle kweminyuziyamu, ubungako bomlando bungase buphume, njengoba izikhumbuzo ezisemqoka zingalahleka. Okwesibili, iminyuziyamu zisebenza njengesikhala sokufundisa. Ab visitori, ikakhulukazi abafundi, banethuba lokuhlola futhi bafunde ngomlando wabo, ngezindlela ezithakazelisayo nezingokwenziwa. Lokhu kudala ukuqonda okujulile phakathi kwabavakashi, kuhlanganiswe nemibono ehlukene yokubuka. Ngaphezu kwalokho, iminyuziyamu ibamba imicimbi ehlukahlukene, efana nemikhosi, izinkulumo, nezifundo, ezikhuthaza ukuxhumana phakathi kwabantu. Lokhu kwenza kube lula ukuhlinzeka ngendawo yokuxhumana kwezamasiko, lapho abantu benganxusa izinkolelo zabo, bephinde bahloniphe izizinda zabo. Ngaleyo ndlela, iminyuziyamu ayigcini nje ngokugcina umlando, kodwa ibalulekile ekwakheni umphakathi onolwazi, ophilayo, noshiyayo. Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukuthi siqhubeke nokuxhasa iminyuziyamu ukuze siqinisekise ukuthi umlando namasiko ethu agcinwa, akhunjuzwe, futhi anconywe.

Wathi yingakho bebone kungcono ukuba bahlele le ngqungquthela.Uthe inhlosongqangi yayo ukuthi kubhungwe kabanzi ngamasu angasetshenziswa ngenhloso yokubhekana nje ngqo nalesi simo.Uthe kungabe benza elikhulu iphutha leli uma bengase bathule nje bagoqe izandle ekubeni izinto zonakala.Okubakhathaza kakhulu uthe ukuthi lezi zigameko kuvela ukuthi zimandla kakhulu kubantu besifazane. Uthe yingakho le ngqunguthela beyethe elokuthi yiGBVF Summit. ''Akumele sithule kodwa njalo uma kukhona isimo esingesihle kuhle ukuthi sisukume,''echaza.Uveze ukuthi kuzophinde kube khona umjaho ozobe useThekwinin nawo okuzobe kuhloswe ngawo ukuthi kuxwayiswe ngalesi sihlava. Uveze ukuthi kungekudala kuzobe sekuvulelekile ukungenela kwabafuna ukuba yingxenye yabazogijima.UNksz Nomasina Zulu onguMengameli wenhlangano iWear Your Brand uthe kubajabulisile kakhulu ukuba yingxenye yokuhlelwa kwalolu hlobo lwengqungquthela.Uthe nabo kungabajabulisa ukuthi kube khona indima abayiklamayo ekutheni kube khona okwenziwayo mayelana nengwadla yabafundi abasezikhungweni zemfundo ephakeme okuthiwa baphila nokuhlukumezeka. ''Iqiniso ukuthi lento ayidingi abantu abathile kuphela kodwa kunalokho udinga ukuthi wonke umuntu abe yingxenye yayo. Nathi sizibophezele ekutheni kube khona esikwenzayo ngalokhu,'' usho kanje.

Ukusetshenziswa kobuhlakani bokwenziwa embonini yezokuthutha Q: Ubuhlakani bokwenziwa buhlanganisa ini? A: Ubuhlakani bokwenziwa (Artificial Intelligence) yindlela yokwenza amakhompyutha noma amadivayisi akwazi ukufinyelela izixazululo ezithile ngokufunda nokuhlaziya idatha. Q: Ubuhlakani bokwenziwa bunjani embonini yezokuthutha? A: Ubuhlakani bokwenziwa buvumela ukuphathwa okulula kwezinqubo ezahlukene embonini yezokuthutha, kuhlanganise ukuhlela, ukunakekela, kanye nokuphathwa kwezinsizakalo. Lokhu kuholela ekwenzeni ngcono ukusebenza, ukunciphisa izindleko, nokwenza izinqumo eziphusile. Q: Ukusetshenziswa kobuhlakani bokwenziwa kubonakala kuphi? A: Ukusetshenziswa kobuhlakani bokwenziwa kubonakala kakhulu ezinhlelweni zokuthutha ezizimele, njengezimoto ezizimele ezihamba ngaphandle kokufunda kwejwayelekile. Futhi, kutholakala ezinhlelweni zokuhlela ukuhamba ukuze kuncishiswe isikhathi sokulinda. Q: Yiziphi izinzuzo zokusebenzisa ubuhlakani bokwenziwa embonini yezokuthutha? A: Izinzuzo zifaka ukuvimbela izingozi emgwaqweni, ukunciphisa umoya ophuma emhathekweni, nokwandisa injabulo yabakhweli. Lokhu kuholela ekuthuthukiseni isithombe sebhizinisi. Q: Kukhona izinselelo ubuhlakani bokwenziwa obuhlangabezana nazo? A: Yebo, kunezinselelo ezifana nokuphepha kwedatha, ukuqonda kwamasiko ahlukene, nokuxhumana phakathi kwemishini nabantu. Lokhu kudinga izixazululo ezicacile ukuze kuzuze abaphakeli nabathengi. Q: Yini elindelwe esikhathini esizayo ngokuqondene nobuhlakani bokwenziwa embonini yezokuthutha? A: Kulindeleke ukuthi ubuhlakani bokwenziwa buqhubeke bujula, busebenze ngendlela ehlukahlukene, futhi buhlanganyele nezinguquko embonini yezokuthutha, kuhlanganise nezinye izinhlelo zokusebenza, njengokuhlola ukuqoqwa kwedatha ukuze kuhlangabezane nezidingo zezimakethe.

Ukuhlaziywa komthelela kwemidlalo ye-eSports kubantu abasha baseNingizimu Afrika Ingxoxo noNkosinathi Mthethwa, umphakathi wezokudlala eNingizimu Afrika Umbuzo: Sawubona, Nkosinathi. Ungasichazela ukuthi imidlalo ye-eSports ibaluleke kanjani kubantu abasha baseNingizimu Afrika? Impendulo: Sawubona! Ngempela, imidlalo ye-eSports ibaluleke kakhulu. Iphakathi kwezindlela ezintsha zokuzijabulisa, ikakhulukazi kubantu abasebancane. Inezinto eziningi ezithinta impilo yabo, njengokwakha ubudlelwano, ukuthuthukisa amakhono, nokuthola amathuba emisebenzi. Umbuzo: Ucabanga ukuthi imidlalo ye-eSports ithinta kanjani umnotho waseNingizimu Afrika? Impendulo: Ngokuqinisekile. Imidlalo ye-eSports ikhulisa umnotho ngokwakha amathuba emisebenzi ezindaweni ezahlukene, njengezokumaketha, ubuchwepheshe, kanye nezokuxhumana. Abadlali abaningi bangathola imali ethile, futhi lokhu kudala umnotho ophilayo. Umbuzo: Kukhona yini izinselelo ezibhekene nabadlali be-eSports? Impendulo: Yebo, zikhona izinselelo eziningi. Ukuze ube yimpumelelo, kudingeka ukuthi ube nezinsiza ezifanele, njengokuxhumana kwe-inthanethi okuhle, futhi abanye bangase babe nezinselelo zokuthola isikhathi sokudlala ngenxa yezifundo noma imisebenzi. Umbuzo: Ngabe ubona ikusasa le-eSports eNingizimu Afrika linamandla? Impendulo: Ngempela! Ngenxa yokwanda kokuthandwa kwemidlalo ye-eSports, ngibona ukuthi ikusasa layo linethemba elikhulu. Uma sikhulisa ukwesekwa kwemfundo nokuthuthukisa izinsiza, sizobona abadlali abaningi bephumelela. Umbuzo: Ngiyabonga, Nkosinathi, ngokwabelana ngalezi zinkcukacha ezibalulekile. Impendulo: Ngiyabonga! Ngiyajabula ukwabelana ngalezi zinto.

Lithe konke kuzocaca uma sekuphelile ukuzila.Mayelana nohlelo lokuhlinzekwa kwabafundi bezikole zakule ndawo ngemifaniswano, lithe yinto uyise abeyikhonzile kakhulu, lathi yingakho-ke nalo libone kukuhle ukuba likwenze lokhu uyise ayenentshisekelo yakho kakhulu. ''Ubaba ubengumuntu obezifela kakhulu ngemfundo. Wayengenza noma yini uma nje kukhulunywa ngodaba lwemfundo. Yingakho nami ngibone kukuhle ukuthi ngingalenzi iphutha kodwa ngiqhubeke nalolu hlelo ngoba ngihlonipha ubaba ongizalayo," usho kanjena.Kuvelile lapha ukuthi lo mcimbi ukuze uphumelele izinyane liwenze ngokubambisana nabaxhasi abehlukene okuyibona abafake isandla ukuqinisekisa ukuthi ziyatholakala izinto ezidingwa ngabafundi.Zingaphezulu kuka-20 izikole zakule ndawo ezihlomule ngomfaniswano wesikole. Othishanhloko bezikole balushayele ihlombe lolu hlelo, bathi luklama indima enkulu ekulekeleleni abafundi abantulayo basezikoleni zaseMgababa. Isikole, uMnganiwakhe High, esike saba sematheni naso singezinye sezihlomulile.Ngaphambi kokuba aqale ukukhuluma, abantu ebebehambele umcimbi basukumile bathi "Bayede! ''INduna yakule ndawo, uMnuz Lungani Makhathini, nayo ilimise ngesihloko elokuthi inkosi yakule ndawo yinye, esho lona kanye izinyane lenkosi.Kodwa-ke uMakhathini uthe ngenxa yokuthi bayahlonipha, bazolinda ukuzila kwezinsuku ezingu-90 ngaphambi kokuba konke kuhlale obala.Unxuse isizwe ukuba siqhubeke nokweseka izinyane njengoba besikade vele senza nakuyise esadla anhlamvana.

ISIKHULU esiphezulu seKhomishini yezoKhetho kuleli, i-Independent Electoral Commission (IEC), uMnuz Sy Mamabolo, siyalele amaqembu ezepolitiki ukuthi asheshe alungise uhlu lwabantu azofolosa ngabo okhethweni oluzayo.UMamabolo uthe amacala amaningi ababewaxazulula okhethweni lukazwelonke nolwezifundazwe lwango-2024, ayemayelana nezikhalo ngabajutshwe amaqembu. "Amaqembu kumele kuthi kushaya uJulayi 30, abe eseyiphothulile eyohlu lwabantu abazowamela. Aba maningi amacala okwadingeka siwaxazulule ayethinta abantu abazojutshwa amaqembu okhethweni lwango-2024," kusho uMamabolo izolo ngesikhathi bekhuluma ngamalungiselelo okhetho, ekomitini loMnyango wezaseKhaya ePhalamende. UMamabolo uthe zizoba zimbili izimpelasonto zokubhalisela ukuvota ngaphambi kokhetho. "Eyokuqala kwamenyezelwa ukuthi izoba ngoJuni 20 no-21. Eyesibili izoba ngasekuqaleni kuka-Agasti. "Uthe balindele ukuthi lufakwe ngokusemthethweni emqulwini kahulumeni usuku lokhetho ngo-Agasti. Lokhu kuzokwenziwa nguNgqongqoshe wokuBusa ngokuBambisana neziNdaba zoMdabu kuleli, uMnuz Velenkosini Hlabisa. UHlabisa kulindeleke amemezele usuku lokhetho ngaphambi kokuphela kukaJuni. Ukhetho kulindeleke ukuthi lube ngoNovemba noma uJanuwari.UNksz Dawn Mbatha, isikhulu esibhekele imali kwikhomishini, uthe banesabelomali sika-R4.75 billion kulo nyakamali.Uthe bayaxoxa noMnyango kaMgcinimafa ngemali njengoba kubhekwe okhethweni. UMamabolo uthe baqinisa izinhlelo zabo ukuze kungabi nezikhalo ngemiphumela yokhetho.

Ingxoxo Nengcibi: Umthelela Wokwanda Kwezindawo Zokusebenza Ezihlanganyelwayo Umbuzo: Sawubona, Ngiyabonga ngokuba lapha. Ucabanga ukuthi umthelela wezindawo zokusebenza ezihlanganyelwayo ubonakala kanjani emnothweni wethu? Impendulo: Sawubona! Ngiyabonga ngokungimema. Ngicabanga ukuthi izindawo zokusebenza ezihlanganyelwayo zikhulisa kakhulu umnotho. Zihlinzeka ngezinsiza ezithuthukisa ukusebenza kwezimboni ezahlukene, futhi zenza kube lula ukusizana phakathi kwabantu abavela emikhakheni ehlukene. Umbuzo: Ngabe zikhona izinzuzo ezithile ezitholakala kubasebenzi? Impendulo: Yebo, ziningi. Okokuqala, izindawo ezihlanganyelwayo zikhuthaza ubudlelwano. Abasebenzi bangahlangana nabanye abantu, bathole imicabango emisha futhi bakhe amanethiwekhi abawadingayo ukuze baqhubeke bephumelela. Lokhu kwandisa amathuba okuthola amaklayenti nokwakha izixazululo ezintsha. Umbuzo: Kukhona yini nezinselelo ezihambisana nalezi zindawo? Impendulo: Impela, kunezinselelo. Abanye abantu bangase bazizwe bengakhululekile, ikakhulukazi uma bezidinga indawo ethule. Futhi, ukuze uthole ukusebenza kahle, kubalulekile ukuthi izindawo zibe nezinqubo ezicacile zokusetshenziswa. Umbuzo: Ngabe uhlela ukukwaziwa ngaphezulu kwezindawo zokusebenza ezihlanganyelwayo? Impendulo: Yebo, ngiyabheka izindlela zokuthuthukisa izindawo ezinjalo. Lolu hlobo lokusebenza luyathandwa, futhi ukukhulisa imithombo yokuxhumana nezinsiza ezitholakalayo kuzoba kubalulekile ukuze sithuthukise imiphumela. Umbuzo: Ngiyabonga ngokwabelana ngemicabango yakho! Impendulo: Ngiyabonga kakhulu! Ukukhuluma ngalolu daba kuhle kakhulu, futhi ngithemba ukuthi sizobona intuthuko enkulu ezindaweni zokusebenza ezihlanganyelwayo.

Naye wabika emaphoyiseni kodwa icala laphelela emoyeni,” kubeka uCele.Uthe uma ekhumbula kahle, lesi yisigameko sesithathu esikhathini esingangezinyanga eziyisishiyagalombili. "Zibulawelwa endaweni eyodwa, nokwenza sicabange ukuthi amasela asicekela phansi abantu ababodwa,” kusho uCele, othe indlela okwenzeka ngayo babuye babe nakho ukusola ukuthi amasela kungenzeka kube abantu bendawo abasebenzisana nabokuhamba. Uthe lokhu bakusho ngoba abanazo izimpendulo zokuthi umuntu wokuhamba angaluthathaphi ulwazi lokuthi amadlelo endawo angakuphi. Unxuse amaphoyisa ukuthi alusukumele lolu daba ngoba nakuba omunye umuntu engayibuka incane into yokwebiwa kwemfuyo kodwa isuke iwudume lwengozi kubanikazi. Wenze umfanekiso ngaye, wathi lezi zinkomo ezebiwe zingabiza u-R120 000 uma zidayiswa. Okhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uCaptain Ntathu Ndlovu, uthe amaphoyisa aseMehlomnyama aphenya icala lokwebiwa kwemfuyo kulandela ukuthi kwebiwe izinkomo eziyisikhombisa eMawuleni. Hheyi, unjani? Ngifuna ukukhuluma nawe ngendaba ethokozisayo—ukhula kwemakethe yezimoto zikagesi. Ucabanga ukuthi lokhu kukhula kuzoba nomthelela omkhulu empilweni yethu? Ngicabanga ukuthi kunjalo! Ucabanga ukuthi sizokwazi yini?

"Okokuqala nje ngangizotholani ngokubulala umuntu engingamazi,'' ubuze kanjena.Uthe waqala ukubona uFaith ngesikhathi ethola ucingo olwaluvela kuCele owayemcela ukuba ahambe aye eMega City, eMlaza ayothatha imoto. ''Ngesikhathi engishayela ucingo wangitshela ukuthi kunemoto yakhe ayithengile okumele ngiyoyilanda eMega City.

Ukuhlaziywa komthelela wemidlalo ye-eSports entsheni yaseNingizimu Afrika Emhlabeni wesimanje, umphakathi ubhekene nezinguquko ezinkulu ngenxa yobuchwepheshe, futhi imidlalo ye-eSports ithole ukugxila okukhulu, ikakhulukazi entsheni yaseNingizimu Afrika. I-eSports, okukhulunywa ngayo lapha, ibhekisela emidlalweni yevidiyo edlalwa ngamathimba noma ngabanye abantu, futhi inezimpikiswano eziningi lapho abadlali besebenzisa amakhono abo ukuze baphumelele. Umthelela wemidlalo ye-eSports entabeni yentsha yaseNingizimu Afrika ungaphezu kokuwina imiklomelo. Okokuqala, imidlalo ye-eSports ikhuthaza ukuthuthukiswa kwamakhono athile, njengokucabanga ngokushesha, ukuhlela, nokusebenza kahle ngokubambisana. Lezi zinto zinomthelela omuhle emsebenzini nasemfundo, njengoba izinkampani eziningi zifuna abafakizolo abaneqiniso ekuxhumaneni nasekuhlanganyeleni. Ngaphandle kwalokho, i-eSports ibuye iveze amathuba amasha emisebenzi. Njengoba umkhakha uqhubeka nokukhula, kudingeka abantu abanohlu olubanzi lwamakhono, kuhlanganise noxhaso lwezobuchwepheshe, ubuchwepheshe bokuxhumana, kanye nezezimali. Lokhu kudala amathuba emisebenzi emisha, ikakhulukazi kubantu abasha abakhula ezingeni lemidlalwana. Ngaphezu kwalokho, imidlalo ye-eSports iyinsika yokuxhumana phakathi kwabantu. Abadlali bahlala bexhumene nabanye, bekhuluma ngezinhlelo zabo nemiphumela, futhi bakha ubudlelwano obunempilo. Lokhu kusiza ekufundeni okuhle kwezemidlalo, ngakolunye uhlanga, kuphinde kube negalelo ekupheleni kwezinkinga ezihlobene nezehlakalo njengezinkinga zokucindezeleka nezokwehluleka. Ekugcineni, umthelela wemidlalo ye-eSports emnothweni nasekuhlangenwe nakho kwemiphakathi yaseNingizimu Afrika ungachazwa njengowesikhathi eside. I-eSports, njengengxenye yezenzakalo zesimanje, ibalulekile ekwakheni umphakathi onokuxhumana okuhle kanye nezinkanyezi ezisha emkhakheni wezokungcebeleka.

Ukwaziswa nge-blockchain, ikakhulukazi njengobuchwepheshe obusekelwa kwi-cryptocurrency, sekuphele iminyaka yokuphila kwayo, sazi kahle ukuthi yayiqale kanjani njengesixazululo sokugcina izimali zedijithali. Nokho, ukusetshenziswa kwayo kudlule kakhulu kule ndawo, kube nezinqumo eziningi ezizwakala phansi kwezimali. Ngemuva kokwaziswa kwayo, abantu abaningi baqonda ukuthi i-blockchain ingasetshenziswa kwezinye izindawo, njengoba igcina amarekhodi anembile futhi anokwethenjelwa. Kusukela ngo-2015, izinkampani eziningi ziqalile ukukhipha izinhlelo zokusebenza ezichitha i-blockchain ukuze zilungise izinkinga ezivamile. Isibonelo, emkhakheni wezempilo, i-blockchain isetshenziswa ukulawula amarekhodi wezempilo. Lokhu kuqinisekisa ukuthi ulwazi lwemiguli lugcinwa ngokuphepha, ngaphandle kokuphazamiseka, futhi lungafinyelelwa kalula ngababheki bezempilo. Ngaphandle kwalokho, i-blockchain ithuthukiswe emkhakheni wezokuthengisa. Izinkampani zifaka izinhlelo ezisebenzisa i-blockchain ukulandelela imikhiqizo, ziqinisekisa ukuthi ababukeli bazi ukuthi imikhiqizo etholiwe ivela kuphi, nokuthi ngabe iyahambisana nezindinganiso eziphezulu. Lokhu kube usizo olukhulu ekunciphiseni ukukhwabanisa, njengoba abathengi bengakwazi ukuqinisekisa izimpahla ezingekho emthethweni. Ngalesi sikhathi, i-blockchain itholakala nakumkhakha wezokuthutha. Amathuluzi athuthukisiwe aklanywa ukuze alandele izimpahla ngesikhathi sangempela, kuqinisekiswa ukuthi zifinyelela kumakhasimende ngokushesha nangempumelelo. Le ndlela ibonisa ukuthi, nangaphandle kwezimali, i-blockchain iyithuluzi elinamandla lokuphucula izinqubo emikhakheni eyahlukene, ikhulisa ukusebenza kahle, futhi ikhulisa ukwethenjwa phakathi kwabathengisi nabathengi. Ngakho-ke, nakuba i-blockchain iqale njengendlela yokuphatha imali, umbhalo wayo omkhulu uye uba yinsika emikhakheni eminingi, udlulisela esikhathini esizayo sokusebenza okwejwayelekile nokuqhubekayo. Ubufakazi balesi sikhathi buveza ukuthi ubuchwepheshe bukhona ukuze buphendule izidingo zomphakathi, futhi lokho kuchaza impumelelo yalo empilweni yethu yanamuhla.

"Ukuqokwa kwakhe kusishiya nemibuzo eminingi yokuthi ngabe akunagcobho yini, futhi kwenza sibe magange ukubheka ukuthi akukho chashaza yini elingase linamekeke egameni lakhe,” kusho uNksz James.UMnuz Ian Cameron weDemocratic Alliance (DA) uthe nakuba bebefisa ukuthi kube khona okwenzekayo ngoMasemola, kodwa abanaso isiqiniseko sokuthi uDimpane uzokwazi yini ukumelana nalo msebenzi ikakhulu ngoba akanawo amava awo.ULiet General Dimpane unamava eminyaka eya ku-20 omsebenzi, kanti uqale ukwenza umsebenzi wokuba yiSikhulu soPhiko lwezeziMali kwezamaPhoyisa ngo-2018. Ngaphambi kwalokho uke waba yiPhini likaKhomishana wamaPhoyisa eFree State, waba yiNhloko yoPhiko lwezeziMali lwe-SAPS, futhi wabamba isikhashana ekubeni wuMholi woPhiko lokuCwaninga amaBhuku emaPhoyiseni. Ngokwemfundo uneziqu ze-BCom in Business Administration.Khonamanjalo, uMshushisi woMbuso u-Adv Santhos Manilall watshela iNkantolo ukuthi uMasemola kumele avele enkantolo naye uMatlala nabanye abathintekayo kulo mkhonyovu wethenda. Icala likaMasemola lizobuyela eNkantolo yeMantshi ePitoli ngoMeyi 13.

Ukusetshenziswa Kwezimali Zedijithali Emabhizinisini Amancane Isingeniso Emkhakheni wezamabhizinisi, izimali zedijithali (cryptocurrency) zikhule zaba yinsiza eyingqayizivele, ikakhulukazi kumabhizinisi amancane. Lezi zimali zikhulisa amathuba okwandisa inzuzo, ukuhweba, nokwenza izinqumo ezihlakaniphile.
