Lokhu kukhuphula izinga lokuncintisana phakathi kwamabhizinisi amancane, kunciphisa izindleko, futhi kwandisa ukufinyelela kumakhasimende. Izinzuzo Zokusebenzisa Izimali Zedijithali 1. Izindleko Zokuhweba Eziphansi: Izimali zedijithali zinciphisa izindleko zokuhweba, njengoba zingadingi izikhungo ezinkulu zezimali. Lokhu kubalulekile kumabhizinisi amancane afuna ukunciphisa izindleko zawo. 2. Ukufinyelela Emakethe Yamazwe Ngamazwe: Izimali zedijithali zenza kube lula kumabhizinisi amancane ukufinyelela emakethe yomhlaba. Lokhu kuvumela abanikazi bamabhizinisi ukuba bathole amakhasimende avela ezindaweni ezahlukene, okwandisa amathuba okukhula. 3. Ukuphepha Nokuthembeka: I-blockchain, okuyisisekelo se-cryptocurrency, inikeza ukuvikeleka okuphezulu. Lokhu kuqinisekisa ukuthi ukudluliswa kwemali kuphephile futhi kuqinisekisiwe, okwenza kube lula ukuhweba. Izithiyo Ezingase Zibe Khona Nokho, kunezithiyo ezithile ezibhekene namabhizinisi amancane uma efuna ukusebenzisa izimali zedijithali. Lokhu kufaka phakathi ukungaqondi kahle kwezimali zedijithali, izinkinga zokuhweba, kanye nemithetho ehlukahlukene ezweni. Kubalulekile ukuthi abanikazi bamabhizinisi baqonde kahle lezi zinkinga ukuze bakwazi ukuzixazulula. Isiphetho Ukusetshenziswa kwezimali zedijithali kumabhizinisi amancane kunikeza amathuba amakhulu okukhula nokuphumelela. Ngokuhlola izinzuzo kanye nezithiyo, abanikazi bamabhizinisi bangathuthukisa izinqubo zabo zokuhweba, baphumelele emhlabeni wezomnotho. Ukufunda nokuhlola izimali zedijithali kuyisinyathelo esibalulekile sokwakha ikusasa eliqhakazile.

Uthe umthetho ucacile ukuthi ingane eneminyaka engu-12 ayikwazi ukuvuma ukuya ocansini. Ukhale ngosonhlalakahle athe bayahluleka ukubika amacala emaphoyiseni. "Ezinye iziteshi zamaphoyisa aziwamukeli la macala. Umthetho wezingane kanjalo nothinta ucansi, uyalela ukuthi kubikwe icala uma kunengane eneminyaka engaphansi kwengu-16 ekhulelwe. "Uthe ngeke bakuvumele ukuthi kudlwengulwe izingane ziphinde zikhuleliswe. "Abomthetho kumele benze umsebenzi wabo, abenzi bobubi baboshwe, bajeziswe," usho kanje. Uthe umthetho ukubeka kucace ukuthi uhulumeni kumele enze okuthile. Umthetho uyalela othisha, abahlengikazi, odokotela, osonhlalakahle nabanye abasebenza nezingane ukuthi babike emaphoyiseni uma kunengane encane ekhulelwe.Kowezemfundo kwakhalwa ngokuthi abanye abazali, bagcina behoxisa amacala emuva kokuba osuke enze icala ethembise ukukhokha inhlawulo. Abanye othisha sebekwe balahlwa amacala okulala nezingane. Abanye kuthiwa bathembisa ukukhokha ilobolo ukuze bangaboshwa, bese imindeni iba manqika ukuvula amacala okudlwengula.

Izindlela zokuvikela izingane emhlabeni wedijithali Emhlabeni wamanje, lapho ubuchwepheshe buhamba phambili, izingane zikhula zihlala emhlabeni wedijithali. Lokhu kuhle, kodwa kudinga ukuthi sibe nezinqubo eziqinile zokuvikela izingane zethu. Ngiyakholelwa ukuthi, uma singanaki, singabeka izingane zethu engcupheni enkulu. Okokuqala, kubalulekile ukufundisa izingane zethu ngezingozi ezihambisana nokusebenzisa i-inthanethi. Lokhu kufaka phakathi ukwazi ukuthi akufanele zabelane ngemininingwane yazo siqu, njengegama, ikheli, noma inombolo yocingo. Ukufundisa izingane ukuthi zihlale ziqaphele, kuzobasiza ukuba bazi ukuthi akukhona konke okuvela ku-inthanethi okungokwenyama. Okwesibili, abazali kufanele babe nomthelela oqinile ekusetshenzisweni kwezingane zabo kwezemidlalo zedijithali. Lokhu kungafaka phakathi ukusetha imikhawulo yokuthi zingaki izinsuku noma amahora ezingane zingachitha ku-inthanethi. Lokhu kuzobasiza ukuba bahlale bephila impilo enempilo, behlukanisa isikhathi sabo phakathi kokudlala, ukufunda, nokuphumula. Ngaphezu kwalokho, kubalulekile ukuba sibe nezinhlelo zokuhlola okuqukethwe okutholakala ku-inthanethi. Abazali bangasebenzisa izinhlelo zokuvikela ezitholakalayo ukuze baqinisekise ukuthi izingane zabo azitholi okuqukethwe okungafanele. Lokhu kuzobasiza ukuba bahlale bephephile, futhi bazi ukuthi baphila kanjani emhlabeni wedijithali. Ekugcineni, kufanele sikhuthaze izingane zethu ukuba zikhulume nathi uma zikhathazekile noma zithola okuthile okungajabulisi ku-inthanethi. Ukuxhumana okuhle phakathi kwabazali nezingane kuzokwakha isikhala sokwethembana, okubalulekile ukuze izingane zethu zikwazi ukusibona njengabavikeli bazo. Ngakho-ke, njengomphakathi, kufanele sihlanganyele ukuze siqinisekise ukuthi izingane zethu zikhula ziphephile emhlabeni wedijithali. Lokhu kudinga ukuzinikela, ukuqonda, nokubambisana. Izingane zethu zidinga ukuvikelwa, futhi thina, njengabazali, singaba yizikhali zazo.

Sivele sesibaqokile abaholi abaphezulu abazohola ithimba. "Ithimba ebelikhona belinabaholi abangaphezu kuka-60.Kulindeleke ukuthi abaningi badliwe yizembe njengoba uMbalula akuveza phambilini ukuthi bazolinciphisa ithimba.UMbalula wakhala nogokuthi ithimba ebelikhona liyahluleka ukwenza umsebenzi walo, lazi ukulwa izimpi zangaphakathi kuphela.Waze wafanisa ithimba nohlobo lwemoto i-Tazz.I-ANC isanda kumemezela izinguquko ebuholi obuphezulu bethimba elihola isifundazwe.Kulezi zinguquko kuqokwe uMnuz Mike Mabuyakhulu njengomdidiyeli, kwathi uMnuz James Nxumalo waqokwa njengomgqugquzeli.Kulezi zinguquko ezimenyezelwe uMbalula ngeledlule, abaholi abanohlonze okubalwa kubo, uMnuz Jeff Radebe, uNkk Nomusa Dube-Ncube, noNkk Weziwe Thusi, badliwe yizembe.UMbalula uveze ukuthi bazophinde baqoke amathimba azohola i-ANC ezifundeni. "NgoMsombuluko, ngeholidi, sizoqoka ubuholi bazo zonke izifunda ze-ANC KwaZulu-Natal. "Lokhu kusho ukuthi buzodliwa yizembe ubuholi be-ANC ezifundeni obaqokwa ngonyaka odlule.Ubuholi obuzomenyezelwa wuMbalula buzohola umkhankaso we-ANC KwaZulu-Natal.Kubheda uhlelo kwi-ANC KwaZulu-Natal njengoba yaphunyukwa yisifundazwe okhethweni lwango-2024.I-ANC iyiqembu lesithathu ngobukhulu KwaZulu-Natal, iyingxenye kahulumeni wokubambisana.Izinto zaqala ukuyibhedela okhethweni lohulumeni basekhaya lwango-2021 i-ANC KwaZulu-Natal lapho eyalahlekelwa khona yinqwaba yomasipala.

Ukuhlaziywa kokwanda kokusebenza kwama-robot embonini, uThandi Mthembu ungumcwaningi ophumelelayo emkhakheni wezobuchwepheshe, ogxile ekwakheni nasekuthuthukiseni ukusebenza kwama-robot embonini. UThandi wazalelwa eThekwini, lapho aqala khona ukuthakasela ubuchwepheshe kusukela ebuncaneni. Ngemva kokuphothula izifundo zakhe zezeMfundo eNyuvesi yaseNatal, wathola ithuba lokusebenza emkhakheni wezobuchwepheshe bokukhiqiza. Ngemva kweminyaka eminingi yokusebenza, uThandi uqaphele ukuthi ama-robot angakhulisa ukusebenza kwemikhiqizo, anciphise izindleko, futhi akhulise ukukhiqiza. Uhlaziye izindlela ezahlukene zokusebenzisa ama-robot, ahlola izinzuzo nezingozi ezihambisana nokufakwa kwama-robot emigqeni yokukhiqiza. UThandi ukholelwa ukuthi ukuhlanganiswa kwama-robot emsebenzini kungaholela ekwandeni kokusebenza, okwenza imboni ibe namandla kakhulu. UThandi uphinde waba neqhaza elikhulu ekwakheni izinhlelo zokusebenza ezisebenzayo ezihlanganisa ama-robot, ezithuthukisa ukusebenza kwabasebenzi. Uhlale efuna izindlela ezintsha zokwenza izinto, futhi ubona ukuthi ubuchwepheshe bama-robot buvulelekile ekuthuthukiseni imikhakha eminingi, kuhlanganise nezokwakha, ezokuthutha, nezokudla. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, uThandi ube yisibonelo esihle sokuthi ubuchwepheshe bama-robot bungathuthukisa kanjani imboni, futhi ubonisa ukuthi ukwakhiwa kobuchwepheshe obuphumelelayo kudinga ubuchule, ubuhlakani, kanye nokubambisana phakathi kwabantu. UThandi Mthembu ungumholi ophambili emkhakheni wezobuchwepheshe, futhi ubheke phambili ekwakheni ikusasa eliqhakazile lama-robot embonini.

Lapha kuvela ukuthi abanye abazali baye bangakwazi ukulawula isimo ngendlela efanele. Leli phuzu ligqamisa abazali abangakwazi ukukhuluma nezingane zabo ngezinto okungafanele zingene kuzo. Kuhlaluka ukuthi yisifo sakhona esesithathwa njengamahlalakhona kwabansundu ukungakhulumi nezingane ngezinto ezijulile okubalwa kuzo nokuya ocansini. Akuqondakali ukuthi yini efaka abazali amanzi emadolweni ngoba ukwesaba kwabo kungenisa amanzi endlini.Enye into ebekwa eqhulwini njengesihlava sokukhulelwa kwentsha yingcindezi yontanga. Kuthiwa intsha engontanga kulula ukuthi ifakelane ingcindezi ngokwenza izinto eziphambene nokulunga.Izingxoxo zezingane ezingaba bukhoma noma ezinkundleni zokuxhumana, zingenza oyingxenye yazo agcine esengena ezintweni angaziqondi ngokuphelele njengokuya ocansini agcine esekhulelwa noma esekhulelisa. Enye ingozi yengcindezi yontanga yizidakamizwa. Ochwepheshe kwezokukhuliswa kwezingane basanwaya amakhanda bexakwa wukuthi kungani izingane njalo zikhetha ukungena kwi-internet uma zifuna ulwazi ngezinto ezithinta ucansi. Okuxaka kakhulu ongoti wukuthi nolwazi olungaziphephisa lusuke lukhona kepha intsha ikhetha ukugxila noma ukusebenzisa olungabalungele abantu abasebancane ngokweminyaka.Ephuzwini lendlala, kuqhakanjiswa ukuthi izingane zamantombazane zigcina ziya ocansini ngoba zifuna ukuhlomula ngezinto ezinhle ezisuke zizidinga.

UMHOLI we-EFF, uMnuz Julius Malema, ufuna kuthathelwe izinyathelo umshushisi wecala eliholele ekutheni agwetshwe iminyaka emihlanu ebhadla ejele, u-Advocate Joel Cesar.UMalema ufake isikhalo esisemthethweni enhlanganweni yezokushushisa, iNational Prosecuting Authority (NPA), lapho ecele khona ukuthi kuphenywe uCesar.UCesar ubengumshushisi ecaleni likaMalema lokuqhumisa isibhamu.Encwadini yabameli, uMalema usola uCesar ngokwephula imigomo yeNPA.UMalema uthe uCesar wenza okungafanele ngesikhathi egunyaza ukuthi isibhamu esaqhunyiswa uMalema sibuyiselwe kumnikazi waso ekubeni inkantolo ingakanqumi ukumkhipha phambili umnikazi wesibhamu.Umnikazi wesibhamu, uMnuz Adriaan Snyman, watholwa engenacala.USnyman, owayengumqaphi kaMalema ngesikhathi eqhumisa isibhamu, ubonakala kwi-video enikeza uMalema isibhamu asiqhumisa ngesikhathi kunomcimbi wokugubha iminyaka engu-10 kwasungulwa i-EFF.UMalema uthe uCesar wakhipha umyalelo wokuthi uSnyman abuyiselwe isibhamu ngaphambi kokuthi inkantolo imkhiphe phambili. "UCesar watshela abameli bakaSnyman ukuthi isibhamu bazosithola enkantolo. Isibhamu sabuyiselwa kuSnyman ekuseni ngosuku okwaphuma ngalo isinqumo sokuthi akanacala. Lokho kusho ukuthi wabuyiselwa isibhamu ngaphambi kokuthi kuphume isinqumo senkantolo. "UMalema uqhuba athi uCesar akanalo igunya lokukhipha umyalelo wokuthi kubuyiselwe uSnyman isibhamu.UMalema uthe yimantshi noma ijaji abanamandla okunquma ukuba kubuyiselwe ubufakazi emuva uma sekuphothulwe icala.

"Athe le moto ayithole ingenamuntu phakathi, isele dengwane. Athi uma eyibheka ngemumva, athola kukhona inqwaba yenyama nezinhloko. Athi uma eyongikhombisa, nebala ngathola ukuthi yizo izinkomo zami lezi engithi zidukile,” usho kanje. Uthe amaphoyisa aqhubeke amtshela ukuthi athe uma ephenya ngale moto etholakele, kwavela ukuthi yayibikwe ukuthi yebiwe esiteshini samaphoyisa i-Durban Central nyakenye. "Ngiphatheke kabi ngokuthi sintshontshelwe imfuyo ngale ndlela. Sifisa amaphoyisa enze kangcono ngamacala okwebiwa kwemfuyo ngoba siyawabika ngethemba lokuthi kukhona abazoboshwa kodwa uphenyo lwakhona luphelele emoyeni,” kusho uCele.Uthe njengoba yena elahlekelwe yimfuyo, ungowesibili emndenini ukulahlekelwa esikhathini esiyizinyanga ezimbalwa. "Umalume wami ubulawelwe ezine ngasekupheleni konyaka odlule. Nezakhe zabulawa ngendlela efanayo emadlelweni. Yena-ke akazange athole namkhondo. Naye wabika emaphoyiseni kodwa icala laphelela emoyeni,” kubeka uCele.Uthe uma ekhumbula kahle, lesi yisigameko sesithathu esikhathini esingangezinyanga eziyisishiyagalombili. "Zibulawelwa endaweni eyodwa, nokwenza sicabange ukuthi amasela asicekela phansi abantu ababodwa,” kusho uCele, othe indlela okwenzeka ngayo babuye babe nakho ukusola ukuthi amasela kungenzeka kube abantu bendawo abasebenzisana nabokuhamba. Uthe lokhu bakusho ngoba abanazo izimpendulo zokuthi umuntu wokuhamba angaluthathaphi ulwazi lokuthi amadlelo endawo angakuphi.

Uveze ukuthi wagcina ekwazile ukuphuma endlini abaleke ayofuna usizo.Njengamanje ubhacile ngoba ubona kahle ukuthi umyeni wakhe uma engahlangana naye angaqeda ngaye. ''Ngenxa yalesi simo ngibone kungcono ukuba ngithuthe emzini wethu ngiye kwenye indawo ngoba ngisabela impilo yami," kusho yena.Uthe udaba ulubikile emaphoyiseni waboshwa umyeni wakhe wavela nasenkantolo kodwa kuyimanje ungaphandle ngebheyili. ''Uyabona njengoba engaphandle ngebheyili ngisaba kakhulu ngoba angimazi ukuthi yini ayicabangayo ngami. Ukukhuluma iqiniso nje, ngizizwa ngingaphephile nje nhlobo,'' echaza.Okhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uLieutenant Paul Magwaza, ukuqinisekisile ukuthi kunowesilisa oboshwe ngamaphoyisa ngemuva kokuba ezame ukubulala owesifazane oneminyaka engu-36. Uthe lo wesifazane walimala kabi. ''Lo wesifazane walimala, umsolwa yena uke wavela eNkantolo yeMantshi yaseMlaza,'' usho kanjena.

KUPHELILE ngabafundi bakaJesu baseDanango, KwaMaphumulo, igama labo elibe sematheni emasontweni edlule. Kungumlando manje ukuthi Isolezwe laba ngelokuqala ukubika kabanzi ngalolu daba.Laya khona lakhuluma nomsunguli webandla uMfu Vusumuzi Sibiya owageqa amagula ngohlobo lwempilo ehlukile athi iphilwa ngabafundi bakaJesu.Wasebenzisa amagama athi bonke abahlala kule ndawo yingoba badele konke okomhlaba. Phakathi kwezinto athi bazidelile amabhizinizisi, imali, yimisebenzi, yimindeni, isikole kanye nabayeka ukudla imishanguzo yokuthithibilasa igciwane lengculazi. NgoMsombuluko uvelelwe ngokukhulu uSibiya ngesikhathi ebizwa umkhandlu wenkosi yakwaQwabe omyalele ukuba abafundi bakaJesu baphume baphele endaweni. Ikhuluma lapha Inkosi uQwabe ilimise ngesihloko elokuthi uSibiya uphambene nenqubomgomo yesizwe. "Mina bengingazi ukuthi kanti wena uhlala nabantu abaningi kangaka kwakho futhi obenzisa izinto ezinjena," isho kanjena.Inkosi ithe aqale ukuzwa ngalolu daba ngemuva kokuba kade lubhalwe kwiSolezwe. Kube sekuphuma isinqumo sokuthi makuphele ngabafundi bakaJesu engakapheli amahora angu-48.Lwagoba uphondo kuSibiya wavuma wathi kuzoba njalo. Izolo ekuseni abafundi bakaJesu bebematasa beqiqinga izimpahla zabo bebuyela emakhaya abo.Nokuba kunje uSibiya utshele Isolezwe ukuthi kakuphelile ngombuso kaNkulunkuku ngoba laba abahlukana nabo emhlabeni bayohlangana ezulwini isangasekho inkosi eyobaxosha.Phambilini uSibiya watshela Isolezwe ukuthi ngempela bashiye konke okomhlaba. "Umhlaba sekumele wazi manje ukuthi kunesizwe esingcwele kodwa esisemhlabeni esidele konke.

Izinguquko emikhubeni yokuthenga ngenxa yokukhula kwe-e-commerce Ngokukhula okukhulu kwe-e-commerce, izinguquko ezinkulu zenzeka emikhubeni yokuthenga. Ngaphambi kokuthi kube khona lezi zinkundla zokuthenga eziku-inthanethi, umthengi wayephoqeleka ukuba aphume endlini, afune izitolo, futhi abhekane nezixakaxaka. Kodwa manje, konke sekushintshile. Ngiyavuma, ngithanda ukuhamba ezitolo, kodwa ngiyabona ukuthi e-commerce iletha ubuhle obungakaze bubonakale. Okokuqala, kube lula ukuthola imikhiqizo ehlukene. Ngaphandle kokukhathazeka ngokuhamba, ungathenga noma yini kusukela ezitolo ezinkulu kuya kumakhelwane. Lokhu kubalulekile, ikakhulukazi kulabo abanesikhathi esincane. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izinkundla zokuthenga eziku-inthanethi zikhombisa izibuyekezo ezivela kwabanye abathengi, okwenza kube lula ukwenza izinqumo ezihlakaniphile. Nokho, akukhona konke okuhle. Ukuthenga ku-inthanethi kungaholela ekunciphiseni kokuxhumana komuntu siqu. Abantu baphila ezindaweni ezixakile, futhi ukungabi khona kokuhlangana nabanye kungaholela ekudakeni. Ngaphezu kwalokho, kunezingozi zokukhwabanisa, futhi abathengi kufanele babe qaphelile uma bethenga. Ngakho-ke, ngicabanga ukuthi, nakuba e-commerce iletha izinzuzo eziningi, kubalulekile ukuthi sikhumbule ukubaluleka kokuxhumana komuntu siqu. Ukuthenga akufanele kube nje ukuhweba; kufanele kube yinto ethokozisayo, enezinkumbulo ezinhle. Kumele sifunde ukusebenzisa lezi zinkundla zokuthenga ngendlela efanele, ukuze sithole okuhle kakhulu kokubili emhlabeni wokuthenga.

Ukusetshenziswa kwe-blockchain ngaphandle kwezimali zedijithali Ngokwanda kokusetshenziswa kwe-blockchain, abacwaningi nabathuthukisi baphenya izindlela eziningi zokusebenzisa le teknoloji ngaphandle kwemali zedijithali. I-blockchain, eyaziwa kakhulu ngezimali ezifana ne-Bitcoin, isivele yaba yinsiza ewusizo emikhakheni ehlukene, okuhlanganisa ezempilo, ezokuxhumana, kanye nezokuthutha. Omunye wemikhakha ephumelelayo wukuphathwa kwemithombo yezempilo. Izibhedlela zisebenzisa i-blockchain ukugcina amarekhodi wezempilo, okuvumela ukuxhumana okungcono phakathi kwezikhungo zezempilo. Lokhu kuhlinzeka ngokuqinisekiswa kokuthi ulwazi lwezempilo lukhona, luhlala lukhona, futhi lutholakala kalula, okwenza kube lula ukuhlinzeka ngempilo engcono kubaguli. Ngaphezu kwalokho, i-blockchain isetshenziswa ekuphathweni kwezimoto. Izinkampani ezithuthukisa izimoto ezizimele zisebenzisa le teknoloji ukuqinisekisa ukuthi ulwazi lokuhamba kwemoto luhlonishwa futhi lutholakala kalula. Lokhu kusiza ekugwemeni ubugebengu bokukhwabanisa, njengoba wonke umsebenzisi angabona umlando ophelele wemoto. Ezinye izinkampani zisebenzisa i-blockchain ekuphathweni kwezimali, lapho ibhalwa khona yonke imisebenzi yezezimali ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuhweba okungcono. Lokhu kudala ukwethembeka phakathi kwabathengisi, kunciphisa amathuba okukhwabanisa. Ngokubheka lezi zinhlelo, kubonakala ukuthi i-blockchain iyithuluzi elinamandla elingasiza emikhakheni ehlukene, ngaphandle kokuba kuphela izimali zedijithali. Lokhu kukhombisa ukuthi le teknoloji ingaba nomthelela omkhulu ekuthuthukiseni izinqubo eziningi, futhi ibonisa ikusasa eliqhakazile lokusetshenziswa kwayo.

Ukusetshenziswa kobuhlakani bokwenziwa embonini yezokuthutha Emhlabeni wanamuhla, ubuhlakani bokwenziwa (AI) busebenza njengomgogodla wezinguquko ezinkulu embonini yezokuthutha. Lokhu kubonakala ngokwanda kokusetshenziswa kwemishini yokufunda, izinhlelo zokusebenza ezihlakaniphile, kanye nezimoto ezizimele. Ukusebenzisa lezi zindlela, izinkampani zikwazi ukuthuthukisa ukusebenza kahle, ukunciphisa izindleko, nokwandisa ukuphepha. Okokuqala, ubuhlakani bokwenziwa buvumela izinkampani ukuthi zihlaziye idatha enkulu ukuze ziqonde izitayela zokuhamba. Lokhu kuhlaziywa kwedatha kusiza ekwakheni izinhlelo zokuhamba ezisebenza kahle, okwenza kube lula ukuhlela imizila yezenzakalo. Njengoba izimoto zisebenzisa izinhlelo zokuhamba ezihlakaniphile, zikwazi ukuhamba ngendlela efanele, zinciphisa isikhathi sokuhamba, futhi zandise ukusebenza kahle. Okwesibili, izimoto ezizimele zisebenzisa ubuhlakani bokwenziwa ukuze ziqonde imvelo ezizungezile. Lezi zimoto zisebenzisa ama-sensors ne-algorithms ukuze zikwazi ukuhamba ngaphandle kokungenelela komuntu, okuholela ekwandeni kokuphepha. Lokhu kubalulekile ikakhulukazi emigwaqweni enokuphazamiseka, lapho izimo zishintsha ngokushesha. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ubuhlakani bokwenziwa buvumela izinkampani zokuthutha ukuthi zithuthukise izinsizakalo zazo. Ngokusebenzisa ama-chatbots nezinhlelo zokusebenza ezihlakaniphile, amakhasimende angathola usizo olusheshayo nolusebenzayo, okwandisa ukwaneliseka kwabathengi. Ngokubheka konke lokhu, kubonakala ukuthi ubuhlakani bokwenziwa buhamba phambili embonini yezokuthutha, buhlinzeka ngezixazululo ezithuthukisa ukusebenza, ukuphepha, nokuhlangenwe nakho kwabathengi. Njengoba le mboni iqhubeka nokukhula, ubuhlakani bokwenziwa buzoba yinsika ebalulekile ekwakheni ikusasa elihlakaniphile nelisebenzayo.

Uthe amaphoyisa abizwa endaweni yesehlo, afika umufi esephuthunyiswe esibhedlela, abuza imibuzo ngokwenzekile kumnikazi womuzi, kwavulwa icala, wathi abasolwa banele babona ukuthi umufi uselimele kanzima, babaleka endaweni. "Kwaphela izinsuku ezimbalwa bengekho endaweni kodwa babuye babuya. Sathi singcwaba base bebuyile, abangaboshwa,” kusho uMtambo. Uqhube wathi babelokhu belindele ukuthi bazoboshwa kodwa kwangenzeka lokho. "Okusiphatha kabi ukuthi sekuze kwaphela cishe unyaka bezihambela ngokukhululeka emphakathini, sabantu abangaze benze lutho. Thina ngapha salahlekelwa othandiweyo ngenxa yabo,” kusho uMtambo.Uthe okubaphatha kabi ukuthi bayazizwa izinkulumo abasolwa abazikhuluma emphakathini, lapho beqhosha ngokuthi akukho mnyakazo ozoke wenzeke ngecala ngoba bona bawakhokhela imali amaphoyisa. Uthe abazi ukuthi le nkulumo iyiqiniso kangakanani kodwa uma bebuka okwenzeka ecaleni, limi ndawonye, basola sengathi iyiqiniso. "Esikukhalelayo ubulungiswa. Sesifisa ukuthi kungenelele noMkhwanazi (uKhomishana wamaPhoyisa eKZN, uLt-General Nhlanhla Mkhwanazi) ngoba usizo asilutholanga emaphoyiseni ebesiwathembile,” usho kanje. Amaphoyisa athe ayiveli imininingwane eqondene nalolu daba ngokwenombolo yecala Isolezwe ebeliyinikwe umndeni.

Lidunyiswa ngesikhiye kanti ine-hand brake edinga ukuthi uyitoboze maqede uyenyuse ngesandla.Le 4x4 ye-JMC ishaya nge-grille nengemuva elinamagama akuheha ukude le, nengikholwa ukuthi azokwenza amakhasimende ayiqaphele futhi akhulume ngayo ngisho isiyosithela.Ngakolunye uhlangothi, iJMC 2.5TD 4x2 double cab auto engiyibambe ngilibhekise eCradle of Humankind World Heritage Site, ingikhumbuze i-Ford Territory ngendlela eshushuluza ngayo emgwaqweni. Ngisho neJMC Vigus eshintshwayo ebengihlezi ngemuva kuyo sibheke e-OR Tambo International Airport, ibishibilika engena kamnandi amagiya ayo. Bekukhombisa ukuthi i-Jiangling Motors Corporation (JMC) le isimnkantshubomvu kwezezimoto njengoba yasungulwa ngo-1947.Ngaphandle kwalokho, inobudlelwano nezinkampani ezidumile i-Isuzu, Ford neChangan esebenzisana nazo ezweni edabuka kulo. Empeleni i-Ford Territory edayisa kuleli yakhiwa efemini yakwaJMC eChina.EChina iJMC iphinde yakhe nezakwa-Isuzu iD-Max neMU-X.Intengo: JMC Vigus 2.5TD double cab manual - R399,900JMC Vigus 2.5TD double cab 4x2 8AT - R459,900 JMC Vigus 2.5 double cab 4WD - R499, 900Zifika ne-service plan yeminyaka emine noma u-200 000km, i-warranty yeminyaka emihlanu noma u-200 000km.

Umthelela wokukhula kwemakethe yezimoto zikagesi Ngokwezibalo zakamuva, imakethe yezimoto zikagesi ibonisa ukukhula okukhulu emhlabeni jikelele, okuthinta izimboni eziningi. Ngokwe-International Energy Agency (IEA), ukuthengwa kwezimoto zikagesi kuqhubeka nokukhula, kuze kube sekupheleni konyaka ka-2023, okukhombisa ukwanda okukhulu kokuthandwa kwalezi zimoto. Lokhu kukhula kuveza izinzuzo eziningi, ikakhulukazi ekunciphiseni ukukhishwa kwegesi ye-carbon dioxide. Ukuze kuhlangatshezwane nezidingo zokuvikela imvelo, amazwe amaningi asebenzisa izinqubomgomo ezikhuthaza ukusetshenziswa kwezimoto zikagesi. Lokhu kuholela ekwandeni kwemikhiqizo ye-battery, okwenza kube lula futhi kube nezinzuzo zokukhiqiza. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukukhula kwemakethe yezimoto zikagesi kudala amathuba emisebenzi emisha. Izinkampani ezikhiqiza izimoto zikagesi zidinga abasebenzi abanobuchwepheshe obuphakeme, okuholela ekwandeni kwemfundo nezifundo ezihlobene nale mikhakha. Lokhu kukhuthaza umnotho, ikakhulukazi ezindaweni ezikhiqiza lezi zimoto. Nokho, ukukhula kwemakethe yezimoto zikagesi akukhululekile ngokuphelele. Izinkinga ezifana nokuntuleka kwezikhungo zokushaja, izindleko eziphezulu zezimoto, kanye nezinsiza zokukhiqiza ziyaqhubeka nokuba yizithiyo. Abathengi badinga ukuqonda kahle izinzuzo nezingozi ezihambisana nokusebenzisa izimoto zikagesi. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, umthelela wokukhula kwemakethe yezimoto zikagesi uzoba namandla, futhi kubalulekile ukuthi izinkampani, uhulumeni, kanye nabathengi basebenzisane ukuze kuqinisekiswe ukuthi lezi zimoto ziba yindlela eqhubekayo yokuhamba.

ngesitimela samabanga amade esifikisa abagibeli sekudlule isikhathi njengoba uhambo olusuka eGoli luya eThekwini, lube ngamahora awu-30 esikhundleni kwamahora awu-18.Lesi sitimela seShosholoza Meyl sisuke eGoli ngoLwesihlanu ebusuku kanti bekufanele sifike eThekwini ngoMgqibelo ekuseni, kodwa sigcine sesifika ntambama.Abantu akade besigibele kodwa abangathandanga ukudalulwa, bathe abaziswanga ukuthi bekwenzenjani njengoba bekunezikhawu lapho isitimela besihamba kancane.Kuvele ukuthi kwezinye izindawo isitimela besihamba kancane ngenxa yokuthi umzila waso wamosheka kakhulu.Kuthiwa kubuye kwafa iguzu endleleni yaso sase siphoqeleka ukuba sime kuze kuba liyasuswa.UNksz Andiswa Makanda okhulumela iPassenger Rail Agency South Africa (Prasa), uthe isitimela esisuka eGoli siye eThekwini, siye sathatha isikhathi eside ngenxa yokuthi besinciphisa ijubane ukuze kuphephe abantu.Uveze ukuthi iPrasa ithole izinqola ezintsha zezitimela kwaTransnet kanti lokhu kuzoyisiza ukuthi zifike ngesikhathi lapho ezisuke ziya khona.Uxolisile kubagibeli ngezingqinamba ezibe khona wathi isimo bahlezi besiqaphile ukuze bathuthukise izinga lokusebenza.Uthe izitimela zamabanda amade ziyaqhubeka nokusebenza masonto onke ngesikhathi esimatasa nakanye ngenyanga ngezikhathi ezingekho matasa.Uphethe ngokucela abantu ukuba babike uma bebona izigameko ezisolisa emizileni yesitimela ngokushayela u-08600 10111.

Ukusetshenziswa kobuchwepheshe be-virtual reality emfundweni Ubuchwepheshe be-virtual reality (VR) buye baba yinsiza ewusizo kakhulu emfundweni, buvumela abafundi ukuba bahlale phakathi kwezimo ezihlukene ezingokoqobo, ngenkathi befundisa izinto ezinzima ngendlela ephusile. Ukusetshenziswa kwe-VR emfundweni kuveza amathuba amasha, kuhlanganise nokubona okwakho okwenziwe ngamehlo, ukuhamba ngokukhululeka ezindaweni ezihlukahlukene, kanye nokuhlanganyela ezinhlelweni zokufunda ezijulile. Ngokwesibonelo, emkhakheni wezokwelapha, abafundi bangakwazi ukufunda izinqubo zokwelapha ngokusebenzisa izimo ze-VR, lapho bezoba neqhaza elibucayi ekufundeni. Lokhu kunciphisa amathuba okwenza amaphutha empilweni yangempela, futhi kukhuthaza ukuzethemba. Ngakolunye uhlangothi, emkhakheni wezomlando, abafundi bangavakashela ezindaweni zakudala, bezwe izenzakalo ezibalulekile njengoba zenzeka, okwenza ukufunda kube mnandi futhi kube lula. Nakuba kukhona izinzuzo eziningi, kubalulekile futhi ukuqaphela izinselelo ezihambisana nokusetshenziswa kwe-VR. Izindleko zokuthenga imishini ye-VR zingaba phezulu, futhi akukhona bonke abafundi abanezinsiza zokufinyelela kulezi zinsiza. Ngaphezu kwalokho, abafundisi badinga ukuqeqeshwa ukuze basebenzise kahle lezi zinhlelo. Ngokuhlanganisa, ubuchwepheshe be-virtual reality buhlale buhamba phambili emfundweni, buhlinzeka ngokuqonda okujulile nokuhlangenwe nakho okuhle kwabafundi. Uma izinselelo zixazululwa, i-VR ingaba ithuluzi elikhulu lokukhulisa izinga lokufunda, isiza abafundi ukuba baqonde kangcono izinto ezinzima.

Ukusetshenziswa kwe-blockchain ngaphandle kwemali zedijithali Ngokuvamile, uma sikhuluma nge-blockchain, sikhumbula izimakethe zezimali zedijithali ezifana ne-Bitcoin ne-Ethereum. Nokho, le teknoloji inezinzuzo eziningi ezingaphezu kokuhweba ngemali. Ngikholelwa ukuthi i-blockchain ingaba yinsiza ebalulekile emikhakheni ehlukahlukene, ikakhulukazi ezokuphatha, ezempilo, nezokuthutha. Okokuqala, emkhakheni wezokuphatha, i-blockchain ingasiza ekwenzeni izinqubo zibe sobala. Ngokusebenzisa le teknoloji, izinkampani zingagcina amarekhodi ahlanzekile, okwenza kube lula ukuhlolela izinkinga. Lokhu kungakhuphula ukwethenjwa phakathi kwabathengi nabathengisi, njengoba wonke umuntu engakwazi ukubheka amarekhodi ngaphandle kokukhathazeka ngokukhwabanisa. Okwesibili, emkhakheni wezempilo, i-blockchain ingagcina ulwazi lweziguli ngendlela ephephile. Lokhu kungavumela odokotela ukuthi bafinyelele kalula kumarekhodi wezempilo, okwenza kube lula ukuhlinzeka ngempilo engcono. Ngaphezu kwalokho, iziguli zingaba nokulawula okukhulu ngolwazi lwazo, ziqinisekise ukuthi kuphela abantu abavunyelwe abangafinyelela kulolo lwazi. Ekugcineni, emkhakheni wezokuthutha, i-blockchain ingasiza ekulandeleni impahla. Lokhu kungavumela izinkampani ukuthi ziqinisekise ukuthi imikhiqizo yazo ifika ngesikhathi, futhi zikwazi ukulandela imithombo yokuhamba kwemikhiqizo. Lokhu kunganciphisa izindleko futhi kuthuthukise ukusebenza kahle. Ngakho-ke, kufanele sikhumbule ukuthi i-blockchain ayikhawulelwe kuphela ezimakethe zezimali. Inezinhlelo eziningi ezithakazelisayo ezizokwenza umhlaba ube ngcono. Njengoba sithuthuka, kubalulekile ukuthi sithathe le teknoloji futhi siyisebenzise ukuze sithuthukise izimpilo zethu.

"UZuma akafunanga ukuthi azixoshe kodwa ushiyele i-ANC ukuthi kube iyona ezithathela isinqumo ngekusasa lakhe. Uwumuntu okwaziyo ukuthola uzwelo ngoba uma i-ANC imxosha uyobe esekhala ngokuthi inhlangano aseyisebenzele iminyaka engaphezu kuka-60 isimxoshile. Okuzoba nzima kwi-ANC wukuthi uma ingamxoshi izokwenzanjani ngaye ngoba uhlala esigungwini esibhekelele ukusebenza kwenhlangalo lapho kuzobe kubhungwa ngezinhlelo zokhetho nokunye njengoba kuqala unyaka,” kusho uKhumalo.Uthe okwenziwa wuZuma nokwenziwa wuThabo Mbeki akufani neze ngoba uMbeki akazange amemezele ukuthi uzosebenzisana nelinye iqembu kodwa wathi ivoti lakhe liyimfihlo.Ekhuluma kwiNewzroom Afrika, uSolwazi Andre Duvenage oyisazi sepolitiki esizinze eNyuvesi yaseNorth West, uthe akayiboni i-ANC ixosha uZuma ngenxa yogazi analo njengoba kubhekwe okhethweni. "UZuma ucuphe i-ANC ukuthi imxoshe. Angiboni kwenzeka lokho ngoba noThabo Mbeki wenza okucishe kufane nalokhu okwenziwe wuZuma emuva kokuba exoshiwe. Wathi ngeke ayivotele i-ANC futhi ngeke aphume kuyona. Akazange axoshwe ngakho noZuma angimboni exoshwa.

Ukuhlaziywa kokusetshenziswa kwezilimi zomdabu ezinkundleni zedijithali Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, izilimi zomdabu zibe yingxenye ebalulekile ezinkundleni zedijithali, njengoba abantu abaningi bezisebenzisa ukuze baxhumane, babelane ngemicabango, futhi bathuthukise ubuhlakani bazo. Ukuhlaziywa kwenziwa ukuze kubonakale indlela ezilimi zomdabu ezisebenza ngayo ezinkundleni ezahlukene, ikakhulukazi ezinkundleni zokuxhumana, ama-blog, nezinhlelo zokusebenza. Ucwaningo lwakamuva lubonisa ukukhula kokusetshenziswa kwezilimi ezifana nesiZulu, isiXhosa, nesiSwati ezinkundleni zedijithali. Lokhu kubonakala ngokwanda kokubhalwa kwemiyalezo, izinkulumo, kanye nezindaba ezibhaliwe ngalezi zilimi. Abantu abaningi baphendukela ezilimini zabo zomdabu ukuze bazwakalise imizwa yabo, okwakha umphakathi onobudlelwano obuqinile. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izinkampani ziyaqaphela ukubaluleka kokuhlinzeka ngama-interface nezinsizakalo ezisebenzisa izilimi zomdabu, okukhulisa ukufinyelela kwabantu abaningi, ikakhulukazi kulabo abangakhulumi isiNgisi kahle. Lokhu kubalulekile ekugcineni isiko nezilimi zomdabu, njengoba zikhuthaza abantu ukuba bahlale bephila izilimi zabo. Nokho, kunezithiyo ezithile ezibhekene nezilimi zomdabu ezinkundleni zedijithali. Ukuntuleka kwezinsiza ezikhethekile, izinhlelo zokusebenza, kanye nezinhlelo zokufunda ezisekela lezi zilimi kungathinta ukukhula kwazo. Kubalulekile ukuthi uhulumeni, izikhungo zemfundo, kanye nezinkampani zisebenzisane ukuze ziqinisekise ukuthi izilimi zomdabu zihlala zikhona futhi zisebenza ezinkundleni zedijithali. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, ukusetshenziswa kwezilimi zomdabu ezinkundleni zedijithali kuzoba nomthelela omkhulu ekugcineni isiko, ukuxhumana, kanye nokwakha umphakathi onobudlelwano obuqinile. Lokhu kukhombisa ukuthi izilimi zomdabu azikupheli, kodwa ziyaqhubeka nokukhula nokuthuthuka.

Izindawo zokusebenza ezihlanganyelwayo ziye zaba yinsakavukela emhlabeni wanamuhla, zikhombisa umthelela omkhulu ezimfundisweni, ezomnotho, nasezimpilweni zabantu. Kubalulekile ukuhlela ingxoxo-mpikiswano mayelana nemiphumela yokwanda kwalezi zindawo. Okokuqala, izindawo zokusebenza ezihlanganyelwayo zandisa amathuba okuxhumana kwabantu. Lokhu kusho ukuthi, abantu abavela emikhakheni ehlukene bangahlangana, bashintshisane ngemicabango, futhi bakhe ubudlelwano obusha. Lokhu kwandisa ubuchwepheshe besikhala somsebenzi, okungaholela ekwenzeni imisebenzi emisha. Ngokwesibonelo, izinhlelo ezivela kubantu abahlukene zingavela, kanti lokhu kungenza umphakathi ube nokuhlanganyela kwezinkanyezi eziningi. Ngakolunye uhlangothi, ukuhlanganiswa kwabantu ngezindawo zokusebenza ezihlanganyelwayo kungabangela izinkinga. Ukwanda kwezingxoxo eziningi nemibono ehlukeneyo kungadala ukungezwani phakathi kwezisebenzi nezimbonini. Abanye abantu bangase bazizwe behlulekile uma behlanganyela nabanye abanamakhono aphezulu noma ababambisene kumabhizinisi amakhulu. Lokhu kungaholela emishweni yokuncipha kokukhuthazeka nokusebenza kahle. Okokugcina, izindawo zokusebenza ezihlanganyelwayo zikhokhela ezindleleni ezintsha zokusebenza. Njengoba abantu behamba phambili, bangathola indlela yokusebenzisa kahle isikhathi sabo, bakwazi ukuhlela imisebenzi yabo ngendlela efanele. Nokho, lokhu kudinga ukuba izindawo zibe nezinsiza ezanele ukuze abantu bakwazi ukusebenza kahle. Ngakho-ke, umthelela wokwanda kwezindawo zokusebenza ezihlanganyelwayo uhambisana nezinzuzo nezinkinga. Kubalulekile ukuthi sihlale sikhumbula lokho okushiwo yindawo yokusebenza ethile futhi sithuthukise imikhuba yethu ukuze sithole izinzuzo ezinkulu.

UTHOLA izinsongo zokubulawa umndeni wenyanga eyayidumile KwaMhlabuyalingana, uMnuz James "God'olulala amankankane" Mthembu (61), kulandela ukubulawa komunye wabasolwa ngokuyisoconga ngeSonto.Kulesi sigameko, okuthiwa senzeke eThengani, khona eManguzi, owesilisa obegqekezelwa ngenhloso yokuthi aphucwe imoto, udubule kwafa "isigebengu", uMnuz Sifiso "Coach" Malwane.Ngokusho kwamaphoyisa, uMalwane, ubengungqondongqondo emacaleni obugebengu bokwebiwa kwezimoto endaweni, bese zeqiswa umngcele, zibhekiswe eMozambique.Kuthiwa ubulawa nje, amaphoyisa abemfunela icala lokubulawa kukaGod'olulala amankankane, owadutshulwa ngoyaba lwezinhlambu ekhaya lakhe ePhelandaba, eManguzi ngasekupheleni kuka-Okthoba nyakenye. UMalwane kuthiwa ubefunelwa necala lokudutshulwa, kubulawe uMnuz Juda Mthethwa ngoFebhuwari 2023.Umthombo ocele ukuthi ungadalulwa uthe umndeni kaGodo usuqalile ukuthola izinsongo ngoba usolwa ngokuthi ubhiyozela ukubulawa kukaMalwane. "Kuthiwa njengoba bejabula nje, nabo basazobulawa,” kusho umthombo.Uqhube wathi okwenzekayo, ukuthi kubulawe abathintekayo ekubulaweni kukaGodo, yinto umndeni obuyilindele vele njengoba ubunayo inkolelo yokuthi umufi uzozilwela nalabo abamsoconga. Ithintwa indodana kaGodo, uMnuz Mandla Mthethwa, yale yaphetha ukuphawula, yathi lolu daba lubucayi, akukho umndeni ongakuphawula.

Ucwaningo ngezindlela abantu abasebenzisa ama-smartwatch Ama-smartwatch sebecashelwe ezimpilweni zethu zansuku zonke, kodwa kubalulekile ukuzibuza ukuthi zisetshenziswa kanjani. Abantu basebenzisa ama-smartwatch ngezindlela eziningi, futhi lezi zindlela ziwusizo kumphakathi ngezindlela ezahlukene. Okokuqala, ama-smartwatch asiza abantu ekulandeleni impilo yabo. Abaningi basebenzisa lezi zinsiza ukuze balandele imisebenzi yabo yokuzivocavoca, njengezinyathelo ezithathwayo, ukuhamba emsebenzini, noma ukufaka izikhumbuzo phakathi nezikhathi zokuphumula. Lokhu kuholela ekutheni abantu baqaphele impilo yabo kangcono, bunciphise izinga le-Obesity, futhi bagcine imithwalo yabo isesimweni esihle. Okwesibili, ama-smartwatch enza imisebenzi yansuku zonke ibe lula. Ngokusebenzisa ama-notifications, abantu bangathola imiyalezo, izikhumbuzo, kanye nezinhlelo zezenzakalo ngaphandle kokudinga ukufaka ifoni. Lokhu kusebenza kahle kubantu abahamba ngebhasi, abahamba ngezinyawo, noma abagibeli, ngoba bangathola izikhumbuzo ngaphandle kokuphazamiseka. Nokho, kunezinkinga ezihambisana nokusetshenziswa kwama-smartwatch. Abanye abantu bakhathazekile ngezinselelo zobumfihlo, njengoba ama-smartwatch evamise ukuhlaziya imininingwane yomsebenzisi. Lokhu kungaba nezinkinga uma imininingwane ingenziwa kahle. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ama-smartwatch adinga ukukhokhelwa, okungaholela ekutheni kube nezinkinga zokufinyelela. Abanye abantu abakwazi ukukhokhela lesi sikhala, okuholela ekubeni kube nzima ukufinyelela ubuchwepheshe obuphakeme. Ngokuqhubekayo, ama-smartwatch anemiphumela emihle nezinkinga. Kodwa-ke, uma abantu beqaphela indlela abawasebenzisa ngayo, bangakwazi ukuqhubeka benza impilo yabo ibe ngcono. Kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi ukukhetha indlela yokusebenzisa ama-smartwatch kuyahluka kumuntu nomuntu, futhi lokhu kumele kube yinto abathengi ebalulekile ukuyicabangela.

"Ngalezi zifundo silungiselela abafundi kwezithinta ubuchwepheshe. Kunesidingo sokuthi izifundo ezifundwayo zihambisane nokudingwa wumnotho. "UHlomuka uthe bayabalalela othisha, abafundi kanjalo nabazali bese bakha uhlelo oluzobhekana nabakudingayo. "Siyabhekana nohlelo lokuthuthukisa othisha kanjalo nengqalasizinda ezikoleni. Imali eyabelwe umnyango kumele ithuthukise abafundi kanjalo nezikole." Usho lokhu nje kuhlale kukhalwa ngokuhluleka komnyango ukulungisa ingqalasizinda ezikoleni ngenxa yezinkinga zemali.Le nkinga yenza umnyango ungakwazi ukukhokhela ngesikhathi osonkontileka osebenza nabo. Umnyango uhluleke ukuthenga izincwadi zokufunda ezikoleni nyakenye. Ukwazi ukuthenga i-stationery.Namhlanje iSadtu izoba senkantolo eNkulu eMgungundlovu lapho ifuna kuphoqwe umnyango ukuthi uthenge izincwadi nezinye izinsiza. Okunye ifuna umnyango ufake imali yezikole eyaziwa ngama-Norms and Standards.Minyaka yonke izinyunyana zihlale zilwa nomnyango ngendaba yemali yezikole engafakwa ngesikhathi. Le mali isetshenziselwa ukulungisa izinto ezincane ezonakele ezikoleni okubalwa nokukhokhela ugesi namanzi.

BUZOLWELA ubumbano nenqubekela-phambili eqenjini, ubuholi obusha be-NFP obukhethwe engqungqutheleni kazwelonke ebibanjelwe eThekwini, ngempelasonto.Lokhu kushiwo okhethwe kwesikaMengameli kuleli qembu, uMnuz Irvin Barnes, engxoxweni yakhe neSolezwe, izolo. UBarnes uqumbe phansi abebanga naye uNkk Zandile Myeni ngamavoti angu-18, njengoba izithunywa ezingu-208 zimqokele kulesi sikhundla. "Ngizizwa ngithobeke kakhulu ukungena ezicathulweni zowumsunguli waleli, uNkk Zanele KaMagwaza Msibi, ongasekho. Izithunywa ezisethembe ngokuyisa phambili iqembu, zisinike umyalelo wokuthi sidale ubumbano, sinxenxe amalungu asebuholini baphambilini - abengekho kule ngqungquthela - ekutheni sibuyisane ukuze sikwazi ukuliyisa phambili. Izithunywa zithe kumele sidale ukuthula, silwe nesihlava esifaka ehlazweni sokugijima izinkantolo,” usho kanje.Uthe bazophinde belwele ukulungisa isimo ne- Independent Electoral Commission ikwazi ukubabuyisela ohlwini lwamaqembu angenele ukhetho.Abanye abaqokwe nguMnuz Milton Sokhela okhethwe ngo- elethu kwesePhini likaMengameli, uMnuz Sibusiso Mkhabela kwesikaSihlalo, uMnuz Rodney Hlatshwayo kwesePhini likaSihlalo, uMnuz Teddy Thwala kwesikaNobhala-Jikelele noNksz Sithembile Msomi kwesephini lakhe.Bekuyingqungquthela yesibili yokukhetha ubuholi baleli qembu elisungulwe ngo-2011 nguKaMagwaza Msibi owayesuka kwi-IFP.

Ukuhlaziywa komkhakha wezokudlala amabhodi nemidlalo yokucabanga Ngomhla ka-15 kuNhlangulana 2023, umcimbi omkhulu wezokudlala amabhodi nemidlalo yokucabanga uzobanjwa eGoli, eNingizimu Afrika. Lo mcimbi uhlanganisa abadlali, abathandi, nabakhiqizi bemidlalo, futhi uhlelelwe ukuba ube yindawo yokuxhumana, ukufunda, nokwabelana ngolwazi. Izivakashi zizokwazi ukuhlola imidlalo emisha, zifunde izindlela ezintsha zokudlala, futhi zixoxe nabakhiqizi bemidlalo abavela emhlabeni wonke. Uhlelo luzoba nezifundo ezihlukahlukene, okuhlanganisa izifundo zokwakha amabhodi, izifundo zokucabanga, kanye nezinkulumo ezivela kubachwepheshe abanolwazi emkhakheni. Ngaphezu kwalokho, kuzoba nezimbangi ezithokozisayo, lapho abadlali bezokwazi ukujabulisa izithameli ngempumelelo yabo. Umcimbi uzophinde ube nendawo yokudayisa, lapho abathengi bangathenga imidlalo emisha, izinsiza, nezincwadi ezihlobene. Lo mcimbi uyithuba elihle lokuhlangana nabanye abathandi bemidlalo, ukwabelana ngemicabango, nokwakha ubudlelwano obusha. Ngakho-ke, uma ungumthandi wezokudlala amabhodi nemidlalo yokucabanga, ungaphuthelwa yileli thuba lokuhlola, ukufunda, nokujabulela! Hamba nathi, futhi ube yingxenye yalesi sikhathi esikhethekile!

Insizwa yasoPhongolo ezakhele udumo ngengoma ethi Yimi uMalume, iveze izithombe yabonga nabalandeli ngokuyeseka yabonga nabayiqashayo.UGatsheni exoxa neSolezwe ngeMpelasonto, uthe kwakuhlala kuyisilonda enhliziyweni yakhe ukubona isimo sakubo sibheda. "Nganginamahloni ngesimo sasekhaya ngazibekela ukuthi uma izinto zilunga ngiqale ngokulungisa ekhaya. Ayikho indawo edlula ikhaya ngoba ngisho ungahamba uyephi ugcinela khona. Ngiyafisa ukugqugquzela izinsizwa ukuthi zilungise amakhaya uma zithola amandla,’’ kusho uGatsheni.IKHAYA lomculi kamaskandi uKhuzani Mpungose ngelinye labatshazwayoUGatsheni uvele unayo ingoma aduma ngayo ethi Koze Kulunge, kuyona usuke ekhuluma ngokuthi kubo kunezindlu zodaka kodwa uyethemba ukuthi koze kulunge.Akagcinanga nje ngokuveza izindlu kodwa uveze ngisho umhlambi wezimbuzi ezinhle zigcwele igceke kucaca ukuthi ukhonze imfuyo. Uke wafaka nesithombe ekhombisa imoto yakhe entsha eyikhipha esitolo.UKhuzani ngelinye lamaciko enze into yamehlo eMandaba, eNkandla. UKhuzani wakhe isithabathaba somuzi wabiya kahle kanti naye uke afake izithombe ezinkundleni zokuxhumana bamhalalisele. UKhuzani uze afake nezimoto ezinhlobonhlobo abantu bambongele.KuKhuzani akugcinanga ngaye ngoba negidangoma lakhe uThibela Mpungose wenze okufanayo wakha izindlu kubo khona eNkandla.

Bakubeka kucace ukuthi kukhona isidingo sokuthi kulungiswe ubudlelwano benhlangano nendlunkulu futhi kulekelelwe ukudala uzinzo.UNobhala -Jikelele we-ANC, uMnuz Fikile Mbalula, egcina ukuvakashela iSilo wakhuleka ngezinkomo eziwu-10 ngoMeyi nonyaka. Kwasabalala ukukhuluma okuthi i-ANC ibizama ukuthenga iSilo kodwa kwachithwa lokho, kwathiwa kushiwo abantu abangaqondi ngosiko. "Ukuvakasha kwethu siyobona iSilo kuyingxenye yokuthi sihlale sixhumene nezinhlaka ezibalulekile emphakathini. Siyazi ukuthi ubukhosi bubaluleke kanjani. Siyaseseka iSilo ngayo yonke indlela,’’ kusho uMbalula ephawula ngohambo lwakhe ukuyokotha.Ufakazi wokuthi indlunkulu ithathwa njengebalulekile kosopolitiki, wukuthi uhulumeni uqinisekisa ukunakekelwa kwayo ngesabelomali unyaka nonyaka. ISilo sinikwa izimoto neminye imihlomulo ehambisana nesikhundla sayo.Indlunkulu neSilo kuze kubangwe amaqembu ezepolitiki ejikijelana ngamazwi esolana ngezinto ezehlukene. Kuke kwaba nomdonsiswano oshubile phakathi kwe-IFP ne-ANC esifundazweni ngodaba lweSilo.I-ANC yayikhala ngokuthi i-IFP isebenzisa indlunkulu negama leSilo ukuzigayela amavoti. I-IFP ibihlala ikuchitha lokhu, ithi yinto engekho yona ayixubi iminxa ehlukene iSilo nenhlangano. Obekudala umsindo wukuthi umsunguli we-IFP inkosi Mangosuthu Buthelezi, ongasekho ibiwundunankulu kaZulu isikhathi eside.I-IFP isanda kuhamba nayo iyokotha iSilo yakhuleka ngezinkomo okuthiwa zicela kwezingu-20.

Izinguquko emikhubeni yokulalela umsakazo ngenxa yezinkundla zokusakaza Namuhla, umhlaba ubhekene nezinguquko ezinkulu emikhubeni yokulalela umsakazo, ikakhulukazi ngenxa yokwanda kwezinkundla zokusakaza ezikwi-inthanethi. Lokhu kuvele kuholele ekutheni abantu baphendule ngendlela ehlukile emlandweni wokulalela umsakazo. Ngaphambi kokuthi izinkundla zokusakaza ziqale, abathandi bomsakazo babephinde bahlale phansi bezilalele eziteshini ezithile, kodwa manje, izinto sezishintshile. Izinkundla ezifana neSpotify, Apple Music, kanye neYouTube Music zifeze ukuguqula indlela abantu abathola ngayo umsakazo. Lokhu kukhuthaze abathandi bomsakazo ukuba bakhethe izinhlelo ezihlukahlukene ezitholakala kalula, futhi lokhu kudala umuzwa wokuthi baphila emhlabeni wezokuxhumana. Lokhu kubalulekile ngoba abantu bangakwazi ukulalela umsakazo noma nini, noma kuphi, kusuka kumakhalekhukhwini abo, okwenza kube lula ukuhamba phambili ezinhlelweni zabo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izinkundla zokusakaza zikhuthaza abaculi ukuba baphumelele, njengoba benikeza ithuba lokufinyelela izithameli ezinkulu. Lokhu kudala umphakathi ophilayo, lapho abaculi nabalaleli behlanganyela imicabango nezifiso zabo. Izinguquko ezinjalo zishintsha umqondo wokusakaza, zenza kube lula ukuhamba phambili kwezobuciko nokuxhumana. Ngakho-ke, izinguquko emikhubeni yokulalela umsakazo zikhombisa ukuthi umhlaba usuhamba phambili, futhi izinkundla zokusakaza zidlala indima enkulu ekuqondiseni lezi zinguquko, ziqinisekisa ukuthi umsakazo uyahlala ubukhali, ufinyelela izithameli eziningi, futhi uhlala ungowesimanje.

UDONSWE ngendlebe ngokubaluleka kokuhlonipha abazalwane nokubekezela uMfundisi obegcotshwa ngokusemthethweni ebandleni lamaZayoni, iNew Born Church.Abebegcotshwa nguMfu Musawenkosi Shozi nomkakhe, uMfu Nana Shozi enkonzweni yaleli bandla ebisesizindeni salo kwaNdengezi. Umsunguli ophinde abe ngumholi waleli bandla, uMbhishobhi Goodenough Makhanya, uyena obeqhuba umsebenzi wokubagcoba ngokumsethethweni elekelelwa wumkakhe, uMbhishobhikazi Zodwa Makhanya.Entshumayelweni yakhe uMbhishobhi Makhanya abeyibhekise kwabebegcotshwa ubatshele ukuthi kukho konke abakwenzayo abaqinisekise ukuthi banyathela ngokucophelela.Ubatshele ukuthi uhlobo lomsebenzi abangena kuwo ludinga ukuthi babe ngabantu abakwaziyo ukubekezela futhi abakuqondayo ukuthi ziyafika izimo kodwa kuya ngokuthi umelana kanjani nazo. ''Okumqoka wukuthi kumele nazi ukuthi nilapha ngoba nilandwe wuNkulunkulu uqobo okunguyena odale izulu nomhlaba. Kungaba yinto embi-ke ukuthi ngelinye ilanga kukhulunywe indaba yokuthi niphumile ebandleni ngenxa yabantu ekubeni kungeyibo abaniholele lapha,'' usho kanjena.Ubadonse ngendlebe wathi noma ngabe kufika ziphi izinselo bangabi ntekenteke baze bacabange ukuliphosa ithawula. ''Kumele nazi ukuthi nisendaweni ezodala ukuthi kwesinye isikhathi nibuye nizibuze niziphendule ukuthi kanti kwenzekani. Noma kungaba njani kodwa nina okwenu ukuma ngoba uNkulunkulu nunibekile kule ndawo ngoba enithembile futhi kakhulu,'' usho kanjena.Abebegcotshwa bathembise ukuthi konke bazokwenza ngendlela efanele baphinde baqinisekisa nokuthi bazonyathela ngokucophelela.Le ndumezulu yenkonzo ibihanjelwe ngamgatsha ahlukene aKwaZulu Natal.

Ingxoxo Ngokuvikelwa Kwedatha Yomuntu Siqu Ezinkundleni Zedijithali Umxoxi: Sawubona, ngiyabonga ngokungimema kulesi sikhathi. Ngifuna ukwazi ngezinto ezihlukahlukene ezithinta ukuvikelwa kwedatha yomuntu siqu ezinkundleni zedijithali. Umlingani: Ngiyabonga, ngithokozile ukuba lapha. Ngokwami, olunye lwezinselelo ezinkulu zokuvikelwa kwedatha yomuntu siqu yikhono lezinhlangano ukukusebenzisa kahle idatha esiyitholayo. Abantu baye bayazisa ukuthi idatha yabo ibalulekile, kodwa abazi kahle ukuthi ihlDBiI ukufinyeleleka. Umxoxi: Yiqiniso, ubani obhekelela ukuvikela le datha? Ingabe izinkampani kufanele zibe nemigomo ecacile? Umlingani: Impela, izinkampani kufanele zibe nemigomo eqinile. Ukuze ziqinisekise ukuthi idatha isetshenziswa ngendlela efanele, kufanele zinikeze abantu inkululeko yokukhetha – lokho kuhambisana nemigomo ye-GDPR. Nokho, izinkampani eziningi azizithobeli. Umxoxi: Lokhu kubonisa umazisi wesiqondiso. Yimaphi amanye amanxeba ahamba phambili? Umlingani: Ukuze siqonde ukuthi sinokuthile kwedatha, lokhu kudinga ukulandela amahlelo ahlukene, ukuze kwandiswe ukuvikeleka. Izinselelo ezinkulu zihlanganisa ubugebengu bedijithali, lapho amagciwane nezinhlobo ezahlukene zokuhlasela zingadala ukulahleka kwedatha. Umxoxi: Ngabe abantu bangawathola kanjani amathuba okwazi ukuvikela idatha yabo? Umlingani: Kubalulekile ukuthi abantu baqonde ukuthi kufanele basebenzise amaphasiwedi aqinile, baphuthe idatha yabo, futhi baqaphe izicelo zokufinyelela. Ukuze kugcinwe ukuvinjelwa kokuhlasela, kubalulekile ukuthi bahlole izinketho zokuvikela ezifana ne-multi-factor authentication. Umxoxi: Ngiyabonga ngale ngcingo ewusizo. Ukuhlukana phakathi kwedatha, kokubili komuntu siqu nokuhlangenwe nakho, kuyalulekwa ukuze siqhubeke siphila ngokuphepha. Umlingani: Ngiyavuma, okubalulekile ukufundisa abantu ukuze babe nesizotha mayelana nedatha yabo. Kuhlale kubalulekile ukuqonda ukuthi ukuvikelwa kwedatha akusiyona nje inhloso, kodwa kuwumsebenzi obalulekile.

Hhawu, ngiyavuma, umkhakha wezokudlala imidlalo yamavidiyo eNingizimu Afrika uhlezi ukhula, futhi lokho kuyajabulisa impela! Ngabe ubona kanjani lokhu? Ngiyazi, uma ubheka eminyakeni edlule, imidlalo yama-video yayithathwa njengento ethile yabantu abancane, kodwa manje sekukhona abantu abaningi, basha nabadala, abajabulela ukudlala. Kukhona imidlalo eminingi ethokozisayo, futhi okuthokozisayo ukuthi abathuthukisi bethu baseNingizimu Afrika baphinde benza imidlalo yabo. Lokhu kusenza sibe nezinhlobonhlobo zezimidlalo ezithokozisayo, ezihambisana namasiko ethu. Ngabe ubone imidlalo efana ne-"Kena: Bridge of Spirits"? Lokhu kubonisa ukuthi singakha izinto ezinhle, futhi sikhombisa ubuciko bethu. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izinkundla zokudlala zikhula kakhulu. Ngabe ubona ukuthi umphakathi wezokudlala uhlanganisa abantu abavela ezindaweni ezahlukene? Lokhu kudala ubudlelwano obuhle phakathi kwabantu, futhi sithola ithuba lokuxhumana nabanye. Futhi, uma sikhuluma ngama-streamers, abanye bethu baye basungula iziteshi ezinkulu, okwenza kube lula ukufinyelela imidlalo. Ngiyazi, futhi uma sikhuluma ngama-eSports, lokho kuyinto enkulu! Imicimbi emikhulu ibanjwa eNingizimu Afrika, futhi abantu bayazibandakanya. Lokhu kusho ukuthi umkhakha wezokudlala imidlalo yamavidiyo uyakhula, futhi sithokozisa kakhulu. Ngabe ucabanga ukuthi kuzoba kanjani eminyakeni ezayo? Ngiyazi ukuthi kuzoba mnandi!

OYISIKHULU samaphoyisa esisamisiwe Ekurhuleni, uMnuz Julius Mkhwanazi, noyimenenja yedolobha lakhona Ekurhuleni, uMnuz Kagiso Michael Lerutla, bazofaka isicelo sebheyili ngoLwesibili ekuseni enkantolo yeMantshi yaseBoksburg.Bakhalelwe ngamasongo kaSigonyela ngempelasonto edlule ngamacala enkohlakalo nokuphazamisa ukusebenza kwengalo yomthetho. Kulindeleke ukuthi uhlangothi loMbuso lusiphikise isicelo sabo sebheyili.Icala liyamene nesigameko esenzeka ngo-2019. UMshushisi uthe uLerutla wahluleka ukuza enkantolo ngecala lokuhamba ngesivinini ngoba ethi wayeye kwinhlolokhono ngosuku olufanayo.UMkhwanazi selokhu amiswa ngoNovemba 2025, waboshwa esemzini wakhe. ULerutla waboshwa esesikhumulweni sezindiza i-OR Tambo Internationl wawaphika amacala abekwe wona. Kwahlaluka ukuthi wayeyotetemuka nenye intokazi.Enkantolo abameli bakaMkhwanazi bemnxusela ibheyili bathe kumfanele ukuyithola ngenxa yokuthi ukwazile ukusebenzisana nabaphenyi becala.

Indima yabasunguli bamabhizinisi obuchwepheshe (tech startups) emnothweni Emhlabeni wanamuhla, ubuchwepheshe busebenza njengomgogodla wezinguquko eziningi, futhi abasukuli bamabhizinisi obuchwepheshe baphinde babe nendima ebalulekile ekwakheni umnotho ophumelelayo. Ngiyakholelwa ukuthi lezi zinkampani, ezivame ukuvela njengemibono emisha, zikhona ukuze zishintshe indlela esiphila ngayo, sikhuluma ngayo, futhi sisebenza ngayo. Okokuqala, abasukuli bamabhizinisi obuchwepheshe baveza amathuba emisebenzi amasha. Njengoba lezi zinkampani zikhula, zidinga abasebenzi abasha, okukhulisa amathuba emisebenzi ezindaweni eziningi. Lokhu akugcini nje ngokwandisa umnotho, kodwa futhi kukhuthaza abantu ukuba bathuthukise amakhono abo, okwenza umphakathi ube namandla. Okwesibili, abasukuli baphinde baveza izixazululo ezintsha ezibhekana nezinkinga ezikhona. Ngokusebenzisa ubuchwepheshe, lezi zinkampani zikhombisa indlela yokwenza izinto ngendlela engcono, efanele, futhi ephumelelayo. Lokhu kuholela ekutheni umnotho ube nekhono lokukhula, njengoba izixazululo ezintsha zikhuthaza ukuncintisana phakathi kwamabhizinisi. Ngaphezu kwalokho, abasukuli bamabhizinisi obuchwepheshe baphinde bahlomula umnotho wendawo. Njengoba beqala izinkampani zabo, baphinde baphakela izinsizakalo ezidingekayo emphakathini, okwenza kube nokukhula kwezomnotho ezindaweni eziningi. Lokhu kuholela ekwakheni umphakathi onempilo, ophumelelayo. Ngakho-ke, kufanele sikhuthaze abasukuli bamabhizinisi obuchwepheshe, sibanikeze ukwesekwa okudingekayo ukuze bakhe izinkampani ezizokwenza umehluko. Umnotho wethu udinga lezi zinguquko, futhi abasukuli bethu bangaba yizikhali ezinamandla ekwakheni ikusasa eliqhakazile. Ngaphandle kwabo, umnotho wethu ungase ube nezinselelo ezinzima, kodwa ngokubambisana, singakha umphakathi onempilo, ophumelelayo.

Indima yezokuvakasha zasemakhaya ekuthuthukiseni umnotho wendawo Izokuvakasha zasemakhaya zidlala indima ebalulekile ekuthuthukiseni umnotho wendawo. Lokhu kuhlanganisa ukuheha izivakashi ezivela kwezinye izindawo ukuze zivakashele imiphakathi yasemakhaya, okwakha amathuba emisebenzi, kuthuthukise izinsizakalo, futhi kuthuthukise umphakathi jikelele. Okokuqala, ukuvakasha kwandisa amathuba emisebenzi. Njengoba izivakashi zifika, kudingeka abasebenzi bezinsizakalo ezahlukene, njengabapheki, abahlinzeki bezokuthutha, nabasizi bezokwelapha. Lokhu kuholela ekwandeni kwemisebenzi, okuvumela abantu bendawo ukuba bathole imali, baphinde bakhuphule izinga labo lokuphila. Okwesibili, izokuvakasha zasemakhaya zikhuthaza ukuthuthukiswa kwezinsizakalo. Imiphakathi iyagqugquzela ukuthuthukiswa kwezindawo zokuhlala, izindawo zokudlela, nezitolo ukuze zikwazi ukuheha izivakashi. Lokhu kuholela ekutheni kube nezinsizakalo ezinhle, ezikhulisa umnotho wendawo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukuvakasha kwandisa ukuqwashisa ngamasiko nemvelo yendawo. Izivakashi zifunda ngamasiko, imisebenzi, nezinsiza zemvelo, okukhuthaza ukuvikelwa kwemvelo kanye nokugcina amasiko. Lokhu kudala umoya wokuhlonipha phakathi kwabavakashi nabantu bendawo. Ekugcineni, izokuvakasha zasemakhaya zidalela imiphakathi ithuba lokukhula nokuthuthuka. Ngokuhlanganyela, imiphakathi ingathola izinzuzo ezinkulu, okuholela ekwakheni umnotho oqinile, ophumelelayo, futhi ozinzile. Ngakho-ke, indima yezokuvakasha zasemakhaya ibalulekile ekwakheni ikusasa eliqhakazile lemiphakathi yasemakhaya.

"Emva kohlelo lokuhlunga, sigcine siqoke amabhizinisi awu-128 eKZN yonkana ukuthi abambe iqhaza ohlelweni lwanonyaka. Sibaqoke eminxeni ehlukene okubalwa owezobuchwepheshe besimanje, ezokwakha, imboni yemfashini, ezempilo nezobuhle okubamba iqhaza elimqoka ukufukula umnotho wesifundazwe sethu,” kusho uNksz Ngobese.Eqhuba, udalule ukuthi kulokhu baqikelelile ukuthi kuqhakambiseke kakhulu osomabhizinisi besifazane njengoba bewu-66% abangenelile, okusho ukuthi nembokodo izoba neqhaza elinqala nelibonakalayo ekukhuliseni umnotho nokuthuthukisa umphakathi. "Konke lokhu esikwenzayo kokuveza amabhizinisi asemalokishini nasezindaweni zasemakhaya kuzosiza kakhulu ukuthuthukisa osomabhizinisi, kube kulekelela ngokuthi kwakhe amathuba okwandisa abatshalimali ukuze bafukuleke,” usho kanje.Uthe nakulo nyaka iwu-20 iminxa ehlukene yamabhizinisi okuzoklonyeliswa osomabhizinisi abanqobile kuyona, bese kuthi abazonqoba kuyona bahlukaniselane umklomelo ka-R1 million wokuxhasa amabhizinisi abo. "Izinga losomabhizinisi esibathole kulo nyaka lisinike ithemba lokuthi emva kokuhlomula kwabo kulolu hlelo bazokwazi ukubamba iqhaza elimqoka emphakathini futhi sizibophezele ukuqhubeka nalo mbono esiwenzayo,” kuthembisa uNksz Ngobese.

Lokhu ukusho eNkantolo eNkulu yaseThekwini izolo.Kuzokhumbuleka ukuthi umufi wadutshulwa wafa esigamekeni esenzeka ngoMeyi 2023 esemzini wakhe kwa-S, eMlaza. Waphuthunyiswa eSiphingo Medical Towers okuyilapho okwafike kwamenela khona.Bekungokokuqala ukuthi uKhumalo angene ebhokisini selokhu laqala leli cala. UKhumalo ungaphandle ngebheyili ayithola leli cala lisaseNkantolo yeMantshi yaseMlaza ngo-2023.Ngaphambi kokuba angene ebhokisini ummeli wakhe,u-Advocate Mdu Mvune, ubekade efake isicelo sokuthi akhishwe phambili engazange abethule ubufakazi okuyinto inkantolo eyichithile wase engena kanjalo ebhokisini uKhumalo.UKhumalo uqale ngokuveza ukuthi uMzo Ntombela inkabi eyavuma icala yagwetshwa ingumakhelwane wakhe kanjalo noKhulani Cele inkabi edonsa esikadilkakajele naye uthe ungamakhelwane wakhe.Ebuzwa ukuthi uyamazi yini uNkk Faith Ntombela uthe akamazi kodwa ngaphambi kokubulawa komyeni wakhe wake wambona KwaDukuza.Utshele inkantolo ukuthi akalazi nephoyisa okukhulunywa ngalo, nendawo okuthiwa labulawelwa kuyona akayazi. ''Angimazi lo muntu okukhulunywa ngaye nendawo enikhuluma ngayo okwenzeka kuyona isigameko,'' usho kanjena esebhokisini ephendula imibuzo yommeli wakhe, u-Advocate Mvune.Ebuzwa ukuthi kukhona yini afisa ukukusho mayelana nokubulawa kukamufi uthe akukho ngoba akazi lutho udidekile ukuthi kungani eyamaniswa naleli cala.

Ukusetshenziswa kobuchwepheshe be-virtual reality emfundweni Ukusebenzisa ubuchwepheshe bokwenziwa kweqiniso (virtual reality - VR) emfundweni kudinga izinyathelo ezithile ezilandelwayo ukuze kuzuze abafundi. Nazi izinyathelo ezihamba phambili: 1. Uhlu Lokuqala: Qala ngokuhlela futhi uhlole izinto ezifanele ukufundiswa nge-VR. Lokhu kungafaka izifundo ezifana nezifundo zemvelo, ezobuchwepheshe, noma ezomlando. 2. Ukukhetha Imishini: Thola imishini efanele ye-VR. Lokhu kungaba ukuphathwa kwezikhalazo (headsets) ezifana ne-Oculus Rift noma i-HTC Vive. Qiniseka ukuthi imishini iyatholakala futhi ilungile ukuze ihlangabezane nezidingo zabafundi. 3. Uhlelo Lokugcina: Dala uhlelo lokusebenza lwe-VR okuqukethwe. Lokhu kufanele kube ukuhlobana nezifundo, okufaka amahlaya, noma ama-module aqukethe izifundo ezithile. Ungasebenzisa amaphakheji ama-VR afanelekile noma uthuthukise eyakho. 4. Ukuhlela Iziqu: Hlela izifundo ukuze zifake isikhathi sokuzijabulisa. Abafundi kufanele bakwazi ukuhamba phakathi nezindawo ze-VR okulungiselelwe okufundisayo, bezilungiselela ukuthi bakhulume nabanye abasebenzisi. 5. Ukuqeqesha Abafundisi: Qeqesha abafundisi ukuze bazi kahle indlela yokusebenzisa i-VR. Lokhu kuzosiza ekwakheni umoya wokusebenzisana phakathi kwabafundi nomfundisi. 6. Ukubuyekezwa Kwempumelelo: Ngemuva kokusebenzisa i-VR, hlela ukuhlola ukuphumelela kwethuluzi. Thola umbono kubafundi ukuze uqonde ukuthi izifundo ezifundwa zisebenzile yini. 7. Ukuthuthukisa: Zithathele isikhathi sokuthuthukisa uhlelo lwakho lwe-VR ngemuva kokuhlola. Lungisa izinkinga ezitholakele futhi usungule izindleko ezizothuthukisa isipiliyoni sokufunda. Ngokulandela lezi zinyathelo, ubuchwepheshe be-virtual reality bungaba nempumelelo enkulu emfundweni, kukhulisa ukufunda ngokubukwayo futhi kulethe ukuthokozisa.

LISAZOKUBA ukudla kwejele iphoyisa elisolwa ngokuba ubhululu wemigulukudu, uSergeant Fannie Nkosi, njengoba kuchithwe isicelo salo sebheyili.INkantolo yeMantshi i-Pretoria North ichithe isicelo sebheyili sikaNkosi izolo. UNkosi uboshelwe amacala okwephula imigomo yokugcinwa kwezibhamu, ukutholakala nesiqhumane nezinhlamvu nelokutholakala namadokodo amacala asavalwa.Imantshi uThandi Theledi ithe uNkosi uhlulekile ukuveza izizathu zokuthi kungani kufanele adedelwe ngebheyili.UMbuso ubungafuni ukuthi uNkosi anikwe ibheyili usabela ukuthi angase abalekele icala, njengoba ububeke nokuthi ubona uNkosi ephephile uma esejele ukunokuba anikwe ibheyili ngenxa yokuthi uzwana nemigulukudu engase ifune ukumenzakalisa uma enikwa ibheyili.Ubusabela nokuthi ubengazama ukuphazamisa uphenyo ngenxa yokuthi uyiphoyisa.UNkosi uzogcinwa ejele njengoba amaphoyisa eqhubeka nophenyo lwawo.Usolwa ngokusondelana nosomabhizinisi ababhekene noxhaxha lwamacala, uMnuz Vusimuzi "Cat" Matlala noKatiso "KT" Molefe.Ngesikhathi efakaza phambi kweKhomishini eholwa yiJaji Mbuyiseli Madlanga, kwavela ukuthi uNkosi kukhona imali ayeyithola kulabo somabhizinisi abasobishini.Kuphinde kuvele ukuthi wayesondelene nosomatekisi owayesatshiswa okwenyoka, uMnuz Jotham "Mswazi" Msibi nePhini likaKhomishana wamaPhoyisa elimisiwe, uLieutenant General Shadrack Sibiya.UNkosi waboshwa emva kokugasela kwamaphoyisa emzini wakhe kulandela ukuvela kwakhe phambi kweKhomishini kaMadlanga.UNkosi usamisiwe emsebenzini njengoba ebhekene nenqwaba yezinsolo.

Kube sekuphuma isinqumo sokuthi makuphele ngabafundi bakaJesu engakapheli amahora angu-48.Lwagoba uphondo kuSibiya wavuma wathi kuzoba njalo. Izolo ekuseni abafundi bakaJesu bebematasa beqiqinga izimpahla zabo bebuyela emakhaya abo.Nokuba kunje uSibiya utshele Isolezwe ukuthi kakuphelile ngombuso kaNkulunkuku ngoba laba abahlukana nabo emhlabeni bayohlangana ezulwini isangasekho inkosi eyobaxosha.Phambilini uSibiya watshela Isolezwe ukuthi ngempela bashiye konke okomhlaba. "Umhlaba sekumele wazi manje ukuthi kunesizwe esingcwele kodwa esisemhlabeni esidele konke. Bhala utshele abantu sesifikile isikhathi," washo kanjena.Kwakukhona abazigqaja ngokuthi bashiye ngisho ukuzibandakanya nocansi ngoba kuyisono.Kwaba khona nabaqinisekisayo ukuthi balaxaze imfundo sebesezikhungweni zemfundo ephakeme ngoba beshiswe ivangeli likaSibiya lokudela konke.Nokho kuse ngokunye ngesikhathi izinhlaka ezahlukene zikahulumeni seziqala sezifika kule ndawo.Kuqale uMnyango wezokuThuthukiswa koMphakathi KwaZulu-Natal walanda izingane ezingafundi ezingu-19. Akuphelanga lapho lo Mnyango ubuyele sewuhamba noMphathiswa wawo uNkk Mbali Shinga ekhashwa uNkk Thoko Mkhwanazi-Xaluva (weKhomishini Yokugqugquzela Nokuvikela Imiphakathi Yamasiko, Ezenkolo, Nezilimi), owayevutha engabaselwe etshela uSibiya ukuthi le nto ayenzayo angeke iphethe kahle.Wamtshela ukuthi laba bantu abanqabela ukuba badle imishanguzo uzobangcwaba. Wamtshela nokuthi uma esebuya okwesibili kuyoba khona ukukhala nokugedla kwamazinyo.

Ukuze uhlale uphephile linensiza ekwazisayo uma umoya wehlile emasondweni.Lishiye umhlaba ngo-225mm, ubude lingu-5 335mm kanti ububanzi ingu-1 882mm.Ngaphakathi ine-touchscreen infotainment system engu-12.8 inch oxhuma kuyo iselula nge-Apple CarPlay/Android Auto kanti i-instrument cluster ezimele yodwana ingu-9.0 inch.Izihlalo zangaphambili eziyisikhumba zihlelwa ngogesi, akudingi ulokhu usidonsa. Inekhamera ecacisa bha uma uhlehla kanti iyakutshela uma ususondele eduze kwento ezoyihuzula noma isisondele odongeni. Ngisho uya phambili iyakubikela ukuthi uqaphele ingozi. Lidunyiswa ngesikhiye kanti ine-hand brake edinga ukuthi uyitoboze maqede uyenyuse ngesandla.Le 4x4 ye-JMC ishaya nge-grille nengemuva elinamagama akuheha ukude le, nengikholwa ukuthi azokwenza amakhasimende ayiqaphele futhi akhulume ngayo ngisho isiyosithela.Ngakolunye uhlangothi, iJMC 2.5TD 4x2 double cab auto engiyibambe ngilibhekise eCradle of Humankind World Heritage Site, ingikhumbuze i-Ford Territory ngendlela eshushuluza ngayo emgwaqweni. Ngisho neJMC Vigus eshintshwayo ebengihlezi ngemuva kuyo sibheke e-OR Tambo International Airport, ibishibilika engena kamnandi amagiya ayo. Bekukhombisa ukuthi i-Jiangling Motors Corporation (JMC) le isimnkantshubomvu kwezezimoto njengoba yasungulwa ngo-1947.Ngaphandle kwalokho, inobudlelwano nezinkampani ezidumile i-Isuzu, Ford neChangan esebenzisana nazo ezweni edabuka kulo.

"IMango ibiphethwe yiSouth African Airways (SAA) noMnyango wamaBhizinisi kaHulumeni. Ingene ohlelweni lokuhlengwa emuva kokungabi namali. Njengamanje kunosomabhizinisi abafuna ukuyithenga, abanezinhlelo ezinhle zokubuyisa imisebenzi yabantu. Asiqondi ukuthi kungani uGordhan evimba ukuthi ithengwe ngabantu abazoyivusa,” kusho uNkk Hlubi-Majola.Uthe kubi ukuthi uGordhan usebenzisa imali yabakhokhi bentela ukuya enkantolo esikhundleni sokuvuma ukuthi iMango ivuswe kabusha.Isolezwe belilokhu libika ngezinkinga zeMango njengoba kwavela ukuthi inezikweletu ezibalelwa kuR2.8 billion okukhona kuwo uR183 million wamathikithi abagibeli abagcina bengagibelanga ngoJulayi ka2021.UMnyango wamaBhizinisi kaHulumeni waqoka abazosebenza ohlelweni lokuhlenga iMango kanti uhlelo lwabo lwamukelwa abakweletwa yile nkampani nezinyunyana.Kwavela nokuthi zikhona izinkampani ezifuna ukuthenga iMango ezinye ezisalindile namanje.UNkk Hlubi-Majola uthe uGordhan uzenza umuntu onendaba nokuthi izinkampani zikahulumeni ziphathwe kahle kodwa izinkampani zikahulumeni okubalwa i-SA Express, SAA, Eskom, Transnet neDenel, ziwe ebuka.

Ukuhlaziywa komkhakha wezincwadi ezilalelwayo (audiobooks) Ngokukhula kwesikhathi esitolo, imikhakha eminingi ibonakala ilandela izinguquko ezinkulu. Omunye wemikhakha ethokozisayo kakhulu kulezi zinsuku nguhlelo lwezincwadi ezilalelwayo. Lezi zincwadi, ezingalalelwa kuzo, zikhombisa indlela entsha yokufunda, eyenza kube lula ukuthi abantu bafunde bengenalo ukuhamba nencwadi ethile. Ngokubona kwami, izincwadi ezilalelwayo zinesithombe esihle kakhulu empilweni yamanje, ikakhulukazi kulabo abahlala bengenakho isikhathi sokubhala noma sokuhlala phansi bafunde. Kunezizathu eziningi ezenza izincwadi ezilalelwayo zibe yindlela yokufunda eyanelisayo. Okokuqala, zokwenza kube lula ukufunda imithombo eminingi ngesikhathi esisodwa. Ungalalela incwadi ngesikhathi uhamba emotweni, uyosebenza, noma ngisho nasemsebenzini. Lokhu kwenza kube lula ukufinyelela kulwazi oluningi ngezikhathi ezihlukahlukene. Okwesibili, izincwadi ezilalelwayo ziwusizo kulabo abaphelezela ubunzima bokufunda. Abantu abanemibandela ethile, njengezinye izifo noma ukungakwazi ukufunda kahle, bangakuthola kulula ukunikeza lezi zincwadi ezizwakalayo ithuba lokuphila. Ngesikhathi esifanayo, khumbula ukuthi lezi zincwadi zidala indlela entsha yokuxhumana nababhali. Umdlali wezwi ungashintsha umqondo wesifanekiso, evuleka ngamazwi akhe, okuholela ekubeni uhlu lwezincwadi ezithokozisayo luhlelwe ngempumelelo. Lokhu akugcini nje ekuthokoziseni, kodwa futhi kudala umuzwa wobudlelwano phakathi komlobi nomlali. Ngakho-ke, sengiyavuma, umbukiso wemikhakha wezincwadi ezilalelwayo ukhombisa ukuthi ukuqhubeka nezifiso zokufunda akuphumi ekufundeni kahle, kodwa nakumaudio athokozisayo. Umkhakha wawela obala, ubonisa ukusha okuhlobene nezokuxhumana, futhi ugcwalisa izikhala eziningi ezindabeni zethu ezithinta imizwa nemicabango. Ngaleso sikhathi, leli thuba lokukhula kwezincwadi ezilalelwayo liyinhlangano ephumelela kakhulu yokwakha umphakathi ofunda kakhulu.

Ukukhula komkhakha wezokudlala imidlalo yamavidiyo eNingizimu Afrika Esikhathini esingaphambili, imidlalo yamavidiyo yayidume kuphela phakathi kwentsha kanye nabantu abathanda ubuchwepheshe. Nokho, eNingizimu Afrika, abantu bathola izindlela eziningi zokwakha, ukudlala, nokwakha umphakathi onenhloso ngalesi sikhala. UThabiso, intombazane encane ethanda ukudlala imidlalo, wayengazi ukuthi uzozithola kanjani emhlabeni omuhle wemidlalo yamavidiyo. UThabiso ubelokhu ethamela izithangami zomphakathi, efunda ngezinsizakalo ezikhethekile zokwenza imidlalo. Ngasikhathi sinye, iminyango yokwakha imidlalo yayiqala ukufinyelela inqwaba yabafundi. Izikhungo zokufunda zaqala ukuvuleka, ziqhakambisa ubuciko nokwakhiwa kwemidlalo. Ababili, uThabiso noBongani, banquma ukuthola uhlelo lokufunda. Bahlangana nabantu abakhuluma isiZulu, bephakamisa amaphrojekthi afana nezinhlobonhlobo zemidlalo ezikhethekile; futhi lokhu kwaba nethonya elikhulu. Ngesikhathi sokuqalisa kwezinkanyezi, uThabiso noBongani benza imidlalo yabo yokuqala, beyisabalalisa ezinkundleni zokuxhumana. Bathola ukubhekwa okukhulu, okwakubavusa ithemba. Abangane babo baziqhenya ngabo, bejabulisa ngesikhathi sokudlala. Umkhakha wezokudlala imidlalo yamavidiyo ufinyelela phezulu, uthuthukisa ikhono labantu abaningi. UThabiso noBongani baveza isithombe esikahle sokuthi, ngekhulu lemidlalade, imidlalo iyakwazi ukuhlinzeka ngezindlela zokuphila, ukwakha, nokunikeza abantu ithuba lokubona umhlaba ngendlela ehluke kakhulu. Iphupho labo lokuba abaphakanyisi bemidlalo sehlanganiswe, base benakekela impumelelo yabo emhlabeni omkhulu wezokudlala.

Ukuhlaziywa komkhakha wezincwadi ezilalelwayo (ama-audiobooks) Umkhakha wezincwadi ezilalelwayo, okwaziwa nangokuthi ama-audiobooks, usuphenduke uhlelo olubalulekile emhlabeni wezincwadi. Kubalulekile ukuhlola lezi zindlela zokufunda ukuze siqonde izinzuzo nezingozi ezihambisana nazo. Kuqala, ama-audiobooks enza ukufunda kube lula futhi kube mnandi. Abantu abaningi bahlala bejolise emisebenzi yabo yansuku zonke, okwenza kube nzima ukuthola isikhathi sokufunda izincwadi ezibhaliwe. Ngakho, ama-audiobooks ahlinzeka ngenketho yokulalela, evumela abantu ukufunda ngaphandle kokuba bahlale bezimele. Lokhu kubaluleke kakhulu kubantu abaqhubeka nemisebenzi yabo noma abahamba njalo, ngoba bangakwazi ukuhamba beqhubeka nezifundo zabo. Kodwa-ke, kufanele siqonde ukuthi ama-audiobooks awanikezi bonke abantu ithuba lokucabanga ngokujulile. Abanye bangase babe nezinkumbulo ezinhle futhi bathole imiqondo ejulile kuphela uma befunda bezimele. Ukuze umqondo uthuthuke, kudinga isikhathi sokucabanga, esingase sithwalwe yimizwa nezincwadi ezibhaliwe, okungaba nzima uma ulalela. Ngakho, lezi zindlela zokufunda zinezingozi nezinzuzo zazo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, abanye abantu bangakhetha ukuhlanganisa zombili izindlela, bebenzisa ama-audiobooks ukuze bathole ulwazi oluthile bese befunda izincwadi ezijulile. Ngakho, umkhakha wezincwadi ezilalelwayo uyakhula, futhi kubalulekile ukuthi sihlolisise kahle ukuze sithole umbono ophumelelayo. Ekugcineni, njengoba umhlaba ushintsha, umkhakha wezincwadi ezilalelwayo ubonakala uyinsiza ebalulekile, kodwa kufanele sikhumbule ukuthi ukufunda ngokwakho nakho kubalulekile.

LIZOQALA ukuqulwa ekuqaleni kwenyanga ezayo elowesilisa waseMlaza, oneminyaka engu-28, okuthiwa waqotha amalungu omphakathi ayisishiyagalombili kuleli lokishi nyakenye. Lokhu kuvezwe yiJaji uJacqueline Henriques ngesikhathi ummangalelwa, uMnuz Sanele Dlamini evele phambi kweNkantolo eNkulu yaseThekwini ngoLwesithathu. Ummangalelwa usolwa ngesigameko okuthiwa senzeka endaweni yokucima ukoma ekwa-U, eMlaza ngoMeyi 16, 2025. Kuthiwa esigamekweni okusolakala ukuthi kwakungesokuziphindeselela ngokubulawa komfowabo, ummangalelwa waqotha amalungu omphakathi ayisishiyagalombili.Kuthiwa abafi kwaqinisekiswa ukuthi bangoMnuz Sbanisezwe Ngcobo, Lindani Ngcobo, Mduduzi Ntobela, Nkanyiso Khumalo, Vumakwenkosi Ndlovu, Sihle Shange, Nksz Thandiwe Madondo noNksz Mbalenhle Mjoko. Kuthiwa kulesi sigameko kwasinda abane kanti abasolwa babaleka endaweni yesehlo. Ummangalelwa osenkantolo kuphela osaboshiwe ngaso. Enkantolo kuvele ukuthi abafi babulawa nje, babekade bezijezisele ababebasola ngobugebengu. Kuthiwa bahlasela ummangalelwa nomfowabo, ababebasola ngokuthi sebewuqedile umphakathi, bewubamba inkunzi.Kuthiwa ummangalelwa, umfowabo ongasekho uMnuz Lungelo Dlamini nomngani wabo uMnuz Secunda Msomi bataxwa "wumphakathi owawusukhathele" ngoMeyi 16, 2025. Kuthiwa kulesi sigameko, uLungelo walimala kabi washona ngenxa yezingozi ayezithole ngalolo suku. Kuthiwa ngosuku olufanayo, uSanele, owayediniwe, wacela usizo kwabanye, ukuba bamlekelele aziphindiselele ngokubulawa komfowabo.

IMOTO: JMC VIGUS DOUBLE CABAKULULA ukuhlabeka umxhwele ngento uqala ukuyibona. Kimina lesi simo sokuncoma senzeke ngiseLanseria International Airport, eGauteng, ngibona okokuqala ngqa iveni i-JMC Vigus double cab. Inenjini engu-2.5l kadizili enamandla angu-123kW ne-torque engu-430Nm. U-gearbox uhlukene kabili njengoba kukhona oyi-6 speed manual noyi-8 speed automatic.Kushayeleke isipikili sokuthi ayizweli futhi yakhelwe ubunzima ngenkathi sinyuka sehla ngayo imiqansa, siyifaka odakeni, siyibhukudisa emaxhaphozini aseSyringa Park, eMuldelsdrift. Yize ifikela emhlabeni owenile ngokwezimbangi - okuyiToyota Hilux engaconsi phansi kosomatekisi neFord Ranger eyintandokazi kwabamathenda, Isuzu D-Max neMahindra Pik UP, iJMC Vigus ibukeka ingase iphendule amatafula ngenxa yentengo yayo engambi eqolo. Kulabo abahlala ezindaweni zamakhosi njengakoLoskop, Lotheni, eMpendle, Nkandla naseMashobeni, nabalayishela abantu izimpahla besuka ezitolo, basengaphephela kuyo, iqhubeke impilo.

UKUNYUKA kwezigameko zabafundi basemanyuvesi okuthiwa baphila nokuhlukumezeka sekusukumise inhlangano iSouth African Union of Student kanye nezinye izinhlaka ukuze kube khona okwenziwayo ngalokhu.NgoLwesihlanu eBlue Water, eThekwini le nhlangano ngokubambisana nabeWear Your Brand bathule ngokusemthethweni ingqungquthela ezokuba ngoJuni okuzobe kuhloswe ngayo ukuqwashisa abafundi abaphila nokuhlukumezeka kodwa buthule.Kuvelile lapha ukuthi laba bafundi ukuhlukumezeka bakuthola,ezindawerni ezahlukene okungaba yisemakhaya ebudlelwaneni nakwezinye izindawo.USihlalo wale nhlangano, uMnuz Quinton Oliphant uveze ukuthi le ngqungquthela ibandakanya izikhungo zintathu eziphakeme yiMangosuthu University of Technology (MUT), University of KwaZulu Natal (UKZN) kanye neDurban University of Technology (DUT).Uthe abakabi nalo usuku oluqondile lwayo, kodwa izokube isingethwe ngesinye salezi zikhungo ezingenhla.Uthe ngokwacwaningo abalwenzile batholile ukuthi baningi kakhulu abafundi abasezikhungweni zemfundo ephekeme abahlukumzekayo ngezindlela ezahlukene. Wathi yingakho bebone kungcono ukuba bahlele le ngqungquthela.Uthe inhlosongqangi yayo ukuthi kubhungwe kabanzi ngamasu angasetshenziswa ngenhloso yokubhekana nje ngqo nalesi simo.Uthe kungabe benza elikhulu iphutha leli uma bengase bathule nje bagoqe izandle ekubeni izinto zonakala.Okubakhathaza kakhulu uthe ukuthi lezi zigameko kuvela ukuthi zimandla kakhulu kubantu besifazane. Uthe yingakho le ngqunguthela beyethe elokuthi yiGBVF Summit. ''Akumele sithule kodwa njalo uma kukhona isimo esingesihle kuhle ukuthi sisukume,''echaza.Uveze ukuthi kuzophinde kube khona umjaho ozobe useThekwinin nawo okuzobe kuhloswe ngawo ukuthi kuxwayiswe ngalesi sihlava.

UKHALA ngokwenzelwa phansi amaphoyisa umndeni wowesilisa okuthiwa wagwazwa wafa kunetiye (umsebenzi wesintu) kamakhelwane eKoki, eMzimkhulu, ngo-Ephreli nyakenye. Kulesi sigameko okuthiwa senzeka emini kwabha phambi kwawo wonke umuntu, kwabulawa ngesihluku uMnuz Ziphilele Mtambo (42).Ngokusho kukamfowabo kamufi, uMnuz Nyameko Mtambo, kwakungu-Ephreli 25, 2025, kwenzeka umshophi. Uthe isigameko senzeka egcekeni lalapho okwakwenziwe khona umsebenzi, okuyikwamakhelwane wakwamufi kanjalo nowabasolwa. Uthe isigameko senzeka lapho okwakuhleli khona wonke umuntu, okukhona kubo nezihlobo zakhe umufi kanjalo nabanye omakhelwane. "Kuthiwa ingxabano yaqala ngenxa yotshwala. Umufi wayefuna ukuphuziswa utshwala, abasolwa bengafuni aphuze. Kuthiwa baqala basukuma bamshaya, bemhlanganyela. Kwathi kusabukwa lokho, oyedwa wabo wakhipha uhalakasha lommese, wamgwaza ephindelela,” kusho uMtambo.Uqhube wathi izihlobo zikamufi ezazikhona endaweni yesigameko, zamphuthumisa esibhedlela, nokho kwamenela ngezikhathi zasebusuku, emva kokulaliswa amahora ambalwa. Uthe amaphoyisa abizwa endaweni yesehlo, afika umufi esephuthunyiswe esibhedlela, abuza imibuzo ngokwenzekile kumnikazi womuzi, kwavulwa icala, wathi abasolwa banele babona ukuthi umufi uselimele kanzima, babaleka endaweni. "Kwaphela izinsuku ezimbalwa bengekho endaweni kodwa babuye babuya. Sathi singcwaba base bebuyile, abangaboshwa,” kusho uMtambo.

Indima yemidlalo yendabuko ekwakheni ubumbano emphakathini Imidlalo yendabuko ibalulekile ekwakheni ubumbano phakathi kwabantu, ikakhulukazi ezindaweni eziningi eNingizimu Afrika. Le midlalo ayisiyona indlela yokuzijabulisa kuphela, kodwa ibalulekile ekuqiniseni ubudlelwano phakathi kwabantu. Umphakathi ophilayo ubonakala ngemidlalo yawo, lapho abantu behlangana khona, behlola izinkumbulo nezifundo ezibalulekile. Ngokwesibonelo, imidlalo efana ne-‘indaba’ ibalulekile ekuqinisekiseni isiko, lapho abantu bejabulisa khona futhi bexoxa ngezinkolelo namagugu. Lokhu kudala umoya wokubambisana, njengoba abathandi bemidlalo behlangana ukuze baphumelele futhi bakhuthazane. Umphakathi ophumelelayo udinga ubumbano, futhi imidlalo yendabuko iyinsika yokwakha leli bumbano. Ngaphezu kwalokho, imidlalo yendabuko iyasiza ekwakheni ubuhlakani bokuxhumana. Nakuba abantu bahlala ezindaweni ezahlukene, imidlalo ibavumela ukuba bahlale ndawonye, baphinde baxoxe ngezinkinga ezibhekene nomphakathi. Lokhu kudala ithuba lokuthi abantu baveze imibono yabo, baphinde bakhe izixazululo ezihlanganyelwe. Ngakho-ke, imidlalo yendabuko ayisiyona indlela yokuzijabulisa kuphela, kodwa ibalulekile ekwakheni ubumbano emphakathini. Isebenza njengendlela yokuxhumanisa abantu, ibasiza ukuba bahlale bexhumene, futhi ibasiza ukuba baphumelele njengeqembu. Ukuqinisekisa ukuthi le midlalo iphila kubalulekile, ukuze sikwazi ukuvuselela ubumbano nemigomo emihle emphakathini wethu.

Indima yezokuvakasha zasemakhaya ekuthuthukiseni umnotho wendawo ibaluleke kakhulu emlandweni wethu. Ngemuva kweminyaka eminingi yokuthuthuka kwezomnotho, izindawo zasemakhaya ziye zaba yizikhungo ezibalulekile zokuvakasha, okwenza kube nokukhula okukhulu emiphakathini. Ekuqaleni, izindawo zasemakhaya zazithathwa njengendawo yokuphumula, lapho abantu behamba khona ukuze baphumule futhi bajabulele ubuhle bemvelo. Nokho, ngesikhathi sokukhula komnotho, abavakashi baqala ukuza ezindaweni ezinjalo ukuze bahlolisise isiko, imikhuba, nezindawo zomlando. Lokhu kwaholela ekutheni kube nezinhlelo eziningi zokuthuthukisa izinsiza zokuvakasha, ezifana nezindawo zokuhlala, izindawo zokudlela, nezinhlelo zokuhamba. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, izokuvakasha zasemakhaya zaba yinsiza ebalulekile yokwakha amathuba emisebenzi. Abantu bendawo baqala ukuhlinzeka ngezinsizakalo ezihambisana nezokuvakasha, okuholela ekwandeni kwemali engenayo. Lokhu kwaba nomthelela omuhle emiphakathini, njengoba abantu bekwazi ukuthola imali yokuphila, futhi izindawo eziningi zathola ukuxhaswa kwezimali ukuze zithuthukise izinsiza zazo. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izokuvakasha zasemakhaya zandise umqondo wokubambisana phakathi kwabantu bendawo. Abantu baqala ukuhlela imicimbi yokwazisa izivakashi ngamasiko nezinkolelo zendawo, okwakha ubudlelwano obuhle phakathi kwezivakashi nabantu bendawo. Lokhu kwaba nomthelela ekwakheni isimo sokuthula nokuqonda phakathi kwezakhamuzi. Ngakho-ke, indima yezokuvakasha zasemakhaya ekuthuthukiseni umnotho wendawo ibalulekile, ngoba ayigcini nje ngokuthuthukisa umnotho, kodwa futhi ikhuthaza ubudlelwano obuhle phakathi kwabantu. Lokhu kuveza ukuthi izokuvakasha akusikho kuphela ukuhamba, kodwa kuyindlela yokwakha umphakathi onempilo.

Ekuqaleni kwalo nyaka, uThandi, ongumthengisi ozimele emzaneni wakhe, wayezizwa edangele. Wayesebenza kanzima ekuthengiseni izingubo zakhe kodwa ukukhula kwezimakethe zokuthengisa online kwenza abanye bethola izinzuzo ezinkulu, kanti yena ethola kuphela abathengi abambalwa. Ngelinye ilanga, uThandi wahlangana noSipho, owayesebenza emkhakheni wezokuthengisa online. USipho wakhuluma ngendlela athole ngayo abathengi abaningi ngokusebenzisa izinkundla zokuxhumana nezinye izinhlelo. UThandi wathola lokho kusemqondweni futhi wanquma ukuzama lokho. Wavula ikhasi elisha lokuthengisa online, waba nokholo olukhulu. Waqala ukuhlola izinkundla zokuxhumana, wabelana ngezithombe ezinhle zezinto azithengisayo, futhi wagcizelela ubuciko bayo. Ngemuva kwezinsuku ezimbalwa, waqala ukukholwa ukuthi uzophumelela. Ngenxa yomsebenzi ongenasici, abathengi baqala ukuvela. Ngemuva kwesonto, uThandi wathola imiyalo eminingi, futhi izibuyekezo ezinhle zakhula. Njengoba izinsuku zedlula, kwavela amakhasimende amaningi. UThandi wathola ukuthi ukuthengisa online kudinga kuphela ubuchwepheshe obufanele nokuzinikela. Emva kwezinyanga eziyi-3, uThandi waba nomuzwa ohlanzekile. Wahamba phambili, wathola abathelisi, futhi uqhubekile nokwandisa ibhizinisi lakhe. Ukukhula komkhakha wokuthengisa online kwasiza uThandi ukuba abone impumelelo engakaze icaciswe, waphinde waba yisibonelo kubanye abathengisi abazimele. UThandi wafunda ukuthi, ngezinyathelo ezincane, ngebhizinisi lakhe labe lihamba phambili, futhi ithalente lakhe lathola indawo yokukhula.

UKUHLANGANA enyuvesi besaqeqeshelwa umkhakha wokuthwebula nokubonana njalo uma benza imisebenzi yabo yalo mkhakha kwaze kwaqinisa ubudlelwano kwizinsizwa ezinhlanu, futhi kwazisiza nangokuzibula ngenkampani ezisiza ukusebenza ndawonye. Labo woMnuz Sabelo Magwaza weSabelo Mag yaseMlaza, wuSiphesihle Biyela weSphewato Media yaseNanda, wuBusiswa Chiliza wenkampani Umshuthi Media yaseMagabheni, wu-Emihle Dlamini wePluug Talk Studio yaKwaMashu noMonde Mhlongo weMonde Films yaseClermont - asebesebenzisana enkampanini yabo abayiqale ndawonye iKune Studio.Engxoxweni neSolezwe Ngempelasonto, uMagwaza uthe baqale ukuzwana noBiyela noDlamini besaqeqeshelwa lomkhakha eDurban University of Technology (DUT) ngo-2020, okuthe ngo-2022 bahlangana noChiliza noMhlongo - sebevele sebenamabhizinisi abo alo msebenzi, okuqinise ubudlelwano babo baze bashisekela ukusebenzisana ndawonye.
