"Kuqale kancane kuwukuthi siyalekelelana uma kukhona oyedwa phakathi kwethu osuke enomsebenzi omkhulu nodinga izandla eziningi, kwagcina kuba wumkhuba wethu ukuthi njalo siyalekelelana uma kunemisebenzi enjalo - sase sanquma ukuqala le nkampani ngenhloso yokuthi uma kunemisebenzi emikhulu siyenze egameni layo kuphela,” kusho uMagwaza.Eqhuba, uthe ukuqala iKune Studio kubasize kakhulu ukuthola imisebenzi yemicimbi emikhulu yohulumeni neyemicimbi emikhulu yobumnandi ejwayele ukwenzeka eThekwini namaphethelo, okubasiza ukuthi benze inzuzo ngezindlela eziningi futhi ezihlukene.

ABAHOLI KwaZulu-Natal, uNdunankulu Thami Ntuli, noKhomishana wamaPhoyisa esifundazwe uLieutenant General Nhlanhla Mkhwanazi, sebephumele obala bakhuza udlame olubhekiswe kwabokufika olufufusayo kulandela ukwandwa kwemibhikisho elwa nabokufika eminye yayo egcina isiba nodlame.Bathe ababhikishi abanalo ilungelo lokuhambe behlola ukuthi abokufika banawo yini amaphepha okuba kuleli njengoba kunezinhlaka ezigunyazwe ukwenza lo msebenzi.Uya ngokubanciphela umhlaba KwaZulu-Natal abokufika njengoba cishe usuku nosuku sekuba nombhikisho wokulwa nabakuleli ngokungemthetho.Imibhikisho miningi kakhulu eThekwini naseMgungundlovu, muva nje isiba khona nasemadolobheni amancane ngisho nasezindaweni zamakhosi imbala. Kukhona amakhosi asephumele obala athi awasabadingi abokufika.Izinhlangano iWomen's Liberation Movement ne-African Solidarity Network, zithe kungase kwenzeke imbedumehlwana yango-2008 no-2015 uma lunganqandwa udlame olufufusayo.Ngo-2015 kwabulawa abokufika abayisikhombisa ngesikhathi kunezigameko zokuhlaselwa kwabo KwaZulu-Natal nasezingxenyeni zeGoli. Kwashiswa inqwaba yezitolo zabokufika kuleyo mibhikisho.Ngo-2008 kwabikwa ukuthi kwashona abantu abangu-62 ngesikhathi kunodlame olubhekiswe kwabokufika olwaqala eGoli lwagcina selusabalele ezifundazweni eziningi okubalwa neKwaZulu-Natal.Esitatimendeni esikhishwe ngokuhlanganyela, izinhlangano ezikhuza udlame zithe kunezinkomba zokuthi isimo singase sibhebhetheke uma kungakhuzwa. "Kulezi zinyanga ezedlule sibonile kushuba isimo KwaZulu-Natal.

Ukusetshenziswa kwama-drone kwezolimo zanamuhla UThabiso Mkhize, ongumlimi odumile eNingizimu Afrika, uthokozisa izitsha zomhlaba ngephrojekthi yakhe yokusetshenziswa kwama-drone kwezolimo. UThabiso wazalwa emndenini wemisebenzi yokulima, futhi kususelwa kuleli thuba, waqala ukubona ukuthi izinga lokukhiqiza libalulekile ukuze ahlale phambili embonini yokudla. Ubuye waqaphela ukuthi izindlela zendabuko zokulima zidinga ukuvuselelwa ukuze zikwazi ukuncintisana ezimakethe zanamuhla. Ngemva kokuphothula izifundo zakhe kwezolimo, uThabiso wanquma ukufaka ubuchwepheshe obusha ebuhleni bakhe. Waqala ukufunda ngama-drone, awafuna ukuwasebenzisa njengensiza yokwengeza ukukhiqiza. Ngama-drone, uthola imifanekiso ephezulu yamasimu akhe, okwenza kube lula ukuhlola izimo zezinhlobo ezahlukene zemvelo neziphuzo. Uphinde wathuthukisa indlela alima ngayo; ngokusebenzisa ama-drone, uthola ukuhlola izinga lokukhula kwezitshalo, futhi angakhetha izinsiza ezifanele ngesikhathi esifanele. Lokhu kubonisa ukunciphisa izindleko futhi kwandisa ukuhamba phambili kwezemvelo. Dala imiphumela emihle, uThabiso uholele ekwakheni umphakathi onolwazi, lapho abanye abalimi befunda indlela yokusebenzisa ama-drone ukuze bathuthukise imisebenzi yabo. Izinyathelo zikaThabiso zikhombisa ukuthi i-drone akusiyena umcabango omaziweyo kuphela, kodwa iyithuluzi elibalulekile empilweni yokulima yanamuhla. Njengoba eqhubeka nokuhola uhlelo lokuguqula ezolimo, uThabiso ubonisa ukuthi ubuchwepheshe bangasiza ukuqinisa umnotho wemiphakathi yasemakhaya nokuqinisekisa ukuthi izinsiza zokudla zikhona esikhathini esizayo.

Ukuhlaziywa komkhakha wezincwadi ezilalelwayo Umkhakha wezincwadi ezilalelwayo, okwaziwa ngesiNgisi njenge-audiobooks, ubukhula ngokushesha eminyakeni yamuva. Lezi zincwadi zibhaliwe ngendlela yokuthi abantu bangazilalela esikhundleni sokuzifunda, okukhuthaza ukufunda kubantu abaningi, ikakhulukazi labo abangenasikhathi sokuhlala phansi befunda. Izincwadi ezilalelwayo zitholakala ezinhlelweni eziningi, ezifana ne-Audible, Google Play Books, kanye ne-Apple Books, okwenza kube lula ukufinyelela izincwadi ezihlukahlukene, kusukela kwezokufunda, izinganekwane, izincwadi zezemfundo, kuya kwezobuciko. Abalaleli bangakhetha phakathi kwezinhlobo ezahlukene, kulula ukuhlela izincwadi ngokwezithakazelo zabo. Ukwanda kokusebenzisa izincwadi ezilalelwayo kudalwe yizizathu eziningi. Okokuqala, zenza kube lula ukufunda ngesikhathi sokuhamba, emsebenzini, noma ngenkathi wenza imisebenzi yasekhaya. Okwesibili, zikhuthaza abantu abasha ukuba bathande ukufunda, njengoba zikhanga kakhulu futhi zikhuluma ngezindaba ezithokozisayo. Okwesithathu, abantu abanezimfanelo zokufunda ezinzima, njengokuphazamiseka kokufunda, bangazuza kakhulu kulolu hlobo lwezincwadi. Ngaphezu kwalokho, umkhakha wezincwadi ezilalelwayo uveza ubuchwepheshe obusha. Ukuvuselelwa kokusebenzisa ama-headphones, ama-smartphones, kanye nezinhlelo zokusebenza kwenza kube lula ukuba abantu bazilalele izincwadi ezilalelwayo noma kuphi. Lokhu kukhombisa ukuthi umkhakha wezincwadi ezilalelwayo uyakhula futhi uthuthuka, uhlinzeka ngezixazululo ezintsha nezikhuthazayo zokufunda. Ngakho-ke, umkhakha wezincwadi ezilalelwayo ubalulekile ekukhuthazeni ukufunda, ubuchwepheshe, kanye nokufinyelela ezincwadini, okwenza kube yinsiza ebalulekile emhlabeni wanamuhla.

UMasemola ubuyiselwe eceleni ngenxa yokuthi ubhekene necala lokwephula umthetho i-Public Finance Management Act of 1999.UMasemola umiswe kusukela ekutheni evele eNkantolo yeMantshi ePitoli ngoLwesibili emva kokuthi ethunyelelwe amaphepha ngenyanga edlule, eyalelwa ukuthi avele enkantolo mayelana nezinsolo abhekene nazo zokwephula umthetho.Ubhekene namacala amane okwephula umthetho mayelana nethenda ka-R360 million yezinsiza kusebenza zezempilo zoPhiko lwamaPhoyisa iSouth African Police Service, okuvela ukuthi yatholwa usomabhizinisi osolwa ngezenzo zobugebengu uMnuz Vusimuzi "Cat” Matlala.Ngaphambi kwalokhu, uLiet General Dimpane wayekade eyiSikhulu esiPhezulu sezeziMali khona oPhikweni lwamaPhoyisa, kanti uke wafakaza kabili, lapho aveza khona ukuthi akakaze abe neqhaza endleleni okwenganyelwa ngayo leyo thenda.Ngenkathi uMcwaningi Mabhuku Jikelele eveza ukuthi iwu-R650 million imali eyasebenza ngendlela engafanele embuthweni wamaphoyisa onyakeni wemali ka-2024/25, lokho kubandakanya no-R360 million wethenda okwahlomula uMatlala kuyona.Okhulumela i-MK Party, uMnuz Nhlamulo Ndhlela, ugxeke isinqumo sikaRamaphosa ngalokhu, asichaze ngokuthi asiyixazululi nhlobo inkinga yobugebengu nenkohlakalo embuthweni wamaphoyisa.UNdhlela ukhale ngokuthi uDimpane akanawo amava adingekayo nafanele omkhakha wobuphoyisa, njengoba imisebenzi eminingi aseyenzile phambilini, kubalwa nabewenza manje - ibigxile kakhulu ekucwaningeni amabhuku nezomnotho.

OSOMABHIZINISI abasafufusa nabashisekela ukuchumisa amabhizinisi abo bazothola ithuba lokucetshiswa ngokumele bakwenze ukuthola intuba yokuphumelela ngawo uma sebehambele umbukiso wezamabhizinisi waminyaka yonke i-Durban Business Fair (DBF).Lo mbukiso wokukhangisa ngamabhizinisi ozoba seDurban Exhibition Centre, eThekwini, kusuka ngo-Ephreli 30 kuya kuMeyi 2, uzokwendlalelwa yi-Business Indaba izoba se-ICC, ngo-Ephreli 29 ngo-9 ekuseni, lapho okuzobhungwa ngamasu okukhulisa ibhizinisi.Nonyaka ukhuza ibuya ihlandla lesi-28 lo mbuthano wamabhizinisi, ondikimba yawo yanonyaka ithi Enabling SMME Growth Through Funding, Compliance, Market Access, and Strategic Partnerships - okusho ukuthi kuzosizwa osomabhizinisi abasafufusa ngamathuba okuxhaswa ebhizinisini, wukuthola amakhasimende nobumqoka bokusebenzisana nabanye.Ezikhulumini kuzobe kukhona isikhulu esiphezulu seProudly SA, uNkk Happy Khumalo-Ngidi, umqondisi woPhiko lokuThutha nokuHwebelana ngeMpahla kuMasipala weTheku, uNksz Sbo Ncube, ilungu loHlaka lwezeNtela eZweni i-SARS, uNksz Wandisa Madyibi nenye yezimenenja zeSEDA, uMnuz Thula Mkhwanazi.Lezi zikhulumi zizobe zidingida izihloko ezisemqoka kubalwa imigudu okumele ilandelwe wosomabhizinisi abasafufusa ukubasiza baxhaseke, izinkinga zokuswela imali, umthelela omubi wokunyuka kwamanani empahla, yimigudu esemqoka okumele ilandelwe yilabo abasanamabhizinisi, ikakhulu abasanda kuwaqala namasu okubasiza ukuwachumisa.

Uthe uphenyo lwawo luqale lwawaholela KwaHlomendlini, eMandeni, lapho okufike kwaboshwa khona abasolwa ababili ngoLwesithathu. "Oyedwa wabasolwa utholwe neselula yoyedwa wabagilwa. Umkhondo ube usuwakhomba KwaDendethu, eSundumbili, amaphoyisa lapho okufike kwaboshwa khona umsolwa wesithathu,” kusho uNetshiunda. Udalule ukuthi umsolwa wesithathu yena utholwe nesibhamu. Uthe angu-11 amaselula abagilwa, atholwe kubasolwa. Uthe yilapho amaphoyisa ethole khona ukuthi oyedwa wabagilwa ubesebenzela abagilwa. Kwabe sekuvela nokuthi abasolwa ngokubambisana bagqekeze emzini wabagilwa, bababopha ngentambo. "Kuvela ukuthi oyedwa wabo uqale wadlwengula umgilwa oneminyaka engu-20 ngaphambi kokuba babalayishe emotweni yomunye wabo (abagilwa), bayikhomba eMelmoth,” kusho uNetshiunda, othe bahambe ibanga elilinganiselwa ku-200km ukusuka emzini wabagilwa kuyiwa endaweni yesigameko. Uveze ukuthi amaphoyisa athole ukuthi umsolwa obedlwengule umgilwa (20) ekhaya lakhe, uphinde wamdlwengula okwesibili sekufikwe eMelmoth. Uthe emva kokumdlwengula isibili, ube esefuna ngodli imininingwane yabagilwa abathathu yasebhange nezinombolo zakhona eziyimfihlo. "Emva kokuthola le mininingwane, babe sebebadubula bebabulala bobathathu. Laba abanye abagilwa abane, bona bagwazwe, baze bafa,” kusho uNetshiunda. Uthe uphenyo lwamaphoyisa luveze ukuthi ngoLwesibili ebusuku kanjalo nangoLwesithathu ekuseni, kube nemali ekhishwe emabhange abagilwa izikhawu eziningi.

"Kulo mthetho ke akukho nokukodwa lapho kuthiwa makalawule amakholwa, kodwa-ke nangu uyakweza. Ngeke kwenziwe lutho-ke ngoba nalabo abambekile bathule ekubeni enza into engekho kulo mthetho. "Inhlangano iSouth African Church Defenders izwakalise ukungenami okukhulu ngale nkulumo kaMkhwanazi-Xaluva. Ithe yingakho nje ecindezela kangaka amaKrestu yingoba vele ukholelwa emadlozini, umelene namaKrestu.Le nhlangano ezinyangeni ezedlule ike yahlela imashi eThekwini lapho ibikhala khona ngoMkhwanazi-Xaluva imsola ngendlela acindezela ngayo amakholwa.USihlalo wale nhlangano, uMfu Mpfariseni Mukhuba, enkulumeni yakhe wathi abakunqeni ukubhekana ngeziqu zamehlo noMkhwanazi-Xaluva bese kuyacaca ukuthi iyiphi eyogoba uphondo.Walimisa ngesihloko elokuthi uNkk Mkhwanazi-Xaluva umelene nebandla likaNkulunkulu futhi unomcabango wokuthi angenza noma yini kulona.UMkhwanazi-Xaluva emasontweni adlule uye KwaMaphumulo, endaweni ebizwa ngokuthi Ikhaya Labafundi eyotshela umsunguli wale ndawo, uMfundisi Vusumuzi Sibiya, ukuthi akayeke leli bandla. Kule ndawo kuhlangene abantu abathi sebezinikele ekusebenzeleni umbuso weZulu, bahlukene nakho konke okomhlaba.UMkhwanazi-Xaluva wasongela uMfundisi, ethi uma kuke kwafa umuntu kuleya ndawo uyobuya engasadle nkobe zamuntu. Abanye balaba bazalwane bakhetha nokuyeka imishanguzo yodokotela ngoba bethi elabo ithemba liseNkosini.

UMNYANGO wezeMfundo KwaZulu-Natal, usezinhlelweni zokwandisa isibalo sothisha ezikoleni.UMphathiswa womnyango uMnuz Sipho Hlomuka, uthe kuseyisiqalo okwenzekile kuqashwa othisha bakwaGrade R muva nje. "Bangu-500 othisha bakwaGrade R abaqale kule nyanga. Sizimisele ukuqhubeka sandise isibalo sothisha esifundazweni," kusho uHlomuka izolo ekhuluma esiShayamthetho eMgungundlovu. UHlomuka usho lokhu nje othisha abangaqashiwe bahlale bekhala ngokushaywa indiva ngumnyango. Baqhinqa emahhovisi omnyango eMgungundlovu befuna ukuqashwa. Sekuphenduke insakavukela ukuthi bayomasha bekhala ngokungaqashwa. Muva nje umnyango umemezele ukuthi uzoqasha othishanhloko, amaphini othishanhloko kanjalo nezinhloko zezifundo ezikoleni. Zevile ku-3 000 izikhala ezikhangisiwe. UHlomuka uthe bafuna ukuqinisa ukufundiswa kwezibalo ezikoleni. Ubalule nokuthi baqinisa nokufundiswa kwesiNgisi, ukuze abafundi bakuqonde abakufundayo. "Siqinisa ukufundiswa kweMaths ukuze kuphuculwe ikhono labafundi kulesi sifundo. Ukwenza kahle kwabafundi kwa-matric, kuncike esisekelweni okumele sisiqinise," kusho uHlomuka. Uthe bafuna ukuphucula nemiphumela ka-matric ukuze isifundazwe silokhu siqhubeka nokwenza kahle. UHlomuka uthe bafuqa nezifundo zobuchwepheshe okubalwa i-Coding and Robotics. "Ngalezi zifundo silungiselela abafundi kwezithinta ubuchwepheshe. Kunesidingo sokuthi izifundo ezifundwayo zihambisane nokudingwa wumnotho. "UHlomuka uthe bayabalalela othisha, abafundi kanjalo nabazali bese bakha uhlelo oluzobhekana nabakudingayo.

"Kubikwa ukuthi uConst Mtolo wayehleli emotweni yakhe nabangani ngesikhathi kusondela kubo uMkulisi. Kuthiwa baba nengxoxo emfishane ngaphambi kokuthi uConst Mtolo aphume emotweni yakhe,’’ kusho uMhlongo.Uqhube wathi uConst Mtolo wathi ngesikhathi esaqhubeka nokukhuluma noMkulisi, wavele wamdubula ngentululwane yezinhlamvu.Kuthiwa uConst Mtolo wafela khona lapho kanti abangani bakhe ababili ayehamba nabo bona balimala base bephuthunyiswa esibhedlela. "Wabe esebaleka endaweni yesigameko ngezinyawo. Kwavulwa icala lokubulala nelokuzama ukubulala khona esiteshini sase-Evatt, idokodo lakhona ladluliselwa koKlebe ukuze benze uphenyo olunzulu,’’ usho kanje.UMhlongo uqhube wathi ngoMsombuluko, uMkulisi ubanjwe esifundazweni saseMpumalanga lapho ebebhace khona.Uthe wabe esebuyiswa KwaZulu-Natal ukuze avele eNkantolo yeMantshi yaseKokstad ngoLwesithathu oludlule.Uphethe ngelithi usagqunywe esitokisini kuze kube uLwesithathu, lapho okulindeleke ukuthi afake isicelo sakhe sebheyili.

Ukukhula Komkhakha Wokuthengisa Online Kubathengisi Abazimele Emhlabeni wanamuhla, ukuthengisa online sekuyinto ejwayelekile, futhi lokho kubalulekile kakhulu kubathengisi abazimele. Ngiyavuma ukuthi lesi sikhulu sikhula ngokuqhubekayo ngenxa yezizathu eziningi. Okokuqala, ukuziphendukela kwezobuchwepheshe kwenze kube lula ukufinyelela emakethe enkulu ngaphandle kwezithiyo ezinkulu ezandleni, njengokutholakala kwezikhala zokuthengisa. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, abathengi bethu bajwayele ukufaka izimpahla zabo online. Lokhu kudala amathuba amasha kubathengisi abazimele, ukuze bakwazi ukufinyelela kubantu abaningi bangaphansi kwendawo yabo. Abathengisi basendaweni bangakwazi ukwakha amabhizinisi abo ngaphandle kokuphazamiseka okukhulu uma beqhuba izinhlelo zabo zokuthengisa online. Ngaphezu kwalokho, izinkundla zokuxhumana zibe yisiqephu esibalulekile kulokhu ukukhula. Ngaphakathi kwalezi zinkundla, abathengisi bangakha umphakathi, baphinde baphendule imibuzo, baqondise abathengi, futhi bakhe ubudlelwano obuqinile. Lokhu kudala ukwaziswa okukhulu kubathengi, okwenza kube lula kubo ukuthembela kubathengisi abazimele. Ngokuhambisana nalokho, izinkampani ezikhiqiza izinsiza zokuthengisa online ziqhubeka nokuthuthukisa izindlela zabo, zinikeza abathengisi abaningi amathuluzi afanele ukuze baphumelele. Lokhu kuhlanganisa izixazululo zokuphathwa kwezimpahla, izinsizakalo zokuhamba, kanye nezindlela zokukhokha ezilula. Ngakho-ke, ngikholelwa ukuthi ukukhula komkhakha wokuthengisa online kumkhankaso womboni wezohwebo wezinsuku zethu. Izinselelo ezithile zikhona, kodwa ngamathuba amaningi, abathengisi abazimele bangathola impumelelo enkulu. Qhubekani niphakamiseni imikhiqizo yenu, nisebenzise lezi zinkundla ukudala umphakathi ofuna ukuzitholela imikhiqizo yakho. Lokhu kuyithemba lokukhula okukhulu, futhi akuyona nje ithuba, kuyiphupho elingaqhutshekiswa.

UTHI ubhecwa ngobende inyama engayidlanga uthishanhloko waseMpumulwane Primary, KwaMaphumulo, uMnuz Sithembiso Khumalo obhekene necala lokusocongwa kwephoyisa loMkhandlu weTheku, uCaptain Zwelakhe Thomas Ntombela. Lokhu ukusho eNkantolo eNkulu yaseThekwini izolo.Kuzokhumbuleka ukuthi umufi wadutshulwa wafa esigamekeni esenzeka ngoMeyi 2023 esemzini wakhe kwa-S, eMlaza. Waphuthunyiswa eSiphingo Medical Towers okuyilapho okwafike kwamenela khona.Bekungokokuqala ukuthi uKhumalo angene ebhokisini selokhu laqala leli cala. UKhumalo ungaphandle ngebheyili ayithola leli cala lisaseNkantolo yeMantshi yaseMlaza ngo-2023.Ngaphambi kokuba angene ebhokisini ummeli wakhe,u-Advocate Mdu Mvune, ubekade efake isicelo sokuthi akhishwe phambili engazange abethule ubufakazi okuyinto inkantolo eyichithile wase engena kanjalo ebhokisini uKhumalo.UKhumalo uqale ngokuveza ukuthi uMzo Ntombela inkabi eyavuma icala yagwetshwa ingumakhelwane wakhe kanjalo noKhulani Cele inkabi edonsa esikadilkakajele naye uthe ungamakhelwane wakhe.Ebuzwa ukuthi uyamazi yini uNkk Faith Ntombela uthe akamazi kodwa ngaphambi kokubulawa komyeni wakhe wake wambona KwaDukuza.Utshele inkantolo ukuthi akalazi nephoyisa okukhulunywa ngalo, nendawo okuthiwa labulawelwa kuyona akayazi.

Indima yemidlalo yendabuko ekwakheni ubumbano emphakathini 1. Ukwazi umqondo wemidlalo yendabuko Imidlalo yendabuko iyingxenye ebalulekile yamasiko amaningi, ibonisa izindlela zokuphila, izinkolelo, nemigomo yokuphila kwempilo. Le midlalwano ivame ukudlalwa emicimbini, ezithakazelweni, nasezinsukwini zokugubha amakhosi. Ihlanganisa abantu abaningi, ibakhuthaza ukuba badlale kanye, lokhu kwenza kube lula ukubumbana. 2. Ukugqugquzela ubumbano Imidlalo yendabuko ibalulekile ekwakheni ubumbano phakathi kwabantu. Ngokulandisa izindaba zomlando, abantu babonisa izimpande zabo, kungakhathalekile izizinda zabo. Ukudlala ndawonye kudala umoya wokubambisana futhi kuvuselela izixhumanisi phakathi kwezizukulwane. 3. Ubuqotho nemikhuba Abantu abadlala imidlalo yendabuko bahlonipha imikhuba nezimiso zezakhamuzi zabo. Lokhu kudalula ubumbano ngoba kwenza kube nokwaziswa nokuhlonishwa kwamagugu amakhosi, okwakha umqondo ophumayo ophathelene nemiphakathi. 4. Ukwakha izinhlelo ezididiyelwe Izinhlelo ezenziwa ukuze zixhase imidlalo yendabuko kufanele zibe nempumelelo ukuze ziqinisekise ukuthi abantu bayakwazi ukuzibandakanya. Lokhu kungabandakanya ukuhlela imicimbi yokudlala, ukuqeqesha abadlali, noma ukuhlela izifundo ngezindlela zokudlala. 5. Ukuhlela imicimbi Imicimbi yokudlala idinga ukuhlela okuhle okwaziyo ukuheha abantu abaningi. Kubalulekile ukuqinisekisa ukuthi imicimbi ibhekelwe kahle ukuze yonke imiphakathi ibhiyozele, inikeze ithuba lokuhlangana nokuxhumana. 6. Ukuphathwa kwemiphumela Ngemuva kwemidlalo, kubalulekile ukuhlola umphumela wokuhlangana. Izikhathi zokuxoxa, ukuhlolisisa okwakusebenza, nokuphendula izimvo zibe yindlela yokuthuthukisa umoya wobumbano. Ngokusebenzisa lezi zinhlelo, imidlalo yendabuko ingadlala indima esemqoka ekwakheni ubumbano emphakathini, iqinisekisa ukuhamba phambili kwezizukulwane ezizayo.

''Angimazi lo muntu okukhulunywa ngaye nendawo enikhuluma ngayo okwenzeka kuyona isigameko,'' usho kanjena esebhokisini ephendula imibuzo yommeli wakhe, u-Advocate Mvune.Ebuzwa ukuthi kukhona yini afisa ukukusho mayelana nokubulawa kukamufi uthe akukho ngoba akazi lutho udidekile ukuthi kungani eyamaniswa naleli cala. "Okokuqala nje ngangizotholani ngokubulala umuntu engingamazi,'' ubuze kanjena.Uthe waqala ukubona uFaith ngesikhathi ethola ucingo olwaluvela kuCele owayemcela ukuba ahambe aye eMega City, eMlaza ayothatha imoto. ''Ngesikhathi engishayela ucingo wangitshela ukuthi kunemoto yakhe ayithengile okumele ngiyoyilanda eMega City. Ngenxa yokuthi angithandanga ukuhamba ngedwa ngacela uMzo ukuba ngihambe naye njengoba naye uCele wayemazi uMzo ngoba sonke sakhelene,'' usho kanjena.Uthe uCele wayelokhu ebashayela ucingo ebheka ukuthi sebekuphi nendawo. ''Engakuqaphela wukuthi wayefona esebenzisa izingcingo ezihlukene. Ngesikahthi sesidlula eGateway wangitshela ukuthi imoto ngizoyifica ipake ngasegaraji eMega City,'' kuchaza yena.Eqhuba uthe wamtshela nokuthi uzohlangana nowesifazane omfishane, ompofu, ogqoke amateku amhlophe futhi ozobe ehamba nge-mercedes benz. "Wangitshela ukuthi loyo wumkakhe,'' kusho uKhumalo. ''Ngampela sengifikile kwaqhamuka le moto kwehla yena kanye lo muntu wesifazane engitshelwe ngaye.

KUHLUKENE imibono kwizazi zepolitiki emuva kokuthi lowo owayengumengameli wezwe, uMnuz Jacob Zuma, ememezele ukuthi ngeke ayivotele i-ANC okhethweni lwangonyaka ozayo.Ngosuku lokubuyisana uZuma ushaqise abaningi ememezela ukuthi uzovotela iqembu elisha elibizwa ngokuthi uMkhonto Wesizwe njengoba engeke asebenzisane ne-ANC eholwa nguMengameli Cyril Ramaphosa.Isazi sepolitiki esizimele, uMnuz Thabani Khumalo, sithe isenzo sikaZuma siphambene nemigomo ye-ANC ekubeka kucace ukuthi uma ujoyina le nhlangano uzimisele ukuyeseka.Uthe silubeka obala uqhekeko olukhona kule nhlangano.Ubalule ukuthi i-ANC izithola ibhekene nesimo esinzima lapho kuyiphoqa ukuthi yenze okuthile ngoZuma kwazise usesigungwini esibhekelele ukusebenza kwayo. "UZuma akafunanga ukuthi azixoshe kodwa ushiyele i-ANC ukuthi kube iyona ezithathela isinqumo ngekusasa lakhe. Uwumuntu okwaziyo ukuthola uzwelo ngoba uma i-ANC imxosha uyobe esekhala ngokuthi inhlangano aseyisebenzele iminyaka engaphezu kuka-60 isimxoshile.

SIYENYUKA isibalo samaqembu ahlangana ngenhloso yokuketula i-ANC emandleni, okhethweni olubhekwe ngabomvu lukazwelonke lwangoyaka ozayo.Lokhu kulandela ukungena kwamaqembu i-Ekhethu People’s Party, ezinze eGauteng ne-United Christian Democratic Party, eyasungulwa ngowayengumholi waseBophuthatswana, uMnuz Lucas Mangope.Leli qembu lizinze eNorth West kanti womabili azoba yingxenye yokhetho ukuze ancozule amavoti kaKhongolose. Isitatimende senhlanganisela yamaqembu abambisene okuyi-DA, IFP, FF Plus, ActionSA, ACDP, ISANCO, UIM neSNP, samukele lawa maqembu kule nhlanganisela. Sithe sinethemba lokuthi lawa maqembu azodla amavoti e-ANC kulezi zindawo. "Sifuna ukunika abavoti into ehlukile kunalokho abakunikwa i-ANC. Sinxenxa abantu bakuleli ukuthi basondele bavotele inqola ehambayo.” Le nhlanganisela ithembisa ukuthi kuzoba nokulingana ngakwezomthetho, amandla azobuyela kohulumeni basekhaya, kuzoliwa nenkohlakalo, kuzolethelwa abantu izidingo ezibafanele. "Kuzohlinzekwa ngemfundo nezempilo ezisezingeni, kukhuliswe nomnotho ontengayo.

Inkampani yaseMkhumbane izama ukuthuthukisa impilo yabalimi bendawo. UThabo, umlimi ophumelele, ubona ukuthi ubuchwepheshe bama-drone bungasiza kakhulu kulolu hlelo. Njengoba izivivo ziqala, uthola umDrone owawubhekiswe kumayela, owaziwa ngokuba nekhono lokuhlola izindawo ezinkulu ezivumelana nezolimo. Ngelanga elikhanyayo, uThabo uvula isikhumba se-drone yakhe, ayiqhubekisele phezulu. I-drone iyagijima, ibuka izivini, izitshalo, namafamu. Njengoba ibhalela izithombe ezinhle zokusebenza, uThabo uyakhumbula izinsuku lapho abelokhu ehlola izivini ngenyawo, ethwele umthwalo omkhulu. Ngemva kwemizuzu embalwa, i-drone ibuyela. UThabo uyathokoza lapho ebona ukuthi izithombe zikhombisa izindawo ezinesithwathwa, okukhombisa izindawo ezidinga ukunakekelwa. Lokhu kumenza acabangele izinhlelo zokufaka imithi ethile ukuze avikele izitshalo zakhe. Ngenxa yokusebenzisa lezi zinsiza ezintsha, uThabo uthola umkhiqizo ophakeme, kwathi izivini zakhe zaba yimpumelelo enkulu. Abanye abalimi bembula izithombe zikaThabo, behlola indlela angathuthukisa ngayo imisebenzi yabo. Ngaleso sikhathi, ubuchwepheshe bama-drone bujolile, buhlangabezana nezidingo zamasiko nezomnotho. Ekugcineni, uThabo waba ngumholi emphakathini wakhe, efundisa abanye abalimi ngokwaziswa okutholakala ngamadrone. Zasiza izivini, zishintsha izimpilo, futhi zathuthukisa umnotho wesifunda. Ngaleso sikhathi, i-drone yaba isikhumbuzo sokuhlakanipha kwezolimo zanamuhla, kwenze uThabo waba umfanekiso wesikhathi esisha sokukhiqiza.

KUTHIWA isibalo esiningi sabantu abebezama ukubhalisela ubulungu kwi-website yeMkhonto Wesizwe Party yikona okuyenze yahluleka ukusebenza ngeMpelasonto.NgoMgqibelo, iNingizimu Afrika ibigubha uSuku lokuBuyisana ngezindlela eziningi ezweni lonke. Ngesikhathi eSoweto abezindaba nabathandi bebehlanganyele esithangamini esibizwe yilowo owayengumengameli, uMnuz Jacob Zuma, ehholo iYMCA elise-Orlando East.Owayengumengameli wakuleli, uMnuz Jacob Zuma, osanda kuphumela obala ngokweseka iqembu elisha iMkhonto Wesizwe Party yize ethi ngeke ayishiye i-ANC isithombe: XLapha uZuma ufike waveza into edide abaningi ngokuthi akazukukhankasa ne-ANC eholwa wuCyril Ramaphosa.EZANGEMPELASONTO: ISIMEMEZELO esibone iNingizmu Afrika ihlukana phakathi ngemibono ngekusasa lalowo owayengumengameli uJacobe Zuma nokhetho lwangonyaka ozayo pic.twitter.com/eCg2ZCxSWG— Isolezwe News (@IsolezweNews) December 18, 2023 NgeSonto ntambama kuvele ukuthi i-website yaleli qembu elisha elesekwa nguZuma ibhidlike kaningi ngenxa yokuhluleka ukumumatha isibalo sabantu abaningi abathuthelane kuyo bezama ukubhalisela ubulungu ngobuchwepheshe besimanje.Kuse ngoMsombuluko leli qembu selinameke ezinkundleni zokuxhumana i-video ebonisa ukuthi sebeyivusile i-website futhi isiyasebenza.The link is back up if you want to register you can click https://t.co/TSnN6aRVux pic.twitter.com/f2mlRPxzDD— @MK (@MkhontoweSizwex) December 18, 2023

KONKE sekumi ngomumo ngomcimbi waminyaka yonke wokuhlonipha nokuklomelisa osomabhizinisi bemikhakha ehlukene, nozohambisana nombukiso wokukhangisa ngamabhizinisi abo, amaBambelela Business Awards.Lo mcimbi ohlelwa yiHollywood Foundaton, okhuza ibuya ihlandla lesithathu nonyaka, uzoqala ngombukiso wamabhizinisi ngo-Ephreli 28 ngo-8 ekuseni, bese kuba wumcimbi wokuklomelisa osomabhizinisi ngo-Ephreli 29 ngo-6 kusihlwa - kokubili okuzoba seHollywoodbets Greyville Convention Centre, eThekwini.Kulo mncintiswano, osekwa nawuhulumeni waKwaZulu-Natal, kuzoklonyeliswa osomabhizinisi basesifundazweni abaqhamuka ezindaweni ezihlukene okubalwa kuzona iTheku, uMgungundlovu, Ulundi, Greytown, Richards Bay, Mpangeni nasePort Shepstone.Okhulumela iHollywood Foundation, uNksz Vuyisile Ngobese, uthe nonyaka lo mcimbi bawenze belandela indikimba ethi "Rooted in KZN, Advancing Township and Rural SMMEs for Inclusive and Sustainable Economic Growth", okusho ukuthi babheke ukufukula osomabhizinisi basemalokishini nabasezindaweni zasemakhaya ukuze kusimame umnotho. "Emva kohlelo lokuhlunga, sigcine siqoke amabhizinisi awu-128 eKZN yonkana ukuthi abambe iqhaza ohlelweni lwanonyaka. Sibaqoke eminxeni ehlukene okubalwa owezobuchwepheshe besimanje, ezokwakha, imboni yemfashini, ezempilo nezobuhle okubamba iqhaza elimqoka ukufukula umnotho wesifundazwe sethu,” kusho uNksz Ngobese.Eqhuba, udalule ukuthi kulokhu baqikelelile ukuthi kuqhakambiseke kakhulu osomabhizinisi besifazane njengoba bewu-66% abangenelile, okusho ukuthi nembokodo izoba neqhaza elinqala nelibonakalayo ekukhuliseni umnotho nokuthuthukisa umphakathi. "Konke lokhu esikwenzayo kokuveza amabhizinisi asemalokishini nasezindaweni zasemakhaya kuzosiza kakhulu ukuthuthukisa osomabhizinisi, kube kulekelela ngokuthi kwakhe amathuba okwandisa abatshalimali ukuze bafukuleke,” usho kanje.Uthe nakulo nyaka iwu-20 iminxa ehlukene yamabhizinisi okuzoklonyeliswa osomabhizinisi abanqobile kuyona, bese kuthi abazonqoba kuyona bahlukaniselane umklomelo ka-R1 million wokuxhasa amabhizinisi abo.

UBEKE eqhulwini ukuphepha kwabafundi nokubaluleka kwemfundo, uMasipala i-Alfred Duma ngesikhathi wethula iphrojekthi yokwakhiwa kwebhuloho lezinyawo, elidle izindodla zemali.Lokhu kudalulwe yiMeya yawo uMnuz Zama Sibisi, edalule ukuthi bethule iphrojekthi esizweni sakwaZwane eMangweni ngenxa yomfula ongaweleki uma ugcwele.Udalule ukuthi ibhuloho lidle u-R6.9 million. "Kuyasijabulisa ukuthi le mali izosetshenziselwa ukuqinisekisa inhlalakahle yabantu,’’usho kanje.Ukuvulwa kwesikole esisha kule ndawo, iMfumbulwane Primary, uthe yikhona okubakhuthazile ukuthi bakhe ibhuloho. "Uma singalakhi leli bhuloho, lokhu kuchaza ukuthi abafundi balesi sikole esisha ngeke baze baye esikoleni. Kokunye kungenzeka bazame ukuwela kanti kakuphephile,''usho kanjena.Ugcizelele ukuthi babone kungcono ukuba babeke phambili ukuphepha kwabafundi basikole.IMeya uSibisi ithe kakumele kube khona okukhinyabeza imfundo yabantu bakule ndawo. Uthe ngeke kuze kuzwakale kahle uma sekuthiwa kukhona abafundi abangayile esikoleni ngenxa yokugcwala komfula. "Yingakho nje sibone kusemqoka kakhulu ukuba sisukume senze isiqiniseko esikhulu sokuthi siyalakha leli bhuloho.

"Neyakhe impilo ibisengcupheni, nabo bebedubula bebhekise kuye,” kusho uNgubane. Uthe ithimba eliyisipesheli elasungulwa ukuze libhekane nalolu hlobo lobugebengu, lisawubambe kahle. "Kuke kuthule, ngoba izigebengu ziyalalisa, kodwa bese kubuye kubhoka ke futhi,” usho kanje, enezela ngokuthi njengoba kwenzeke isigameko nje, ikhona imoto eyiveni ethathwe kuzosa kube yizolo eBhambanana. Unxuse umphakathi ukuthi uqhubeke ubambisane namaphoyisa ekulweni nalobu bugebengu, waphinde wawuxwayisa ngokuthi uqaphele ngoba izigebengu zalolu hlobo ziyingozi. Okhulumela amaphoyisa KwaZulu-Natal, uColonel Robert Netshiunda uthe umufi ungomunye wezelamani zakwaMalwane ezaziwayo, ezisohlwini lwabasolwa abafunwa amaphoyisa ngamacala okubulala kanjalo nawobugebengu obusemngceleni. "Phakathi kwalawo macala, kukhona nelokubulala uMnuz Juda Mthethwa,” kusho uNetshiunda. Uthe umufi udutshulwe wafa ngesikhathi kubanjwa inkunzi eThengani, eManguzi, ngeSonto. Uthe uMalwane nomunye abehamba naye bagqekeze umuzi, bephethe izibhamu, bafuna ngodli izikhiye zemoto kumnikazi womuzi. "Umgilwa usheshe wathatha isibhamu sakhe, wadubula ebhekise kubasolwa, abaphunyule babaleka. Umufi ubaleka nje, udubulekile,” kusho uNetshiunda.Uthe amaphoyisa alwa nobugebengu obusemngceleni azwe ukuthi kunesidumbu esingcwatshwe ngendlela engafanele eMgodiwemvubu ngeSonto. "Amaphoyisa athole ukuthi leso sidumbu ngesikaMalwane obedutshulwe esikhathini esingengakanani ngosuku olufanayo.

Angiboni kwenzeka lokho ngoba noThabo Mbeki wenza okucishe kufane nalokhu okwenziwe wuZuma emuva kokuba exoshiwe. Wathi ngeke ayivotele i-ANC futhi ngeke aphume kuyona. Akazange axoshwe ngakho noZuma angimboni exoshwa. Into engenzeka wukuthi i-ANC ingazama ukuxoxa naye ngoba ukumxosha kuzoyilahlekisela ngamavoti KwaZulu-Natal,” kusho uDuvenage.Wenze isibonelo sokuthi uZuma unawo amandla ngoba ngo-2021 ngesikhathi eboshwa kwabheduka izwe, kwayizibhelu zikaJulayi, KwaZulu-Natal naseGauteng.Uthe uZuma uzosebenzisa ithuba lokuthi abe nekusasa elingamgqigqisi enkantolo uma i-ANC ikhetha ukuxoxa naye.UMnuz Mafika Mndebele okhulumela i-ANC KwaZulu-Natal, uthe bayamhlonipha kakhulu uZuma njengomakadebona kodwa lokhu akwenzile bakubona kuyindlela yokuzama ukususa abantu kwi-ANC.Ucele bonke abantu ukuba bavotele i-ANC ngoba iyona eyithemba labantu. Wathi uZuma uyena owabafundisa ukuthi akekho umuntu obaluleke ukudlula i-ANC ngakho abantu mabaqhubeke nokuyeseka.

Ucwaningo ngezindlela abantu abasebenzisa ngazo ama-smartwatch Ama-smartwatch asezandleni zethu, futhi akuyona nje imfashini, kodwa futhi kube yithuluzi elibalulekile empilweni yethu. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, abantu banikela kakhulu ekusebenziseni lezi zinsiza, futhi indlela abasebenzisa ngayo ama-smartwatch iyathakazelisa. Okokuqala, ama-smartwatch asiza abantu ukuthi bahlale bephapheme. Ngokuthola izaziso zomlayezo, izikhumbuzo, nezaziso zokuhamba, abantu bangakwazi ukuphendula nasekusebenzeni kwabo ngaphandle kokuphuma kwi-skin. Lokhu kubalulekile kakhulu, ikakhulukazi emsebenzini, lapho kokuhlala uqaphile nezinsuku ezibucayi zikhona. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ama-smartwatch akhuthaza ukusindisa impilo. Ngokulandela izinga lokushisa komzimba, imithambo yegazi, nokuzivocavoca, abantu bathola ulwazi oluqondile mayelana nempilo yabo. Lokhu kubavumela ukuthi benze izinqumo ezingcono zokudla, ukuzivocavoca, nokuhlala bejabulile. Ngiyavuma ukuthi lokhu kuthuthukisa impilo yabo, kuyilapho kunciphisa amathuba okuba nezinkinga zempilo ezinzima. Futhi, ama-smartwatch ayisikhumbuzo esihle sokusebenzisa isikhathi kahle. Ngokusebenza kwezikhathi ezithile, abantu bangakwazi ukuhlukanisa phakathi komsebenzi nempilo yomuntu siqu. Lokhu kubalulekile ekwakheni ibhalansi empilweni, ezehlenga emphakathini ngoba abantu abanesikhathi sokuphumula bazokwazi ukwakha ubudlelwano obuqinile nabanye. Nokho, akukhona konke okuhle. Kunesidingo sokuba siqaphele ukuze singabavumi ukuthi ama-smartwatch akhiphe isikhathi sethu. Kukho umqondo obalulekile wokuthi kufanele sizwisise futhi sihloniphe imizwa yethu nempilo yethu yengqondo. Ngamafuphi, ama-smartwatch anikeza amathuba amaningi, kodwa kufanele sibe neqhaza lokusebenzisa lezi zinsiza ngokuhlakanipha. Ukuze sithuthukise impilo yethu, sithumele imiyalezo yethu, futhi sakhe ibhalansi empilweni yethu, kudingeka siqapidise amanye ama-smartwatch ethu. Lolu cwaningo lukhombisa ukuthi ama-smartwatch, uma esetshenziswa kahle, angaba usizo olukhulu kithina sonke.

Kwazulu, emadolobheni nasemaphandleni, umsakazo bekungumthombo omkhulu wolwazi, ukuhlekisa, nokuxhumana. Abantu babejwayele ukusho ukuthi, "Ngiyalalela umsakazo," njengoba bephumile emsebenzini, noma besebenza emakhaya. Kodwa-ke, izinguquko zenzeka, futhi izinkundla zokusakaza zashintsha indlela abantu abawulalela ngayo umsakazo. Ngonyaka odlule, uThandi, owayejabulela ukulalela umsakazo, waqala ukuhamba phambili. Wathola uhlelo olusha lokusakaza olwakhiwe ku-inthanethi, olwakwazi ukufinyelela ezindaweni ezikude. Lokhu kwavula umnyango omusha. UThandi wathola ukuthi angalalela umsakazo wakhe owawuthandayo noma kuphi, kungakhathaliseki ukuthi ubani. Wazithokozisa ngokuqhubeka nokulalela izinhlelo ezithokozisayo, ezinjengokuhlola izindaba zakamuva, umculo, kanye nezinhlelo zokuxoxa. Kodwa lokhu akukhona kuphela. Abanye abantu, njengomngani wakhe uSipho, baqala ukusebenzisa izinhlelo zokusebenza ezikwi-smartphone zabo. USipho, owayejwayele ukulalela umsakazo kuphela emakhaya, wathola ukuthi angalalela umsakazo wezwe lonke, ngisho neziteshi ezivela kwamanye amazwe. Lokhu kumenze waba nomuzwa wokuba yingxenye yomhlaba omkhulu. Ngalesi sikhathi, izinkundla zokusakaza zashintsha umqondo wokuthi umsakazo ungumthombo owodwa kuphela. Zaba yindawo yokuxhumana, yokwabelana ngemicabango, nezinhlelo ezihlukahlukene ezithokozisayo. Abantu bahlala bexoxa ngezinhlelo ababelalele, bejabulela imicabango emisha, futhi bezwakalisa imibono yabo. Ngakho-ke, izinguquko emikhubeni yokulalela umsakazo zikhombisa ukuthi, ngisho noma izindlela zishintsha, umoya wokuxhumana nokuqonda phakathi kwabantu uhlala uqinile. UThandi noSipho bahlala bejabule, bephila impilo enothile, bazi ukuthi umsakazo awupheli, kodwa uthola indlela entsha yokuphila.

SITAKULWE ngusomabhizinisi isikole saseMthwalume, kwaQoloqolo, kuward 15 iSibonguJeza Primary School esinamagumbi amancane okufundela.USomabhizinisi wakule ndawo, uMnuz Jacob Gumede wenkampani iLunga Da Bhiva, unikezele ngegumbi elilodwa lokufunda ukuze kuzonezeleleka amagumbi okufunda kulesi sikole.Ekhuluma neSolezwe uGumede uthe njengosomabhizinisi ubone kumqoka kakhulu ukuthi abuyisele emphakathini kube khona akwenzela lesi sikole.Ukhale ngokuthi okumsukimisile ukuthi ukuqaphelile ukuthi lesi sikole sinamgumbi amancane kakhulu okufundela. ''Ngibone kungcono ukuthi njengosomabhizinisi wakhona andaweni kube khona engikwenzayo. Bekungeke kube lula ukuthi ngithule ekubeni ngibona ukuthi likhona iqhaza engingaba nalo kulesi simo lesi sikole esibhekene naso,''echaza.Uthe kuhle ukuthi osomabhizinisi babonakale beklama indima ukulekelela imiphakathi abakuyona. Uveze ukuthi basebenzise imali elinganiselwa ku-R180 000 ukuphothula wonke lo msebenzi. ''Angeke size siyikhalelele yonke le mali ngoba yenze into ebelulekile kakhulu. Ayikho into engikholwa ukuthi imqoka ngaphezulu kwemfundo.Yingakho sibone kungcono ukuba sifake isandla,''echaza.Uveze nokuthi emagcekeni alesi sikole bafake nesigwedla samanzi ngenxa yokuthi bayiqonda kahle kamhlophe indaba yenkinga yamanzi ebhekene nalo mphakathi wakule ndawo. ''Yonke leya ndawo inenkiga yamanzi yingakho sibone kufanele ukuba sibalekelele nangamanzi,''usho kanjena.Uveze ukuthi lesi sikole sesizoba nabafundi abangu-84 ngemuva kokuba kunezelwe leli gumbi. Ekuqaleni uthe bebengu-54.

ITHIMBA elijutshwe yiSilo uMisuzulu Sinqobile kaZwelithini lithi ziyathembisa izingxoxo zalo namaqembu ameleleke ePhalamende mayelana nodaba lokuchibiyela umthetho olawula isikhwama esigade umhlaba kaZulu, iNgonyama Trust.Ithimba libe nemihlangano namaqembu ezepolitiki ameleleke ePhalamende ayisishiyagalombili kulezi zinsuku ezimbili ezedlule.Obekuxoxwa emhlanganweni yisiphakamiso seSilo sokuba kuchitshiyelwe umthetho olawula iNgonyama Trust.IMbube ifuna umthetho ugunyaze ukuthi kube iyona eqoka amalungu ebhodi leNgonyama Trust, njengamanje amalungu ebhodi aqokwa uNgqongqoshe wezoMhlaba.IMbube ifuna nokuthi iNgonyama Trust iphathwe uhulumeni waKwaZulu-Natal esikhundleni sokuthi iphathwe uhulumeni kazwelonke.Amaqembu ahlangane nethimba yi-ANC, MKP, DA, EFF, Bosa, ACDP, FF Plus neRise Mzansi.UNdunankulu kaZulu, uMfu Thulasizwe Buthelezi, uthe izingxoxo zabo namaqembu ezepolitiki zihambe kahle. "Amaqembu azibophezele ekwesekeni izinguquko ezizokwenza ukuthi kuzuze abantu abahlala ezindaweni zamakhosi.

Izinselelo zokuvikeleka kwedatha yomuntu siqu ezinkundleni zedijithali Njengoba izinkundla zedijithali zikhula, izinselelo zokuvikela idatha yomuntu siqu zikhula nazo. Abasebenzisi bezinkundla zokuxhumana, izinhlelo zokusebenza, kanye nezinsizakalo ezikwi-inthanethi bahlala behlangabezana nokudideka phakathi kokufuna ubuchwepheshe obuphambili kanye nezingozi zokulahlekelwa ngemininingwane yabo. NgokweZikhangiso zedijithali, abanikazi bezinkundla badinga ukuqinisekisa ukuthi bahlola abalaleli babo ngezindlela zokuvikela idatha. Lokhu kuhilela ukusungula izinqubomgomo eziqinile zokuvikela, ezihlanganisa izinsiza zokuvikela eziphumelelayo nezokuthola izinkinga. Nokho, imbangela yokukhathazeka iqhubeka ifihliwe, ikakhulukazi uma kukhulunywa ngamathuluzi obuchwepheshe. Ucwaningo lwezokuphepha kwedatha, uNkk. Thandiwe Mkhize, uphawule ukuthi: "Izinkundla eziningi zisebenzisa izindlela zokuvikela, kodwa abanye abasebenzisi abazi kahle ukuthi kufanele baphathe kanjani imininingwane yabo." Lokhu kukhombisa ukuthi abanye abantu basaqhubeka nokwabelana ngezimfihlo zabo, bephonsa inselelo ezinkampanini ezikhangisa ukuvikeleka. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukuvikeleka kwedatha kudinga izinqubomgomo ezithathelwa phezulu, kodwa akusikho konke okungokwesikhathi eside. Uma abathengi bengazi kahle izinqubo zokuvikela, bangase bahluleke ukugcina imininingwane yabo, okuholela ekulahlekelweni okukhulu kokwaziswa komuntu siqu. Kubalulekile ukuthi abathengi baqonde izingozi ezihambisana nezinkundla zedijithali ukuze bavikele imininingwane yabo. Ukuze kuqhubeke phambili, kudingeka ukubambisana phakathi kwabathengi, abanikazi bezinkundla, kanye nohulumeni ukuze kudalwe indawo ephephile yokuxhumana.

Indima yeminyuziyamu ekugcineni umlando namasiko ibalulekile emiphakathini eminingi. Iminyuziyamu iyizikhumbuzo eziphilayo zomlando, lapho izigameko, abantu, nezinto ezibalulekile ziqoqwa khona ukuze zihlale zikhumbuleka. Zihlinzeka ngendawo yokufunda, lapho abantu bengafunda khona ngempilo, amasiko, nezinkolelo zabantu abahlala emhlabeni. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, iminyuziyamu ibalulekile ekugcineni umlando. Ziqoqa izimpahla ezihlobene nezikhathi ezahlukene, okuhlanganisa izinsiza, izithombe, nemibhalo ebalulekile. Lokhu kuqoqwa kwenza kube lula ukuhamba emuva emlandweni, kubonisa izinguquko ezenzekile emiphakathini nasemhlabeni jikelele. Ngokwesibonelo, iminyuziyamu efana neMnyuziyamu yaseLuvuvhu eNingizimu Afrika ibonisa umlando wezizwe ezahlukene, izinkolelo zazo, nezindlela zokuphila. Ngaphezu kwalokho, iminyuziyamu ibamba imicimbi ehlukene, efana nezinkulumo, izifundo, nemikhosi, okuvumela abantu ukuba baxhumane futhi babelane ngolwazi. Lokhu kudala umqondo wokuhlanganyela, okuqinisa ubudlelwano phakathi kwabantu. Ngaphezu kwalokho, iminyuziyamu ibalulekile ekugcineni amasiko, ikakhulukazi kulabo abavela ezizindeni ezincane, lapho amasiko angase aphumele ngaphandle. Ngakho-ke, iminyuziyamu ayigcini nje ngokugcina umlando, kodwa ibalulekile ekwakheni umphakathi onolwazi, oqondayo, futhi ophilayo. Ziyizikhumbuzo eziphilayo, ezisiza abantu ukuba baziqonde kangcono izimpilo zabo, izimpande zabo, kanye nezinto ezibenza babe yilowo nalowo. Indima yeminyuziyamu ibalulekile, futhi kufanele iqhubeke ibalulekile emiphakathini yethu.

Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, emhlabeni wedijithali, izingane zathola amathuba amahle okunethezeka, ukufunda, nokuxhumana. Nokho, lezi zikhathi zivalelisa ezithakazelisayo nezizwakalayo zaveza izingozi eziningi. Ukuze kuvikelwe izingane, abaphathi, abafundisi, nabazali baqala ukukhipha izindlela ezahlukene zokuvikela. Emakilasi, ngonyaka ka-2004, kwavulwa imihlangano yezokuphepha kwedijithali ezikoleni. Abafundisi bangenisa izifundo zokusebenzisa ubuchwepheshe ngendlela efanele, befundisa izingane ngezingozi ezifana nokuxhumana nezing strangers, ukudlula emugqeni ongemuhle, nokulawula isikhathi sokusebenzisa izinjini zokusesha. Lokhu kwaba yisinyathelo sokuqala sokwakha ukuqonda kwengane ngokuqhubeka kwalesi sikhathi esisha. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ngo-2010, izinhlelo zokuvikela eziphephile zavela, ezaziza ezinhlelweni zokusebenza kanye nezinhlelo zokusebenza mobile. Kwaba nezinhlelo ezichwepheshe, ezazenzelwe ukuhlola okuqukethwe okungafanele, njengoba kwaba nomphumela omkhulu ekuvikeleni izingane emhlabeni we-inthanethi. Lokhu kwavumela abazali ukuba balawule okuqukethwe okwakufinyelelwa ngabantwana babo ngaphandle kokubakhathaza. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, ukuvikelwa kwezingane emhlabeni wedijithali kwaba koko, okubandakanya izikhungo ezifana ne-SAIEV (South African Internet Education and Awareness) nezinye eziningi, ezazithuthukisa amaqhinga okusebenzisana nezinkampani zedijithali, ukuze ziqinisekise ukuthi kuhloswe ukugcina izingane ziphephile. Namuhla, sikhumbula lezi zinyathelo ezithathiwe, futhi ngendlela yokuvikela okuhle kwezingane, umhlaba wedijithali ushlenza. Lokhu kwaba umphumela wokuhlangana kwemizamo yemiphakathi eminingi, edlulisela izifundo ezibalulekile empilweni yabantu abasha. Lokhu kubonisa ukuthi, naphezu kwengozi, indlela esiqonde ngayo ukuvikela izingane emhlabeni wedijithali iyinhloko ekwakheni ikusasa eliqhakazile.

Abangeke baphumele obala ukuthi bazokhankasela i-ANC, sizothatha ngokuthi bazokhankasela elinye biqembu. Abakhankasela iqembu elincintisana ne-ANC bazothathelwa izinyathelo. "Uma ujutshwe esikhundleni kuhulumeni sizokuthathela izinyathelo okubalwa kuzo ukuthi sikukhiphe esikhundleni. Sizokukhipha esikhundleni ngoba uzokube ukhankasela iqembu elibanga ne-ANC okhethweni, nokuyinto ephambene nemigomo ye-ANC." UMbalula uthe amalungu e-SACP angeke axoshwe kwi-ANC. "Siyasihlonipha isinqumo se-SACP sokungenela ukhetho. Angeke silwe namaKhomanisi emkhankasweni wethu. Asinankinga namalungu e-SACP. I-SACP inabaholi abanohlonze abanye babo bajutshwe ezikhundleni kuhulumeni. Amanye amalungu e-SACP anombono ohlukile ngodaba lokungenela ukhetho. "Asikho empini. Into nje okufanele abantu bakhethe ukuthi bazokhankasela liphi iqembu. Awukwazi ukukhankasela womabili amaqembu. Kufanele ukhethe iqembu elilodwa. Awukwazi ukuthi namhlanje uzokhankasela i-ANC, uvuke kusasa usukhankasela i-SACP. "UMbalula uthe bayoze bayibone emva kokhetho i-SACP. "Mhlawumbe le nto sizoyixoxa emva kokhetho. Uma sekuphume imiphumela yokhetho mhlawumbe sizobona ukuthi singakwazi yini ukusebenzisana ne-SACP. Ngeke uphinde usizwe sikhuluma ngale ndaba."

Bathuka izanya abahlali basemijondolo iPopo Molefe, eBoitekong, esifundazweni iNorth West, kulandela isigameko esishaqisayo sokubulawa kwabantu bezidlela ijiki egcekeni ngoMgqibelo ebusuku.Kuthiwa kugasele oshayasibhamu abangaziwa ngabo-9.15, emzini okuyo le ndawo, bavulela ngenhlamvu kwabebesegcekeni.Kufe abesilisa abahlanu nabesifazane abane.UThandile Mampolo, ongomunye wabasindile, uthi ubuhlungu ngokwenzekile ngoba ulahlekelwe wumngani wakhe abemthanda kakhulu. "Besihleli siziphuzela, kwangena abantu esangweni bavulela ngenhlamvu kuwo wonke umuntu, sonke sivele salala phansi, baqhubeka badubula. Laba bantu bebehambe bedubula sesilele phansi, nami ngivele ngazenza osefile ngalala ngathula,” kusho yena.UBrigadier Sabata Mokgwabone, okhulumela amaphoyisa kulesi sifundazwe, uthi ngokombiko abawutholile bekuyiqoqo labantu abakhuluma isiXhosa abebehlangene egcekeni lalo muzi bephuza utshwala ngesikhathi behlaselwa. "Kuthiwa bahlaselwe ngabasolwa abebekhuluma isiSuthu. Abagilwa abayisishiyagalombili bafe ujuqu, kwathi oyedwa washonela esibhedlela. Bayisishiyagalombili abathelwe ngamachaphazelo,” kusho yena.Uthi imbangela yokuhlaselwa kwalaba kayaziwa okwamanje futhi akukaboshwa muntu.UKhomishana wamaPhoyisa kulesi sifundazwe, uLieutenant General Sello Kwena, uhlanganise ithimba elikhethekile elizophenya ngalokhu.

UYATHUTHUMELA owesifazane wakwa-H, eMlaza, othi ubhacile njengoba esaba ukuthi umyeni wakhe kungenzeka aphinde amenze isilo sengubo njengoba ezame ukumdubula kodwa wamshweba waphinda wamgxokogxa ngesikele esithweni sakhe sangasese. UNksz Wendy Zondi (36) wakwa-H, eMlaza, uvele ahlengezele izinyembezi uma echaza ngokulimala kwakhe athi kwenzeke ezinyangeni ezedlule.Uthe umyeni wakhe, uMnuz Kagiso Ndimande (38) wafika endlini ntambama baba nokuhilizisana nakhona athi akaqondi ukuthi kahle hle kwakubangelwa yini, wathi umyeni wakhe wafika ekhaya "edle amponjwana" wakhala ngokuthi akakuthandi ukujwayelwa kabi umuntu omganile.UNksz Ndimande uthe kuthe uma embuza ukuthi kwenzekani kodwa engaphenduli, kunalokho ebelesela amazwi awodwa wokuthi akakuthandi ukujwayelwa kabi.Eqhuba, uthe umyeni wakhe ube eseqonda kuyena ehlezi kusofa wamqala ngempama, wathi esababaza lokho wamane wadonsa isibhamu sakhe wamshaya ngesidunu emhlane nasekhanda..Uthe waqhubeka wamshaya waze wadubula kodwa engamphenduli uma embuza ukuthi kwenzenjani futhi woneni ukuze axolise, wathi wayengezwa mshini, wamthatha wamyisa egumbini labo okuyilapho amkhumule khona ngezansi naye wase eyakhumula ibhulukwe. ''Ngaleso sikhathi bengizitshela ukuthi uzothamba mhlawumbe usefuna senze inkonzo yasekameleni kanti angibuzanga, umuntu kukhulu afuna ukukwenza kimina,'' echaza.Uthe umyeni wakhe ube esemthatha emsondeza kahle wambeka echosheni lombhede samuntu abazokwenza inkonzo njengoba naye ekhumule ibhulukwe.

Ukusetshenziswa kwezimali zedijithali (cryptocurrency) emabhizinisini amancane kudinga ukubhekwa ngokucophelela, njengoba lezi zimali zikhula ngokushesha, zikhuthaza ubuchwepheshe obusha futhi zikhulisa amathuba okukhula. Njengoba umhlaba uhamba phambili, izinkanyezi ezinjenge-Bitcoin ne-Ethereum ziyaqhubeka nokuduma, zenza ukuqashwa kwezimali zedijithali kube yindlela ethokozisayo yokuxhasa amabhizinisi amancane. Ngokwesibonelo, amabhizinisi amancane angazuza kakhulu ekunciphiseni izindleko zokuhweba. Ngokusebenzisa izimali zedijithali, umphakathi ungagwema izinkokhelo ezinzima ezihlanganiswe nezinhlelo zebhange zasendaweni. Lokhu kudala umfaniswano obalulekile wokwenza ibhizinisi, ikakhulukazi emkhakheni wezokuthengisa. Ngaphezulu kwalokho, izimali zedijithali ziwusizo kumabhizinisi athengisa kumakhasimende avela emhlabeni wonke, njengoba zibuswa yizimakethe ezisemhlabeni jikelele, okwenza kube lula ukufinyelela emakethe yezezimali. Nokho, kufanele sikhumbule ukuthi ukusetshenziswa kwezimali zedijithali akukhululi amabhizinisi efuqulwe. Ukuntuleka kokwaziswa, izigameko zokukhwabanisa, kanye ne-volatility echazwe ngalesi sikhathi kungaholela ezinkingeni ezinkulu. Amabhizinisi amancane adinga ukuqonda lezi zinkinga ukuze akwazi ukusiza izinqumo zokuthi angazisebenzisa kanjani lezi zimali ngendlela efanele. Ngakho-ke, ngikholelwa ukuthi, uma amabhizinisi amancane ewafaka kahle, izimali zedijithali zingaba yisikhombisa sesikhathi esizayo kwezokuhweba. Ukukhetha kahle nokuqonda kahle izingozi kuzoba yisihluthulelo sokuphumelela kwayo. Jikelele, lezi zimali zedijithali ziyasivula emaphethelweni amasha, futhi kubalulekile ukuthi sizijabulele kahle.

UNksz Wendy Zondi (36) wakwa-H, eMlaza, uvele ahlengezele izinyembezi uma echaza ngokulimala kwakhe athi kwenzeke ezinyangeni ezedlule.Uthe umyeni wakhe, uMnuz Kagiso Ndimande (38) wafika endlini ntambama baba nokuhilizisana nakhona athi akaqondi ukuthi kahle hle kwakubangelwa yini, wathi umyeni wakhe wafika ekhaya "edle amponjwana" wakhala ngokuthi akakuthandi ukujwayelwa kabi umuntu omganile.UNksz Ndimande uthe kuthe uma embuza ukuthi kwenzekani kodwa engaphenduli, kunalokho ebelesela amazwi awodwa wokuthi akakuthandi ukujwayelwa kabi.Eqhuba, uthe umyeni wakhe ube eseqonda kuyena ehlezi kusofa wamqala ngempama, wathi esababaza lokho wamane wadonsa isibhamu sakhe wamshaya ngesidunu emhlane nasekhanda..Uthe waqhubeka wamshaya waze wadubula kodwa engamphenduli uma embuza ukuthi kwenzenjani futhi woneni ukuze axolise, wathi wayengezwa mshini, wamthatha wamyisa egumbini labo okuyilapho amkhumule khona ngezansi naye wase eyakhumula ibhulukwe. ''Ngaleso sikhathi bengizitshela ukuthi uzothamba mhlawumbe usefuna senze inkonzo yasekameleni kanti angibuzanga, umuntu kukhulu afuna ukukwenza kimina,'' echaza.Uthe umyeni wakhe ube esemthatha emsondeza kahle wambeka echosheni lombhede samuntu abazokwenza inkonzo njengoba naye ekhumule ibhulukwe. "Emqondweni wami bese ngizitshela ukuthi siya ocansini,'' echaza.Uthe umuzwe esememeza esethi ngeke aze alale naye yena ngoba uyamcika futhi unephunga elingelihle. "Ngemuva kwalokho, wathatha isikele wangilimaza ngaphansi,'" echaza.Nakhona lapho, uthe waqhubeka embuza ukuthi wenzeni kepha impendulo engayitholi, kunalokho uthe umyeni wakhe wayephenduke isilwane ebona kahle nje ukuthi usho ukumudla eluhlaza futhi usho ukuqeda nje nya ngaye.Uthe kukhona lapho ayemshaya aze amhudule phansi endlini, walimala kabi emhlane nasezingalweni ngokunjalo.

Ucwaningo ngezindlela abantu abasebenzisa ngazo ama-smartwatch luhlelwe ukuze kuhlolwe izindlela ezahlukene zokusebenzisa lezi zinsiza zobuchwepheshe. Ngalesi sikhathi, abacwaningi bahlangana nabantu abavela ezindaweni ezahlukene, baphinde bahlola izimo ezihlukene zokuphila ukuze baqonde kahle ukuthi ama-smartwatch asebenza kanjani empilweni yabo yansuku zonke. Umcimbi uqale ngenkulumo-mpikiswano phakathi kwabathandi be-smartwatch, lapho abanye bekhuluma ngezindlela ezilula zokusebenzisa ama-smartwatch, njengokulandelela izinyathelo, izinga lokuphefumula, nokubala ama-calories. Abanye baphinde bakhombisa ukuthi ama-smartwatch awasiza kanjani ekuphatheni izinhlelo zabo zokusebenza, okuhlanganisa nokubeka izikhumbuzo zokuphila kahle. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ucwaningo luhlanganisa nezifundo ezithokozisayo ezivela kubasebenzisi abavela ezindaweni ezahlukene, abakhuluma ngempumelelo yokusebenzisa ama-smartwatch ekuphatheni izinkumbulo, ukuxhumana nabangani, kanye nokuhlola izimo zempilo. Lokhu kuhlola kuveza ukuthi ama-smartwatch awasizi kuphela ekwenzeni izinto, kodwa futhi akha ubudlelwano obuqinile phakathi kwabantu. Ekugcineni, umcimbi ugcizelela ukubaluleka kokuhlola izindlela ezahlukene zokusebenzisa ama-smartwatch, ukuze abantu bakwazi ukuthola izinzuzo eziphelele ezivela kulolu hlobo lobuchwepheshe. Ucwaningo luhlinzeka ngokuqonda okujulile kokuthi ama-smartwatch angaba kanjani ithuluzi eliwusizo empilweni yansuku zonke, futhi lukhuthaza abantu ukuba baphile impilo enempilo futhi enobuchwepheshe.

Kukhona amakhosi asephumele obala athi awasabadingi abokufika.Izinhlangano iWomen's Liberation Movement ne-African Solidarity Network, zithe kungase kwenzeke imbedumehlwana yango-2008 no-2015 uma lunganqandwa udlame olufufusayo.Ngo-2015 kwabulawa abokufika abayisikhombisa ngesikhathi kunezigameko zokuhlaselwa kwabo KwaZulu-Natal nasezingxenyeni zeGoli. Kwashiswa inqwaba yezitolo zabokufika kuleyo mibhikisho.Ngo-2008 kwabikwa ukuthi kwashona abantu abangu-62 ngesikhathi kunodlame olubhekiswe kwabokufika olwaqala eGoli lwagcina selusabalele ezifundazweni eziningi okubalwa neKwaZulu-Natal.Esitatimendeni esikhishwe ngokuhlanganyela, izinhlangano ezikhuza udlame zithe kunezinkomba zokuthi isimo singase sibhebhetheke uma kungakhuzwa. "Kulezi zinyanga ezedlule sibonile kushuba isimo KwaZulu-Natal. Kube nemibhikisho ngaphandle kwesikole i-Addington Primary, kube nezinsolo zokuvimba abokufika ezibhedlela nasezikoleni, baningi nje abantu abavelile abakhuluma izinto ezicwasa abokufika. "Izinhlangano zinxuse amaphoyisa ukuba abophe abaphehla udlame.Zinxuse amakhosi, izinhlaka zikahulumeni, abamasonto nosomabhizinisi ukuba bangenelele. "NeSilo uMisuzulu kaZwelithini sineqhaza elibalulekile okufanele silibambe ekubuyiseni uzinzo. "UNtuli unxuse abantu ukuthi behlise umoya, wathi akufanele kubukeke sengathi abantu baKwaZulu-Natal bacwasa abantu bokufika.Ukusho lokhu ngesikhathi ekhuluma nabeSABC News. "Kufanele kucace ukuthi inkinga esinayo ingabantu abakuleli ngokungemthetho. Akufanele kube nokudideka kule nto.

"ISilo namakhosi bayingxenye ebalulekile emphakathini, yingakho sithe asivele. Sizobonakala kakhulu KwaZulu-Natal nomkhankaso wethu wokhetho uzoba khona la. Besizozethula ukuze iSilo namakhosi bangasexwayi,’’ kusho uMalema.I-DA nayo ayifuni ukusala ngaphandle ngokuyokhuleka kuBayede ngoba nayo ilandelane eduze ne-EFF ngosuku olulandelayo yatheleka. Nayo yafika yakhuleka ngezinkomo eSilweni yaxoxa nangodaba lokubulawa kosopolitiki esifundazweni nokunye okuningi.I-DA nayo yezwakalisa ukweseka iSilo nokusifisela okuhle kodwa ekuholeni isizwe saso.Iqembu elisha i-ActionSA nalo libuya khona ukuyokotha iSilo lafika lakhuleka ngenkomo lizethula kuBayede. Nalo lakhombisa ukuseseka kakhulu iSilo lathembisa ukuthi lizoba nobudlelwano obuhle naso.Wonke amaqembu agqigqa kangaka nje, kungenzeka ukuthi anethemba lokuthi lokhu kuzolekela ngandlela thizeni ekutholeni amavoti.OSOPOLITIKI bakhuleka ngezinkomo uma beyokotha iSilo sikaZulu baze baqinisekise ukuthi bayaseseka futhi basifisela okuhle Isithombe: TIMOTHY BERNARD/AFRICAN NEWS AGENCY ANA

Ucwaningo ngokusetshenziswa kwezimoto ezizishayelayo emhlabeni luqala eminyakeni engama-20 edlule, lapho ubuchwepheshe obusha buqala ukuthuthuka. Ngalesi sikhathi, izimoto ezizishayelayo, noma ezaziwa ngesiNgisi njenge-‘self-driving cars,’ zathathwa njengephupho elikude, kodwa isayensi yaba nesandla kulokhu. Ekuqaleni kweminyaka yama-2000, inhlangano yeGoogle yathola ithuba lokuhlola umqondo wezithuthi ezizishayelayo. Lezi zinto zokuqala, ezifana ne-Google Self-Driving Car Project, zathola impendulo ethokozisayo emphakathini. Izinjini ezihlakaniphile, izinzwa ezisezingeni eliphezulu, kanye nezinhlelo zokusebenza ze-software zenza kube nokwenzeka ukuthi izimoto ziqhube zodwa, ziphephile, futhi zigcine isikhathi sokuhamba. Ngo-2016, izimoto ezizishayelayo zathola ukuthandwa okukhulu, kwavela izinkampani eziningi ezifuna ukungena kulesi sikhala. I-automotive industry yaguquka kakhulu njengoba izinkampani ezinkulu, ezifana ne-Tesla, Ford, ne-Uber, zifaka imali enkulu ocwaningweni nasekuthuthukiseni izimoto ezizishayelayo. Lokhu kwaholela ekwenzeni izinqumo ezibalulekile mayelana nokuphepha, imithetho, kanye nemithelela emphakathini. Naphezu kwezinselelo eziningi, njengezokuphepha nokuxhumana phakathi kwezithuthi, umhlaba uqhubeka nokubona intuthuko enkulu. Ngo-2023, izimoto ezizishayelayo zikhona emadolobheni amaningi, futhi abantu baziwa ngokukhetha lezi zindlela zokuhamba ezikhululekile. Ucwaningo luveza ukuthi izimoto ezizishayelayo zinganciphisa ukungcoliswa komoya futhi zithuthukise ukuphepha kwezimoto. Ngakho-ke, umnotho wezithuthi ubukeka uyashintsha, futhi isifiso sokuphila ngendlela engcono sikhula. Umqondo wezithuthi ezizishayelayo ususisusa emaphusheni, ube yimpilo yanamuhla, ubonisa indlela esihamba phambili ngayo emhlabeni wesimanje.

I-DA ifuna kubizwe umhlangano ophuthumayo ohlanganisa iminyango ehlukene kahulumeni, okubalwa nezinhlaka zokuphepha nezokushushiswa komphakathi, ukuze kubhungwe ngesihlava sokukhulelwa kwezingane kuleli.Leli qembu libhalele uSihlalo wekomiti labesiFazane, iNtsha nabaPhila nokuKhubazeka ePhalamende, ukuze abize umhlangano ofaka iminyango ehlukene okubalwa oweMfundo eyisiSekelo, owezokuThuthukiswa koMphakathi, owezeMpilo, amaphoyisa kanjalo nophiko lwezokuShushisa kuleli, iNational Prosecuting Authority.Okhulumela i-DA eMnyangweni wezabesiFazane, iNtsha nabaPhila nokuKhubazeka, uNksz Angel Khanyile, uthe bakhathazekile ngesihlava sokukhulelwa kwezingane. Uthe ziyashaqisa izibalo zezingane ezikhulelwe KwaZulu-Natal, onyakenimali u-2025/26. "Izibalo ziveza ukuthi zingu-421 izingane ezineminyaka engu-10 kuya ku-14 ezikhuleliwe esifundazweni onyakenimali u-2025/2026. Lokhu kusho ukuthi izingane ezintathu zikhulelwa ezinsukwini ezimbili," kusho uNksz Khanyile.Uthe lezi zibalo zikhomba ukuhlukunyezwa kwezingane kuleli. "Kulo mhlangano kumele yonke iminyango iveze iqhaza layo ekulweni nalesi sihlava. Kudingeka kube nokubambisana kweminyango ukuze kulandelelwe amacala asuke ebikiwe agcina egweba abathintekayo." Uthe umthetho ucacile ukuthi ingane eneminyaka engu-12 ayikwazi ukuvuma ukuya ocansini. Ukhale ngosonhlalakahle athe bayahluleka ukubika amacala emaphoyiseni. "Ezinye iziteshi zamaphoyisa aziwamukeli la macala.

OnguNobhala walolu phiko, uNksz Nokulunga Khuzwayo, usigxekile kakhulu lesi sehlakalo. ''Silimele kakhulu ngokudlula komfundi emhlabeni ngale endlela. Sifisa ukuthi umthetho usebenze.. Eqhuba uthe bezwe ukuthi umfundi ubeziphilisa ngakho ukudayisa. Uchaze lesi senzo njengesikhombisa ubulwane obukhulu.Lesi sikole sike saba sematheni futhi eminyakeni eyedlule ngesikahthi amaDelangokubona ephazamisa ukwakhiwa kwaso ngoba efuna ukuba yingxenye yakho.Ukwakhiwa kwaso kugcine kuqedeliwe ngemuva kokuba uMphathiswa wezeMisebenzi yoMphakathi kanye neNgqalasizinda KwaZulu-Natal, uMnuz Martin Meyer, engenelelile.IMenzi ibalwa nezinye izikole ezikhiqiza imiphumela emihle ka-matric unyaka nonyaka. Ukusebenza ngokuzimisela kothisha bakhona kuyinto ehlale ibatshazwa yizwe lonke. Nangonyaka odlule siphinde senza okufanayo.

UMshushisi uthe uLerutla wahluleka ukuza enkantolo ngecala lokuhamba ngesivinini ngoba ethi wayeye kwinhlolokhono ngosuku olufanayo.UMkhwanazi selokhu amiswa ngoNovemba 2025, waboshwa esemzini wakhe. ULerutla waboshwa esesikhumulweni sezindiza i-OR Tambo Internationl wawaphika amacala abekwe wona. Kwahlaluka ukuthi wayeyotetemuka nenye intokazi.Enkantolo abameli bakaMkhwanazi bemnxusela ibheyili bathe kumfanele ukuyithola ngenxa yokuthi ukwazile ukusebenzisana nabaphenyi becala. Batshele inkantolo ukuthi futhi akasiyona ingozi emphakathini.Wathi kumphatha kabuhlungu ukuyamaniswa nokushona kukaMnuz Marius Van Merwe owaduma kwiKhomishini kaMadlanga ngoWitness D owabulawa emva kokuthi ethule ubufakazi kwiKhomishini.Kuzokhumbuleka ukuthi uVan De Merwe owayefihliwe waveza okuningi okushaqisayo ngoMkhwanazi ngesikhathi ethula ubufakazi.Phambilini uMkhwanazi watshela iKhomishini ukuthi usesaba ngisho ukuphumela emnyango ngenxa yokuthi kukhona abamyamanisa nokushona kukaWitness D.Abameli bakaLerutla bona bathe bacela ukuthi anikezwe ibheyili ngoba uyena obheke umndeni wakhe uyawondla futhi ngeke abe budedengu aphazamise ukuphenywa kwecala.Ngakolunye uhlangothi uMbuso umile kwelokuthi laba akubafanele ukuthola ibheyili ngoba bangakuphazamisa ukuphenywa kwecala.

Koxakile onezithiyo eziningi uyibeka ku-4L, ungayixini ngoba bungachitheka bugayiwe.Leli veni lethulwa nje, bekungakapholi amaseko iJMC - izimoto zayo ezilethwa yiSalvador Caetano South Africa - yethule iveni layo lokuqala eNingizimu Afrika, iVigus, intengo yayo ebiqala ku-R299 900 i-single cab.Amasondo ayo okwazi ukunqamula ngawo kuyo yonke indawo angu-17 inch. Ine-hill descent control engadinge ukuthi ubambe ibhreki uma usendaweni eyehlelayo njengoba izenzela yona umsebenzi. Inama-airbag amane kwewumshini ozishintshayo kanti kweshintshwayo mabili. Inama-LED daytime running lights nezitebhisi zokugibela.Leli veni isakhiwo salo elifuze olweFord yango-1970, bathi likwazi ukuthwala isisindo esingu-915kg. Ukuze uhlale uphephile linensiza ekwazisayo uma umoya wehlile emasondweni.Lishiye umhlaba ngo-225mm, ubude lingu-5 335mm kanti ububanzi ingu-1 882mm.Ngaphakathi ine-touchscreen infotainment system engu-12.8 inch oxhuma kuyo iselula nge-Apple CarPlay/Android Auto kanti i-instrument cluster ezimele yodwana ingu-9.0 inch.Izihlalo zangaphambili eziyisikhumba zihlelwa ngogesi, akudingi ulokhu usidonsa. Inekhamera ecacisa bha uma uhlehla kanti iyakutshela uma ususondele eduze kwento ezoyihuzula noma isisondele odongeni. Ngisho uya phambili iyakubikela ukuthi uqaphele ingozi.

Ubefuna ukuba uMkhandlu wakhe unikwe amandla okuphenya la masonto athe chithi saka ukuthi awanyatheli yini amalungelo abantu abangamakholwa. Lesi siphakamiso senyusa imimoya emakholweni amaningi ekhuza ibhadi ngokuthi uhulumeni ufuna ukushayela abezenkolo imithetho ngendlela abakhonza ngayo, okuyinto uMthethosisekelo ongayivumi.Ekhuluma neSolezwe Ngempelasonto ngalokhu, uSolwazi Musa Xulu phambilini obekade eyingxenye yomsebenzi wale Khomishini, uthe uNkk Mkhwanazi-Xaluva akenzanga kahle ngokugqashiya ngokuthi uyisangoma ekubeni azi ukuthi uphethe isikhundla esimqoka kanjena.UXulu ukhuluma kanjena nje kune-video eveza uXaluva ekhuluma emi phambi kwezangoma esho ukuthi yena uyakholelwa kwelakhe idlozi. ''Asazi mhlawumbe phela awabo amadlozi awabasebenzeli,'' uzwakala ebhinqa kanje engacacisi ukuthi ubhekise kubani.UXulu lokhu uthi kubi ngoba kuzodala inzondo phakathi kukaMkhwanazi-Xaluva namaKrestu. ''Ngingasho kugcwale umlomo nje ukuthi ube budedengu kakhulu ngokukhuluma ngaleya ndlela. Okubi kakhulu ngaye wukuthi umane akhulume nje noma yikanjani ezinkundleni zokuxhumana, kumele akuyeke lokho ngoba kuzomfaka enkingeni,'' kuxwayisa uXulu.Eqhuba uthe lusazoqhubeka udungunyane phakathi kukaMkhwanazi-Xaluva namaKrestu uma eqhubeka eziphatha ngale ndlela.UXulu ukhale ngokuthi enye inkinga enkulu wukuthi uMkhwanazi-Xaluva akayiqondi kahle inkolo yobuKrestu, wathi ngenye yezinto ezidala ukuthi enze noma kanjani. ''Iqiniso ukuthi indaba yamadlozi nayo ingenye inkolo ngokwayo.

Ukuhlaziywa kokwanda kokusebenza kwama-robot embonini Ngomhla ka-15 kuNhlangulana 2023, umcimbi obalulekile uzobanjelwa eGoli, lapho kuzobe kuxoxwa khona ngokuqhubekayo kokusebenza kwama-robot embonini. Lo mcimbi, obizwa ngokuthi "I-Industrial Robotics Summit," uzohlanganisa ochwepheshe, abacwaningi, nabathengisi abavela emhlabeni wonke, ukuze bahlaziye izinzuzo nezithiyo ezihambisana nokwandiswa kokusetshenziswa kwama-robot emikhakheni ehlukahlukene. Izinkulumo ezibalulekile zizophathwa ngochwepheshe abahamba phambili embonini, bechaza indlela ama-robot athuthukisa ngayo ukukhiqiza, ukunciphisa izindleko, nokwandisa ikhwalithi yomkhiqizo. Kuzoba nezinkomba ezithokozisayo zokuthi ama-robot asiza kanjani ekwenzeni imisebenzi ethile, njengokuhlanganiswa, ukulawulwa kokusebenza, kanye nokupakisha. Ngaphezu kwalokho, umcimbi uzoba nethuba lokuxhumana, lapho abahlanganyeli bengaxhumana khona, babelane ngemicabango, futhi bakhe ubudlelwano obuqinile. Izingxoxo ezizokwenziwa zizoqhakambisa izindlela ezintsha zokusebenzisa ubuchwepheshe be-robotics, okuhlanganisa nokufaka izinhlelo zokusebenza ezihlakaniphile, ezizokwazi ukunciphisa imiphumela emibi yokusebenza kwabantu. Lo mcimbi uzoba yithuba elihle lokuhlola ikusasa le-automation embonini, futhi uzokhuthaza abahlanganyeli ukuba bacabangele izindlela ezintsha zokuthuthukisa imisebenzi yabo. Ngakho-ke, abathintekayo baphakanyiswa ukuba babambe iqhaza futhi bazuze kulolu hlelo oluyingqayizivele.

Ukusetshenziswa kobuchwepheshe bokuphrinta be-3D embonini Ukuphrinta kwe-3D sekuyinsiza ebalulekile embonini, njengoba kuvumela ukukhiqizwa kwezinto ezihlukahlukene ngendlela esheshayo nehlelekile. Nansi imiyalelo yokusebenzisa leli thuluzi elisha: 1. Ukukhetha Umkhiqizo: Qala ngokukhetha umkhiqizo ofuna ukuwuphrinta. Lokhu kungaba yizinto ezincane ezifana nezinsiza zokusebenza noma imikhiqizo emikhulu efana nezakhiwo. Qinisekisa ukuthi umkhiqizo unokwakheka okungafaneleka ukuphrinta. 2. Ukudala I-3D Model: Sebenzisa isoftware yokwakha imodeli ye-3D. Ungasebenzisa amathuluzi afana ne-Tinkercad, AutoCAD, noma SolidWorks. Qinisekisa ukuthi imodeli yakho iyahambisana nezidingo zokuphrinta, njengezindleko zokusebenzisa izinto ezithile. 3. Ukulungiselela Ukuphrinta: Ngemuva kokwakha imodeli, sebenzisa isoftware yokulungisa ukuphrinta (slicing software) ukuze uguqule imodeli ibe yifomethi efanele yokuphrinta. Lokhu kufaka phakathi ukusetha izinga lokushisa, isivinini sokuphrinta, kanye nezinye izilungiselelo. 4. Ukukhetha Okokusebenza: Khetha okokusebenza okufanele ukuphrinta. Izinto ezivame ukusetshenziswa zifaka i-PLA, ABS, noma i-Nylon. Qinisekisa ukuthi okokusebenza okukhethile kuhambisana nezidingo zomkhiqizo wakho. 5. Ukuqala Ukuphrinta: Ngemuva kokulungisa konke, qala ukuphrinta. Bheka izinqubo zokuphrinta ukuze uqinisekise ukuthi konke kuhamba kahle. Qaphela izinkinga ezifana nezithiyo noma ukungahambi kahle kokuphrinta. 6. Ukubuyekeza Umkhiqizo: Ngemuva kokuphrinta, hlola umkhiqizo ukuze uqinisekise ukuthi uhambisana nezinga elifunwayo. Ungase udinge ukwenza izinguquko ezincane noma ukulungisa. 7. Ukusebenzisa Umkhiqizo: Uma umkhiqizo uhambisana nezidingo, ungawusebenzisa embonini yakho. Lokhu kungahlanganisa ukufaka kumaphrojekthi, ukuwusebenzisa njengemodeli, noma ukuwuthengisa. Ngalezi zinyathelo, ubuchwepheshe bokuphrinta be-3D bungaba yinsiza ewusizo kakhulu embonini, kukhulisa ukukhiqiza nokwenza kube lula ukwakha izinto ezintsha.

IZINYANE leNkosi yaseMathulini, eMgababa, esanda kukhothama, lithi mabangadideki abantu bakulesi sizwe ngoba yinye inkosi futhi inkosi iyazalwa kayiqokwa ngabantu.UMntwana uMazwi Luthuli oyindodana yeNkosi esikhotheme, uPhathisizwe Luthuli, usho kanjena ngesikhathi kunohlelo lokuhlinzekwa kwabafundi bezikole zaseMgababa ngemifaniswano yesikole, obuqhubeka emagcekeni enkosi.Izinyane likugcizelelile ukuthi inkosi iyazalwa, hhayi le nto yabathile abakhonjwayo ukuze bangene ezikhundleni. Izinyane kuzokhumbuleka ukuthi yilona elasukunyiswa ngosuku lokutshalwa kwenkosi lethulwa njengozongena esikhundleni sikayise. ''Mabangadideki abantu, yinye Inkosi yesizwe saseMathulini, ikhona yazalwa,'' usho kanjena ezisho yena.Izinyane likhuluma kanjena nje, kufanele kukhunjulwe ukuthi kuke kwanemibiko eveza ukuthi usha phansi umbango wesihlalo sobukhosi kulesi sizwe.Kuvela igama likaMnuz Msawakhe Luthuli ozichaza njengoyise wenkosi ekhotheme, owatshela Isolezwe ukuthi naye kumfanele ukuba sesihlalweni sokuhola isizwe.Khona lapho, kuvela negama likaMnuz Busani Luthuli owengamele isikhwana sesizwe saseMathulini futhi ongumfowabo wenkosi esanda kukhothama.Kuzokhumbuleka ukuthi inkosi yaguqa isigubhukane. Likhuluma izinyane, liveze ukuthi lizimisele ukuqhubeka nemisebenzi kayise emihle yokunakekela umphakathi abekade eyenza esadla anhlamvana.Yize izinyane lithe fahla ngodaba lombango wesihlalo sobukhosi kodwa lithe alithandi ukukhuluma ngalolu daba ngenxa yokuthi kusaziliwe.

Ukuhlaziywa komkhakha wokukhiqiza okuqukethwe ku-YouTube Ku-YouTube, umkhakha wokukhiqiza okuqukethwe ushintshile kakhulu eminyakeni edlule, ube yindawo eyinhloko yokwabelana ngolwazi, ukuhlekisa, imfundo, nezokuzijabulisa. Ukuze siqonde kahle le mboni, kubalulekile ukuhlaziya izici ezahlukene ezithinta ukukhiqizwa kokuqukethwe. Okokuqala, kudingeka sikhumbule ukuthi abakhiqizi bokuqukethwe ku-YouTube bahlukaniswe ngezindlela eziningi. Kukhona abakhiqizi abakhangisayo, abahlinzeka ngemfundo, nabafaka umculo nezinye izinsiza. Lokhu kuhlukanisa kuveza izidingo ezihlukene zababukeli, futhi kukhombisa ukuthi umkhakha unamathuba amaningi okukhula. Okwesibili, ubuchwepheshe busiza kakhulu ekwakhiweni kokuqukethwe. Ukuthuthuka kwemishini yokurekhoda, izinhlelo zokuhlela, nezinsiza zokuhlanganyela kudale amathuba amaningi kubakhiqizi, bavumela ukuthi benze okuqukethwe okuphakeme futhi okunethezeka. Lokhu kuholela ekwandeni kwenani lokubukwa, okwenza kube lula kubakhiqizi ukuheha ababukeli. Okokugcina, ukuxhumana nababukeli kubalulekile. Abakhiqizi bokuqala bokuqukethwe bathola impendulo ngokuqondile kubabukeli babo, okwenza kube lula ukuba bazi ukuthi yini ethokozisa izilaleli zabo. Lokhu kudala umphakathi ophilayo, lapho abakhiqizi beqhubeka nokwenza okuqukethwe okuhambisana nezidingo zababukeli. Ngokubheka lezi zici ezintathu - ukuhlukaniswa kwabantu abakhiqiza, intuthuko yobuchwepheshe, kanye nokuxhumana nababukeli - sithola isithombe esicacile sokuthi umkhakha wokukhiqiza okuqukethwe ku-YouTube uyakhula futhi uhlale ushintsha, unikeza amathuba amaningi kubakhiqizi nababukeli.

"Leli thuba lihlanganisa izinhlaka ezihlukene futhi eziwukhiye wokuthuthuka kosomabhizinisi abasafufusa, lapho bekwazi ukuthi bathole amathuba, amasu namathuluzi okubasiza ukufukula amabhizinisi abo, okusiza ukufukula umnotho wethu,” kusho uNtuli.Abafisa ukwethamela lo mbuthwano wokubhunga ngezamabhizinisi, ohlelwa wuMasipala weTheku - banxuswa ukuthi bathumele i-email ku: [email protected]

Sithe asivele sizoduduza iSilo ngokulahlekelwa kwaso. UShenge ubambe elikhulu iqhaza ezindabeni zobukhosi endlunkulu. Okunye wukuthi siyazi ukuthi iSilo sibaluleleke kakhulu emphakathini,’’ kusho uHlengwa.ISILO uMisuzulu kaZwelithini sihlala semukela amahele osopolitiki bezokotha bese bedlana indlebe naso ngezindaba ezehlukene Isithombe: NQOBILE MBONAMBI/AFRICAN NEWS AGENCY (ANA)UHlengwa waveza nokuthi bakubona kubalulekile ukuthi bayobona iSilo ngoba nabo banengxenye yabantu beSilo ababasebenzelayo lapho abaphethe khona. UHlengwa wathi kufanele bazi ukuthi iSilo sinamuphi umbono ngezwe.UHlengwa waluthinta udaba lomhlaba weSilo, wathi njengoba kubhekwe okhethweni udaba lomhlaba luzobe luseqhulwini, waveza nokuthi kukaningi kuhlaselwa Ingonyama Trust ephethe umhlaba weSilo.Iqembu lezepolitiki elinye elisanda kufika liyokotha iSilo kwaba yi-EFF iholwa wuMnuz Julius Malema uMengameli wayo. UMalema nezakhe nabo abafikanga beshwiba izandla kodwa bafika bakhuleka ngezinkomo ezinhlanu bezithwele ngeloli.UMalema naye waveza ukubaluleka kweSilo nodaba lomhlaba oluyindaba egudwini. "ISilo namakhosi bayingxenye ebalulekile emphakathini, yingakho sithe asivele. Sizobonakala kakhulu KwaZulu-Natal nomkhankaso wethu wokhetho uzoba khona la. Besizozethula ukuze iSilo namakhosi bangasexwayi,’’ kusho uMalema.I-DA nayo ayifuni ukusala ngaphandle ngokuyokhuleka kuBayede ngoba nayo ilandelane eduze ne-EFF ngosuku olulandelayo yatheleka.

Kuthiwa bahlasela ummangalelwa nomfowabo, ababebasola ngokuthi sebewuqedile umphakathi, bewubamba inkunzi.Kuthiwa ummangalelwa, umfowabo ongasekho uMnuz Lungelo Dlamini nomngani wabo uMnuz Secunda Msomi bataxwa "wumphakathi owawusukhathele" ngoMeyi 16, 2025. Kuthiwa kulesi sigameko, uLungelo walimala kabi washona ngenxa yezingozi ayezithole ngalolo suku. Kuthiwa ngosuku olufanayo, uSanele, owayediniwe, wacela usizo kwabanye, ukuba bamlekelele aziphindiselele ngokubulawa komfowabo. Kuthiwa babe sebeya emijondolo kwa-U, lapho amalungu omphakathi ayebhiyozela khona "ukuphumelela ukufundisa lezi zelamani kanjalo nomngani wazo isifundo".Kuthiwa ummangalelwa, nayehamba nabo, bafika kule ndawo, bavulela ngenhlamvu, kwafa abayisishiyagalombili. Enkantolo kuvele ukuthi bafa ngenxa yokudutshuwa ezindaweni ezehlukene emzimbeni, okuthiwa abanye babedubuleke emakhanda, izifubeni kanjalo nakwesingenhla. Ummangalelwa uveze ukuthi uhlela ukubiza abakhe ofakazi abazomvikela uma sekuqulwa icala.

Umthelela wezobuciko bedijithali emisebenzini yesimanje I. Isingeniso Emhlabeni wekhulu lama-21, ubuciko bedijithali buvele njengezinto ezibalulekile emikhakheni ehlukene, okuhlanganisa imisebenzi, ubuchwepheshe, nezokuxhumana. Lokhu kukhombisa indlela entsha yokubuka izinto, edlulisela izimvo ezinzulu, kanye nezinhlelo ezijulile, okuholela ekuguqulweni kwenkulumo yomphakathi. II. Ubuciko bedijithali nezindawo zokusebenza Ubuciko bedijithali buvumela abantu ukuthi bakhe, babelane, futhi benze imibono yabo ibe yinto esebenzayo. Lokhu kuholela ekutheni izinkampani zifunde ukusungula izinhlelo ezihambisana nomphakathi, zibandakanye abasebenzisi ngesikhathi sokudala. Umsebenzi wobuciko bedijithali uvumela ukuthi kube nesimo esithokozisayo, esihlekisayo, nesiyingqayizivele esithinta abathengi ngendlela ehlukile. III. Umthelela kokuqamba nokwakha Ubuciko bedijithali bukhuthaza ukuqamba okusha kumasevisi nezimikhiqizo. Izinkampani ezisebenzisa ubuchwepheshe bedijithali zihlala zikhululekile ukwenza izinguquko ezidingekayo ukuze zenze imikhiqizo ethokozisayo. Lokhu kuchaza ukuthi abantu bethu bangakhulisa imikhuba yokwazisa nezimpendulo ezibonakalayo, okuholela ekutheni kube lula ukuhamba phambili ngokushintsha izidingo zomphakathi. IV. Isiphetho Ngokuphetha, umthelela wezobuciko bedijithali emisebenzini yesimanje ungowokuqala, ochaza indlela esikhuluma ngayo nezinsizakalo. Ukusetshenziswa kobuciko bedijithali kudinga ukuba kubhekwe, izinkampani kufanele zifunde ukuhlanganisa ubuciko bedijithali ukuze zisebenzise izinzuzo ezingachazeki nezimo zamakhasimende. Lokhu kuqinisekisa ukuhamba phambili emhlabeni obumbene nezidingo eziguquguqukayo zomphakathi.

Hheyi, unjani? Ngicabanga ukuthi sithole ithuba elihle lokukhuluma ngalezi zinguquko ezithinta indlela esilalela ngayo umsakazo. Ngabe ubona kanjani? Ngiyazi, uma sikhuluma ngomsakazo, sikhumbula izinsuku lapho sithola khona iziteshi ezithile kuphela, futhi sasingakwazi ukulalela kuphela uma sikhona eduze kwedivayisi yethu. Manje, njengoba izinkundla zokusakaza zikhula, konke sekushintshile. Uhlelo lokulalela umsakazo lukhululekile kakhulu. Ungalalela noma yini, noma kuphi, nganoma yisiphi isikhathi. Lokhu kuguqule indlela esithokozisa ngayo umsakazo. Ngabe ubona ukuthi izinkundla ezifana neSpotify, Apple Music, nezinye zenza kube lula ukufinyelela kumasiko ahlukahlukene? Lokhu kudala ithuba lokuthi abantu baziqhenye ngezinkanyezi zabo zomculo, futhi baphinde bahlale bejabulile. Futhi, akukhona nje kuphela umculo. Izinkundla zokusakaza zenza kube lula ukufinyelela kumaphodikhasti, izinhlelo zokuxoxa, nezindaba. Lokhu kusho ukuthi ungathola ulwazi oluningi, futhi ungakhetha lokho okuthandayo. Ngabe ubona ukuthi lokhu kuguqula kanjani indlela esithola ngayo ulwazi? Ngiyazi, abanye bethu basathanda ukulalela umsakazo ngendlela yakudala, kodwa ngempela, izinkundla zikusiza ukuthi ube nezinye izinketho. Ngakho, ngabe sikhuluma ngempela ngempilo entsha yokulalela umsakazo? Ngiyavuma, izinguquko zikhona, futhi zenza kube mnandi kakhulu. Ngabe unayo imicabango ethile ngalokhu? Ngithanda ukuzwa ukuthi ubona kanjani lezi zinguquko.

KONKE sekumi ngomumo ngomcimbi waminyaka yonke wokuhlonipha nokuklomelisa osomabhizinisi bemikhakha ehlukene, nozohambisana nombukiso wokukhangisa ngamabhizinisi abo, amaBambelela Business Awards.Lo mcimbi ohlelwa yiHollywood Foundaton, okhuza ibuya ihlandla lesithathu nonyaka, uzoqala ngombukiso wamabhizinisi ngo-Ephreli 28 ngo-8 ekuseni, bese kuba wumcimbi wokuklomelisa osomabhizinisi ngo-Ephreli 29 ngo-6 kusihlwa - kokubili okuzoba seHollywoodbets Greyville Convention Centre, eThekwini.Kulo mncintiswano, osekwa nawuhulumeni waKwaZulu-Natal, kuzoklonyeliswa osomabhizinisi basesifundazweni abaqhamuka ezindaweni ezihlukene okubalwa kuzona iTheku, uMgungundlovu, Ulundi, Greytown, Richards Bay, Mpangeni nasePort Shepstone.Okhulumela iHollywood Foundation, uNksz Vuyisile Ngobese, uthe nonyaka lo mcimbi bawenze belandela indikimba ethi "Rooted in KZN, Advancing Township and Rural SMMEs for Inclusive and Sustainable Economic Growth", okusho ukuthi babheke ukufukula osomabhizinisi basemalokishini nabasezindaweni zasemakhaya ukuze kusimame umnotho. "Emva kohlelo lokuhlunga, sigcine siqoke amabhizinisi awu-128 eKZN yonkana ukuthi abambe iqhaza ohlelweni lwanonyaka.

BASADIDEKILE ngokubulawa komfundi oyedwa nokugwazwa kwababili baseMenzi okwenzeke ngoLwesine ntambama eMlaza.Kuvela ukuthi kusuke uthuli lwezichwe phakathi kwabafundi nabathile bangaphandle kwesikole ngesikhathi bexabana ngesizathu esingakaqinisekiswa ngokuphelele.Kuvela ukuthi umnyombo wengxabano ususwe wukuthi kube nelungu lomphakathi elibize abafundi libasola ngokuthi badayisa (amaswidi) ngaphakathi esikoleni.Kuthiwa ilungu lomphakathi libathethisile abafundi labasabisa ngokuthi kufanele bayeke ukudayisa ngaphakathi emagcekeni esikole okanye bakhokhe kulona intela yokudayisa.Kuvela ukuthi leli lungu lomphakathi lidinwe lathelwa ngamanzi labe selibagwaza liphindelela abafundi, kwalimala kabi ababili kwashona oyedwa.Umthombo waleli phephandaba izolo uveze ukuthi kukhulu ukudideka ngalesi sehlakalo njengoba kungaqondakali ukuthi kahle hle kwenzekeni. ''Eqinisweni lesi sigameko senzeke ngaphandle kwamagceke esikole. Sithole ukuthi kuqhamuke umuntu wangaphandle wabalwisa abafundi wagcina ngokuthi abalimaze,'' kusho umthombo.Umthombo uveze ukuthi ababili abafundi baphuthunyiswe esibhedlela.kodwa oyedwa usephumile omunye akakaphumi.Uveze ukuthi kuvulwe icala ngalolu daba wathi sebethembe uphenyo lwamaphoyisa ukuze bathole ukuthi kwenzekeni ngampela.Izolo uPhiko lwe-ANCYL luhambele eMenzi ngemuva kokuba luzwe ngalesi siga sangoLwesine. OnguNobhala walolu phiko, uNksz Nokulunga Khuzwayo, usigxekile kakhulu lesi sehlakalo. ''Silimele kakhulu ngokudlula komfundi emhlabeni ngale endlela. Sifisa ukuthi umthetho usebenze.. Eqhuba uthe bezwe ukuthi umfundi ubeziphilisa ngakho ukudayisa.

Ukuhlaziywa komkhakha wezokudlala amabhodi nemidlalo yokucabanga Umkhakha wezokudlala amabhodi nemidlalo yokucabanga ubonakala ukhula ngokuqhubekayo emhlabeni jikelele. Le midlalo ibalulekile, hhayi kuphela njengendlela yokuzijabulisa, kodwa futhi njengendlela yokufunda, yokuxhumana, nokuthuthukisa amakhono ahlukahlukene. Amabhodi nemidlalo yokucabanga ziwusizo ekwakheni amakhono okucabanga, njengokuhlaziya, ukuhlela, nokwenza izinqumo. Imidlalo efana ne-Chess, i-Go, kanye ne-Scrabble, ikhulisa ubuchwepheshe bokucabanga ngokuqinile, ibalula indlela yokubona izinto ezihlukahlukene ezihambelana nezimo ezithile. Lokhu kuhlelwa kwengqondo kukhuthaza abadlali ukuba bacabangele izinyathelo zabo, benze izinqumo ezihlakaniphile, futhi baphendule ezimeni ezinzima. Ngaphezu kwalokho, ukudlala amabhodi nemidlalo yokucabanga kudala ithuba lokuxhumana nabanye. Ngokuvamile, le midlalo idlalwa phakathi kwabantu, okwenza kube lula ukwakha ubudlelwano obusha, ukuhlinzeka ngenkulumo, nokuthuthukisa amakhono okuxhumana. Lokhu kubalulekile ikakhulukazi ezikhathini zanamuhla lapho abantu behlukaniswa kakhulu ngenxa yokusebenza kwezimoto noma ubuchwepheshe. Ekugcineni, umkhakha wezokudlala amabhodi nemidlalo yokucabanga ungumkhakha onothile, ogcwele amathuba okuthuthukisa izimpilo zabantu. Uhlelo lokudlala oluhlangene nolwazi oluhamba phambili lungasiza ekwakheni umphakathi onempilo, ophilayo, futhi ohlanganyelayo. Ngakho-ke, kubalulekile ukukhuthaza abantu, ikakhulukazi izingane, ukuba badlale le midlalo ukuze bathole izinzuzo eziningi ezitholakala kuyo.

Ukuhlaziywa komkhakha wezokudlala amabhodi nemidlalo yokucabanga Umkhakha wezokudlala amabhodi nemidlalo yokucabanga ubonakala uthuthuka ngokushesha, uheha abantu abaningi abavela ezizindeni ezahlukene. Lezi zindlela zokudlala zikhuthaza ubuhlakani, ukucabanga okujulile, nokuxhumana phakathi kwabantu, okwenza kube yindlela ethokozisayo yokuchitha isikhathi. Amabhodi afana ne-"Catan" ne-"Ticket to Ride" akhombisa indlela yokudlala ethokozisayo, lapho abadlali bephoqwa ukuba bacabangele izinqumo zabo ukuze baphumelele. Lokhu kudala umoya wokuncintisana, kodwa futhi kuvumela abadlali ukuba babe nezinhloso ezihlukene, okwenza umdlalo ube nezinhlobonhlobo. Ngakolunye uhlangothi, imidlalo yokucabanga efana ne-"Dungeons & Dragons" ibonisa ubuciko bokwakha izindaba, lapho abadlali benza izinqumo ezithinta umhlaba abawudlalayo. Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, umkhakha ubonakala uthola ukuthandwa okukhulu, ikakhulukazi phakathi kwabantu abasha. Lokhu kungenxa yokuthi imidlalo eminingi ibonisa izici ezithokozisayo, ezifana nezithombe ezinhle, izindaba ezijulile, kanye nezindlela zokudlala ezihlukahlukene. Abadlalayo bangathola imidlalo efanele izidingo zabo, kungakhathaliseki ukuthi baphila kanjani. Kodwa-ke, umkhakha unamathuba amaningi okukhula. Ukukhula kwezobuchwepheshe kudala ithuba lokwakha imidlalo ye-digital, okwenza kube lula ukufinyelela ezindaweni eziningi. Lokhu kudinga ukuthi abadlali bahlale bejabulile futhi bephokophele ekuthuthukiseni izindlela zokudlala.
