Ngokuphetha, umkhakha wezokudlala amabhodi nemidlalo yokucabanga ubonakala unempilo, unamathuba amaningi okukhula, futhi uhlala uthokozisa abantu abaningi. Ukuxhumana, ubuhlakani, nokudlala okujabulisayo kwenza kube yindawo efanelekile yokuchitha isikhathi.

ISOSHA elisolwa ngokudubula libulale umkalo, litshele iNkantolo yesiFunda sasePinetown, izolo ukuthi wazidubula yena, wafa. Lokhu kuza njengoba uMnuz Lwanda Mxolisi Zungu, ethula ubufakazi phambi kwenkantolo ngecala lokufa komkakhe, uNkk Tania Zungu.UNkk Zungu wadutshulwa wafa ekhaya labo elisePinetown, ngoJanuwari 3, 2024. UZungu utshele inkantolo ukuthi ngokusuku lwesigameko, umufi wazidubula ephindelela kwaze kwaba kasishiyagalombili. UZungu ubehlonywa imibuzo umshushisi woMbuso, uMnuz Rowan Souls. Ethula ubufakazi bakhe, uZungu uthe wezwa umkakhe ekhokha isibhamu sakhe, ngesikhathi ematasa ecinga amateki okojima. Uthe ngesikhathi esifanayo, umkakhe washo ngengila, ememeza unina, naye owayekhona endlini, ethi uZungu uyamhlasela. Ngokusho kukaZungu, wagxumela embhedeni ukuzivikela, eqinisekisa ukuthi umbhobho wesibhamu wawungabhekile ngakuye. Uthe umbango wesibhamu wasuka khona embhedeni, kwathi kuso leso sixakaxaka, isibhamu saqhuma. Ugcizelele eyokuthi akazange yena asicindezele lapho esidubula khona isibhamu kodwa wehluleka ukusho ukuthi ubani pho owadubula kasishiyagalombili. Izinhlamvu eziyisikhombisa zangena zonke entanyeni kamufi, kwathi eyesishiyagalombili, yangena esifubeni. "Uyavumelana nami ukuthi umkakho wayengeke azidubule?” kubuza uSouls.UZungu uphendule ngelithi isibhamu sadubula ngesikhathi sisezandleni zikamufi. "Isibhamu saqhuma ngesikhathi sisezandleni zakhe. Ngiyadideka.

Izinguquko endleleni abantu abasebenzisa amabhange edijithali ziye zaba mkhulu emhlabeni wanamuhla. Ukuthuthuka kwezobuchwepheshe, ikakhulukazi ngenxa yokwanda kwe-inthanethi, kube nomthelela omkhulu ekutheni amabhange edijithali abe yingxenye ebalulekile yokuphila kwabantu. Abantu baye baqonda ukuthi bangawasebenzisa kanjani amabhange edijithali ngokusebenzisa izinkundla zokuxhumana nezinhlelo zokusebenza zokubhanga. Lokhu kuphumelele ekwenzeni amabhange edijithali athandwa, njengoba abantu befuna ukufinyelela kalula ezinsizeni zabo. U-Nikki Ndaba, umsebenzisi, uveza ukuthi kubalulekile ukuba akwazi ukufinyelela imali yakhe nganoma yisiphi isikhathi, noma ngabe usesikhathini esikude. "Ngisebenzisa i-app yebhange lami, futhi ngiyakwazi ukwenza zonke izinto, kusukela ekudluliseni imali kuze kube ekuphathweni kwezinsiza," kusho uNdaba. Ngokwezibalo, ababhali bezezimali baveza ukuthi ukusetshenziswa kwamabhange edijithali kuholele ekwakhiweni kwezindlela zokukhokha eziphephile nezisheshayo. Lokhu kukhuthaze abantu abaningi ukuba bacabangele ukusebenzisa amakhadi okudayisa, okuyindlela entsha yokukhokha ekhuthaza ukuhamba kwemali ngokuhambisana nezinhlinzeko zokuphepha. Ngaphezu kwalokho, amabhange amaningi athuthukise izinsizakalo zawo ukuze ahlinzeke ngemisebenzi eyengeziwe efana nokuhweba ngezimali, ukutshalwa kwezimali, kanye nezinsizakalo zezezimali ukuze kuhlangatshezwane nezidingo zabantu. Lokhu kuholele ekukhuleni kweziqhamo, njengoba abantu benza ezinye izinqumo ezithinta ukuphila kwabo. Nokho, ubuchwepheshe bulethe nezinkinga, okuyinto imakethe yezezimali ezama ukuyilungisa. Nokho, kubonakala ukuthi abantu sebekuthokozela kakhulu ukusetshenziswa kwamabhange edijithali, okwenza kube umkhuba ophumelelayo okhula njalo.

Ukusetshenziswa kwama-drone kwezolimo zanamuhla Ama-drone asetshenziswa kakhulu kwezolimo ukuze kutholakale izinzuzo eziningi ekulimaneni nasekubhekeni izitshalo. Uma uthanda ukusebenzisa ama-drone, landela lezi zinyathelo: 1. Ukukhetha uhlobo lwe-drone: Khetha i-drone efanele izidingo zakho. Kunezinhlobo ezahlukene zama-drone, okufanele ube sobala mayelana nokuthi uyafuna ukuyisebenzisa ukukala, ukuphonsa imithi, noma ukuskena izindawo. 2. Ukufunda imithetho yendawo: Ngaphambi kokusebenzisa i-drone, kubalulekile ukufunda imithetho esebenzayo endaweni yakho. Lokhu kufaka phakathi izimvume ezidingekayo nokuhlonza izindawo ezithile lapho ukufaka i-drone kungekho ngaphansi kokuvunyelwa. 3. Ukuphatha amathuluzi: Qiniseka ukuthi unayo yonke imishini efanele, njengemishini yokubona (sensors) noma amakhompyutha angakwenza ube nolwazi olunembile lwezimo zezindawo. 4. Ukwenza ucwaningo: Sebenzisa i-drone ukukala futhi uhlole ukukhula kwezitshalo. Ama-drone angakwazi ukuhlinzeka ngemininingwane ethile ngempilo yezitshalo, kubandakanya ukukhula, ukwehla kwezinga lamanzi, noma izifo ezithile. 5. Ukuphatha imisebenzi yokudla: Enza imithi enembile, uma kudingeka, ukuze uqinisekise ukuthi izitshalo zakho zithola ukunakekelwa okufanele. I-drone ingezwa imithi ngokujulile kumhlabathi, iyophinde iqiniseke ukuthi kuyahamba kahle. 6. Ukuhlaziya idatha: Ngemuva kokuhlola izindawo, sebenzisa isoftware ezithile ukuze uhlole futhi udale izixazululo ezithile okufanele zisetshenziswe kumapulani akho okulima. 7. Ukuphinda uhlole: Njalo qinisa imiphumela yakho futhi uhlole izinga lemisebenzi yakho. Ukusebenzisa ama-drone kwezolimo akupheli lapho kuphuliwe; kufanele uqhubeke uhlole intuthuko. Ngendlela le, ama-drone angasiza kakhulu ekulimaleni, ukwandisa ukukhiqiza, futhi yenze izinqumo ezinembile. Njengoba izinkanyezi zikhula emkhakheni wezolimo, ama-drone azoba yinsiza ebalulekile kumalimi.

''Ngesikhathi ngizwa ngalokhu ngibone kungcono ukuba ngingayizibi le nto kodwa ngisukume ngifake isandla. Ngiwumuntu okholelwayo kakhulu ekutheni kumele bathandwe futhi banakekelwe ngayo yonke indlela ikakhulu labo abaphila nokukhubazeka,''echaza.Uthe uyafisa ukuthi bathole ukusizakala nabanye abantu abaphila nokukhubazeka abasezingxenyeni ezehlukene zeKwaZulu-Natal kanjalo naseNingizimu Afrika jikelele. ''Lena yinselelo kunoma ngubani ukuthi lapho ekhona abhukule kube khona akwenzayo ukulekelela abantu abaphila nokukhubazeka. Akukhathaleki ukuthi noma ngabe kuyinto encane kangakanani, inqobo nje uma kukhona abalekelelwa ngakho," echaza.Uthembise ukuthi basazoqhubeka nokufaka isandla uma nje kukhona abantu abadinga ukulekelelwa ikakhulukazi labo abaphila nokukhuzeka.UNksz Nzimande ubonge wanconcoza kubaholi ngokubakhumbula. Uthe ubengalindele ukuthi kukhona abantu abangaqhamuka benze okuthile ukuze kuqedelwe ukwakhiwa kwendlu yakhe nomfowabo. ''Ngiyabonga kakhulu. Ngiswele wona amazwi okubonga. Inkulu kabi le nto eyenzekile kuleli khaya. Bengicabanga ngivele ngiphelelwe amagama ngingazi ukuthi yini esingayenza ukuze lendlu esihlala kuyone iqedelwe," echaza.Uthe bekungathi uyaphupha ngenkathi ebona abantu befika bephethe amawindi nezicabha nakho konke okudingekayo ukuze kuqedelwe indlu.Nomfowabo uhambe emazwini kadadewabo wathi bazizwa bejabule kakhulu ukuthola usizo olumqoka kangaka. ''Siyabonga kakhulu ngalokhu okuhle kangaka. Kuyasijabulisa thina njengabantu abaphila nokukhubazeka ukubona ukuthi bakhona abantu abasithandayo futhi abazimisele ngokusilekelela ngezindlela ezahlukene," echaza.
